10TH_ANNIV_CHAR_WELCOME_LIGHTSPEED_DESC|Celebrate our [b]10th Anniversary[/b] with an exclusive gift bundle! Unlock legendary heroes from the origins of Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. Instantly upgrade all 65 original Holotable Characters to 5 Stars and Level 10!\n\nClaim limit: 1
10TH_ANNIV_CHAR_WELCOME_LIGHTSPEED_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 5 Stars\n- Level 10

BAD_BATCH_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 7

BATTLE_OF_HOTH_LIGHTSPEED_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[c][AFFFFFFF]CHARACTERS[-][/c]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 7

CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_LEAGUE_DESCRIPTION_V2|[ACFEFF]There are[-] [FFED8D]five leagues[-][ACFEFF] in Grand Arena Championships, and [FFED8D]each league contains five divisions[-][ACFEFF]. At the end of each Grand Arena round, players can move to a higher or lower division depending on their performance within the round.\n\nAt the end of each Grand Arena season, players who finish in Division 1 of their league are promoted to the next league up, and players who finish in Division 5 are relegated to the next league down.[-]

CHAMPIONSHIP_INFO_STRUCTURE_DESCRIPTION_V2|[ACFEFF]A Grand Arena season consists of[-] [FFED8D]three 1-week-long events[-][ACFEFF]. A match-made group of[-] [FFED8D]8 players[-][ACFEFF] competes in each weekly event.\n\nEach event has a 24-hour Join phase, and players may only join the event during this phase. Afterwards, there are 3 rounds, each consisting of two 24-hour phases: the Defense phase and the Attack phase.\n\nPlayers are matched against new opponents in each round. Players earn round rewards at the end of each round, event rewards at the end of each event, and season rewards at the end of the season.[-]

COLISEUM_INFO_FEATURE_INFO_BODY|The [c][ffffff]Coliseum[-][/c] is a daily Event where you use your Era Units to defeat a [c][ffffff]Coliseum Boss[-][/c] encounter! Only [c][ffffff]Era Units[-][/c] can be used in the Coliseum. There are 4 different Coliseum Bosses each Era, and which one you face rotates each day.\n\nEach boss has several [c][ffffff]difficulty tiers[-][/c]. All players start at Tier 1 difficulty for each boss. Fully depleting a Coliseum Boss' health bar wins the difficulty tier and unlocks the next one. Beware that bosses become more deadly and durable as their health is depleted! Dealing damage to the boss earns points, and reaching certain score thresholds for the first time in each tier will also grant one-time rewards!\n\nYour score on the [c][ffffff]Coliseum Leaderboard[-][/c] is determined by the tier of the boss you faced and the score you earned. Tier progress and top score is saved per boss across the entire Era, but the leaderboard resets each day. You may attempt the Coliseum up to 5 times each day, and your leaderboard placement is based on your best Coliseum attempt that day. At the end of each day you'll receive Coliseum rewards based on your leaderboard position.\n\nThe highest tier has an [c][ffffff]overtime phase[-][/c]. Players who get to 100% on this tier get extra time to deal as much damage as they can to increase their score on the leaderboard.

CONQUEST_UNIT_TRIALS_MISSION_02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 1 per tier (3x rewards) \n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Relic 3+ Characters \n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Face off against Maul and a team of Mandalorians\n\n[c][24ccf4]Global Modifier (Perilous Escape):[-][/c] At the start of the encounter, all characters have -100 Speed; whenever a character lands a critical hit, gain 20 Speed (max 200); whenever a character attacks out of turn, apply Vulnerable for 1 turn; at the end of round, if a character doesn't have Protection, gain Stealth for 2 turns (once per character); whenever a character loses Stealth, they gain Expose for 1 turn\n\n[c][24ccf4]Enemy Modifier (The Code):[-][/c] Whenever a Mandalorian ally takes damage, all Mandalorian allies gain a stack of [c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented; if there is exactly one non-Mandalorian ally at start of battle, that ally also gains Clan Loyalty if they are not in the Leader slot; allies with Clan Loyalty have a 50% chance to assist when another ally attacks during an enemy's turn (limit once per turn), dealing 95% less damage\n\n[c][FFFF33]Clan Loyalty:[-][/c] +1% Max Protection and counter chance, -1% damage penalty when assisting for 1 turn

CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TB_JABBA_MISSIONS_01_TEXT|Welcome back to the holotables! I am happy to share that new holodata has been discovered related to Jabba the Hutt's exploits during the Hoth and Geonosis Territory Battles.

CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_BATTLES_01_TEXT|You are now eligible for [f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-], a cooperative feature where you and your Guildmates can [f0ff23]EARN NEW REWARDS[-]!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_BATTLES_02_TEXT|Are you ready to check out [f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-]?

CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_BATTLES_03_TEXT_V2|[f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-] currently run over the course of [f0ff23]6 DAYS[-] and will have [f0ff23]MULTIPLE PHASES[-] to complete.

CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_BATTLES_06_TEXT|[f0ff23]DEPLOY UNITS[-] in a Territory to [f0ff23]PARTICIPATE IN MISSIONS[-].\nEach Territory will display your Guild's activity and progress.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_BATTLES_07_TEXT|You must [f0ff23]EARN AT LEAST 1 STAR[-] in order to progress to the next Territory. Your Guild can earn up to [f0ff23]3 STARS PER TERRITORY[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_BATTLES_08_TEXT|[f0ff23]COMPLETE MISSIONS TO EARN STARS[-], which unlock rewards and allow your Guild to progress!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_COMBAT_MISSION_01_TEXT|[f0ff23]COMBAT MISSIONS[-] require players to take a single squad, or fleet, and [f0ff23]DEFEAT WAVES OF ENEMIES[-].
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_COMBAT_MISSION_02_TEXT|[f0ff23]YOU ONLY GET ONE ATTEMPT PER COMBAT MISSION AND CANNOT RETREAT[-], so choose your squads and fleets wisely!
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_COMBAT_MISSION_03_TEXT|Players earn [f0ff23]TERRITORY POINTS FOR EACH WAVE DEFEATED[-]. Each wave grants more Territory Points than the previous one.
CONTEXTUALMSG_FTUE_TERRITORY_COVERT_MISSION_01_TEXT|[f0ff23]SPECIAL MISSIONS[-] are similar to Combat Missions, but will have fewer encounters. These fights will be much more challenging and only one attempt per Territory Battle.

CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_MESSAGE01|We've discovered a new recording concerning Jabba the Hutt's involvement in this Territory Battle! Let's take a listen.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_MESSAGE02|You know, Jabba and I once fought Kenobi, Skywalker, and his apprentice on Geonosis. One could say we were the champions of the Petranaki arena.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_MESSAGE03|Apprentice? You mean Ahsoka?
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_MESSAGE04|...and that was the first of many, many victories over the Jedi. They really could learn a thing or two from me.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_MESSAGE05|That's not how Ahsoka tells it. I don't think she was even at the Battle of Geonosis.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_GEONOSISMISSION_MESSAGE06|Well, what does she know. Come along, that's enough chit chat.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSAGE01|We've discovered a new recording concerning Jabba the Hutt's involvement in this Territory Battle! Let's take a listen.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSAGE02|Why just let me tell you about the time I helped Jabba capture the notorious criminal, Han Solo...
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSAGE03|Oh, this ought to be good.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSAGE04|...and THAT is how we brought Solo to justice. Before Jabba the Hutt's untimely demise, of course.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSAGE05|Uh huh. You know it was Boba Fett who captured Han, right? My friend Han. Who I rescued.
CONTEXTUALMSG_TB_JABBA_HOTHMISSION_MESSAGE06|That's ridiculous. Anyway, it's your turn to deal.

The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. DATACRON_CHARACTER_MOFFGIDEONS3_002_DESC|At the start of battle, Dark Trooper Moff Gideon gains 15% Accuracy and 15% Potency for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever Dark Trooper Moff Gideon gains a stack of insight, he gains 20% Offense (max 100%, stacking) until the end of the encounter and 10% Turn Meter and he ignores taunt.\n\nWhenever Dark trooper Moff Gideon Stuns on an enemy, All Imperial Remnant allies gain 30% Critical Chance and 30% Critical Damage for 2 Turns \n\nWhenever Dark Trooper Moff Gideon uses a Special ability, he gains 1 Insight stack.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_MONMOTHMA_001_DESC|When Mon Mothma uses special ability Field Promotion and no Rebel Commander ally is present, Mon Mothma will gain a Bonus Turn and the cooldown of Field Promotion is reset.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_MOTHERTALZIN_001_DESC|Allies revived by The Great Mother are not defeated after assisting.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_NIGHTSISTERINITIATE_001_DESC|At the start of battle, Nightsister Initiate gains Protection Up (500%) until the end of battle, which can't be dispelled or prevented. Whenever Nightsister Initiate is resisted by an enemy, she has an 80% chance to inflict a Damage Over Time effect for 1 turn on that enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Nightsister Initiate inflicts a debuff on an enemy, she gains 100% Armor Penetration and 50% Physical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle and 45% Turn Meter. Nightsister Initiate is immune to Daze and Stun.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_NIGHTSISTERZOMBIE_001_DESC|Whenever Nightsister Zombie Taunts, she gains 10% Defense (stacking) until the end of encounter, and all Nightsister allies gain Offense Up and Tenacity Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever Nightsister Zombie is defeated, inflict all enemies with Healing Immunity and Buff Immunity for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_NIGHTTROOPER_001_DESC_V5|At the start of battle, Night Trooper gains 75% Potency and 25 Speed until the end of the encounter.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with a stack of Blight they inflict themselves with another stack, which can't be copied or evaded, until the end of the encounter or until they fully recover their Health.\n\nWhenever an enemy that already had Blight is inflicted with another stack of Blight by an ally, inflict Blight on another random enemy that doesn't have it, which can't be copied, evaded, or resisted, until the end of the encounter or until they fully recover their Health.\n\nWhenever Night Trooper uses Shambling Shot, they gain an additional 3 stacks of Blight which can't be copied or evaded, until the end of the encounter.\n\nWhenever an ally or an enemy gains or is inflicted with Blight, Night Trooper recovers 20% Health and gains 25% Offense per stack for 2 turns.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_NINTHSISTER_002_DESC_V3|At the start of encounter, all Inquisitorius allies have +200% Max Health and are immune to Ability Block.\n\nNinth Sister deals 20% bonus True damage based on her Max Health with her Basic ability if the target enemy is inflicted with Purge.\n\nIf any enemy has 6 stacks of Purge when Ninth Sister is defeated for the first time, she consumes all stacks of Purge from a random enemy with 6 stacks of Purge, revives with 100% Max Health and Max Protection, and removes 50% Turn Meter from all enemies.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_PADAWANOBIWAN_001_DESC_V2|At the start of the encounter, Padawan Obi-Wan gains 100% counter chance until the end of the encounter. Whenever he evades an attack, he recovers 20% Health and Protection. Whenever he attacks out of turn, he deals True damage to the target enemy, which can't be evaded. While he has Discipline, he is immune to Daze and Stun.\n\nWhenever Turn Meter is removed from an enemy, Padawan Obi-Wan gains Foresight for 1 turn. At the start of each Galactic Republic ally's turn, if Padawan Obi-Wan has a stack of Heal Over Time, he gains 20% Offense; and if he has a stack of Protection Over Time, he gains 20% Defense penetration for 1 turn, doubled if there is an active Handmaiden Decoy.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_padmeamidala_001_DESC|Whenever a Galactic Republic ally with Courage or Protection Up uses an ability, if there are no enemies with Provoke, a random enemy is inflicted with Provoke for 1 turn. Whenever another Galactic Republic ally recovers Health or Protection, Padmé recovers double that amount.\n\nWhenever an enemy targets a Non-Galactic Legend Galactic Republic ally with Protection Up while attacking out of turn, the damage they receive is reduced to 1 and the attacking enemy is Exposed for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever a Non-Galactic Legend Galactic Republic ally resists a debuff, they gain a stack of Courage, and whenever they are inflicted with a debuff, they gain Protection Up (10%, stacking) and Tenacity Up for 2 turns.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_PAO_001_DESC|At the start of battle, all allies gain 100% Max Health and Max Protection and are immune to Healing Immunity.\n\nWhenever Pao assists, he deals bonus massive damage, which can't be evaded, and all allies recover 10% Health.\n\nWhenever Pao uses Special ability, he Shocks all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.\n\nWhenever Pao uses a Basic ability on his turn, he Stealths and gains Defense Penetration Up for 1 turn and inflicts target enemy with Offense Down for 1 turn, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_PLOKOON_001_DESC|At the start of Battle, Plo gains 100% Defense and Max Health and Protection.\n\nWhenever Plo Koon uses his Basic ability, he deals 25% bonus True damage based on his Max Health, which can't be evaded. Whenever another ally uses an ability while buffed on their turn, Plo assists.\nWhenever Plo uses a Special ability, Stun all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be evaded.\n\nWhenever Plo gains Defense Up, he also gains 5% Max Health (stacking) until the end of encounter. Whenever Defense Up expires, he Taunts and gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn and inflicts Ability Block to all enemies for 2 turns, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_POEDAMERON_001_DESC|At the start of each encounter, Poe inflicts Fear on all enemies, which can't be copied, dispelled, evaded, prevented, or resisted, and Exposes them for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Taunt expires on Poe, all enemies are inflicted with Fear for 1 turn, which can't be copied or dispelled, and all allies gain 20% Turn Meter. Whenever Poe Dameron is critically hit while Taunting, he gains Protection Up (50%) for 1 turn. Whenever a buff expires on another ally, Poe Taunts for 1 turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_POGGLETHELESSER_001_DESC|Geonosian allies have +20% Max Health and Max Protection. Whenever Poggle evades an attack, all Geonosian allies gain 20% Max Health. Whenever another Geonosian ally evades an attack, all Geonosian allies recover 20% Health. Whenever an enemy gains a buff, Poggle gains Evasion Up for 1 turn. Whenever a Geonosian ally is inflicted with a debuff, dispel all debuffs on Poggle then he gains 5% Turn Meter and lowers the cooldown of Warlord's Resolve by 1. 
DATACRON_CHARACTER_POGGLETHELESSER_002_DESC|Each time Poggle the Lesser inflicts Ability Block, he also inflicts Burning for 2 turns on the target enemy, {0} gains 10% Turn Meter, and all allies gain 20% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_PRINCESSKNEESAA_001_DESC|Ewoks have +10% Offense (stacking) for each buff on them, and Kneesaa gains 2% Critical Damage (stacking, max 100%) whenever she attacks out of turn.\n\nThe first time each Ewok is defeated, they are revived with 100% Health and Protection.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_QIRA_001_DESC|Qi'ra has +100% Critical Chance and other Smuggler allies have half that amount. Prepared allies are immune to Turn Meter reduction and apply Healing Immunity for 1 turn when they use a Basic ability. At the start of her turn, Qi'ra gains Prepared. Whenever Qi'ra gains Prepared, all other Smuggler allies gain Prepared and gain 5% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_QIRA_002_DESC_V2|At the start of the encounter, Qi'ra gains Damage Immunity for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented.\nAt the start of her turn, Qi'ra gains Prepared. Whenever Mercenary ally attacks, she assists (once per turn) if she has Health Steal Up. Whenever she loses Prepared, she gains 5 stacks of Soldier of Fortune and 20% Potency (stacking, max 100%) until the end of encounter. The first time she uses a Special ability, when she has 20 stacks of Soldier of Fortune, she inflicts Healing Immunity and Protection Disruption for 3 turns on target enemy, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_R2D2_001_DESC|Whenever R2-D2 uses a Basic ability, R2-D2 gains Protection Up (50%, stacking) for 2 turns and 50% Turn Meter. Whenever R2-D2 damages an enemy using a Special ability, inflict Fear for 1 turn on that enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_RESISTANCETROOPER_001_DESC|Whenever Resistance Trooper uses his Basic ability on his turn, he Exposes the target enemy for 2 turns. Whenever Resistance Trooper attacks an Exposed enemy, all other allies gain 20% Turn Meter, Resistance Trooper has a 50% chance to attack again and Expose a random enemy for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever Resistance Trooper falls below 50% for the first time, he gains Damage Immunity and Health Steal Up for 2 turns and all other allies gain Evasion Up for 2 turns.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_REY_001_DESC|Whenever an ally takes a bonus turn, all allies recover 20% Health and Protection, and {0} gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 160%) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_ROSETICO_001_DESC_V2|Whenever Rose uses Dauntless Bravery, inflict Expose on the target enemy for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Rose uses Shock Prod Strike, when the Stun is dispelled or expires inflict Deathmark for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever Rose uses a Basic ability on an enemy with Expose, dispel all buffs on the enemy and debuffs on herself, recover 100% Protection, and gain 5% Critical Damage (stacking, max 200%).
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SANASTARROS_001_DESC|The first time each turn Rebel allies or Sana deal damage more than once there is a 20% chance to increase all enemies' cooldowns by 1.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SANASTARROS_002_DESC_V2|At the start of encounter, all allies (excluding summoned units) gain 100% Max Health, 50% Max Protection and 25 Speed for the rest of encounter, and Defense Up for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled.\nWhenever Sana Starros gains Turn Meter, all allies gain 25% Offense (stacking) for 3 turns.\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with Vulnerable, they are also Target Locked for 1 turn if they didn't already have it.\n\nWhenever a Scoundrel ally uses a Special ability, the target enemy loses 40% Turn Meter, which can't be resisted.\nWhenever a Rebel or Scoundrel ally attacks an enemy with Target Lock, they gain Retribution for 2 turns.\nThe first time each ally is defeated, Captain Han Solo gains a bonus turn, his cooldown resets, and all allies recover 50% Health and Protection. 
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SCOUTTROOPER_V3_001_DESC|Whenever Scout Trooper inflicts a debuff, Scout Trooper's Imperial Precision ability gains 6% bonus damage (stacking, max 300%) until the end of battle. Imperial Precision grants Imperial Trooper allies Potency Up for 1 turn and Imperial Remnant allies Offense Up for 1 turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SECONDSISTER_001_DESC|Second Sister gains all 3 bonuses from Everyone is Expendable whenever an enemy or Empire ally is defeated.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SECONDSISTER_002_DESC|Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Purge, Second Sister gains 5% Offense and 5% Health Steal (stacking, max 120%), and 10 Speed (stacking, max 200) for the rest of the encounter.\n\nWhenever Second Sister defeats an enemy with Purge, she recovers 100% Health and Protection, and Ninth Sister gains Retaliate for 2 turns. 
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SEVENTHSISTER_001_DESC|Seventh Sister is immune to Ability Block, Fear, and Stun. DATACRON_CHARACTER_SHORETROOPER_001_DESC|At the start of the battle, if all allies are Empire or Imperial Trooper, all allies gain 50% Health Steal, Max Health, and Max Protection. DATACRON_CHARACTER_SITHPALPATINE_001_DESC|At the start of battle, Sith Eternal Emperor gains 20% Ultimate Charge for each other Sith ally. If all allies were Sith at the start of battle, when Sith Eternal Emperor uses I Am All The Sith he takes a bonus turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SITHTROOPER_001_DESC|While Sith Empire Trooper has Defense Up, he also has 30% Defense Penetration and 100% Offense. When Defense Up expires on Sith Empire Trooper, he gains 10% Tenacity (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_STAP_001_DESC|Whenever another Separatist ally uses an ability against an enemy with Target Lock, STAP assists (once per turn). Whenever STAP loses a stack of Overcharge, STAP gains 10% Turn Meter. 
DATACRON_CHARACTER_STARCK_001_DESC|At the start of battle, if Darth Vader is in the Leader slot, he gains the Imperial Trooper tag for the rest of the battle and Colonel Starck gains 100% Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection until the end of battle.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_STORMTROOPERHAN_001_DESC|Whenever Stormtrooper Han gains Taunt all allies gain Protection Up (50%) for 3 turns. DATACRON_CHARACTER_STORMTROOPERLUKE_001_DESC|At the start of each encounter, Princess Leia gains Offense Up for 2 turns, and Stormtrooper Han gains Defense Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever an enemy is Distracted, Princess Leia resets her cooldown and gains a bonus turn (once per turn). DATACRON_CHARACTER_STRANGER_001_DESC|Whenever The Stranger is healed by an ally or attacks out of turn, he gains 5 Speed (stacking, max 100).\n\nWhenever The Stranger uses his Basic ability and damages a Stunned or Shocked enemy, reduce the cooldown of Was That Its Name? by 1.\n\nThe Stranger is immune to Daze.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SUNFAC_001_DESC|Sun Fac has +100% counter chance and is immune to Daze and Stun.\n\nWhenever Sun Fac attacks out of turn, he dispels all debuffs on himself, Sun Fac deals bonus True damage equal to 15% of their Max Health to the enemy.\n\nFor each debuff dispelled this way, Geonosian allies gain 5% Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection until the end of battle.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SUPREMELEADERKYLOREN_001_DESC|If Supreme Leader Kylo Ren is in the Leader slot, then whenever a First Order ally gains Advantage, Supreme Leader Kylo Ren gains 3% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_SUPREMELEADERKYLOREN_002_DESC|Whenever Supreme Leader Kylo Ren has 100 or more stacks of Siphon, he ignores Stealth and Taunt during his turn. For every 20 stacks of Siphon he has, First Order allies gain 10% Defense and 10% Health Steal (stacking, max 200%) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TARFULL_001_DESC|At the start of battle, if Tarfful is in the leader slot, Wookiee allies gain 25% Offense until the end of battle. Whenever a Wookiee ally is defeated, all Wookiee allies' cooldowns are refreshed and they recover 100% Health and Protection. DATACRON_CHARACTER_TARONMALICOS_001_DESC|At the start of battle, Taron Malicos gains 5 stacks of Edge of Madness and 3 stacks of Resilient Defense which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\nThe first time Taron Malicos gains 20 stacks of Edge of Madness, he gains a bonus turn and his cooldowns are reset.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_THEMANDALORIANBESKARARMOR_001_DESC|After using Disciplined Set Up, until he uses Swift Takedown, The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) can't be defeated and is immune to Fear, Stun, and Turn Meter reduction. Swift Takedown deals 20% more damage for each stack of Whistling Birds The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) had at the start of the turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_THIRDSISTER_001_DESC|Whenever any character is defeated, Third Sister gains Hatred for the rest of the battle or until she is defeated. While Third Sister has Hatred, she also has +100% counter chance and +50% Critical Damage.\n\nAt the start of Third Sister's turn, all Inquisitorius allies with Taunt dispel all debuffs on themselves, recover 20% Max Health and Max Protection, and gain 20 speed for 2 turns.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TIEFIGHTERPILOT_002_DESC|First Order SF TIE Pilot has +100% Potency. While allied Supreme Leader Kylo Ren is active, First Order SF TIE Pilot can't be defeated. While First Order allies have Advantage, they ignore Taunt.\n\nWhenever the ally in the Leader slot or First Order SF TIE Pilot is damaged while they have Advantage, Stun that enemy for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. Whenever an enemy is Stunned, First Order SF TIE Pilot's abilities gain 5% bonus damage (stacking, max 200%), he and the ally in the Leader slot gain 10% Max Health  until the end of the encounter, and if the ally in the Leader slot is Supreme Leader Kylo Ren, he gains 5% Ultimate Charge. Whenever a Stunned enemy is defeated, they can't be revived, the ally in the Leader slot gains a bonus turn, and the allied Leader and First Order SF TIE Pilot recover 100% Health and Protection.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TRENCH_001_DESC_V2|Non-Droid Separatist allies start the encounter with Tactical Supremacy for 2 turns. Whenever Separatist allies gain a stack Protection Over Time they gain 5% Defense (stacking, max 200%) for the rest of the encounter. DATACRON_CHARACTER_TRIPLEZERO_001_DESC|While BT-1 is active, 0-0-0 is immune to Daze and Stun. Whenever 0-0-0 damages a Target Locked enemy, he gains Protection Up (100%, stacking) for 2 turns, 50% Turn Meter, and inflicts Protection Disruption for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TRIPLEZERO_002_DESC|While BT-1 is active, 0-0-0 is immune to Daze and Stun. Whenever 0-0-0 damages a Target Locked enemy, he gains Protection Up (20%, stacking) for 2 turns, 25% Turn Meter, and inflicts Protection Disruption for 1 turn, which can't be resisted.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_001_DESC|Whenever another Tusken ally uses an ability, Tusken Chieftain assists.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with Damage Over Time, inflict an additional Damage Over Time for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENHUNTRESS_001_DESC_V2|Tusken Warrior starts the encounter with 10 stacks of Momentum for 3 turns. DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENRAIDER_001_DESC|For each Tusken ally at the start of the encounter, Tusken Raider gains an additional 25% Offense. Whenever a Tusken ally assists during Tusken Raider's turn, they recover 100% Protection.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_UGNAUGHT_001_DESC|At the Start of the Battle, Uganught has +30% Evasion.\n\nAt the start of each encounter, inflict Breach and Health Down for 2 turns on all enemies, which can't be evaded or resisted. DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADER_001_DESC|Percent Health damage enemies receive is increased by 300%.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADER_002_DESC_V2|At the start of battle, if the only active allies that Darth Vader has consist of any number of the following allies: Admiral Piett, Colonel Starck, General Veers, or Snowtrooper, then the following effects are active:\n\n- Darth Vader can't be defeated while he has active allies\n\n- Whenever an ally is defeated, Darth Vader dispels all debuffs on himself, resets all of his cooldowns, and takes a bonus turn
DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADER_003_DESC_V3|At the start of battle, if there are no Galactic Legend allies, Darth Vader can't be defeated until all the other allies are defeated or Captured. DATACRON_CHARACTER_VADERDUELSEND_001_DESC|Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, Vader (Duel's End) takes a bonus turn (once per turn).\n\nVader (Duel's End) can't be defeated if Emperor Palpatine is active.\n\nAt the start of his turn, if Darth Vader (Duel's End) has less than 25% Health, he gains 10% Defense Penetration, Health Steal, and Offense for each active ally until the end of his turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_VANGARDTEMPLEGUARD_001_DESC|Whenever Temple Guard is inflicted with a debuff, they Taunt for 2 turns. Whenever Temple Guard Taunts, all Jedi Vanguard allies gain a stack of Courage, which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_VEERS_001_DESC|Whenever an enemy is inflicted with a Damage Over Time stack, Ruthless Assault gains 2% bonus damage (stacking) until the end of battle and all allies recover 5% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_VISASMARR_001_DESC|Whenever Visas Marr revives an ally, she resets the cooldowns of all other allies, Deathmark the weakest enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted, and if Maul (Hate-Fueled) is an active ally, he takes a bonus turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_WAMPA_001_DESC_V2|If there are no other active allies at the start of battle, Wampa's omicron ability is active in Territory Wars, Wampa gains 100% Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection, is immune to Daze and Stun, and whenever Wampa attacks out of turn, ignores Protection.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_YODACHEWBACCA_001_DESC|Whenever Yoda & Chewie gain Foresight, they also gain +20% Turn Meter and Protection Up (20%) for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever a non-Tank Wookiee ally is critically hit, Wookiee Tanks Taunt for 1 turn. Whenever a Wookiee Taunts, the weakest ally gains 2 stacks of Bulwark for 1 turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZAALBAR_001_DESC_V2|Zaalbar gains +20% Defense for each Old Republic ally. Whenever another Old Republic ally uses a Special ability, Zaalbar recovers 20% Health and Protection and inflicts a stack of Damage Over Time for 2 turns on all enemies, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZAALBAR_002_DESC|At the start of his turn, Zaalbar gives Taunt for 1 turn to all Tank allies, and Tank allies are immune to Buff Immunity and Stun while he is active. Once per turn when Zaalbar inflicts Armor Shred on an enemy, he inflicts it on all other enemies until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZAMWESELL_001_DESC|Zam always critically hits if able. The first time Zam is defeated while there are any active allies, Zam revives with 100% Health and Stealths for 3 turns.\n\nWhenever Zam inflicts an enemy with Thermal Detonators, she gains 10% Defense and Offense (stacking) for the rest of the encounter, and there is a 50% chance to inflict an additional Thermal Detonator for 2 turns.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZORIIBLISSV2_001_DESC|If Stealth is dispelled on a Resistance or Smuggler ally, they gain a bonus turn. Whenever a Resistance or Smuggler ally gains Damage Immunity or Stealth, they recover 100% Health and gain 20% Defense (stacking, max 200%).
DATACRON_CHARACTER_ZUCKUSS_001_DESC|Whenever Zuckuss uses a Special ability, all Bounty Hunter allies gain Protection Up for 2 turns. Zuckuss calls a random Bounty Hunter ally to assist. All allies gain Foresight for 2 turns.

DATACRON_FACTION_BADBATCH_001_DESC|Bad Batch allies can ignore Taunt to target an enemy that was damaged previously by a Bad Batch ally on their turn.\n\nWhenever an ally is defeated, dispel Stealth from the strongest ally, they gain 200% Defense for 2 turns, and recover 100% Health and Protection.
DATACRON_FACTION_BADBATCH_002_DESC|While a Bad Batch ally is Stealthed, they gain 20% Critical Chance and 20% Critical Damage.\n\nWhenever a Bad Batch ally uses an ability on a Marked enemy, they gain 25% Turn Meter.\n\nWhile a Bad Batch ally is Captive, Bad Batch allies deal an additional instance of damage to the target enemy on their turn.\n\nWhenever a Bad Batch ally defeats an enemy, they reset their cooldown and gain 25% Offense stacking (max 150%) until the end of encounter.\n\nWhenever a Bad Batch ally assists, they gain +20% Offense (stacking, max +80%) and +20% Turn Meter until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_BOUNTYHUNTER_001_DESC|Whenever a Bounty Hunter inflicts a debuff on an enemy, they have a 50% chance to also inflict Damage Over Time.
DATACRON_FACTION_BOUNTYHUNTER_002_DESC|Whenever an enemy is defeated, Bounty Hunter allies gain Bounty Hunter's Resolve
DATACRON_FACTION_BOUNTYHUNTER_003_DESC|Whenever a Bounty Hunter ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, they gain 30% Offense (stacking, max 300%) until the end of battle. Whenever an enemy resists a debuff, Bounty Hunter allies gain Potency Up for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_CLONE_001_DESC|Whenever a Clone Trooper ally uses a Basic ability, Clone Trooper allies gain 5% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_DROID_001_DESC|Whenever a Droid damages an enemy with a Basic ability, inflict Target Lock for 2 turns. If the enemy was already Target Locked, inflict Breach and Buff Immunity for 2 turns. These effects can't be resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_DROID_002_DESC|At the start of each Droid ally's turn, inflict Target Lock for 1 turn, which can't be resisted, to a random enemy that does not have it. Whenever a Droid ally uses a Basic ability against an enemy with Target Lock, they recover 10% Protection and gain 5% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_FACTION_DROID_003_DESC|The first time each Droid ally falls below 40% Health, they gain Damage Immunity for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled.\nWhenever a Droid ally dispels a buff or debuff, all Droid allies gain Critical Damage Up and Offense Up for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled.\nWhenever an enemy is Stunned by Droids, all Droid allies recover 25% Health and gain 10 Speed (stacking, max 100).
DATACRON_FACTION_DROID_004_DESC|Whenever a Droid ally dispels a buff or debuff, all Droid allies gain Critical Damage Up and Offense Up for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled.\n\nWhenever a Droid ally gains Stealth, other weakest non-Stealthed Droid ally gains 100% Defense and Max Protection for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_EMPIRE_001_DESC|Whenever Empire allies inflict a debuff, they reduce their cooldowns by 1 (limit once per turn per enemy and ally).
DATACRON_FACTION_EMPIRE_002_DESC|Whenever an enemy loses Turn Meter, {0} allies gain Protection Up (stacking, 10%) for 2 turns.  Whenever an ally loses Protection Up they gain 10% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_FACTION_EWOK_001_DESC|Whenever an Ewok ally attacks out of turn, each Ewok ally gains 2% Offense (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_001_DESC|Whenever First Order allies are critically hit they gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_002_DESC|Whenever a First Order ally scores a critical hit, the Leader gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 200%) until the end of encounter. If the Leader scores a critical hit, they gain an additional 10% Offense, and all other First Order allies recover 15% Health and Protection.\n\nWhenever the Leader uses an ability, remove 1% Turn Meter from all other First Order allies. Whenever a First Order ally loses Turn Meter, they gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking) for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever a First Order ally attacks a Stunned enemy, they deal 10% Max Health damage to that enemy. This damage can't defeat enemies.\n\nWhenever the Leader is not damaged during the enemy's turn, if there are no allies with Damage Immunity, a random First Order ally gains Damage Immunity for 1 turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_003_DESC|If all allies are First Order at the start of battle, First Order allies gain Damage Immunity for 2 turns. Whenever a First Order ally is critically hit, all First Order allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 50%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever a First Order ally attacks out of turn, all First Order allies gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_GALACTIC_REPUBLIC_002_DESC|Whenever a Galactic Republic ally with Protection Up assists, if there are no enemies with Protection Disruption, inflict it for 1 turn on the target enemy, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.\n\nWhile Galactic Republic allies have Protection Up they have +50% Accuracy, counter chance, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and they ignore Taunt.
DATACRON_FACTION_GALACTICREPUBLIC_001_DESC|Whenever a Galactic Republic ally is critically hit, they recover 12% Health.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_001_DESC_V2|At the start of the encounter and at the end of their turn, {0} allies gain 1 stack of Retaliate (max 3) for 3 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\n[c][ffff33]Retaliate:[-][/c] When damaged by an attack, deal 20% of the damage received per stack to the attacker; this damage can't defeat enemies.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_002_DESC_V2|Whenever {0} allies Stagger or Stun on an enemy, they deal bonus damage equal to 35% of that enemy's Max Health, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_003_DESC|Whenever {0} allies grant a buff to another ally, that ally gains 10% Turn Meter (limit once per turn per ally).
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_004_DESC|Whenever {0} allies use a Special ability during their turn, they Stun target enemy for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_005_DESC|Whenever {0} allies start their turn with at least 2 debuffs that can be dispelled, they have a 65% chance to dispel all debuffs on themselves.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_006_DESC|Whenever {0} allies start their turn with fewer than 2 buffs, all other allies gain 15% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_007_DESC_V2|Whenever {0} allies inflict a debuff on an enemy during their turn, they deal bonus damage equal to 10% of that enemy's Max Health, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_008_DESC|At the end of each turn, {0} allies recover Health and Protection equal to 50% of the amount enemies recovered that turn. This recovery can't trigger this effect on enemies.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_009_DESC|Whenever enemies are damaged at the start of their turn, {0} allies gain 2% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_010_DESC|Whenever {0} allies damage all enemies with an ability, they grant Tenacity Up for 2 turns to all allies.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_011_DESC|At the end of their turn, {0} allies recover 50% Protection if they inflicted at least 5 debuffs that turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_012_DESC_V2|At the start of their first turn, {0} allies gain Offense equal to 400% of their current Defense until the end of battle. Then they lose 50% Defense until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_013_DESC|Whenever {0} allies recover Health, they recover Protection equal to the amount of Health recovered. {0} allies can't recover Protection this way more than once per turn or if their Health was full.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_014_DESC_V2|Whenever a debuff on an enemy expires, {0} allies gain 2% Potency and Tenacity (stacking) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_015_DESC|At the start of battle, {0} allies lose all Max Protection and gain that much Max Health. {0} allies gain Grit until the end of battle, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. [c][ffff33]Grit:[-][/c] Takes reduced damage from percent Health damage effects
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_016_DESC|Whenever {0} allies critically hit an enemy during their turn, that ally gains 10% Offense (stacking) for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_017_DESC|The first time each {0} ally falls below 50% Health, all {0} allies reduce their cooldowns by 1 and gain 10% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_018_DESC_V2|Whenever {0} allies target another ally with an ability during their turn, they both gain 5% Defense, Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_019_DESC_V2|Whenever a debuff on an enemy expires, {0} allies gain 2% Turn Meter, doubled if that debuff was dispelled by an enemy.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_020_DESC|Whenever {0} allies are revived, they gain Protection Over Time (25%) for 2 turns and 25% Turn Meter and reduce their cooldowns by 1.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_021_DESC_V2|At the start of each {0} ally's turn, if they have not taken damage since their last turn, they gain Critical Chance Up and Offense Up for 1 turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_022_DESC|Whenever {0} allies Stun an enemy, they gain Speed Up and Offense Up for 2 turns and inflict Expose for 2 turns at the end of that turn, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_023_DESC|At the start of battle, {0} allies gain Retribution for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_024_DESC|The first time each {0} ally falls below 50% Health they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn and gain Health Steal Up for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_025_DESC_V2|Whenever a {0} ally has full Health and Protection at the start of their turn, they deal +100% more Damage on their turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_026_DESC|At the end of their turn, {0} allies gain Defense Penetration Up and Offense Up for 1 turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_027_DESC|Whenever {0} allies attack out of turn, they have a 25% chance to remove 10% Turn Meter from the target.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_028_DESC|Whenever {0} allies use a Special Ability on their turn, they gain Riposte for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_029_DESC|{0} allies start the battle with Damage Immunity for 2 turns (can't be copied).
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_030_DESC|Whenever {0} allies are Stunned, gain 50% Turn Meter and recover 25% Health and Protection.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_031_DESC_V3|At the start of each turn, if non-Galactic Legend {0} allies have 50% or more Turn Meter, damage they receive is reduced by 75% until the end of the turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_032_DESC|Whenever a debuff on an enemy expires, {0} allies gain 2% Offense, doubled if that debuff was dispelled, until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_033_DESC|Whenever an enemy is defeated by a {0} ally, that enemy can't be revived.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_034_DESC|Whenever a {0} ally defeats an enemy, they take a bonus turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_035_DESC_V3|Whenever a {0} ally deals damage to an enemy and no other enemy is Ability Blocked, inflict Ability Block for 1 turn on the target enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_036_DESC_V2|Whenever a {0} ally deals damage to an enemy and no other enemy is Blinded, inflict Blind for 2 turns on the target enemy, which can't be resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_037_DESC_V3|Whenever a {0} ally deals damage to an enemy and no other enemy is Marked, inflict Marked for 1 turn on the target enemy, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_038_DESC|Whenever a {0} ally falls below 100% Health, they gain a bonus turn. Limit once per character per battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_039_DESC|Whenever {0} allies are revived, they recover 25% Protection, gain 25% Turn Meter, and reduce their cooldowns by 1.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_040_DESC_V2|Whenever a {0} ally is critically hit, they gain 100% Critical Avoidance and Critical Chance for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_041_DESC|{0} allies can ignore Taunt to target a debuffed enemy.
DATACRON_FACTION_GENERIC_042_DESC|Whenever {0} allies are revived, they gain 25% Turn Meter, Protection Over Time (25%) for 2 turns, and reduce their cooldowns by 1. All allies recover 50% Health and Protection, dispel all buffs on all enemies, and inflict Buff Immunity on them for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_GUNGAN_001_DESC|Whenever a Gungan ally is damaged or the allied Shield Generator loses a stack of Plasma Shielding, remove 1 stack of Recharge from the allied Shield Generator.\n\nWhenever the allied Shield Generator uses Plasma Pulse, dispel all debuffs from all Gungan allies and inflict Plasma Residue on all enemies for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. If an enemy is already inflicted with Plasma Residue, remove 100% Turn Meter, Daze, Stagger, and Stun them for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever a Gungan ally deals damage to a debuffed enemy, they also deal 5% Max Health damage to that enemy. This damage can't defeat enemies.
DATACRON_FACTION_HUTTCARTEL_001_DESC|The first time each Hutt Cartel ally falls below 50% Health, they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n\nWhenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator expiring, Hutt Cartel allies recover 5% Health and Protection, gain 5% Turn Meter, and there is a 50% chance that enemy is inflicted with a Thermal Detonator for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_HUTTCARTEL_002_DESC|Whenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator, all Hutt Cartel allies gain 5% Offense (stacking), until the end of encounter.\nWhile an enemy is inflicted with Thermal Detonator, they are immune to Health and Protection recovery.\nWhenever a Hutt Cartel ally uses a Basic ability during their turn, all Hutt Cartel allies gain 10% Turn Meter (once per turn).
DATACRON_FACTION_IMPERIALREMNANT_001_DESC|Whenever an allied Imperial Remnant uses a Special ability, they gain Alert for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with a stack of Blight, all Imperial Remnant allies gain 10% Turn Meter, and 5% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_IMPERIALREMNANT_002_DESC|At the start of battle, all Imperial Remnant allies gain 45% Accuracy, 45% Potency, and 20 Speed until the end of encounter.\n\nWhenever an Imperial Remnant ally uses a Special ability, all Imperial Remnant allies gain Alert for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever an Imperial Remnant ally defeats an enemy, all Imperial Remnant allies gain 40% Offense (max +120%) until the end of encounter.\n\nWhenever an Imperial Remnant ally is inflicted with a debuff, they recover 10% Health and Protection.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with Armor Shred all Imperial Remnant allies gain 30% Critical Chance and Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_IMPERIALTROOPER_001_DESC|Whenever an Imperial Trooper ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, all Imperial Trooper allies gain 4% Critical Damage (stacking, max 80%) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_INQUISITORIUS_001_DESC|The first time each turn Inquisitor allies inflict Purge on an enemy, they recover 5% Protection and inflict 1 stack of Purge (max 6) on target enemy until the end of the encounter, which can't be evaded. At the end of each turn, for each Purge dispelled from an enemy, that enemy has a 50% chance to gain 1 stack of Purge (max 6) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_INQUISITORIUS_002_DESC_V3|Inquisitorius allies gain 100% Potency. At the start of each Inquisitorius ally's turn, dispel all buffs on enemies inflicted with Purge and then inflict Health Down on them for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_INQUISITORIUS_003_DESC_V2|Whenever an Inquisitorius ally inflicts a stack of Purge, they gain 5% Defense, Offense, and Tenacity (stacking) for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever a stack of Purge is consumed or dispelled on an enemy Expose them for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever an Inquisitorius ally uses a Basic ability against an enemy inflicted with a stack of Purge, a random other Inquisitorius ally assists, dealing 5% bonus damage per stack of Purge and then they inflict a stack of Purge (max 6) on target enemy, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_FACTION_JAWA_001_DESC_V2|At the start of battle, Jawa allies gain 100% bonus Protection until the end of the encounter and all enemies are inflicted with Provoked for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.\n\nWhenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator expiring, Jawa allies recover 5% Health and Protection, gain 5% Turn Meter, and there is an 80% chance that enemy is inflicted with a Thermal Detonator for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_JAWA_002_DESC|At the start of battle, Jawa allies gain 100% bonus Protection until the end of the encounter and all enemies are inflicted with Provoked for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted. Whenever a Jawa ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, all Jawa allies gain Foresight for 1 turn. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Thermal Detonators, Jawa allies gain 10% Defense and Offense (stacking, max 300%). At the start of each turn, if a Jawa ally has 50% or less Health, damage they receive is reduced by 75% (excluding percent health damage and massive damage) until the end of the turn.\n\nWhenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator expiring, which can't be evaded, Jawa allies recover 5% Health and Protection, gain 5% Turn Meter, and that enemy is inflicted with an aditional Thermal Detonator for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_JEDI_001_DESC|Whenever a Jedi ally gains Foresight, they deal 20% more damage (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_JEDI_002_DESC|While Jedi allies have 100% Health they have 100% Offense, otherwise they have 100% Defense. At the start of their turn, if they are buffed, they gain Advantage for 1 turn, otherwise they gain Tenacity Up for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_JEDI_VANGUARD_001_DESC|If all allies are Jedi Vanguard at the start of battle, they gain Protection Up (100%) for 1 turn at the end of their turn, and additional bonuses based on their role:\n\n- [c][B5E7F5]Attackers:[-][/c] Ignore Taunt during their turn\n- [c][B5E7F5]Healers and Supports:[-][/c] The first time this character is defeated, they are revived with 100% Health and Protection\n- [c][B5E7F5]Tanks:[-][/c] Immune to Stun\n\nWhenever an enemy dispels a buff from a Jedi Vanguard ally they are inflicted with Provoked for 2 turns. Whenever a Jedi Vanguard ally is attacked out of turn, their cooldowns are reduced by 1.
DATACRON_FACTION_MANDALORIAN_001_DESC_V2|Whenever a Mandalorian ally damages an enemy with an attack, if that enemy was damaged during the last Mandalorian ally turn, all Mandalorian allies gain 2% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_MECHANIC_NAME|Bonus mechanics for {0} characters
DATACRON_FACTION_MERCENARY_001_DESC|At the start of each of their turns, Mercenary allies have 2% Offense equal to the number of stacks of Solider of Fortune they have, until they are defeated.\n\nWhenever an enemy attacks out of turn, they take bonus True Damage, which can't be evaded and can't defeat them.
DATACRON_FACTION_MERCENARY_002_DESC_V2|At the start of the encounter, all Mercenary allies have +100% Defense Penetration.\nWhenever a Mercenary ally attacks out of turn, they attack again (once per turn), dealing 5% more damage for each stack of Soldier of Fortune they have.\nWhenever an enemy attacks a Mercenary ally out of turn, Expose that enemy for 2 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_NIGHTSISTER_001_DESC_V2|Whenever they use a Basic ability during their turn, Nightsister allies inflict Plague for 3 turns on target enemy, which can't be copied, dispelled, or evaded.
DATACRON_FACTION_NIGHTSISTER_002_DESC|Whenever a Nightsister ally is defeated or revived, they inflict 2 stacks of Plague on all enemies for 3 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_NIGHTSISTER_003_DESC|Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Defense Down, reduce their Max Protection by 5% (stacking, max 50%).\n\nWhenever a Nightsister ally gains Foresight or Stealth, all Nightsister allies gain 5% Turn Meter and Critical Damage (stacking) until the end of encounter.\n\nWhenever an enemy attacks out of turn, all Nightsister allies recover 40% Health and Protection, gain Retribution for 1 turn, and 15% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_FACTION_OLDREPUBLIC_001_DESC|Whenever an Old Republic ally defeats an enemy, they refresh the cooldown of all Old Republic allies.
DATACRON_FACTION_PHOENIX_001_DESC|Whenever a Phoenix ally uses a Special ability, Phoenix allies gain 5% counter chance (stacking) and 10% Offense (stacking) until they're defeated.
DATACRON_FACTION_PIRATES_001_DESC|Pirate Attacker allies gain 10% Offense and Potency per buff on them at the start of their turn until the start of their next turn (max 100%) and Pirate Healer, Support, and Tank allies gain 5% Defense and Tenacity per buff on them at the end of their turn until the start of their next turn (max 50%).
DATACRON_FACTION_PIRATES_002_DESC|If all allies are Pirates at the start of encounter, Pirate allies gain 3 stacks of Profit. Whenever Pirate allies have 15 or more combined stacks of Profit:\n\n- Pirate Attacker allies gain Stealth for 1 turn whenever they are critically hit.\n- Whenever a Pirate Tank ally uses an ability, all other Pirate allies are called to assist.\n- Whenever a Pirate Support or Healer ally is inflicted with a debuff, all Pirate allies recover 5% Health and 5% Protection.\n\nWhenever a Pirate ally consumes a stack of Profit, all Pirate allies gain 5% Defense, Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense (stacking, max 150%) for the rest of the encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_REBEL_001_DESC|Whenever a Rebel ally attacks out of turn, they dispel all debuffs on themself.
DATACRON_FACTION_REBELFIGHTER_001_DESC_V2|Whenever {0} allies lose a stack of Heal Over Time, they gain a stack of Heal Over Time (10%) for 2 turns at the end of the turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_RESISTANCE_001_DESC|Whenever an enemy is damaged by Expose, all Resistance allies gain 8% Turn Meter, and they have a 40% chance to reduce their cooldowns by 1.
DATACRON_FACTION_RESISTANCE_002_DESC|Whenever a Resistance ally is critically hit, they gain 100% Critical Avoidance and 100% Critical Chance for 2 turns.
DATACRON_FACTION_RESISTANCE_003_DESC|Resistance allies have +100% Tenacity. Resistance allies can't be defeated until each ally that had 100% Health at the start of battle has fallen below 100% at least once.
DATACRON_FACTION_ROGUEONE_001_DESC|At the start of battle all Rogue One allies gain 100% Max Health and Max Protection, 60% Offense, and 20 Speed, and if Jyn Erso is an ally, she assists whenever another Rogue One ally uses an ability.\n\nIf all allies were Rogue One at the start of battle, whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, Expose them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted, and all Rogue One allies gain Speed Up for 1 turn and recover 30% Health and Protection.
DATACRON_FACTION_SCOUNDREL_001_DESC|The first time each Scoundrel ally uses a Basic ability on their turn, reset their cooldowns and gain 100% Turn Meter. Limit once per character per battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_SEPARATIST_001_DESC|Separatist allies are immune to Daze. Enemies with Extortion have -100% Critical Chance and Potency. Whenever non-Droid Separatist allies use a Special ability on their turn, they gain Riposte for 1 turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_SEPARATIST_002_DESC|At the start of each Separatist ally's turn, inflict Target Lock on a random enemy that doesn't already have it for 1 turn, which can't be resisted. Whenever a Separatist ally gains bonus Turn Meter when they didn't have 100% Turn Meter, gain 3% Critical Damage (stacking) for the rest of the encounter. If the target enemy is Target Locked, whenever Separatist allies use a Special ability they gain 3% Max Health (stacking) for the rest of the encounter. 
DATACRON_FACTION_SITH_001_DESC|Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Fear, Pain, or Shock, Sith allies gain 5% Offense until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_SITH_002_DESC|The first time each Sith ally is reduced below 50% Health, they inflict Doubt on all enemies for 1 turn.
DATACRON_FACTION_SITH_003_DESC|At the start of their turn, Sith allies can ignore Taunt to target a debuffed enemy. Whenever a Sith ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, they also deal 5% Max Health damage to that enemy, which can't be evaded. This damage can't defeat enemies.
DATACRON_FACTION_SMUGGLER_001_DESC|Whenever a Smuggler ally gains Prepared, reduce their cooldowns by 2.
DATACRON_FACTION_SMUGGLER_002_DESC|Whenever a Smuggler ally has less than 100% Turn Meter and gains bonus Turn Meter, they gain 2% Critical Damage (stacking) for the rest of the encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_SMUGGLER_003_DESC|Smuggler allies have +100% Evasion. If they are debuffed, they lose 100% Evasion. Whenever a Smuggler ally critically hits an enemy, they dispel all debuffs on themselves.\nWhenever Smuggler allies gain Prepared they gain Tenacity Up for 2 turns. Whenever a Smuggler ally evades an attack, all Smuggler allies recover 10% Health and Protection, and the enemy that was evaded is inflicted with a stack of Damage Over Time for 3 turns, which can't be evaded or resisted.
DATACRON_FACTION_TUSKEN_001_DESC|Whenever a Tusken ally critically hits an enemy, the enemy gains 1% Turn Meter. Whenever an enemy takes damage from a Damage Over Time effect, Tusken allies recover 10% Protection and gain 5% counter chance (stacking, max 100%). If a Tusken ally is active in the Leader slot, at the start of each turn, all enemies inflicted with a Damage Over Time effect can't recover Health.
DATACRON_FACTION_UFU_001_DESC_V2|Whenever a Light or Dark Side Unaligned Force User ally gains a buff or debuff, all Unaligned Force User allies gain 5% Defense (stacking, max 200%) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FACTION_UNALIGNEDFORCEUSER_001_DESC|Whenever a Dark Side or Light Side Unaligned Force User critically hits an enemy, dispel all debuffs on themself and gain 5% Turn Meter. Whenever a Dark Side or Light Side Unaligned Force User uses a Special ability against an enemy with at least 3 debuffs, reduce that enemy's Max Health by 5%. Whenever a Dark Side or Light Side Unaligned Force User uses a Special ability when they have at least 3 buffs that can be dispelled, gain 5% Max Health.
DATACRON_FACTION_WOOKIEE_001_DESC|Whenever an allied Wookiee is critically hit, Wookiee allies gain Foresight for 1 turn and 10% Defense (stacking, max 200%) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_FTUE_ENEMY_EQUIPPED_01|Oh goodness! It looks like your opponent has a Datacron equipped!
DATACRON_FTUE_ENEMY_EQUIPPED_02|You can long press on an equipped Datacron to get more information about how it will affect the battle.
DATACRON_FTUE_ENEMY_EQUIPPED_02_PC|You can click and hold on an equipped Datacron to get more information about how it will affect the battle.
DATACRON_FTUE_ENEMY_EQUIPPED_03|Take extra care when you fight against that squad!
DATACRON_FTUE_MECHANIC_AFFIX_01|My stars! That's quite the bonus mechanic!
DATACRON_FTUE_MECHANIC_AFFIX_02|Note that bonus mechanics only affect units within a certain Scope: Alignment, Faction, or possibly a single Character.
DATACRON_FTUE_MECHANIC_AFFIX_03|This Scope also restricts what bonus mechanics are available at higher Levels.\n\nSelect this next Level and we can take a look.
DATACRON_FTUE_MECHANIC_AFFIX_04|As you can see, this earlier Scope has limited the subsequent options.
DATACRON_FTUE_MECHANIC_AFFIX_05_V2|Most Datacrons let you re-roll a bonus mechanic if the next one has not yet been unlocked.\n\nI will demonstrate the process when you attempt it.
DATACRON_FTUE_REROLL_01|Select the bonus mechanic you want! The one on the left is always the one you had before. You can keep it if you don't like the other options!
DATACRON_FTUE_REROLL_02|Once a Datacron is fully upgraded, any level can be re-rolled - even stat boosts!
DATACRON_FTUE_STAT_AFFIX_01|Extraordinary!\n\nWhen you attach this Datacron to a squad, this bonus stat applies to all characters in the squad.
DATACRON_FTUE_STAT_AFFIX_02|However, the ENTIRE SQUAD must satisfy the requirements of a Datacron level to gain its benefits.
DATACRON_FTUE_STAT_AFFIX_03|Upgrading Datacrons unlocks a range of bonus stats and bonus mechanics for your squad!\n\nTap here to look at possible outcomes!
DATACRON_FTUE_STAT_AFFIX_03_PC|Upgrading Datacrons unlocks a range of bonus stats and bonus mechanics for your squad!\n\nClick here to look at possible outcomes!
DATACRON_FTUE_STAT_AFFIX_04_V2|Explore this screen to find information on all potential bonus mechanics in this Datacron set!
DATACRON_FTUE_UNLOCK_01|Ah, I see you've collected your first DATACRON. Fascinating things! Let me instruct you in their use.
DATACRON_FTUE_UNLOCK_02_V2|DATACRONS are powerful objects to assign to squads in game modes that permit them. You can see your collection in the Datacrons tab of your inventory.
DATACRON_FTUE_UNLOCK_03_V2|Be aware that Datacron sets have expiration dates, at which time they are automatically dismantled into components.
DATACRON_FTUE_UNLOCK_04_V2|Certain types of Datacron can be dismantled manually as well.
DATACRON_FTUE_UNLOCK_05_V2|Use Datacrons to improve an entire squad with BONUS STATS and BONUS MECHANICS. Let's look at the one you found!
DATACRON_FTUE_UNLOCK_06|Ah, I see it's not activated. Upgrading Datacrons to higher levels requires specific resources. UNLOCK the first level of this one when you're ready!
DATACRON_FULLY_UNLOCK_REROLL|Fully unlock datacron to re-roll

DATACRON_HELP_1_BODY|Datacrons are an effective way of improving the power of an entire squad in the Grand Arena and Territory War game modes.\n\nAll Datacrons have multiple upgrade levels, each including bonus stats that affect your entire squad or powerful bonus mechanics that apply to specific units.
DATACRON_HELP_1_TITLE|General
DATACRON_HELP_2_BODY|Unlocked Datacron levels have additional requirements. Every member of a squad with a Datacron assigned must meet the minimum requirements for each level in order for the squad to gain the benefits of that level. If any member of the squad does not satisfy the minimum requirement of a Datacron level, then that level’s benefit is not applied to any member of the squad.\n\nFor example, a Datacron level requiring Relic 5 units only applies its benefits if all members of the squad are Relic 5 or higher. If any unit is Relic 4 or below, then that level’s benefits are not applied to any member of the squad.\n\nHowever, if a bonus mechanic applies only to a single, specific character in a squad, then only that character must satisfy the requirement of that Datacron level to receive its benefits, provided that the requirements of all previous bonus mechanics in that Datacron have been met.
DATACRON_HELP_2_TITLE|Equip
DATACRON_HELP_3_BODY|Upgrading Datacrons requires a variety of materials; pay attention to what's needed to upgrade yours! When a Datacron is upgraded, it selects a random bonus. Each level of the Datacron specifies if this will be a bonus stat or mechanic. Bonus mechanics are only rolled within the scope of previous bonus mechanics on the Datacron.\n\nFor example, if a Datacron's first bonus mechanic is specific to Light Side characters, its later bonus mechanics are always specific to Light Side factions and characters. As another example, a Datacron with a bonus mechanic specific to the First Order will not roll a later bonus mechanic specific to the Empire or Nightsisters; it remains focused on the First Order faction and characters.
DATACRON_HELP_3_TITLE|Upgrade
DATACRON_HELP_4_BODY_V2|Datacron bonus mechanics can be re-rolled on most Datacrons for a cost in materials. However, Focused Datacrons can't be re-rolled at all.\n\nEach re-roll on a Datacron increases in cost. Only the most recent unlocked bonus mechanic on a Datacron can be re-rolled until the Datacron has been maximally upgraded. Once a higher-level bonus mechanic has been unlocked, previous ones become locked. Bonus stats initially cannot be re-rolled.\n\nOnce a Datacron is fully upgraded, all of its levels can then be re-rolled, including both bonus stats and mechanics. However, a Datacron's bonus mechanics still cannot re-roll outside the locked scope of all bonus mechanics on the Datacron.\n\nFor example, a Datacron with bonus mechanics affecting Light Side, Resistance, and BB-8 cannot have its Light Side ability re-rolled to a Dark Side mechanic. However, it can be re-rolled to a different Light Side mechanic.
DATACRON_HELP_4_TITLE|Re-roll
DATACRON_HELP_5_BODY_V2|Datacrons have a set lifespan. When a Datacron set reaches the end of its lifespan, all owned Datacrons within that set are automatically dismantled.\n\nMost unwanted Datacrons can be dismantled at any time, creating materials that can be used to upgrade other Datacrons. However, Focused Datacrons can't be dismantled until the set expires.
DATACRON_HELP_5_TITLE|Dismantle

DATACRON_ROLE_ATTACKER_001_DESC|Whenever an Attacker critically hits they attack again(limit once per turn) Otherwise, they gain 10% Defense Penetration (stacking).\n\nWhenever an Attacker attacks out of turn they deal bonus True damage which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_ROLE_ATTACKER_002_DESC_V2|Whenever an ally inflicts a debuff on an enemy, all Attacker allies gain Accuracy Up for 1 turn and 5% Offense (stacking, max 120%) until the end of battle. Whenever an Attacker ally attacks out of turn, they deal bonus True damage, which can't be evaded, and gain 5% Defense Penetration (stacking, max 120%) until the end of battle.\n\nWhenever an Attacker ally uses a Special ability, damage they deal to enemies that turn is increased by 5% for each buff on that enemy.\n\nDuring Attacker allies' turns, they ignore Stealth and Taunt if they have no debuff on them.
DATACRON_ROLE_HEALER_001_DESC|Whenever a character is healed by an allied Healer they reduce their cooldowns by 1.\n\nWhenever an ally Healer is critically hit they recover 10% Health and gain 10 Speed (stacking, max 100) for the rest of the encounter.\n\nWhenever an ally is revived on an ally Healer's turn all allies recover 100% Max Health and Max Protection.\n\nThe first time each Healer ally is defeated they are revived and recover 100% Max Health.

When a Duelist is defeated, the remaining Duelist gains [c][ffff33]Victor[-][/c] until the end of battle and Duelist is dispelled. Then, another random non-Leader ally and random non-Leader enemy gain Duelist. If there are no non-Leader counterparts for a Duelist, they are granted Victor by default.\n\nIf all non-Leader characters have Victor, the allied and enemy Leaders gain Duelist. When one of the Leaders is defeated, whichever team has more Victors wins.\n\nSummoned units and pacifists flee immediately. General Skywalker may not be used. No characters can be revived.\n\n[c][ffff33]Duelist:[-][/c] Enemies will target this character; defeating this character grants Victor\n\n[c][ffff33]Victor:[-][/c] Defeated an enemy with Duelist

DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE01_TEXT|[23C8F5]On one of the many battlefields of the Clone Wars, the nefarious General Grievous has made a rare appearance to personally direct the battle. Defeating him here would surely turn the tide of the war![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE02_TEXT|[23C8F5]Grievous's patience has worn thin--he orders one of his dreaded AATs to cover his retreat. With nigh-impervious armor and a small arsenal of anti-personnel weaponry, it is one of the deadliest weapons on the battlefield.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE03_TEXT|[23C8F5]The AAT has been disabled, but the battle is far from over--Grievous summons a squad of B1 Battle Droids, led by one of his special B2 Rocket Troopers, to hold the line while the AAT is repaired.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_AAT_DIFF01_PHASE04_TEXT|[23C8F5]Grievous has ordered an all-out offensive, deploying additional B2 Super Battle Droids to support the AAT, as well as granting clearance for air strikes to crush any opposition.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_DARK_HERO_TB3_TEXT|[23C8F5]All of your Dark Side path Rise of the Empire Heroes (Director Krennic, Gar Saxon, Grand Inquisitor, Lord Vader, Second Sister, Third Sister) gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_EMPIRE_TEXT|[23C8F5]All of your Empire characters gain the following ability:[-]

DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_HERO_HOTH_TEXT|[23C8F5]All of your Hoth Hero Characters gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_LIGHT_HERO_TB3_TEXT|[23C8F5]All of your Light Side path Rise of the Empire Heroes (Bodhi Rook, Jyn Erso, K-2SO, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Omega) gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_MIXED_HERO_TB3_TEXT|[23C8F5]All of your Mixed path Rise of the Empire Heroes (Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum), Doctor Aphra, Hondo Ohnaka, Jabba the Hutt, Qi'ra) gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_GRANTEDABILITY_REBEL_TEXT|[23C8F5]All of your Rebel Characters gain the following ability:[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE01_TEXT|[23C8F5]Pig-like brutes known as Gamorreans stand as the first line of defense toward the inner sanctum of The Pit. Their captain, heavily guarded by his seemingly-endless waves of reinforcements, must be defeated to breach the sanctum door.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE02_TEXT|[23C8F5]The terror residing within the inner sanctum has been unleashed. Riled from the sounds of battle, the Rancor's enduring defenses are nearly impenetrable. Beware of its insatiable appetite![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE03_TEXT|[23C8F5]Taking on a more aggressive nature, the Rancor is more susceptible to damage. Sometimes, however, the best defense is a strong, debilitating offense.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_RANCOR_DIFF01_PHASE04_TEXT|[23C8F5]Wounded but not tiring, the Rancor's rage during its final stand is unquestionable.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE01_TEXT|[23C8F5]At the doors to the Trayus Academy, the Lord of Hunger makes an appearance. The Sith Lord Nihilus has come to drain the force of those who wish to enter the Academy. Defeat Nihilus here to find the Core.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE02_TEXT|[23C8F5]As Nihilus retreats into the depths of the Academy, a new foe shows his face in the Sparring Room. The seemingly unkillable Lord of Pain is now on the offensive and seeks to destroy all who would try to stand in his way.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE03_TEXT|[23C8F5]Darth Sion is seemingly defeated, left lying in the Sparring Room. Inside of the Trayus Academy Core, the Master of the previous Sith lurks in the shadows. The Lord of Betrayal, Darth Traya, comes forward to destroy those who would defy her.[-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_SITHRAID_PHASE04_TEXT|[23C8F5]Darth Nihilus and Darth Sion rejoin the fight alongside Darth Traya. Face the deadly Sith Triumvirate all at once![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_TERRITORYBATTLE_GEONOSIS_SEPARATIST_TEXT|[23C8F5]The Galactic Republic has amassed some of its best fighting forces in its onslaught on Geonosis. Be on the lookout for Elite characters – not only are they much stronger than normal characters, but they also have powerful Elite abilities![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_TERRITORYBATTLE_GEONOSIS_SEPARATISTS_TEXT|[23C8F5]The Separatists have dug in with some of their deadliest fighting forces in defense of Geonosis. Be on the lookout for Elite characters – not only are they much stronger than normal characters, but they also have powerful Elite abilities![-]
DYNAMICDESC_LAYOUT_TERRITORYBATTLE_HOTH_EMPIRE_TEXT|[23C8F5]The Rebel Alliance utilizes a myriad of seasoned soldiers well-equipped for combat in Hoth's harsh icy environment. Be on the lookout for Elite units--not only are they much stronger than normal units, but they also have powerful Elite abilities![-]

EVENT_AHSOKATANA_GALACTICLEGEND_T01_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (4x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Snips)\n- Commander Ahsoka Tano\n- CT-7567 "Rex"\n\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Anakin trained Ahsoka by pitting her against a most formidable enemy: the very clones she would fight alongside during the Clone Wars\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Snips), CT-7567 "Rex", or Commander Ahsoka Tano being defeated will result in immediate loss
EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T02_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (4x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Snips)\n- Barriss Offee\n- Asajj Ventress\n\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- A pivotal moment for Ahsoka came as she was betrayed by Barriss Offee, a fellow Jedi Padawan she fought alongside during the Clone Wars; Barriss framed Ahsoka, and with the assistance of Bounty Hunter Asajj Ventress and the faith of her master Anakin she was able to finally clear her name with the Jedi Order\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Snips) being defeated will result in immediate loss
EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T03_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (4x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Commander Ahsoka Tano\n\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Commander Ahsoka Tano has just learned of Maul's insidious plans to take down Anakin Skywalker in attempt to deprive Sidious of his new apprentice
EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T04_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (3x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)\n- Ezra Bridger\n\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka assisted the crew of the Ghost on Malachor IV; it was here she would have her first confrontation against Darth Vader, the new incarnation of her former Jedi Master, Anakin Skywalker\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) being defeated will result in immediate loss\n- Ezra Bridger's stats have been modified for this battle\n- Darth Vader cannot be defeated in the first encounter\n- At the start of battle, Darth Vader will gain Dramatic Entrance, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented
EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T05_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (3x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Commander Ahsoka Tano\n\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano's quest to find Grand Admiral Thrawn would take her to Seatos, where she would confront Baylan Skoll, a former Jedi-turned-Mercenary; this confrontation would turn out to be a chrysalis in Ahsoka's life....\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Face off against Baylan Skoll, and to obtain victory, attempt to survive 10 turns!\n- Baylan Skoll can't be defeated\n- Commander Ahsoka's abilities and appearance has been modified for this battle\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] This version of Commander Ahsoka Tano has been modified and isn't obtainable, and can't be used outside of this battle.[-][/c]
EVENT_AHSOKATANO_GALACTICLEGEND_T06_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (10x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano\n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Ezra Bridger (Exile)\n\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Reunited with Ezra Bridger, Ahsoka and her Padawan, Sabine Wren, made one final attempt to stop Grand Admiral Thrawn from returning to the galaxy, only to be confronted by his forces; forces that proved loyal even in death\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Ezra Bridger (Exile) will be loaned to you for this event\n- Ahsoka Tano being defeated will result in immediate loss\n- Ahsoka Tano will not have access to her Ultimate ability for this battle and her abilities have been modified\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] This version of Ahsoka Tano has been modified and isn't obtainable, and can't be used outside of this battle.[-][/c]
