EVENT_BADBATCH_PROMO_SUMMARY|Collect characters from The Bad Batch!\n\n[c][ffff33]Note:[-][/c] You must have less than 50 shards of a Bad Batch character in order to unlock their event tier.
EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Hunter[-][/c]\n[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]\n[c]- Echo[-][/c]\n[c]- Tech[-][/c]\n[c]- Omega[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][ffff33]Combat Prowess[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Expose; when fully upgraded, if the target enemy is debuffed, Hunter will attack again.\n- [c][ffff33]Shrouded Approach[-][/c] gives Evasion Up and Stealth to Clone Trooper allies, then deals damage to all enemies.\n- [c][ffff33]Finish What We Started[-][/c] inflicts Expose on target enemy and grants Turn Meter to a targeted Clone Trooper ally; when fully upgraded, if the ally target is Bad Batch, they ignore Taunt and inflict Stun on their target enemy, which can't be evaded.\n- [c][ffff33]A Different Path[-][/c] buffs Bad Batch allies' Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency; when fully upgraded, when using an ability against a Target Locked enemy, Bad Batch allies can't be countered, and when Bad Batch allies use an ability, while they have Defense Up, they deal True damage to all enemies.
EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Hunter[-][/c]\n[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]\n[c]- Echo[-][/c]\n[c]- Tech[-][/c]\n[c]- Omega[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][ffff33]Call the Shot[-][/c] inflicts Target Lock on Tech's target, with a chance to also inflict Target Lock on the healthiest enemy who doesn't already have it.\n- [c][ffff33]Delicate Operation[-][/c] keeps Tech and his allies on their feet, recovering their Health plus applying Stealth and Translation.\n- [c][ffff33]Brilliant Idea[-][/c] is a powerful ability that can turn the tide of battle. It dispels debuffs from Tech's allies, with a chance to Stun enemies that are Dazed or Target Locked.\n- [c][ffff33]Clone Interpreter[-][/c] makes Tech even better at giving Translation to his Clone Trooper allies, who gain a stack every time they use a Special ability; when fully upgraded, Clone Interpreter boosts Tech's Speed, and at the start of battle, if all allies are Clone Troopers, Tech gains Stealth.
EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Hunter[-][/c]\n[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]\n[c]- Echo[-][/c]\n[c]- Tech[-][/c]\n[c]- Omega[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][ffff33]Dauntless Commando[-][/c] gives Wrecker the ability to gain stacks of [c][ffff33]Fury[-][/c] by taking damage or using certain abilities, at max stacks of Fury, Wrecker becomes [c][ffff33]Furious[-][/c], which gives his activated abilities additional effects.\n- [c][ffff33]The Cavalry[-][/c] deals damage to a single enemy. If Wrecker is Furious, he uses this ability again.\n- [c][ffff33]I Hate That Word[-][/c] dispels Stealth from all enemies, and Clone Trooper allies recover Protection. If Wrecker is Furious, Bad Batch allies recover additional Protection.\n- [c][ffff33]Wrecking Ball[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and grants Wrecker Taunt while Clone Trooper allies gain Defense Up and Tenacity Up; if Wrecker is Furious, he will inflict Stun on all enemies.
EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Hunter[-][/c]\n[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]\n[c]- Echo[-][/c]\n[c]- Tech[-][/c]\n[c]- Omega[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][ffff33]Daring Defense[-][/c] damages the target enemy and gives a chance to grant Defense Up and Evasion Up (chance to avoid an enemy attack) to weakened Clone Trooper allies.\n- [c][ffff33]One Step Ahead[-][/c] inflicts Buff Immunity on target enemy, and Expose on all enemies. Then, it dispels all debuffs on target other Clone Trooper ally who is then called to assist.\n- [c][ffff33]Never Any Doubt[-][/c] gives all Clone Trooper allies Evasion Up and dispels all buffs on all enemies. For each buff dispelled, Clone Trooper allies gain additional Offense until the end of their next turn.\n- With [c][ffff33]One That Survives[-][/c] whenever a Clone Trooper ally gains or loses a buff, they recover Health and Protection.
EVENT_BADBATCHPROMO_TIER05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 1 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Hunter[-][/c]\n[c]- Wrecker[-][/c]\n[c]- Echo[-][/c]\n[c]- Tech[-][/c]\n[c]- Omega[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][ffff33]Disarming Shot[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and if Omega has Evasion Up, can Blind and Daze them.\n- [c][ffff33]Adaptive Learner[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and if the enemy is Exposed, will inflict them with Target Lock, and remove Turn Meter.\n- [c][ffff33]Empathy First[-][/c] dispels debuffs on Omega and gives her Stealth, Bad Batch allies gain Protection Up, Defense Penetration, and Turn Meter.\n- [c][ffff33]Part of the Squad[-][/c] gives Omega additional bonuses while Stealthed and bonuses to Offense if all of her allies are Bad Batch.

EVENT_BAZE_MALBUS_SUMMARY|For a limited time, [b]Baze Malbus[/b] has been added to [b]Light Side Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nLight Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 05/8/2023 through 05/9/2023.
EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_TIER01_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- CX-2 (Relic Level 5 or higher)\n- RC-1262 "Scorch" (Relic Level 5 or higher)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The events on Coruscant sent ripples of change across the galaxy.\n- Prevent Bad Batch enemies from completing their rescue objectives to keep the battle in your favor.\n- [c][F0FF23]NOTE:[-][/c] TK Stormtrooper is a loaned, non-player obtainable character.[-][/c]
EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_TIER02_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Depa Billaba (Relic Level 5 or higher)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Once the Padawan of Mace Windu, this fearless Jedi Master helped ignite the spark that would one day fuel a galactic rebellion.\n- Depa starts the battle with 60 stacks of [c][F0FF23]Caleb's Escape[-][/c]. When she reaches 0 stacks, the battle ends in victory.\n- When Depa ends her turn, she loses 1 stack of Caleb's Escape. Whenever she defeats an enemy, she loses 5 stacks.\n- Depa's Clone Troopers will respawn and trigger additional effects when defeated.\n- CC-10/994 "Grey" can inflict Speed Down which enables additional effects for his team and prevents Depa from counterattacking. Dispelling this through strategic play will help secure victory.\n- Depa being defeated before reaching 0 stacks of Caleb's Escape will result in immediate loss.[-][/c]
EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_TIER03_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Temple Guard (Relic Level 5 or higher)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- A Jedi Master's guidance echoes through their Padawan's actions long after their time together has passed.\n- Kanan gains a stack of Kanan's Will whenever he uses a Special ability and Temple Guard's cooldowns are refreshed.\n- When Kanan has 10 stacks of [c][F0FF23]Kanan's Will[-][/c] at the start of his turn, the battle ends in victory.\n- Kanan's Tenacity is doubled whenever he has Taunt. Dispelling it will be crucial.\n- At the end of each of his turns, Kanan is inflicted with Ability Block. Temple Guard's first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Fear Leads to Anger[-][/c] dispels it and all buffs on Kanan\n- Temple Guard's Basic ability recovers 10% Health and Protection for each instance of damage dealt.\n- Temple Guard's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Stoic Determination[-][/c] inflicts Daze, which stops Kanan from counterattacking.[-][/c]
EVENT_BESET_ON_ALL_SIDES_TIER04_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Master Mace Windu\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Master Mace Windu finds himself beset by Separatist forces. But enough is enough; Mace has had it with their incursion and will show them the folly of their programming.\n- Jedi Master Mace Windu will be loaned to you for this battle at Relic 5.\n- Whenever an enemy ends their turn or whenever Jedi Master Mace Windu is damaged, Mace has a chance to gain 100% Turn Meter.\n- Whenever Jedi Master Mace Windu defeats an enemy, his cooldowns are reset and he has a chance to gain 100% Turn Meter.[-][/c]

EVENT_HOME_ONE_SUMMARY|For a limited time, [b]Home One[/b] has been added to [b]all Dark Side Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, this unit's drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nDark Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 4/17 through 4/21.
EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T01_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (4x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- General Kenobi\n- Hondo Ohnaka\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- CC-2224 "Cody"\n\n[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]\nAhh, the Utapau affair! Now that is a tale worth telling over a drink you didn't pay for. You see, General Kenobi and I — well, we've crossed paths more times than I've double-crossed warlords. Which is to say...often.\n\nNow, yes, I am a Pirate, but even I know when the galaxy needs a little Hondo heroism. So there I was — charm in one hand, distraction in the other — helping old Kenobi outmaneuver that walking scrap heap, Grievous.\n\nA little chaos here, a "misplaced" shipment there, some very expensive tactical advice...and bam! Victory. You're welcome, Republic.\n\nOf course, I may have had one or two completely unrelated personal interests in the matter, but who's counting? Certainly not the Jedi. And now, thanks to my efforts, Kenobi owes me a favor. Or three. And that, my friend, is the true profit.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- General Grievous can't be defeated or targeted in this battle\n- You must defeat all of General Grievous' squad to be victorious.\n- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T02_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (4x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Hondo Ohnaka\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Kelleran Beq\n\n[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]\nAhhh... Order 66. Nasty, nasty business, my friend. You know, I was there. Yes—me. Right in the middle of it. Jedi Temple in flames, clone troopers everywhere, chaos thick in the air like the smell of a bad deal going worse. And scared little younglings? Ohhh, so many. Poor things didn’t even know who to trust. Lucky for them, they had me.\n\nWhile a very skilled, very glowstick-happy Jedi kept the troopers busy, I slipped in and did what I do best – navigated the chaos, calmed the little ones, and secured their escape.\n\nDid I have my reasons? Always.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The youngling can't gain Turn Meter, or be damaged, debuffed, or defeated.\n- The youngling is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.\n- The Dark Side clouds everything and all Jedi will lose Foresight when Clone Troopers use their abilities.\n- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T03_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (4x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Hondo Ohnaka\n- Ezra Bridger\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]\nAhhh, Malachor. What a disaster! Ancient Sith traps, spooky ruins, a brooding Darth Vader, and a very intense Togruta with two lightsabers—yes, that one.\n\nAnd there I was, as always, offering my unmatched strategic brilliance. Some say she teamed up with a Hutt—who am I to confirm or deny? I just know I was the one thinking clearly while everyone else was swinging lightsabers and screaming.\n\nIt was my quick thinking that helped them survive. No need to thank me. Actually... no, wait—yes, there is.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) or Hondo Ohnaka being defeated will result in immediate loss.\n- At the start of battle, Darth Vader will gain Dramatic Entrance, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.\n- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T04_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (3x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Hondo Ohnaka\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Han Solo\n- Rebel Officer Leia Organa\n- C-3PO\n- Chewbacca\n\n[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]\nAAhhh yes, Hoth! Cold. Miserable. Absolutely crawling with Imperials—and, as it happens, adventure!\n\nChewbacca—furry, loud, surprisingly graceful in a blizzard—and a few of his less memorable friends were in desperate need of an exit. Who answered the call? Hondo Ohnaka, of course. No charge! Well... no upfront charge.\n\nTogether, we dashed through frozen corridors, fended off snowtroopers, and just barely avoided a hallway conversation with Darth Vader. Close one.\n\nBut thanks to my quick thinking and Chewie’s excellent growling, everyone escaped intact—and with all fingers and fur accounted for.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Each time an enemy takes a turn, Vader gets closer to entering the battle.\n- Hondo Ohnaka will have his appearance and abilities altered for this battle.
EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T05_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (5x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker\n\n[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]\nAhhh, the Battle of Endor! Now that was a party. Forests, firepower, fuzzy warriors with sharp sticks—it had everything! And right at the heart of it? Me. And... young Skywalker, of course.\n\nHe was on his way to confront Darth Vader and that wrinkly lightning enthusiast, and I—being the responsible, deeply strategic individual that I am—insisted on coming along. You know, to keep him out of trouble. And alive. Mostly alive.\n\nWith my guidance—and the occasional perfectly timed suggestion—the boy practically danced through every obstacle. Even the ones hurled at him by the Force.\n\nSome say the galaxy was saved by hope, destiny, and redemption. I say... a little Pirate insight didn’t hurt either.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker being defeated will result in immediate loss.\n- The Emperor's overconfidence is his weakness.\n- In the final encounter, Darth Vader is immune to damage and all effects and can't be targeted.
EVENT_HONDOOHNAKA_GALACTICLEGEND_T06_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (5x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka\n- Rey (Scavenger)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Finn\n\n[c][23C8F5]Hondo Says:[-][/c]\nAh yes, Starkiller Base! Cold place. Bad energy. Even worse company. And yes, I was there—when young Rey and that very enthusiastic ex-stormtrooper confronted the ever-brooding Kylo Ren.\n\nHe’d just murdered his own father, you know. Terrible family dynamic. Poor Chewbacca—absolutely devastated. And who was there to help hold it all together? Me. That’s who.\n\nNow, I don’t like to take credit where it’s not due... but thankfully, it is. If I hadn’t been on that base—offering timely distraction, a bit of tactical brilliance, and possibly detonating something by accident—who knows if those two would’ve survived?\n\nSo in a way… you have me to thank for the state of the galaxy. You’re welcome.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Fight Kylo Ren to escape Starkiller Base!\n- Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka will start this battle with 75% Ultimate Charge.\n- Rey (Scavenger) and Finn gain the Pirate tag for this battle.\n- Victory will be achieved when Kylo Ren reaches 1% Health.\n- Rey (Scavenger) will have her appearance and abilities altered for this battle.

EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Grand Moff Tarkin\n- Death Trooper\n- Scout Trooper\n- Stormtrooper\n- CC-1119 "Appo"\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Appo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Imperial March[-][/c], offers offensive boosts, with added effectiveness when used on his turn.\n- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Knightfall[-][/c], utilizes buff dispels to keep enemies at a disadvantage while providing assists and buffs to his allies.\n- [c][F0FF23]No Witnesses[-][/c], his second Special ability, gains additional value when enemies are affected by Damage Over Time and has strong synergy with Galactic Legend Lord Vader.\n- His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Vader’s Fist[-][/c], enhances Appo, Dark Side Clone Troopers, and Lord Vader with a range of powerful buffs, gaining extra power through his Omicron in Territory Battles.\n- His summoned ally, [c][F0FF23]Knightfall Trooper[-][/c], is a formidable attacker while also making Appo more resilient through several unique synergies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Though Appo can work alongside and boost Empire characters, his greatest synergies are with other Dark Side Clone Troopers and the mighty Galactic Legend, Lord Vader. 
EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- While Appo brings a variety of buffs and team-enhancing mechanics, his primary role remains that of an Attacker. Focusing on damage and Speed through mods can help maximize his impact, allowing him to take down key targets efficiently.
EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Order 66[-][/c] is a devastating debuff that all Dark Side Clone Troopers share synergy with and gain benefits from. Enemies afflicted by Order 66 will be unable to gain buffs or be revived if they are defeated.
EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Knightfall Trooper[-][/c] is a summoned character that functions similarly to others in the game, possessing its own abilities and inheriting stats from its summoner, Appo. If it is the last remaining unit on its team, it will retreat from the battlefield.
EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Appo's Omicron, while in the Territory Battles game mode, provides Appo with additional stats and Order 66 application.\n- The Knightfall Trooper Appo summons will severely punish enemies who defeat it while also making Appo himself more difficult to defeat.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Battles game mode and with CC-1119 "Appo"'s Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_APPO_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- CC-1119 "Appo" is a loyal and strategic Clone Commander who executes his orders with precision and lethal efficiency.\n- Galactic Legend Lord Vader will be loaned to you for this battle.\n- Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to defeat your foes!

EVENT_MARQUEE_ARMORER_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- The Armorer\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With [c][F0FF23]Both Hunter and Prey[-][/c] The Armorer gains a stack of Beskar Ingot the first time another ally falls under 60% Health and grants them Protection. \n- [c][F0FF23]Tempered Strike[-][/c] pummels enemies twice and grants a stack of Beskar Ingot if the enemy had Armor Shred.\n- NOTE: In order to demonstrate Tempered Strike, the enemy team will be inflicted with Armor Shred at the start of the battle.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ARMORER_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- The Armorer\n- The Mandalorian\n- Sabine Wren\n- Canderous Ordo\n- Gar Saxon\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]This is the Way[-][/c] inflicts Armor Shred on an enemy and then calls all allies with the Beskar Armor buff to assist.\n- When fully upgraded, Mandalorian allies are also called to assist.\n- [c][F0FF23]Our Survival is our Strength[-][/c] grants a powerful defensive buff to Mandalorian allies at the start of battle.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ARMORER_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- The Armorer\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- To get the most out of [c][F0FF23]Earn Your Signet[-][/c] you'll need Beskar Ingots.\n- When attacking an enemy with Armor Shred, The Armorer gains stacks of Beskar Ingots; so not killing those targets too quickly will yield more Beskar Ingots overall.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ARMORER_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- The Armorer\n- The Mandalorian\n- Greef Karga\n- Cara Dune\n- IG-11\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- When using [c][F0FF23]Earn Your Signet[-][/c] try to place it on an ally with taunt to get as much benefit as possible.

EVENT_MARQUEE_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple)\n- Boba Fett, Scion of Jango\n- Fennec Shand\n- 4-Lom\n- Zuckuss\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Asajj's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Swift Strikes[-][/c], deals damage to an enemy, debuffs them and grants herself Turn Meter.\n- [c][F0FF23]Come Back to Me[-][/c], her first Special ability, deals damage to all enemies, inflicts Armor Shred on the enemy and grants Asajj Ventress Retribution.\n- Her second Special [c][F0FF23]Know your Place[-][/c], deals damage, Stuns the target and calls all allies with Disciple to assist.\n- [c][F0FF23]Disciple[-][/c] is a non-stacking buff that grants the ally additional Speed and makes them immune to Ability Block.\n- Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Train Under Me[-][/c], grants her Critical Avoidance, Max Health, and Offense at the start of the battle and has synergy with allies who have Disciple.\n- Asajj's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Selfless Act[-][/c], grants Bounty Hunter allies Critical Chance Up and Offense Up. If her Contract is fulfilled she gains 100% Critical Damage.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Asajj's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Swift Strikes[-][/c], inflicts Tenacity Down on target enemy and attacks again if they are debuffed.\n- If the enemy is not debuffed she gains Turn Meter and Retaliate.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Asajj's first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Come Back to Me[-][/c], grants Disciple to a non-Galactic Legend Bounty Hunter ally.\n- Disciple can only be applied on one ally during an encounter. 
EVENT_MARQUEE_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Asajj's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Know your Place[-][/c], dispels all debuffs on Asajj and all allies with Disciple.\n- Each dispelled debuff also grants both Asajj and her ally with Disciple stacking Critical Damage till the end of the encounter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- If all allies are Bounty Hunters, Asajj's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Selfless Act[-][/c], applies Daze on an enemy whenever they have more than 5 debuffs.\n- Asajj's Contract can be completed by attacking out of turn on a Disciple ally's turn.\n- If completed, the Contract grants all Bounty Hunter allies Defense Penetration and Damage Immunity on revival.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Train Under Me[-][/c], has strong synergy with allies who have Disciple, increasing their chance to assist or be assisted and granting them buffs which can increase their Health, Protection and Critical Chance.\n- If Boba Fett Scion of Jango is the leader, Asajj gains Defense Up and Speed Up, and she also gains bonus Protection for each non-Tank Bounty Hunter ally.\n- While in Grand Arenas, Asajj and her allies with Disciple are immune to Turn Meter reduction and if Asajj gains Turn Meter she also gains additional Offense until the end of the encounter.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Grand Arena game mode and with Asajj Ventress (Dark Disciple)'s Omicron enabled, and all allies have Disciple granted for this battle.
EVENT_MARQUEE_ASAJJDARKDISCIPLE_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Asajj Ventress is a relentless Bounty Hunter, who strikes with calculated precision against any who stand in her way.\n- Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to face her Master and her overcome past!

EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]DROID BATTALION[-][/c] - B1s can't score critical hits. EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]B1 BARRAGE[-][/c] - Deals Physical damage to target enemy. If the damaged enemy is Target Locked, all Droid allies recover Health and Protection.

EVENT_MARQUEE_B1BATTLEDROIDV2_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n[c][F0FF23]ROGER ROGER[-][/c] - Whenever another Separatist ally attacks an enemy with their Basic ability, the B1s assist with reduced damage. When another Droid uses a Special ability, the B1s gain Turn Meter.

EVENT_MARQUEE_BADBATCHOMEGA_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Hunter\n- Tech\n- Wrecker\n- Echo\n- Omega\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Adaptive Learner[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy, and if the enemy is Exposed, will inflict them with Target Lock and remove Turn Meter\n- When fully upgraded, this ability also applies [c][F0FF23]Zeroed In[-][/c] to the target enemy and gives Omega a stack of [c][F0FF23]Target Practice[-][/c] which gives her bonus Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit), Offense (increases ability damage), and Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits)

EVENT_MARQUEE_BATCHERS3_M01_DESC_V2|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Omega (Fugitive)\n- Wrecker (Mercenary)\n- Hunter (Mercenary)\n- Batcher\n- Crosshair (Scarred)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Batcher's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Crushing Assault[-][/c], grants her Speed Up. If used during her turn and the enemy was Marked, she inflicts Off Balance and Defense Down.\n- Her first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Piercing Howl[-][/c], grants her Bad Batch allies Offense Up and inflicts Marked on the target enemy. It also inflicts Offense Down, and Ability Block onto all enemies with Off Balance.\n- [c][ffff33]Ferocious Bite[-][/c], her second Special ability, deals damage to the target enemy and inflicts them with 2 stacks of Bleed (max 6) and Pinned.\n- Bleed is a debuff that lowers the enemy's Speed and Tenacity, and deals damage at the start of their turn. It lasts until the end of the encounter, and can't be dispelled unless the enemy recovers Health.\n- Her Unique ability, [c][ffff33]LH-201[-][/c], lets Batcher ignore Stealth and Taunt during her turn, and she gets bonuses when a Bad Batch ally is Captive.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BATCHERS3_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Batcher (3 Stars or above)\n- Omega (Fugitive)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Wrecker\n- Hunter\n- Echo\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Her Special ability [c][ffff33]Savage Growl[-][/c] grants Bad Batch allies a temporary Offense buff.\n- If used during her turn, it also inflicts Offense Down on all enemies, and Ability Block on all enemies inflicted with Off Balance.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BATCHERS3_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Batcher (4 Stars or above)\n- Omega (Fugitive)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Wrecker\n- Hunter\n- Echo\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Her second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ferocious Bite[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy and inflicts Pinned and 2 stacks of Bleed (max 6).\n- Cripple your enemy's speed by stacking Bleed and Pinned.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BATCHERS3_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Batcher (5 Stars or above)\n- Omega (Fugitive)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Wrecker\n- Hunter\n- Echo\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- While another Bad Batch ally has Captive, Batcher gains Offense and Speed, and her Special 1 ability's cooldowns are reduced by 1.\n- Batcher's damage can't be evaded, and she ignores Stealth and Taunt during her turn.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BATCHERS3_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Batcher (6 Stars or above)\n- Omega (Fugitive)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Wrecker\n- Hunter\n- Echo\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The first time Batcher would be defeated, she instead gains Captive and all other Bad Batch allies can assist in rescuing her. If they succeed within 10 allied turns, she recovers 100% Health and Protection.\n- In order to rescue her, Bad Batch allies need to gain 30 stacks of Target Practice.\n- If they fail to rescue her, she is instantly defeated.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BATCHERS3_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Batcher (7 Stars or above)\n- Omega (Fugitive)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Wrecker\n- Hunter\n- Echo\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Batcher's Omicron on her Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ferocious Bite[-][/c], inflicts an additional stack of Bleed.\n- If a Bad Batch ally is inflicted with Captive, the cooldown of this ability is refreshed.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Wars game mode and with Batcher's Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BATCHERS3_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Batcher (Relic 5 or above)\n- Omega (Fugitive) (Relic 5 or above)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Wrecker\n- Hunter\n- Echo\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Batcher's abilities will be crucial to allowing her allies to deal the maximum amount of damage.\n- Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to hound your foes!

EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_00_CONTRACTS_SUMMARY|\nControl a powerful Bounty Hunter squad and learn about the new [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] system.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_DESC|Earn Bossk Shards!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M00_DESC|[B5E7F5]Contracts Tutorial:[-]\n - Learn about the new Bounty Hunter [c][F0FF23]CONTRACTS[-][/c] with a powerful Bounty Hunter squad.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]PREY ON THE WEAK[-][/c] deals Physical damage and will Critically Hit the weakest enemy if they are the target
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HUNTING PARTY[-][/c] Stuns the target and calls Bounty Hunters to assist for reduced damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]PREDATOR INSTINCTS[-][/c] dispels all Debuffs on Bossk and grants him Taunt and Frenzy
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ON THE HUNT[-][/c] grants all Bounty Hunters bonus Tenacity and Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN RAGE[-][/c] grants Bossk Health and Defense while Taunting, and Offense and Health Steal while attacking buffed enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M06_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Bossk will be forced into the Leader position. Use this mission to perfect your strategy with Bossk!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_M07_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and requires careful strategy.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_NAME|ON THE HUNT\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_01_BOSSK_SUMMARY|\nJoin forces with [c][F0FF23]BOSSK[-][/c] and track down elusive bounties.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_BONUS_DESC|This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_DESC|Earn Hound's Tooth Blueprints!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TOOTH AND NAIL[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and dispels all debuffs from Hound's Tooth\n - Hound's Tooth recovers Health and Protection if it has Taunt
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DEVOURER OF PREY[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and inflicts Breach, then Hound's Tooth gains Taunt\n - [c][F0FF23]BREACH[-][/c] reduces Speed and Defense
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]TRANDOSHAN BARRICADE[-][/c] grants Hound's Tooth Protection Up (stacking) whenever it takes damage from an enemy\n - While not Taunting, Hound's Tooth has increased Tenacity and gains Turn Meter whenever an ally takes damage from an enemy\n - When Hound's Tooth loses Taunt, it gains Taunt if an enemy is Breached\n - While Hound's Tooth is active, Breached enemies have reduced Evasion
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SECURE THE HUNT[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants all allies Tenacity\n - Additionally, all Bounty Hunter allies gain Counter Chance (stacking) whenever they Resist a detrimental effect
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_NAME|ON THE HUNT II\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_PRACTICE_DESC|This is a Practice Tier. Hound's Tooth and the Executrix will be forced units, and you do not need to bring a full fleet in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_02_HOUNDSTOOTH_SUMMARY|Join forces with the [c][F0FF23]HOUND'S TOOTH[-][/c] and hunt an elusive bounty across the galaxy!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_BONUS_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_DESC|Earn Embo Shards!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DISMANTLING SHOT[-][/c] dispels all buffs from the target enemy and deals Physical damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]KYUZO WAR HELMET[-][/c] deals bonus damage based on Embo's Max Protection, then Embo loses 50% Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]THE QUIET ASSASSIN[-][/c] grants Bounty Hunter allies Counter Chance and Health Steal when Embo is in the Leader slot\n - When fully upgraded, Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense Up when they score Critical Hits
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]WAY OF THE KYUZO[-][/c] grants different bonuses based on whether or not Embo has Protection\n - When Embo receives damage from an attack and has no Protection, he gains Foresight\n - When fully upgraded, Embo can't be Critically Hit
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Embo's [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] is active when he is in the Leader slot, and not the Ally slot\n - Damage enemies without Buffs to complete the Contract (only Bounty Hunter allies can contribute)\n - When completed, Embo gains a chance to take a bonus turn after scoring a Critical Hit and all Bounty Hunter allies gain Offense and deal bonus damage based on the target's Max Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_M06_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - When fully upgraded, [c][F0FF23]EMBO'S PAYOUT[-][/c] grants Embo the Special Ability [c][F0FF23]ELUSIVE STRIKES[-][/c] when a Bounty Hunter Contract is completed\n - [c][F0FF23]ELUSIVE STRIKES[-][/c] ignores Protection, deals Physical damage, and recovers Protection equal to the damage dealt
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_NAME|CLONE WARS: HUNTERS I\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_PRACTICE_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Embo will be forced into the Leader slot. Use this mission to perfect your strategy with Embo!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_03_EMBO_SUMMARY|Join forces with [c][F0FF23]EMBO[-][/c] and track bounties across the galaxy!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_BONUS_DESC|This Bonus tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_DESC|Earn IG-2000 Blueprints!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EXPLOIT IDENTIFIED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy\n - If the enemy is Breached, the IG-2000 attacks again
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INERTIAL DAMPENERS DISABLED[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Stun and Target Lock \n - Deals more damage to Breached enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]RECONSTRUCT PROTOCOL[-][/c] recovers the IG-2000's Health at the start of each turn\n - The IG-2000 gains Offense for each debuffed enemy\n - While the IG-2000 is active, Breached enemies have lowered Critical Chance
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INITIATE SLICE SEQUENCE[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants a random Attacker ally Offense Up\n - All enemies are inflicted with Critical Chance Down\n - Additionally, Target Lock is inflicted on the highest and lowest Health enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_NAME|INTO THE BREACH II\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_PRACTICE_DESC|This is a Practice Tier. The IG-2000 and the Executrix will be forced units, and you do not need to bring a full fleet in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_04_IG2000_SUMMARY|Join forces with the [c][F0FF23]IG-2000[-][/c] to propagate cold, metal, and evil across the galaxy!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_BONUS_DESC|This Bonus Tier features powerful enemies and will require careful strategy to complete.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_DESC|Earn Xanadu Blood blueprints!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HULL BREACH[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]BREACH[-][/c]\n - Breach lowers enemy Defense and Speed by 25%
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ROGUE MANEUVER[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, inflicts Target Lock on the weakest enemy, then calls a targeted ally to assist\n - If any enemy is already Target Locked, they are inflicted with Breach
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CLOAK AND DAGGER[-][/c] grants Stealth at the start of an Encounter or when a Scoundrel ally suffers a critical hit, and lowers the Offense of Breached enemies\n - When fully upgraded, Bounty Hunter allies will also deal additional damage when attacking a Breached enemy
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INTO THE BREACH[-][/c] inflicts Breach on the target enemy when Xanadu Blood enters from Reinforcement\n - When fully upgraded, Scoundrel allies also gain Retribution when Xanadu Blood enters from Reinforcement and all enemies gain Defense Down
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_NAME|ROGUE HUNTER\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_PRACTICE_DESC|This is a Practice Tier. Xanadu Blood and Executrix will be forced allies. Experiment with different team compositions and strategies to learn the power of the Xanadu Blood.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_05_XANADU_SUMMARY|Form a fleet and battle with Cad Bane’s [c][F0FF23]XANADU BLOOD[-][/c]!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_BONUS_BOUNTY_01_DESC|[c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  A member of one of the criminal cartels has information that could jeopardize our plan. You will eliminate this criminal and ensure nobody interferes.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_BONUS_BOUNTY_02_DESC|[c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  An opportunity has arisen to eliminate a high ranking Jedi Temple Guard who has left Coruscant for unknown reasons. Use extreme caution and eliminate the target and any Jedi present.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_BONUS_BOUNTY_03_DESC|[c][B5E7F5]Requirements:[-][/c] Bounty Hunters\n\n  A group of witches has been isolated on Dathomir. This is a rare opportunity to eliminate some potential competition, so see to it.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_DESC|Earn Jango Fett Shards!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]UNSCRUPULOUS GUNFIRE[-][/c] deals damage which increases for each debuff the enemy is suffering from\n - When fully upgraded, Jango will attack again if the enemy is debuffed
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SHRAPNEL BLAST[-][/c] deals damage to the primary target and another random enemy, in addition to applying Healing Immunity\n - When fully upgraded, enemies are also inflicted with Stagger
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CONFLAGRATION[-][/c] inflicts BURNING and deals damage, which can't be Evaded\n - [c][F0FF23]BURNING[-][/c] minimizes Evasion chance on afflicted units and deals damage over time
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ANYTHING TO GET AHEAD[-][/c] grants Scoundrel allies Speed, lowers enemies Tenacity, and has other beneficial effects\n - When fully upgraded it adds a Contract ability to damage Debuffed enemies with a Basic or Special ability\n - When Jango fulfills his Leadership Contract, all allies gain [c][F0FF23]BOUNTY HUNTER'S RESOLVE[-][/c] and increased Critical Chance
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]NOTORIOUS REPUTATION[-][/c] grants Jango bonus Defense Penetration and Health, and prevents enemies he defeats from being Revived\n - When fully upgraded, Jango Fett has 100% Defense Penetration making him extremely powerful against high Defense targets
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_M06_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Jango Fett's [c][F0FF23]CONTRACT[-][/c] grants Jango a large Offense boost\n - When fully upgraded, Jango gains Damage Immunity briefly once his Contract is fulfilled
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_NAME|THE TEMPLATE IN THE TEMPEST\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_PRACTICE_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Jango Fett will be placed into the Leader slot, and you can bring as little as a single unit in order to experiment with different strategies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BH_06_JANGO_SUMMARY|Join forces with [c][F0FF23]JANGO FETT[-][/c] and evaluate the new Clone Troopers. Then hunt important targets across the Galaxy with other [c][F0FF23]BOUNTY HUNTERS[-][/c] before the Jedi uncover your mission.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_BONUS_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan Kryze\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Careful application of [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Armor[-][/c] can save allies at key times, allowing them to recover with [c][F0FF23]Stronger Together[-][/c]\n- Use Bo-Katan Kryze with other Mandalorians to get the most of [c][F0FF23]Unite the Clans[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Stronger Together[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_DESC|Earn Bo-Katan Kryze Shards!
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan Kryze\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Use [c][F0FF23]Practiced Aim[-][/c] during her turn to apply Vulnerable to an enemy\n- Have Bo-Katan Kryze attack out of turn on the same target to deal even more damage 
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan Kryze\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Crippling Strike[-][/c] is great for dispelling buffs on the enemy and dazing them so they are unable to attack out of turn.
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan Kryze\n- Sabine Wren\n- The Armorer\n- Canderous Ordo\n- Gar Saxon\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Unite the Clans[-][/c] calls another Mandalorian ally to assist whenever a Mandalorian ally uses a Basic ability during their turn \n- It also grants stacking Critical Damage to Mandalorian allies who attack out of turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan Kryze\n- The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)\n- The Armorer\n- Canderous Ordo\n- Sabine Wren\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Stronger Together[-][/c] grants Max Protection to Mandalorian allies for each Mandalorian ally while also recovering their Health whenever a Mandalorian ally attacks out of turn\n- When fully upgraded, Mandalorian allies also recover Protection when they recover Health this way
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan Kryze\n- The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Unite the Clans[-][/c] grants all Mandalorian allies the ability [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Armor[-][/c], allowing them to dispel all debuffs from themselves and gain Defense Up, Taunt, and Tenacity Up
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_NAME|TALES FROM THE OUTER RIM VI\n[c][FFC891]Marquee Event[-][/c]
EVENT_MARQUEE_BOKATAN_SUMMARY|Follow [c][F0FF23]Bo-Katan Kryze[/c][-] as she fights for the honor of Mandalore!

EVENT_MARQUEE_BWINGREBEL_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Rebel B-wing\n- Home One\n- Cassian's U wing\n- Rebel Y-wing\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Rebel B-wing's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Gyrhil R-9X Heavy Laser Cannons[-][/c], can inflict Target Lock. If the Capital Ship is Home One, the chances are increased to inflict Target Lock, and Rebel B-wing also gains Offense Up for 1 turn.\n- With its first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Blockade Buster[-][/c], Rebel B-wing inflicts all enemies with Accuracy Down and Defense Down, dispels all debuffs on itself, and gains Protection Up. If Home One is the Capital Ship, it also calls all allies with Defense Up to assist and grants them Critical Damage Up.\n- With [c][F0FF23]Composite-beam Laser[-][/c], its second Special ability, Rebel B-wing gains with Critical Chance Up. If the Capital Ship is Home One, it also inflicts Evasion Down onto all enemies. If target enemy is already inflicted with Evasion Down, they are Ability Blocked instead and take bonus damage. And if the allied Capital Ship was Home One at the start of battle, the cooldown on this ability is reduced.\n- Its Unique, [c][F0FF23]Tactical Maneuver[-][/c], allows it to gain Turn Meter and Retribution whenever it's damaged by an enemy's ability. If Home One is the Capital Ship, gain Max Health and Offense. Whenever Rebel B-wing attacks out of turn, it reduces all cooldowns on Home One (except Call Reinforcement). If Rebel B-wing gains Master Plan, all Rebel allies get Critical Chance for the rest of the encounter, and when Master Plan expires, Rebel B-wing gains Tactical Supremacy.

EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINDROGAN_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Mon Mothma[-][/c]\n[c]- Kyle Katarn[-][/c]\n[c]- Pao[-][/c]\n[c]- Hoth Rebel Scout[-][/c]\n[c]- Captain Drogan[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With enough investment into his unique ability, Captain Drogan's first use of his Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Coordinated Shot[-][/c], deals extra damage on his turn. Use this to defeat wounded foes or severely wound healthy ones.\n- [c][ffff33]Fire Support[-][/c] paves the way for Drogan's team by dispelling buffs from his target and inflicting them with Burning. If they were already Burning, he'll spread Burning to other targets who aren't.\n- With [c][ffff33]Battle Plan[-][/c], Drogan can hand out the special buff [c][ffff33]Keen Stratagem[-][/c] which enhances his allies' Offense and Potency along with other benefits such as calling all allies with Keen Stratagem to assist.\n- Keen Stratagem's benefits can be increased with Drogan's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Second in Command[-][/c]. Keen Stratagem can't be dispelled and will persist between encounters, but expires if the character with it is defeated. Drogan being defeated does not remove it from allies who have it.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINDROGAN_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Saw Gerrera[-][/c]\n[c]- Baze Malbus[-][/c]\n[c]- Chirrut Îmwe[-][/c]\n[c]- Biggs Darklighter[-][/c]\n[c]- Captain Drogan[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Drogan excels at punching through hard targets but is vulnerable to focused enemy attacks. Try to keep him safe with tanks and defensive buffs.\n- His Omicron provides added survivability and if the ally in the Leader slot is a Rebel Tank, it makes him immune to Ability Block and allows him to dispel debuffs from allies and recover Health and Protection.\n- While Drogan can help non-Rebel allies, his primary synergy is alongside other Rebel characters.\n- [c][ffff33]Note:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Grand Arenas game mode

EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINENOCH_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch\n- Death Trooper (Peridea)\n- Night Trooper\n- Stormtrooper\n- Scout Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Enoch's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Die Well[-][/c], has extra benefits if the enemy is under the effects of Blight.\n- [c][ffff33]Last Command[-][/c], Captain Enoch's Special ability, provides many supportive effects, including dispelling debuffs on his allies.\n- With [c][ffff33]Arbiter of Decay[-][/c], Enoch's Leader ability, non-Droid Imperial Remnant allies can come back from the brink of death and gain the [c][ffff33]Decay[-][/c] effect.\n- [c][ffff33]Ominous Sentinel[-][/c], Enoch's Unique ability, has additional synergy with Blight and reduces the likelihood that his allies will be critically hit.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINENOCH_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch (3 Stars or above)\n- Death Trooper (Peridea)\n- Night Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Decay will limit how much of your Imperial Remnant's Health bar can be recovered, but in turn provides a series of powerful benefits thanks to Enoch's Leader and Unique abilities.\n- When facing Enoch, you can bypass Decay from triggering if you can defeat Enoch's ally with a critical strike, but Enoch has ways of making that difficult to accomplish.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINENOCH_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch (4 Stars or above)\n- Death Trooper (Peridea)\n- Night Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Enoch makes it very difficult to critically hit his allies thanks to different effects within both his Leader and his Unique abilities. Protecting him to keep his Unique active for your Imperial Remnant allies will be critical to your success (no pun intended).
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINENOCH_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch (5 Stars or above)\n- Death Trooper (Peridea)\n- Night Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Enoch can remove Turn Meter from an enemy through his Basic and Special abilities, allowing Enoch to reliably trigger Blight's damage effect.\n- Make sure Night Trooper and Death Trooper (Peridea) are able to stack Blight as much as possible to get the most from both of Enoch's abilities.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINENOCH_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch (6 Stars or above)\n- Death Trooper (Peridea)\n- Night Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- If an Imperial Remnant ally has less than 3 stacks of Decay and less than 50% Health, with Enoch's Leader ability he can use his Basic to effectively force these relevant allies to gain Decay.\n- This synergizes very closely with his Unique which applies Blight to all enemies whenever Enoch's allies gain Decay.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINENOCH_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch (7 Stars)\n- Death Trooper (Peridea)\n- Night Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon\n- Stormtrooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With his Omicron active while in Territory Battles, Enoch's Unique ability drastically improves the resilience of his Imperial Remnant allies, and deals substantial damage to enemies whenever an ally is defeated.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Battles game mode and with Captain Enoch's Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINENOCH_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch (Relic 5 or above)\n- Death Trooper (Peridea) (Relic 5 or above)\n- Night Trooper (Relic 5 or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Captain Enoch is a commanding presence on the battlefield who supports his Imperial Remnant allies at every turn.\n- Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to defeat your opponent and secure victory!

EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINREX_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- CC-2224 "Cody"[-][/c]\n[c]- Clone Sergeant[-][/c]\n[c]- Captain Rex[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Captain Rex excels at taking out healthy front lines with Clone Trooper allies in 3v3 Grand Arenas\n- Captain Rex's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]The Lost Commander[-][/c], provides recovery and defensive buffs for Clone Trooper allies when they fall below half health\n- Use his first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Master Marksman[-][/c], to Stun a high priority enemy target and restore Health and Protection to allies if it scores a critical hit\n- While in 3v3 Grand Arenas when all allies are Clone Trooper, whenever an ally assists they inflict Armor Shred until the end of the encounter and have a chance to dispel buffs on enemy targets\n-[c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the 3v3 Grand Arenas game mode

EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINSILVO_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Silvo\n- Captain Ithano\n- Vane\n- Brutus\n- Kix\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Captain Silvo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Zero Patience[-][/c], inflicts Evasion Down and, if the target is Staggered, grants the same amount of Turn Meter to Captain Silvo that was removed.\n- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Open the Vault[-][/c], Staggers the enemy, then gives Silvo Alert and Pirate allies Speed Up.\n- [c][F0FF23]The Only Thing That Matters[-][/c], his second Special, helps him Support his squad as he removes all the Turn Meter from the target and grants it to Pirate allies. He also Steals Heal Over Time and Protection Over Time and grants them to Pirate allies.\n- His Unique, [c][F0FF23]Well Now It's Mine[-][/c], allows Captain Silvo to gain bonus Tenacity while he has Heal Over Time or Protection Over Time. He also gains bonus Potency while he has Health Steal Up. Additionally, whenever a Pirate ally gains a stack of Profit, they recover Health (or Protection), giving them a consistent edge in battle.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINSILVO_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In addition to dealing Special damage and inflicting Evasion Down on target enemy, Captain Silvo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Zero Patience[-][/c], also has a bonus when used on Staggered enemies: he gains any Turn Meter that is removed from the enemy. Time this correctly to shift momentum in your favor.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINSILVO_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Open the Vault[-][/c], Captain Silvo's first Special ability, Staggers the targeted enemy, Silvo gains Alert, and all Pirate allies gain Speed Up.\n- Use Open the Vault to Stagger, then Silvo's Basic ability to remove the target's Turn Meter and gain the same amount.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINSILVO_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Captain Silvo's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Only Thing That Matters[-][/c], removes Turn Meter from target enemy and all other Pirate allies gain the same amount. It also reduces the target’s Max Health, while Pirate allies gain Max Health for the rest of the encounter.\n- Whenever an enemy has Heal Over Time or Protection Over Time, target them to Steal those buffs and grant them to all Pirate allies.\n- If there are no Heal Over Time or Protection Over Time buffs to Steal, you can still use this ability to grant Health Steal Up to all Pirate allies, helping them recover Health.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINSILVO_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Well Now It's Mine[-][/c], synergizes well with his second Special ability. If Captain Silvo successfully Steals Heal Over Time or Protection Over Time, he gains bonus Tenacity. If there are no buffs to Steal, he instead gains bonus Potency, making it easier for him to land debuffs on enemies.\n- It also helps other Pirate allies to recover Health whenever they gain a stack of Profit. If they were already at full Health, they recover Protection instead.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CAPTAINSILVO_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Captain Silvo's Omicron is for Grand Arenas, and states that whenever an enemy with bonus Protection, Protection Up, or Shield Up attacks out of turn they lose Max Protection. This helps punish teams that rely on additional Protection gain and/or perform a lot of assists when attacking.\n- Additionally, whenever an enemy gains Protection Up, they are Exposed.\n- Whenever an enemy loses Turn Meter, all Pirate allies recover Health and Protection and gain a stack of Profit. Combined with Captain Silvo’s abilities that remove Turn Meter from enemies and grant it to Pirate allies, using his Basic and second Special strategically can help you control the flow of battle and turn the tide in your favor.\n- If Pirate allies gain Protection Up, they also gain bonus Turn Meter.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, this battle is being simulated as if it were in the Grand Arenas game mode with Captain Silvo's Omicron enabled.

EVENT_MARQUEE_CROSSHAIRS3_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Omega (Fugitive)\n- Wrecker (Mercenary)\n- Hunter (Mercenary)\n- Batcher\n- Crosshair (Scarred)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Crosshair is at his best when he loses the [c][F0FF23]Shaken[-][/c] debuff. Utilize Target Practice to help dispel this effect.\n- Keep the debuffs rolling with his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]A Hit or A Miss[-][/c], which has benefits even if Crosshair misses his shot.\n- Further remove Shaken or call your Bad Batch allies to assist with his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Will Handle It[-][/c], which grows more powerful the more Relic Amplifier levels you invest into Crosshair.\n- Utilize his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Target Secured[-][/c], after your opponent has taken multiple turns as this will empower its damage up to a maximum bonus of 500%!\n- Pair Crosshair alongside his Bad Batch companions to gain the full benefits of his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]It's In My Head[-][/c], which will help him remove Shaken alongside many other stat synergies.\n- Crosshair is vulnerable to focused fire from your enemy, so do your best to keep him safe so he can reliably deal damage throughout the battle.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CROSSHAIRS3_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Shaken is a new debuff for Crosshair which stacks and reduces his Accuracy stat.\n- Even if his Basic ability, A Hit or A Miss, is evaded by his target, Crosshair continues to be a threat by Exposing the enemy for his squad to damage.\n- Throughout his abilities, Crosshair has various ways he can remove the Shaken debuff especially when aided by the new set of Bad Batch characters.\n- Removing Shaken efficiently will allow you to make use of Target Secured more reliably, resulting in significant damage.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CROSSHAIRS3_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Although Crosshair can work alongside the original Bad Batch squad, he greatly benefits from Target Practice and other mechanics the new Bad Batch characters bring to the table.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CROSSHAIRS3_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- His Special ability, I Will Handle It, can be utilized to either help Crosshair remove stacks of Shaken, or to call Bad Batch allies to assist.\n- If the target enemy was damaged in the previous Bad Batch ally's turn, this ability will reduce the cooldown of Target Secured which can deal a significant amount of damage.\n- Choosing whether to target Crosshair or another Bad Batch ally will depend on how the battle has progressed and the actions of your other characters. Experiment to find what works best for you in different situations!
EVENT_MARQUEE_CROSSHAIRS3_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Crosshair is an Attacker and not an especially resilient one at that, this makes him susceptible to enemies who can focus him down with effects like Marked.\n- To counteract this, try and keep him topped off with recovery effects and buffed with defensive effects. It helps to have a Tank on the team who can also keep him safe by Taunting.\n- As he is an Agility Attacker, the higher his Relic Amplifier level investment the better his synergy with critical hits will be. Beware enemies who are highly protected against critical hits as they may be difficult for Crosshair to reliably burst down.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CROSSHAIRS3_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Although he is an expertly trained marksman, as a result of Shaken, Crosshair may be prone to missing more in the early portions of a battle. However, he has many effects that can turn a miss into a benefit regardless.\n- Experimenting with his mods to help offset the negatives of Shaken early could be helpful.\n- With his unique ability, It's In My Head, while in Grand Arenas with his Omicron active, Crosshair benefits even more from allies with Target Practice and he can reliably keep many debuffs off of himself.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Grand Arenas game mode and with Crosshair (Scarred)'s Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_CROSSHAIRS3_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Crosshair is a burst damage, Agility Attacker who relies on a bit of setup from his allies to get the most out of his abilities.\n- Good soldiers, (mostly) follow orders. Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to defeat your foes!

EVENT_MARQUEE_DEDRAMEERO_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Dedra Meero\n- Major Partagaz\n- Director Krennic\n- Imperial Probe Droid\n- KX Security Droid\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Dedra Meero's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Effective Covert Action[-][/c], deals damage to the enemy and Exposes them.\n- Her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Watch Your Back[-][/c], can [c][F0FF23]Undermine[-][/c] an ally.\n- [c][F0FF23]Undermine[-][/c] grants Speed, lowers Critical Avoidance and Critical Chance, and blocks from gaining bonus Turn Meter.\n- Her first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Systems Either Change or Die[-][/c], allows her to recover Health and gain [c][F0FF23]Overconfident[-][/c] when she Undermines an ally.\n- With her second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Chain of Command[-][/c], Dedra Meero can gain or lose [c][F0FF23]Ranks[-][/c].\n- [c][F0FF23]Ranks[-][/c] add extra effects to Dedra Meero's abilities, and can go from Rank 1 (lowest) to Rank 3 (highest).
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEDRAMEERO_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Director Krennic\n- Imperial Probe Droid\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Dedra Meero’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Effective Covert Action[-][/c], deals bonus damage and grants Retaliate against Exposed enemies.\n- Focus this ability on a single enemy to stack Expose and Retaliate for increased damage.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEDRAMEERO_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Major Partagaz\n- KX Security Droid\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Dedra Meero’s first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Watch Your Back[-][/c], dispels debuffs on ISB allies.\n- With this ability, all ISB allies who are not Undermined also assist.\n- Assisting allies gain Offense Up and recover Health.\n- Dedra Meero gains bonus Turn Meter whenever an Undermined ally takes a turn with her ability [c][F0FF23]Systems Either Change or Die[-][/c].
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEDRAMEERO_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Major Partagaz\n- Director Krennic\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Do Not Bore Me[-][/c], Dedra Meero gains stackable Critical Chance and Critical Damage for each Undermined ISB ally.\n- At Rank 2 or higher, Dedra Meero gains Protection Up, and at Rank 3, all ISB Support allies gain Retribution and Speed Up.\n- Undermine multiple ISB allies before using this ability to maximize Critical stats and Rank bonuses.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEDRAMEERO_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Major Partagaz\n- Imperial Probe Droid\n- KX Security Droid\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With her first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Systems Either Change or Die[-][/c], Dedra Meero Undermines ISB allies when they Expose an enemy.\n- While Dedra Meero is Rank 3, ISB allies inflict [c][F0FF23]Torture[-][/c] when using Special abilities against Exposed enemies.\n- [c][F0FF23]Torture[-][/c] inflicts bonus damage, stacks Defense reduction, and blocks the character from gaining bonus Turn Meter.\n- Dedra Meero loses a Rank when Undermine expires on an ally without them having taken any damage.\n- To maintain a high Rank, use [c][F0FF23]Watch Your Back[-][/c] on Taunting allies to draw damage before Undermine expires.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEDRAMEERO_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Director Krennic\n- Imperial Probe Droid\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With her Omicron ability, in 3v3 Grand Arenas, Dedra Meero gains 30% Max Health until the end of battle.\n- Undermined ISB allies have an additional 50% Offense and Defense.\n- Undermined ISB allies below 50% Health gain Tenacity Up and Protection Up until they are no longer Undermined.\n- When Dedra Meero Undermines an ISB ally below 50% Health, she gains Potency Up.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, this battle is being simulated as if it was in the 3v3 Grand Arenas game mode and with Dedra Meero's Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEDRAMEERO_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Major Partagaz\n- Director Krennic\n- Imperial Probe Droid\n- KX Security Droid\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Utilize everything you have learned so far to snuff out the Rebellion!
