EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_DESC_REHEAT|Unlock Depa Billaba
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Depa Billaba\n- Jedi Master Mace Windu\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Serene Blade[-][/c] is Depa’s Basic ability and provides bonus effects depending on whether she is attacking during her turn or out of turn.\n- Her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Vaapad Disciple[-][/c], applies debilitating debuffs to enemies and gains additional benefits if Jedi Master Mace Windu is the team’s Leader.\n- With her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Will of the Council[-][/c], Depa deals damage to all enemies and synergizes with the Shatterpoint debuff. This ability also grants buffs to her Jedi Vanguard allies and gains increased effectiveness when Jedi Master Mace Windu is present.\n- Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Nothing and Everything[-][/c], provides multiple stat boosts and enhances Depa’s offensive potential. It also enables impactful interactions with both the Shatterpoint and Investigation mechanics when paired with Jedi Vanguard allies and Jedi Master Mace Windu.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n-[c][F0FF23] Serene Blade[-][/c] allows Depa to become a powerful out of turn attacker, gaining additional damage with each out of turn strike until her next turn begins.\n- Pair this with assist calls from characters like Jedi Master Mace Windu to focus down key targets efficiently.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Will of the Council[-][/c] damages all enemies, triggers Shatterpoint's effect, deals additional damage to affected targets, and then reapplies Shatterpoint.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Although Depa can contribute and be a helpful presence in other Jedi teams, she works best alongside Jedi Vanguard characters and Jedi Master Mace Windu.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Nothing and Everything[-][/c] provides several useful stat boosts and helps ensure that stacks of Investigation aren't wasted when an enemy is defeated. If an enemy is defeated while they have any stacks of Investigation, Jedi Vanguards will apply an additional stack the next time they trigger the effect, giving your team a head start toward revealing new target.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Depa's Omicron can be found on her unique, [c][F0FF23]Nothing and Everything[-][/c]. This Omicron greatly improves the Max Health and Offense of her Jedi Vanguard allies, and also gives them ways to manipulate Turn Meter in their favor.\n[c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Battles game mode and with Depa Billaba's Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DEPABILLABA_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Master Mace Windu\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Depa is an Attacker whose mechanics strongly align with Jedi Vanguard characters and Jedi Master Mace Windu.\n- She gains increased effectiveness when attacking out of turn, making her a risky target unless her reactions can be controlled - such as with a Stun.\n- Use this knowledge, along with everything you've learned so far, to help defend the Galactic Republic and preserve the Jedi Order!

EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_DESC_REHEAT|Unlock Disguised Clone Trooper!
EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Grand Moff Tarkin\n- CX-2\n- Disguised Clone Trooper\n- Stormtrooper\n- CC-1119 "Appo"\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Disguised Clone Trooper's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Covert Assault[-][/c], Stuns the enemy if he has Ruse, a new buff that grants him additional effects when using abilities. If they were already stunned or had Ability Block, and his allies are all Dark Side Clone Troopers and / or Lord Vader, it inflicts Order 66.\n- Ruse is a buff that lets Disguised Clone Trooper's abilities gain additional effects. Disguised Clone Trooper gains it from his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse[-][/c], when he is Stealthed at the start of his turn. However, it gets dispelled at the end of his turn.\n- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Well-Executed Ambush[-][/c], deals additional damage if the target has Damage Over Time. It also gains additional effects if the enemy is Light Side, Galactic Republic, or Jedi.\n- [c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse[-][/c] is his first Unique ability and it grants him buffs if he's Stealthed. It also grants him and his allies buffs whenever an enemy starts their turn if Disguised Clone Trooper is Stealthed.\n- His second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Decoy Squad Five[-][/c], grants him Offense at the start of battle, and Stealth if there was a Galactic Republic enemy. He also gains Stealth if he didn't already have Ruse. When attacking, he does massive damage to Jedi and Light Side Unaligned Force User enemies inflicted with Order 66.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- When using Disguised Clone Trooper's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Covert Assault[-][/c], it Stuns the enemy if he has Ruse.\n- If they were already Stunned or had Ability Block, and his allies are all Dark Slide Clone Troopers and / or Lord Vader, he inflicts them with Order 66.\n- Having high Speed and Potency ensures that he can land his Stuns so he can consistently inflict Order 66 on his target.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Well-Executed Ambush[-][/c] is Disguised Clone Trooper's powerful Special ability that does additional damage for each Damage Over Time effect on the enemy, and it does even more damage if he has Ruse. His Dark Side Clone Trooper allies then gain Advantage.\n- If the enemy was Light Side, they are inflicted with Healing Immunity. If Disguised Clone Trooper had Ruse, the Healing Immunity can't be dispelled or resisted, and they're inflicted with Damage Over Time.\n- If the enemy was Galactic Republic, their Speed is reduced. If Disguised Clone Trooper had Ruse, their Speed is reduced even more, and they're inflicted with Damage Over Time.\n- If the enemy was Jedi, they are inflicted with Offense Down. If Disguised Clone Trooper had Ruse, the Offense Down can't be dispelled or resisted, and they're inflicted with Damage Over Time.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Disguised Clone Trooper's first Unique ability is [c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse[-][/c]. If he was Stealthed at the start of his turn, he recovers Health and Protection, and gains Turn Meter and Ruse. He loses Stealth whenever he attacks.\n- Whenever an enemy starts their turn, if Disguised Clone Trooper had Stealth, all of his Dark Side Clone Trooper allies gain Retribution. If the enemy was a Jedi, Disguised Clone Trooper also gains Tenacity Up.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- His second Unique ability is [c][F0FF23]Decoy Squad Five[-][/c], which gives him Offense and Stealth at the start of battle.\n- At the end of his turn, if he didn't already have Ruse, he Stealths.\n- When attacking enemies with Order 66, he deals massive damage when attacking, and an additional instance of damage per Relic Amplifier level if the target was a Light Side Unaligned Force User or Jedi.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Disguised Clone Trooper's Omicron is in his first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse[-][/c]. While in Territory Wars, it makes it so Ruse no longer gets dispelled at the end of his turn. Instead, it lasts for the whole battle.\n- Additionally, if an enemy inflicted with Order 66 is defeated, his Dark Side Clone Trooper allies and allied Lord Vader gain a bonus turn, making this Omicron extremely powerful if you can inflict Order 66.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Wars game mode and with Disguised Clone Trooper's Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DISGUISEDCLONETROOPER_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Carry out your orders within Decoy Squad Five by inflicting powerful debuffs with your ruses.\n- Galactic Legend Lord Vader will be loaned to you for this battle.\n- Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to deceive and take down the Jedi!

EVENT_MARQUEE_DROIDEKA_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tip:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]DEFLECTOR SHIELD GENERATOR[-][/c] adjusts the Droideka's Speed based on whether it has Damage Immunity, and grants stacks of Charge, which boost its Offense and power its abilities.\n\nWhen fully upgraded, this ability gives the Droideka additional Evasion while it doesn't have Damage Immunity, and allows it to assist other Separatist allies while it does. It also helps keep the Droideka alive when attacking Target Locked enemies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DROIDEKA_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tip:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]TWIN BLASTER CANNONS[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy.\n\nWhen fully upgraded, this attack tears through enemies that are faster than the Droideka.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DROIDEKA_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tip:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]DESTRUCTIVE ARMAMENT[-][/c] deals damage and additional true damage based on the Droideka's Charge stacks.\n\nWhen fully upgraded, the Droideka can Target Lock an enemy, and unleash an unavoidable barrage of blaster bolts on an enemy based on the number of stacks of Charge it has.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DROIDEKA_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tip:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]RECONSTRUCTIVE REVOLUTION[-][/c] grants Damage Immunity, dispels debuffs, and restores Protection.\n\nWhen fully upgraded, this ability allows the Droideka to gain Damage Immunity and Tenacity Up while recovering Protection based on how many stacks of Charge it has.
EVENT_MARQUEE_DROIDEKA_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Fully powered Separatist Droid squad\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tip:[-][/c]\n- The Droideka is a force to be reckoned with when reinforcing Separatist assault squads.

EVENT_MARQUEE_GENERALSYNDULLA_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla\n- Huyang\n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- If the target enemy is buffed, General Syndulla's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Blurrg-1120 Holdout Blaster[-][/c], calls a random Spectre ally to assist and dispels buffs on target enemy.\n- Her first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Pulling Rank[-][/c], dispels debuffs on a Spectre ally and grants Offense and Speed based on the number of debuffs dispelled.\n- Her second Special ability, [c][ffff33]I'm Not Just Going to Sit Around[-][/c], deals True damage to all enemies and removes Turn Meter from enemies with 50% or more Turn Meter.\n- Her Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Unauthorized Mission[-][/c], grants Defense Penetration to Spectre allies with Exile or Perfect Defense.\n- With her Leader ability, [c][ffff33]New Republic General[-][/c], she allows Spectre allies to ignore Taunt to target an enemy with Exile or Fracture.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GENERALSYNDULLA_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla (3 Stars or above)\n- Huyang \n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Chopper\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Pulling Rank[-][/c], grants bonus Offense and enables target ally to inflict Blind on target enemy on their next turn.\n- It also grants Perfect Defense to all Spectre allies who have Defense Up and Tenacity Up.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GENERALSYNDULLA_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla (4 Stars or above)\n- Huyang \n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Chopper\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With her Leader ability, [c][ffff33]New Republic General[-][/c], she grants Health and Protection recovery to Spectre allies and Garazeb "Zeb" Orrellos when their Health is reduced to 30% for the first time.\n- With this ability, she also allows them to dispel all debuffs on themselves, gain Damage Immunity and take a bonus turn whenever their Health reaches 1%. During this turn, they gain bonus Offense, and defeating an enemy lets them recover Health and Protection.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GENERALSYNDULLA_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla (5 Stars or above)\n- Huyang \n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Chopper\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]I'm Not Just Going to Sit Around[-][/c], allows the strongest Tank ally to Taunt and grants them Protection Up.\n- It also inflicts Fracture on target enemy.\n- This can be combined with her Leader ability, [c][ffff33]New Republic General[-][/c], which allows Spectre allies to remove 100% Turn Meter from all enemies if an enemy with Fracture is defeated.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GENERALSYNDULLA_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla (6 Stars or above)\n- Huyang \n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Ezra Bridger (Exile)\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- All Spectre allies and Zeb gain bonus Offense based on their Defense at start of their turn with her Leader ability, [c][ffff33]New Republic General[-][/c].
EVENT_MARQUEE_GENERALSYNDULLA_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n [c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n [c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla (7 Stars or above)\n- Huyang \n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n [c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren\-n Huyang\n- Ezra Bridger (Exile)\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- General Syndulla's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Unauthorized Mission[-][/c], grants all the non-Taunting Spectre allies and Zeb bonus Defense when there is an ally Taunting.\n- It also enables Spectre allies with Perfect Defense to deal True damage whenever they use a Special ability.\n- Her Omicron grants bonus counter chance and Potency to all Spectre allies and Zeb in Territory Wars.\n- Using her Omicron, whenever a Spectre ally and Zeb are Stunned, they dispel it and inflict Buff Immunity and Healing Immunity to all enemies.\n- She also allows them to gain some Protection back when they lose all their Protection for the first time.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Wars game mode and with General Syndulla's Omicron enabled.

EVENT_MARQUEE_GREATMOTHERS_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers\n- Morgan Elsbeth\n- Talia\n- Nightsister Spirit\n- Nightsister Acolyte\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers' Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Energy Threads[-][/c], have different effects depending on if the enemy is Doomed or not.\n- Their Special ability [c][ffff33]Majik Storm[-][/c], deals damage multiple times and dispels buffs from all enemies, and dispels debuffs from all allies if the enemy Leader is Light Side. Nightsister allies gain additional bonuses when landing critical hits on enemies, and when critically hit themselves.\n- Their Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Threads of Destiny[-][/c], allow Great Mothers to use the Granted abilities [c][ffff33]Fate Weaving[-][/c], which inflicts Doomed on the target enemy and [c][ffff33]Gift of Shadows[-][/c], on a Nightsister ally if all allies are Nightsister at the start of battle.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GREATMOTHERS_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers (3 Stars or above)\n- Morgan Elsbeth\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Talia\n- Nightsister Spirit\n- Nightsister Acolyte\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers' Special ability [c][ffff33]Majik Storm[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and inflicts Vulnerable on Doomed enemies.\n- Blessed allies and Great Mothers temporarily gain Offense and recover Protection when critically hitting enemies with their Unique ability, [c][ffff33]To The Old Ways[-][/c], doubled when they are Vulnerable.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GREATMOTHERS_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers (4 Stars or above)\n- Morgan Elsbeth\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Talia\n- Nightsister Spirit\n- Nightsister Acolyte\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Bless a Nightsister ally of your choice to grant them a myriad of buffs.\n- Great Mothers can Bless another Nightsister ally if the Blessed ally is defeated and there are no other Blessed allies.

EVENT_MARQUEE_GREATMOTHERS_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers (6 Stars or above)\n- Morgan Elsbeth\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Talia\n- Nightsister Spirit\n- Nightsister Acolyte\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Whenever Great Mothers or an Attacker Nightsister ally is critically hit, Attacker Nightsister allies gain Foresight and Stealth.\n- Nightsister allies gain Foresight and non-Tank Nightsister allies gain Stealth whenever a Vulnerable enemy starts its turn.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GREATMOTHERS_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers (7 Stars)\n- Morgan Elsbeth\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Talia\n- Nightsister Spirit\n- Nightsister Acolyte\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Great Mothers' Omicron on her Unique ability, [c][ffff33]To The Old Ways[-][/c], prevents the first other Nightsister ally from being defeated. EVENT_MARQUEE_KELLERANBEQ_LEGACY_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Kelleran Beq (5-Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\nUse what you have learned to defeat the clone troopers assaulting the Jedi Temple!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KELLERANBEQ_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n-5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Qui-Gon Jinn[-][/c]\n[c]- General Kenobi[-][/c]\n[c]- Jedi Knight Anakin[-][/c]\n[c]- Ki-Adi-Mundi[-][/c]\n[c]- Kelleran Beq[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Kelleran Beq's best offense is a good defense. For every 10,000 Protection he has, he gains a stack of [c][ffff33]Padawan Lessons[-][/c] through his Unique, [c][ffff33]The Sabered Hand[-][/c] (max 100). This new status effect provides Defense Penetration and Offense per stack, so increasing Kelleran's Protection through mods and pairing him with characters like Ki-Adi-Mundi ensures that Kelleran can achieve maximum damage.\n- The Sabered Hand also sacrifices a portion of Kelleran's Health for an even larger amount of additional Protection, further increasing the maximum stacks of Padawan Lessons.\n- In addition, The Sabered Hand provides Kelleran Beq guaranteed counter attacks when attacked and a chance to attack again whenever he uses his Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Saber Stability[-][/c], while Kelleran Beq has Protection.\n- Saber Stability grants Foresight to random allies and will attack again when using this ability on his turn.\n- His second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Jedi Bravery[-][/c], also benefits from Protection as it deals bonus damage based off of a percentage of his total Protection. It will also dispel all debuffs on all allies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KELLERANBEQ_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Kelleran Beq[-][/c]\n[c]- Ki-Adi-Mundi[-][/c]\n[c]- Barriss Offee[-][/c]\n[c]- Mace Windu[-][/c]\n[c]- Anakin Skywalker[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][ffff33]Lightsaber Training[-][/c], Kelleran Beq's first Special ability, provides Offense Up to all allies, then calls all Galactic Republic allies to attack the selected target. Until the end of the turn, a percentage of the damage dealt is converted back into healing for Kelleran Beq's team.\n- Kelleran Beq's Leader Ability, [c][ffff33]By The Will Of The Council[-][/c], provides other allies stacks of Padawan Lessons equal to the number of stacks that he acquired at the start of battle and some helpful stats like Defense, Tenacity, and Speed.\n- His Omicron ability further increases the offensive and defensive capabilities of his team by providing extra Offense per stack of Padawan Lessons, calling allies to assist when any ally uses an ability on their turn, and a significant boost to Defense that allows the team to survive even the most ferocious enemies.\n- Furthermore, while Kelleran Beq has his Omicron active he can't be defeated while another ally has Protection.\n- [c][ffff33]Note:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory War game mode

Tank Pirate allies gain Taunt while others gain Stealth.\n- His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Republic Medic Corps[-][/c], grants him bonus Speed for each Pirate ally below full Health, he also gains Stealth if his health falls below full.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KIX_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Kix's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Rapidfire Blast[-][/c], grants him a stack of Profit and Retribution when used during his turn.\n- For each critical hit scores using [c][F0FF23]Rapidfire Blast[-][/c], a random Pirate ally is dispelled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KIX_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Explosive Response[-][/c], his first Special ability, can be very useful in Stealing Buffs from enemies.\n- He can Steal Critical Hit Immunity, Heal Over Time, Health Up, Health Steal Up, Protection Over Time, and Protection Up.\n- If enemies do not have any buffs to Steal, [c][F0FF23]Explosive Response[-][/c] grants Kix a stack of Profit.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KIX_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Having more Profit stacks allows Kix's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Emergency Medpac[-][/c], to grant addition Health and Protection on revival and also grants Damage Immunity if there is no allied Galactic Legend.\n- If no Pirate ally is revived while using [c][F0FF23]Emergency Medpac[-][/c], the ability's cooldown is reduced.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KIX_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Kix's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Republic Medic Corps[-][/c], grants his allies Evasion Up if their health is not full, otherwise it grants them additional Offense.\n- Republic Medic Corps also increases Kix's healing abilities based on stacks of Profit on him.\n- If there is no allied Galactic Legend and Kix has Profit stacks, a Pirate ally who is defeated for the first time is revived immediately.\n- Kix can grant Endure stacks to revived Pirate allies, which prevents them from being instantly defeated.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KIX_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In Territory Wars, Kix gains Critical Avoidance, Defense and Tenacity during a battle whenever a Pirate ally falls below full Health.\n- If Kix revives a Pirate ally, they get a bonus turn, Offense, have their cooldowns reset and gain Taunt or Stealth.\n- If no ally is revived, all Pirate allies gain Health, Defense, Offense and Bonus Protection.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Wars game mode and with Kix's Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KIX_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Kix is an expert medic and cunning Pirate who heals and buffs his team.\n- Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to take your squad to victory!

Characters with this will revive with full Health when defeated along with other benefits.\n- Her Unique, [c][F0FF23]I Don't Have Lately, I Have Always[-][/c], grants her increased Potency and Critical Chance. Kleya gains Turn Meter whenever an allied Rebel Fighter is damaged.

EVENT_MARQUEE_KLEYA_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Luthen Rael\n- K-2SO\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Kleya's first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Know What I Want[-][/c], inflicts Undermine on target enemy for 1 turn.\n- This ability also calls Luthen Rael and another random Rebel Fighter ally to assist, then Kleya also assists.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KLEYA_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Luthen Rael\n- Cassian Andor\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Kleya's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]This Is Do or Die[-][/c], deals Physical damage and inflicts Burning to all enemies, while removing 50% Turn Meter and increasing the cooldown for Undermined enemies by 1.\n- If the target ally is Luthen Rael at 25% Health or less, he is defeated and can't be revived; all Rebel Fighter allies are revived with 100% Health.\n- Kleya also Ability Blocks all enemies for 2 turns and grants all Rebel Fighters [c][F0FF23]Rebel Network[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter, which can't be dispelled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KLEYA_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Luthen Rael\n- Vel\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Kleya's Unique, [c][F0FF23]I Don't Have Lately, I Have Always[-][/c], grants her additional Critical Chance and Potency at the start of a battle and dispels all debuffs when debuffed by Undermined enemies.\n- Allies with [c][F0FF23]Keen Stratagem[-][/c] get +25% Accuracy and ignore Taunt.\n- During battle, if Luthen Rael is present, Kleya can't be targeted; if Cassian Andor (Undercover) is present and Luthen was not at the start of battle, Kleya gains the same benefits; when Luthen drops to 25% Health or less, he gains Damage Immunity and Kleya takes a bonus turn.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KLEYA_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Saw Gerrera\n- Luthen Rael\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With her Omicron ability, in 3v3 Grand Arena, Kleya gains [c][F0FF23]Axis[-][/c] if Saw Gerrera is in the Leader slot and if Mon Mothma is in the Leader slot, Kleya gains [c][F0FF23]Curator[-][/c].\n- If Luthen Rael is an ally, Kleya can’t be defeated until his Health falls to 25% or less; the first time this happens, Kleya resets the cooldown of her Special ability [c][F0FF23]This Is Do or Die.[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Axis[-][/c] inflicts Buff Immunity whenever Kleya uses her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Know What I Want[-][/c], and grants Evasion Up to all allies.\n- [c][F0FF23]Curator:[-][/c] When Kleya uses This Is Do or Die, Rally Mon Mothma and all Rebel Fighters, give all allies Crit Damage Up, stacking Offense and are immune to Turn Meter reduction, and spread Keen Stratagem if any ally has it.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the 3v3 Grand Arenas game mode and with Kleya's Omicron enabled.

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]LEGENDARY BATTLE MEDITATION[-][/c] gives Turn Meter and a buff to allies at the start of Bastila's turns\n - This buff grants Potency and Counter Chance, and the effect is doubled on Jedi allies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INITIATIVE[-][/c] provides powerful early battle bonuses for Jedi including Turn Meter and an undispellable Protection Up\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also grants Jedi Tanks [c][F0FF23]TAUNT[-][/c] at the start of battle and increases the damage of allied Jedi who have Protection Up
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_01_BASTILA_M06_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Bastila's leader ability, [c][F0FF23]INITIATIVE[-][/c], gives Jedi a very powerful early battle advantage and survivability\n - Use the full squad of Jedi in this Mission to defeat your enemies and see the power [c][F0FF23]BASTILA SHAN[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]JOLEE BINDO[-][/c] provide to a Jedi squad

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]NO OTHER OPTIONS[-][/c] deals Physical damage and heals Jolee\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also reduces Jolee's cooldowns when he deals damage during his turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EH, YOU DO IT[-][/c] calls a target Ally to assist\n - Jolee's second Unique Ability, [c][F0FF23]EXPERIENCE AND WISDOM[-][/c], synergizes with Eh, You Do It when fully upgraded
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]THAT LOOKS PRETTY BAD[-][/c] heals a targeted ally and dispels any debuffs on them\n - When upgraded fully, this ability also revives all defeated Jedi and grants them Critical Avoidance for 5 turns
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DON'T INTERRUPT ME[-][/c] grants Jolee immunity to Turn Meter Reduction effects and bonus Tenacity\n - When upgraded fully, this Ability grants Jolee 100% Tenacity and additional survivability
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EXPERIENCE AND WISDOM[-][/c] increases Jolee's Max Health\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also grants Protection Up to targets of Eh, You Do It and That Looks Pretty Bad, and heals the target as well as heals all Jedi
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_M06_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - In this Mission your Jedi allies will be defeated at the start. Use Jolee to revive them with a fully upgraded [c][F0FF23]THAT LOOKS PRETTY BAD[-][/c] and then defeat your enemies\n - [c][F0FF23]BASTILA SHAN[-][/c] is the leader here, and her leader ability causes Jedi with Protection Up to deal increased damage

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_02_JOLEE_PRACTICE_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - This is a Practice Tier. Jolee Bindo will be placed into the Ally slot, and you can bring as little as a single unit in order to experiment with different strategies.

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STIFLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Healing Immunity\n - This attack deals high damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]FIRST STRIKE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Health Down\n - If the target is below 50% Health, this ability deals increased damage
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SWARM TACTICS[-][/c] allows Sith fighter to ignore Protection on Debuffed enemies and provides other benefits to allied Sith ships\n - This ability makes Sith fighter especially powerful against ships with large amounts of Protection
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_03_SITHFIGHTER_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]EXTREME MANEUVERABILITY[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that grants Foresight when entering battle or when a Sith ally Critically hits\n - When Sith Fighter has Foresight, it deals increased Damage and loses Max Health (stacking) at the start of its turns

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DISABLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block\n - When fully upgraded, the Ability Block cannot be resisted by Target Locked enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]REPAIR KIT[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on the target, and if the target was a Droid they are Healed\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also restores Protection and grants Offense Up and Critical Hit Immunity to Droids
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CARBONITE PROJECTOR[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, dispels their Defensive buffs, removes Turn Meter, and inflicts Critical Chance Down\n - When fully upgraded, this ability also adds Offense Down and Target Locked enemies can't resist the Debuffs
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]COMBAT LOGIC UPGRADE[-][/c] grants T3-M4 stacking Potency and Critical Hit Chance each time he uses an ability\n - When fully upgraded, Droid allies also gain T3-M4's stacks of Potency and Critical Hit Chance
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_04_T3M4_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MASTER GEARHEAD[-][/c] grants T3-M4 bonus Defense Penetration and inflicts Target Lock on enemies\n - When fully upgraded, this ability grants Droid allies 100% of T3-M4's Defense Penetration

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]DON'T BLINK[-][/c] deals damage and can inflict Daze\n - When fully upgraded, Mission gains Turn Meter if her target was debuffed
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STREET SMARTS[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on Mission, grants her Turn Meter, and Stealth\n - This ability also inflicts [c][F0FF23]BLIND[-][/c] which causes the enemy to miss their next attack
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]NOW YOU SEE ME[-][/c] grants Mission increased Potency and she will inflict Damage over Time on her target when using abilities\n - When fully upgraded, Mission gains additional Potency if the Damage over Time is resisted until she successfully inflicts Damage over Time
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] grants Mission bonus Offense, which Zaalbar also gains\n - When fully upgraded, Mission will also Assist Zaalbar
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_05_MISSION_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Mission and Zaalbar have strong ally synergy thanks to [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c]\n - When paired together, they strongly complement one another and enable powerful strategies

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]STALWART ALLY[-][/c] deals Physical damage and Zaalbar recovers Health\n - When fully upgraded, the target is also inflicted with Damage Over Time
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]POWER BLAST[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and Zaalbar gains Taunt\n - When fully upgraded, Critical Hits inflict Armor Shred
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]WOOKIEE TOUGHNESS[-][/c] grants Defense (stacking) whenever Zaalbar takes damage until the end of his next turn
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] Zaalbar and Mission gain additional Critical Avoidance and Zaalbar gains Taunt and Retribution when any ally drops below Max Health\n - When fully upgraded, they recover Health and Protection for each Damage over Time effect on enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_06_ZAALBAR_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Zaalbar and Mission have strong ally synergy thanks to [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]ME AND BIG Z FOREVER[-][/c] \n - When paired together, they strongly complement one another and enable powerful strategies

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_DESC|Earn B-28 Bomber Blueprints!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]LASER BARRAGE[-][/c] deals Physical damage and the B-28 has a chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit\n - When fully upgraded, the B-28 has a 100% chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOMBING RUN[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and places Concussion Mines on them\n - [c][F0FF23]CONCUSSION MINES[-][/c] deal 10% Max Health damage and Daze the target when they explode
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]HIGH-VALUE TARGET[-][/c] grants the B-28 Taunt the first time other Sith allies take damage and any time other Sith allies drop below 100% Health, and the B-28 recovers Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes\n - When fully upgraded, the B-28 gains Critical Avoidance while Taunting, and any time a Sith ally takes damage or evades an attack from an enemy, there is a chance to place a Concussion Mine on that enemy
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_07_SITHBOMBER_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOMBER BACKUP[-][/c] is a Reinforcement Ability that places Concussion Mines on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle\n - When fully upgraded, Sith allies recover Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes (while the B-28 is active) and an additional Concussion Mine is placed on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_BONUS_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Face a squad of deadly Raiders! These powerful foes terrorized the Old Republic, and now wreak havoc on the peaceful world of Dantooine. Use all Carth Onasi's tricks to defeat his enemies and make the galaxy a safer place.\n - Raider attacks are more effective against enemies suffering from Armor Shred. Only the Raider Marshal can apply Armor Shred in this mission.
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_DESC|Earn Carth Onasi Shards!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]RAPID SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Damage Over Time\n - When upgraded fully, this ability also deals more damage for each Damage Over Time effect on the target enemy
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]JUST KEEP SHOOTING[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and grants Carth Offense Up\n - When upgraded fully, Carth gains bonus Turn Meter for each critical hit
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SOLDIER OF THE OLD REPUBLIC[-][/c] grants Potency, Tenacity, and Critical Avoidance to Old Republic allies as well as a chance to call another Old Republic ally to assist\n - When upgraded fully, allied Old Republic characters recover Health and Protection when an enemy is afflicted with a Damage Over Time effect
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SOLDIER'S TRAINING[-][/c] grants Carth Offense for each enemy and Old Republic ally, and also gives him other bonuses when he defeats an enemy\n - This ability gains maximum potential when Carth is paired with a squad of Old Republic allies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_09_CARTH_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Carth is best paired with Old Republic allies that can inflict Damage Over Time such as Mission Vao and Zaalbar.

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SITH ASSAULT[-][/c] deals Special damage and inflicts Ability Block\n - When fully upgraded, this ability gains Damage and Critical Chance for each active Sith ally
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]WILD LIGHTNING[-][/c] deals Special damage and Shocks an enemy\n - When fully upgraded, this ability deals bonus Special damage to all enemies, which can't be countered if the target was already Shocked
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]FEAR[-][/c] Stuns the target then inflicts multiple debuffs when that Stun expires\n - When fully upgraded, this ability has a chance to Stun a random second enemy
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CORRUPTED BATTLE MEDITATION[-][/c] reduces Turn Meter and debuffs enemies at the start of Bastila's turns\n - This debuff lowers Critical Hit Chance and Counter Chance, and the effect is doubled against non-Jedi, non-Sith enemies
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_BASTILASHANDARK_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]SITH APPRENTICE[-][/c] grants Defense, Tenacity and stacking Offense to Bastila and her leader whenever an enemy is inflicted with Deathmark, Marked or Shock\n - When fully upgraded, Bastila and her leader gain Foresight at the start of battle

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]INTERMINABLE ASSAULT[-][/c] deals damage to target enemy and Canderous attacks a second time\n - When fully upgraded, this ability allows Canderous to attack an enemy a third time if the enemy had any Protection before the attack
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]OVERWHELMING FIREPOWER[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and inflicts Offense Down\n - When fully upgraded, this attack ignores Armor
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - With [c][F0FF23]I LIKE A CHALLENGE[-][/c], Canderous deals more damage with Interminable Assault and Overwhelming Firepower to enemies who have taunting effects. Canderous gains buffs when an enemy gains Taunt, Deathmark or Marked\n - When an enemy with a Damage Over Time effect is damaged by an attack, Canderous gains Turn Meter
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_CANDEROUS_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]MANDALORIAN VETERAN[-][/c] grants Canderous bonus Health Steal and Potency for each Old Republic and Scoundrel ally\n - When Canderous damages an enemy, he inflicts a Damage Over Time effect

EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_DESC|Earn Juhani Shards!
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M01_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]RAGING STRIKE[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy, dealing more damage for each debuffed enemy
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M02_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]BOASTFUL PROVOCATION[-][/c] causes Juhani to Taunt with a chance to Stun the target enemy\n - When fully upgraded, Juhani will dispel all debuffs from Jedi and Old Republic allies before Taunting, and the Stun chance becomes 100%
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M03_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]REMORSEFUL THRASH[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies and provides Juhani with Health and Protection recovery for each Critical Hit\n - When fully upgraded, this ability Staggers all enemies if Juhani is Stealthed when she uses it
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M04_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - [c][F0FF23]CATHAR RESILIENCE[-][/c] provides Juhani with Health recovery at the beginning of each of her turns and increased Counter Chance while Taunting\n - When fully upgraded, any time Juhani drops below 100% Health she recovers Protection for each active Jedi or Old Republic ally, and gains Offense Up, Health Steal Up and Stealth
EVENT_MARQUEE_KOTOR_JUHANI_M05_DESC|[B5E7F5]Strategy Tips:[-]\n - Juhani’s abilities are most effective when she enters battle with [c][F0FF23]JEDI[-][/c] or [c][F0FF23]OLD REPUBLIC[-][/c] allies, so take her into battle with these factions to get the most out of her abilities!\n - In this battle, you will be using Juhani in a full Old Republic squad. Enjoy!

When the Chance Cube comes up Blue he grants his team many beneficial effects.\n- His Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Stay Close To Me[-][/c], reduces an enemy's Critical Damage and Defense while they have Tenacity Down, and when Master Qui-Gon is critically hit, he grants all Galactic Republic allies Advantage and Protection Up and they recover Health.
EVENT_MARQUEE_MASTERQUIGON_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\nAre [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Master Qui-Gon (3 Stars or above)\n- Padawan Obi-Wan\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- If there are no Taunting allies when Master Qui-Gon uses Feel, Use Your Instincts, he grants Stealth to all other Galactic Republic allies that aren't a Galactic Legend. EVENT_MARQUEE_MASTERQUIGON_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\nAre [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Master Qui-Gon (5 Stars or above)\n- Padawan Obi-Wan\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In addition to Stay Close To Me granting all Galactic Republic allies Advantage and Protection Up, they recover Health when Master Qui-Gon is critically hit, and he also grants Padawan Obi-Wan Critical Damage Up.

EVENT_MARQUEE_NIGHTTROOPER_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon\n- Moff Gideon\n- Scout Trooper\n- Death Trooper\n- Night Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Utilize Night Trooper's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Shambling Shot[-][/c], to build up stacks of [c][ffff33]Blight[-][/c] on themselves.\n- [c][ffff33]March of the Undying[-][/c], Night Trooper's first Special ability, can give them the new [c][ffff33]Alert[-][/c] buff, granting Turn Meter under the right conditions.\n- With [c][ffff33]Share My Suffering[-][/c], Night Trooper can apply Blight on their targeted enemy equal to the number of stacks Night Trooper has. Combine this with Shambling Shot to inflict as many stacks as possible.\n- [c][ffff33]Inevitable End[-][/c], Night Trooper's Unique ability, provides a wide range of benefits, including some much needed Potency as Blight can be resisted by your opponent.
EVENT_MARQUEE_NIGHTTROOPER_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Night Trooper (3 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon\n- Moff Gideon\n- Scout Trooper\n- Death Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Blight is a potent debuff that reduces Health Steal and causes the character affected by it to take True damage whenever they lose Turn Meter. Partnering Night Trooper with characters that can manipulate Turn Meter and avoiding matchups that have Turn Meter prevention will help tip the odds in your favor.\n- Additionally, to remove Blight, a character with this debuff must fully recover their Health, so finding ways to delay an enemy from being able to do this will be key to maximizing Blight's potential.
EVENT_MARQUEE_NIGHTTROOPER_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Night Trooper (4 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon\n- Moff Gideon\n- Scout Trooper\n- Death Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Similar to Blight, the new Alert buff greatly benefits Night Trooper when allies are able to gain bonus Turn Meter. Avoiding encounters that have prevention of Turn Meter manipulation will allow you to get the most out of these effects.\n- Carefully timing your abilities so Night Trooper is under the effects of Alert when your allies are using their Special abilities will in turn help Night Trooper stack Blight on themselves by assisting.
EVENT_MARQUEE_NIGHTTROOPER_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Night Trooper (5 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Mother Talzin\n- Daka\n- Asajj Ventress\n- Merrin\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- When facing Night Trooper, they have the ability to recover Health whenever their opponents do. Use this to your advantage to help keep Night Trooper's Blight stacks to a minimum.\n- When using Night Trooper, preventing the enemy from recovering Health will help maintain high stacks of Blight for both Night Trooper and against your opponent.

EVENT_MARQUEE_PADAWANSABINE_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Kanan Jarrus\n- Ezra Bridger\n- Padawan Sabine Wren\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Practiced Swing[-][/c], grants her Armor Penetration until her next turn, which can stack up to 3 times.\n- Her Special ability, [c][ffff33]Frantic Strike[-][/c], deals two instances of damage; once to the target enemy, and once to all enemies. It also applies a new debuff called [c][ffff33]Off Balance[-][/c], which will deal with a percentage of an enemy's Max Health as damage and reduce their Turn Meter.\n- Her second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Fallback Tactic[-][/c], deals 2 instances of damage to the targeted enemy. This ability gains additional Critical Damage based on the number of buffs and debuffs on her target and removes Turn Meter.\n- Her Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Sentinel of Lothal[-][/c], synergies nicely with both Mandalorian and Spectre allies, and even has specific callouts to her master, Ahsoka Tano.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PADAWANSABINE_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren (3 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Ezra Bridger\n- Hera Syndulla\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Padwan Sabine Wren's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Practiced Swing[-][/c], can stack multiple instances of Armor Penetration when she is called to assist.\n- Use both Ezra Bridger and Hera Syndulla's abilities to target Sabine in order to stack her Armor Penetration.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PADAWANSABINE_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren (4 Stars or above)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Frantic Strike[-][/c], deals damage to the target enemy first and inflicts Pinned on them, then deals damage and inflicts a new debuff called [c][ffff33]Off Balance[-][/c] on all enemies.\n- Off Balance is a stackable debuff that, when a character is damaged by an attack, will deal extra damage based on their Max Health and remove some Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PADAWANSABINE_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren (5 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan Kryze\n- Paz Vizla\n- The Armorer\n- IG-12 & Grogu\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\nPadawan Sabine Wren's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Fallback Tactic[-][/c], gains extra Critical Chance based on the number of Mandalorian and Spectre allies on her team.\n- This attack will also remove Turn Meter from an enemy, which grows more powerful with Relic Amplifier Levels.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PADAWANSABINE_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren (6 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)\n- Hera Syndulla\n- Chopper\n- Ezra Bridger (Exile)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Sentinel of Lothal[-][/c], provides her with extra Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and counter chance.\n- When a Spectre ally uses a Special ability, Sabine gains a stack of Force Connection, gaining even more stacks of Force Connection if that ally was Ahsoka Tano.\n- As Sabine gains enough stacks of Force Connection, she will gain a large boost to her Critical Damage, improving her damage even more.\n- Sabine's Omicron provides passive bonuses to all of her Mandalorian and Spectre allies, while granting her extra stats based on how many stacks of Force Connection and Ancestral Resolve she has.\n- Her Omicron also provides extra Ultimate Charge for her master, Ahsoka Tano, extra stacks of Purrgil Migration for Ezra, and whenever an ally loses Exile, they gain extra Offense for 2 turns.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Wars game mode and with Sabine's Omicron enabled.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) is being counted as Ahsoka Tano and all allies are considered Spectres.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PADAWANSABINE_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren (7 Stars)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- When there is a Light Side Mandalorian ally in the leader slot, Sabine gains stacks of Ancestral Resolve when she uses a Special ability.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PADAWANSABINE_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Padawan Sabine Wren (Relic 5 or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Ezra Bridger (Exile)\n\n [c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Utilize everything you have learned so far to defeat the enemies and get Ezra home.

EVENT_MARQUEE_PAZVIZSLA_LEGACY_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Paz Vizsla (5-Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\nUtilize your training to defend yourself in a standoff against Imperial Remnant forces!
EVENT_MARQUEE_PAZVIZSLA_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Maul[-][/c]\n[c]- The Armorer[-][/c]\n[c]- The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)[-][/c]\n[c]- Canderous Ordo[-][/c]\n[c]- Paz Vizsla[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Paz generates stacks of [c][ffff33]Heat[-][/c] by using his Basic, [c][ffff33]Stalwart Barrage[-][/c], and first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ancestral Broadside[-][/c]; this buff improves his Potency and also adds different effects to these abilities.\n- When Heat reaches its max of 10 stacks, these abilities will generate [c][ffff33]Overheat[-][/c] instead, which enhances Paz's Offense at the cost of his Tenacity and provides even more bonus effects for his abilities.\n- Paz also generates [c][ffff33]Resilient Defense[-][/c], a stacking taunt effect that focuses the enemy's wrath upon him to keep his team safe. Pairing him alongside another Light Side Mandalorian in the Leader slot allows Paz to gain stacks of Resilient Defense at the start of each encounter.\n- Paz consumes stacks of Overheat to deal increased damage when he uses his second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Vengeful Incineration[-][/c], allowing him to balance his aggression and defensive capabilities as needed.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PAZVIZSLA_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Bo-Katan Kryze[-][/c]\n[c]- The Armorer[-][/c]\n[c]- The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)[-][/c]\n[c]- Sabine Wren[-][/c]\n[c]- Paz Vizsla[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Paz's abilities inflict a variety of debuffs, making Potency a helpful stat if you want to reduce the effectiveness of your opponent.\n- Although Paz benefits from the presence of any Mandalorian ally, his best synergy is alongside other Light Side Mandalorians.\n- His Omicron further enhances his sturdiness while also providing a counter against pesky enemies who refuse to stay defeated.\n- [c][ffff33]Note:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory Battle game mode

EVENT_MARQUEE_PRINCESSKNEESAA_01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Chief Chirpa[-][/c]\n[c]- Logray[-][/c]\n[c]- Paploo[-][/c]\n[c]- Wicket[-][/c]\n[c]- Princess Kneesaa[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Princess Kneesaa is an Attacker Ewok who thrives on critical hits for her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Rock Sling[-][/c]. She can attack up to an additional 2 times if she scores a critical hit. When she uses this ability on her turn, she gains Offense Up. When she uses her Basic and it's not her turn, she deals more damage and inflicts an enemy with Potency Down.\n\n- Use Princess Kneesaa's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Dangar, Ewoks![-][/c] (this is an Ewokese phrase) when Ewoks are being punished with debuffs or low on Health. This ability calls another Ewok ally to assist on a target enemy and inflicts them with Speed Down. This ability also dispels all debuffs on all Ewok allies and recovers Health and grants them Critical Chance Up.\n\n- Princess Kneesaa's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Yub Nub[-][/c] is a good way to punish enemies! She deals damage to all enemies while Stunning a target enemy and reducing their Turn Meter. This also grants her Critical Damage Up, so she can deal more damage every time she scores a critical hit!\n\n- Kneesaa's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Bright Tree Village[-][/c], grants her and Ewok allies Defensive, Offensive, Health, Tenacity, and Potency stat increases. It also calls Kneesaa to assist every time an Ewok ally uses a Special ability. Ewok allies punish enemies by dealing True damage and inflicting enemies with a stack of Damage Over Time when they attack out of turn. Kneesaa also gains buffs and Turn Meter every time an enemy attacks an ally. Kneesaa is also able to protect Ewok allies when they are Dazed or Stunned by granting them additional Defense, and protective buffs like Foresight and Protection Up.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PRINCESSKNEESAA_02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Chief Chirpa[-][/c]\n[c]- Logray[-][/c]\n[c]- Paploo[-][/c]\n[c]- Wicket[-][/c]\n[c]- Princess Kneesaa[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][e7e7e7]While in Territory Wars:[-][/c] Kneesaa starts with 100% Turn Meter and her cooldowns are reduced by 1 every time she attacks. Whenever an Ewok ally assists, they also reduce the enemy's Critical Damage. Kneesaa also recovers Health and Protection when an Ewok ally gains a buff. However, all Ewok allies recover Health and gain Turn Meter for every debuff they are inflicted with.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Territory War game mode.

EVENT_MARQUEE_PUNISHINGONE_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Any Capital Ship\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Executor \n- Hound's Tooth \n- Razor Crest \n- Punishing One\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Quad Laser Cannon[-][/c], deals multiple instances of damage based on certain debuffs on the enemies.\n- Its first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Disruptive Combo[-][/c], can be used to call the right Bounty Hunter ally to assist, which can set up your team for success.\n- With [c][ffff33]Wanted: Dead[-][/c], it can inflict Breach on all enemies and Deathmark to the target enemy and heal itself to full.\n- Its Unique ability, [c][ffff33]JumpMaster 5000[-][/c], allows Punishing One to Stun enemies when its called to assist against the enemy with Buff Immunity or Marked.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PUNISHINGONE_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One (3 Stars or above)\n- Dengar (2 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Executor \n- Hound's Tooth \n- Razor Crest\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With its unique ability, [c][ffff33]JumpMaster 5000[-][/c], Punishing One counters Breached enemies by reducing their Health and Protection recovery and Deathmarked enemies by preventing their Health and Protection recovery.\nIt also enhances the survivability of all Bounty Hunter allies by granting them Defense and recovering Protection if an enemy with Deathmark is defeated. \nPunishing One gains bonus Speed at the start of battle for each Bounty Hunter ally and gains double that amount for each Light Side enemy. \nAdditionally, it can punish enemies by stealing Stealth from them and inflicting Breach.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PUNISHINGONE_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One (4 Stars or above)\n- Dengar (2 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Executor \n- Hound's Tooth \n- Razor Crest\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With its second Special Ability, [c][ffff33]Wanted: Dead[-][/c], Punishing One inflicts Deathmark on the target enemy, which can't be dispelled, evaded or resisted. It also recovers 100% Health with this ability.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PUNISHINGONE_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One (5 Stars or above)\n- Dengar (3 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Executor \n- Hound's Tooth \n- Razor Crest\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Utilize Punishing One's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Disruptive Combo[-][/c], to dispel all buffs from all enemies and remove Speed from Light Side enemies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PUNISHINGONE_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One (6 Stars or above)\n- Dengar (3 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Executor \n- Hound's Tooth \n- Razor Crest\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One can inflict Breach and Deathmark with its second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Disruptive Combo[-][/c], which can be combined with its Basic Ability, [c][ffff33]Quad Laser Cannon[-][/c], to apply multiple instances of damage.\n- Combining Punishing One's potential of dealing multiple instances of damage with Executor's Crew ability, [c][ffff33]Vader's Bounty[-][/c], can inflict a significant amount of Target lock on enemies. This results in dispelling Breach Immunity and Chaff from all enemies, while inflicting Breach and Target Lock on them. 
EVENT_MARQUEE_PUNISHINGONE_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One (7 Stars)\n- Dengar (4 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Executor \n- Hound's Tooth \n- Razor Crest\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Even though Punishing One's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Wanted: Dead[-][/c], has a high cooldown, it can be reduced by its Unique ability, [c][ffff33]JumpMaster 5000[-][/c], whenever enemies attack out of turn. If those enemies are Light Side, the cooldown reduction is tripled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_PUNISHINGONE_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- Punishing One (7 Stars)\n- Razor Crest (5 Stars or above)\n- Executor (4 Stars or above)\n- Hound's Tooth (4 Stars or above)\n- Dengar (Relic 3 or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- When paired with the right allies, Punishing One excels in combat and dismantles enemy fleets. Leverage everything you have learned to punish your opponents!

EVENT_MARQUEE_QUIGGOLD_DESC_REHEAT|Unlock Quiggold!
EVENT_MARQUEE_QUIGGOLD_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Ithano\n- Quiggold\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Quiggold's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Deck Sweeper[-][/c], Steals Taunt (removing it from the target and giving it to Quiggold), while dealing damage and inflicting Defense Down to all enemies.\n- [c][F0FF23]Buccaneer[-][/c], his first Special ability, Steals Foresight and Tenacity Up from enemies and grants them to Pirate allies. If no buffs are stolen, grants Defense Up and Protection Up to Pirate allies.\n- His first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]First Mate[-][/c], gives him Taunt at the start of battle and bonus stats per Pirate ally. He gains Defense Up and Protection Up when he is low on Health. Resisting debuffs grants him Profit, which builds Bulwark and makes him immune to Stun.\n- With his second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Prayer Necklace[-][/c], he gains Retaliate while Taunting based on his Profit stacks. If led by a non-Galactic Legend Pirate and Ithano is present, Quiggold's first defeat consumes the Profit stacks, triggering team recovery and granting Damage Immunity to all allies.
EVENT_MARQUEE_QUIGGOLD_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Quiggold's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Deck Sweeper[-][/c], he removes Taunt from all enemies and gains it himself.\n- He deals Physical damage to all enemies, applying pressure across the board.\n- He also inflicts Defense Down on all enemies, setting them up for stronger follow-up attacks.
EVENT_MARQUEE_QUIGGOLD_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Buccaneer[-][/c], his first Special ability, Steals Foresight and Tenacity Up from all enemies, and grants them to Pirate allies, resetting their duration.\n- Quiggold also applies Tenacity Down and Blind to enemies, which are unavoidable.\n- If no buffs are Stolen, Pirate allies gain Defense Up and Protection Up to enhance their survivability.
EVENT_MARQUEE_QUIGGOLD_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With his first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]First Mate[-][/c], Quiggold begins the battle with Taunt, immediately drawing the enemy's focus. He also gains Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection for each Pirate ally.\n- The first time Quiggold drops below half Health, he gains Defense Up and Protection Up, giving him a crucial survivability boost.\n- Whenever Quiggold gains Taunt, he gains a Bulwark stack for each stack of Profit. With enough Profit stacks, he becomes immune to Stun.

EVENT_MARQUEE_SCORCH_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Grand Moff Tarkin\n- CC-1119 "Appo"\n- CX-2\n- Disguised Clone Trooper\n- RC-1262 "Scorch"\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Scorch's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Exterminate with Extreme Prejudice[-][/c], deals Physical damage to a target enemy while dispelling debuffs from one other Empire ally.\n- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Breaching Charge[-][/c], damages all enemies and inflicts them with Damage Over Time and Off Balance.\n- [c][F0FF23]Entrenched[-][/c], his second Special ability, causes him to Taunt and recover Health and Protection, bolsters his defenses with the new Bulwark buff, and gives Dark Side Clone Trooper allies Protection Up.\n- Bulwark is a stacking buff that grants 150% Defense per stack. However, stacks are removed every time he receives damage.\n- His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Following Protocol[-][/c], enhances Scorch's use of Bulwark, Damage Over Time, and Taunt, while also increasing his synergy with Grand Moff Tarkin. These benefits are further strengthened and extended to other Dark Side Clone Troopers and Empire allies through his Grand Arena Championship Omicron.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SCORCH_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In addition to dealing damage and removing debuffs from a random Empire ally, Scorch's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Exterminate with Extreme Prejudice[-][/c], reduces the cooldowns of one other, non-Galactic Legend Empire ally if target enemy has Order 66.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SCORCH_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Breaching Charge[-][/c], Scorch's first Special ability, inflicts two powerful debuffs on all enemies: Damage Over Time and Off Balance.\n- Use this ability to set up powerful attacks from Disguised Clone Trooper and Lord Vader. 
EVENT_MARQUEE_SCORCH_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Scorch's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Entrenched[-][/c], makes Bulwark undispellable if Grand Moff Tarkin or Lord Vader were in the allied Leader Slot at the start of battle.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SCORCH_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Following Protocol[-][/c], Scorch Taunts at the start of battle.\n- While Scorch is Taunting he has extra Defense and Tenacity.\n- Scorch gains bonus Protection whenever he loses Taunt or a Damage Over Time effect inflicted by him expires.\n- Scorch is immune to Speed Down, Stagger, and Stun while he has Bulwark.\n- If an enemy dispels Scorch's Taunt, that enemy is inflicted with Order 66.\n- If Grand Moff Tarkin is present at the start of battle, Grand Moff Tarkin gains extra Potency and several other bonuses, and Scorch assists whenever he uses an ability.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SCORCH_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Scorch's Omicron, while in the Grand Arenas game mode, increases Scorch's Health, Max Protection, and Tenacity.\n- It also boosts the survivability of Dark Side Clone Trooper and/or Empire allies in a number of ways.\n- Scorch also gains an additional 5 stacks of Bulwark every time he uses [c][F0FF23]Entrenched[-][/c].\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Grand Arenas game mode and with Scorch's Omicron enabled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_SCORCH_M07_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Scorch dutifully carries out his orders, following protocol to the letter.\n- Galactic Legend Lord Vader will be loaned to you for this battle.\n- Utilize this information combined with everything you have learned so far to defeat the Jedi.
