EVENT_MARQUEE_SCOUTTROOPER_V3_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n[c]- Iden Versio[-][/c]\n[c]- Snowtrooper[-][/c]\n[c]- Death Trooper[-][/c]\n[c]- Magmatrooper[-][/c]\n[c]- Scout Trooper[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Scout Trooper's attacks have additional effects while she has Accuracy Up and / or Stealth, and she performs best when working under an Imperial Trooper or Imperial Remnant Leader.\n- Scout Trooper's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Prepared Shot[-][/c], inflicts Accuracy Down and is guaranteed to critically hit if she is Stealthed. If it's her turn, all Imperial Trooper allies gain Potency Up.\n- Scout Trooper's first Special ability, [c][ffff33]Imperial Precision[-][/c], deals damage, dispels all buffs, and inflicts Speed Down on the target enemy. This Speed Down can't be evaded if she is Stealthed, and can't be resisted if she has Accuracy Up.\n- Scout Trooper's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Strategic Assessment[-][/c], calls an ally to assist and supports her allies by gaining Stealth and granting Imperial Trooper allies Critical Damage Up. Additionally, she inflicts all enemies with Expose and Stagger, and Dazes the target enemy.\n- Scout Trooper's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Imperial Vanguard[-][/c], boosts her survivability by Stealthing and healing whenever she is critically hit. While active, she also grants Imperial Trooper allies Critical Chance and Imperial Remnant allies Speed.\n-[c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c]For demonstrative purposes, the enemy Wampa will have her Omicron ability activated.

EVENT_MARQUEE_STAP_LEGACY_DESC|[c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n\nUnlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Required:[-][/c]\n- STAP (5 Stars or above)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n\n- Use what you have learned to defeat these Jedi dogs!
EVENT_MARQUEE_STAP_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n\n5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n\n[c]- General Grievous[-][/c]\n[c]- B1 Battle Droid[-][/c]\n[c]- B2 Super Battle Droid[-][/c]\n[c]- IG-100 MagnaGuard[-][/c]\n[c]- STAP[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n\n- The STAP's Basic ability [c][ffff33]Checkpoint Secure![-][/c] applies Target Lock if the enemy does not have it. If the enemy already has Target Lock, it instead applies a new debuff called [c][ffff33]Pinned[-][/c]. Enemies inflicted with Pinned can't gain bonus Turn Meter and have reduced Speed, but it does not stack with Breached or Speed Down.\n- [c][ffff33]Die Jedi Dogs![-][/c] is the STAP's first Special ability, which is an attack that affects all enemies and can't be evaded by Jedi! This ability will also inflict Provoked on all enemies and will deal double damage to any enemies who are Pinned.\n- Using [c][ffff33]We Need to Recharge![-][/c] will recover Health and Protection for the STAP and grant it five stacks of Overcharge, which lasts for the entire battle. The STAP and an ally will then assist each other in attacking the targeted enemy.\n- Using any ability besides We Need to Recharge! will cause the STAP to dispel one stack of Overcharge from itself, so be sure to use this ability as often as possible to keep your Overcharge stacks up!
EVENT_MARQUEE_STAP_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n\n5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n\n[c]- General Grievous[-][/c]\n[c]- B1 Battle Droid[-][/c]\n[c]- B2 Super Battle Droid[-][/c]\n[c]- IG-100 MagnaGuard[-][/c]\n[c]- STAP[-][/c]\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n\n- [c][ffff33]Single Trooper Aerial Platform[-][/c], isn't just an acronym, it's also the STAP's unique ability! In addition to the extra Defense and Offense Overcharge provides, the STAP will also gain additional Speed with each Overcharge stack.\n- If put on a team with all Separatist Droids, whenever an ally inflicts Pinned or Target Lock on an enemy, they will deal additional damage.\n- The Omicron ability grants the STAP a bonus turn at the start of the battle, and an additional bonus turn the first time each enemy takes their first turn. Additionally, every time the STAP gains a stack of Overcharge, all allies gain extra Health and recover Health and Protection.\n[c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes this battle is being simulated as if it was in the Grand Arenas game mode

EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- The Mandalorian\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Transpierce[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and calls another target Bounty Hunter ally to assist.\n- When fully upgraded, the Mandalorian and the assisting ally gain Critical Damage Up.
EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- The Mandalorian\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The Mandalorian's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Asset Acquisition[-][/c], gives all Scoundrel allies Speed, Tenacity and Critical Chance.\n- If the Mandalorian is in the Leader slot, his Contract is active.\n- Bounty Hunter allies who score critical hits while buffed contribute to the Mandalorian's Contract.\n- After Contract completion: While a Bounty Hunter ally is attacking, they have bonus Offense and Health Steal for each buffed ally.

EVENT_MARQUEE_THEMANDALORIAN_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- 5 per tier (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- The Mandalorian\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Whenever the Mandalorian receives a Reward from a Contract, he also gains his Payout which grants him Critical Damage and the Special ability [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] until the end of battle.\n- If the Mandalorian does not have Critical Chance Up or Critical Damage Up at the start of his turn, [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] can't be used.\n- [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] instantly defeats the target enemy, which can't be evaded. EVENT_MARQUEE_VADERDUELSEND_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Darth Vader (Duel's End)'s Omicron, while in the Grand Arenas, grants all other Empire allies [F0FF23]Hatred[-] until they are defeated.\n- Whenever an Empire Tank ally loses Taunt, they are Marked and recover Health and Protection.\n- Vader gains Speed whenever an Empire ally targets a debuffed enemy with an ability, takes damage from an enemy ability while debuffed, or scores a critical hit (stacking, max 80).\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, this battle is being simulated as if it were in the Grand Arenas game mode with Darth Vader (Duel's End)'s Omicron enabled.

EVENT_MARQUEE_VANE_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Vane\n- Brutus\n- Captain Ithano\n- Kix\n- Hondo\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Vane's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]We Just Want the Credits[-][/c], inflicts Offense Down, and if he has 4+ stacks of Profit, also Dazes the target. He gains Defense per Profit stack for the turn, reinforcing his durability for the entire turn.\n- With his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Put It Down, Little One[-][/c], if Vane's current Health is equal to or higher than the target’s, he Stuns them and gains a stack of Profit. If his Health is lower, he instead recovers Health and gains Evasion Up.\n- [c][F0FF23]It Must Be Fake[-][/c], his second Special ability, allows him to dispel all debuffs from other Pirate allies and takes the same debuffs onto himself. If Defense Down, Evasion Down, or Tenacity Down are dispelled this way, all other Pirate allies gain the opposite buff. He also gains Max Health for each debuff on him.\n- His Unique, [c][F0FF23]Myth of the Outer Rim[-][/c], allows him to Taunt whenever a Pirate ally gains a stack of Profit. If all allies are Pirates, Vane gains Max Health and Max Protection at the start of battle. While Taunting, he supports the weakest ally by equalizing Health and Protection when another Pirate ally takes damage, and Vane gains stacks of Bulwark. Whenever another Pirate ally scores a critical hit while Vane is Taunting, he recovers Health and Protection. Vane also gains Critical Avoidance for each debuff on him, and Protection Up whenever a debuff is dispelled.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VANE_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In addition to dealing damage and inflicting Offense Down to target enemy, Vane's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]We Just Want the Credits[-][/c], provides Defense for each stack of Profit on him.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VANE_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][F0FF23]Put It Down, Little One[-][/c], Vane's first Special ability, works in 2 different ways.\n- First, if Vane's Health percentage is equal to or greater than the target enemy, he gains a stack of Profit and Stuns them.\n- Second, if Vane has lower Health percentage, he recovers Health and gains Evasion Up.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VANE_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Vane's second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]It Must Be Fake[-][/c], makes him a very reliable ally as Vane can dispel all debuffs on all other Pirate allies and he is inflicted with same debuffs. Plus, if Defense Down, Evasion Down, or Tenacity Down were dispelled, all other Pirate allies gain the opposite buff.\n- Gaining debuffs on himself is beneficial part for Vane, as he gains Max Health per debuff on him for the rest of the encounter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VANE_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Myth of the Outer Rim[-][/c], Vane gains Max Health and Max Protection if all allies are Pirates at the start of battle.\n- Whenever another Pirate ally gains a stack of Profit, Vane Taunts.\n- Vane gains Bulwark and helps his allies by equalizing his Health and Protection with the weakest ally whenever another Pirate ally takes damage while Vane is Taunting.\n- While Vane is Taunting, whenever a Pirate ally scores a critical hit, he recovers Health and Protection.\n- Vane has Critical Avoidance per debuff on him.\n- Whenever Vane has a debuff dispelled on him, he gains Protection Up for the rest of the encounter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_VANE_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Vane's Omicron, while in the Territory Battle game mode, grants Pirate allies Max Health, Max Protection, and stacks of Profit at the start of battle.\n- Whenever Vane's Health falls below 25% for the first time, he recovers 50% Health, gains 100% Protection, and Taunts. If he is already Taunting, he also dispels all the debuffs on himself.\n- At the start of his turn, if Vane has at least 5 stacks of Profit, he inflicts Potency Down and Tenacity Down on all enemies, which can't be resisted.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, this battle is being simulated as if it were in the Territory Battle game mode with Vane's Omicron enabled.

It also dispels debuffs on all Bad Batch allies and grants the opposite buff of certain debuffs. Wrecker gains bonuses whenever this ability is used.\n- His first Unique ability, [c][ffff33]You Gotta Be in Front To Win[-][/c], grants Tenacity to Bad Batch allies and Taunt to Wrecker. EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER01_DESC|You will only be able to use Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 in the first encounter.\n\nYou will only be able to use Han Solo, Lando Calrissian, and Chewbacca in the final encounter.\n\nChewbacca can only use his Basic ability in the final encounter.\n\nHan Solo has Carbonite Sickness and is inflicted with Blind for 13 turns at the start of the final encounter.\n\nVictory is achieved by defeating Boba Fett in the final encounter.

EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER04_DESC|Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.\n\nSupreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.\n\nYou will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER04_NAME|Special Mechanics Tier 4
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER05_DESC|Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.\n\nSupreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER05_NAME|Special Mechanics Tier 5
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLLUKE_TIER06_DESC|Jedi Master Luke Skywalker begins the encounter with 100% Ultimate Charge (even if you have not unlocked his Ultimate ability) and must use Heroic Stand during his first turn.\n\nSupreme Leader Kylo Ren has Blinding Rage and starts Blind for 1 turn. Whenever he loses Blind, he gains Rage for 3 turns. Whenever he loses Rage, he gains Blind for 1 turn.\n\nAfter each ally who is not Jedi Master Luke Skywalker takes a turn, they are defeated.\n\nYou will lose this battle if Jedi Master Luke Skywalker is defeated.

EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER01_DESC_V2|Whenever Mace Windu uses an ability, he will gain one stack of Shatterpoint for each Galactic Republic Jedi ally. When Mace Windu has 20 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.\n\nMace Windu cannot be defeated in this encounter.\n\nDefeat Agen Kolar, Kit Fisto, and Saesee Tiin to be victorious.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER01_NAME|Special Mechanics Tier 1
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER02_DESC_V2|Whenever Mace Windu uses an ability, he will gain one stack of Shatterpoint. When Mace Windu has 5 or more stacks of Shatterpoint, his next Smite will deal double massive damage.

EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER03_DESC|You will only use Darth Vader in the first encounter.\n\nYou will only use Emperor Palpatine in the final encounter.\n\nBring Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker below 25% health in the first encounter to proceed to the final encounter.
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER03_NAME|Special Mechanics Tier 3
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER04_DESC|While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.\n\nRey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.\n\nSith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER04_NAME|Special Mechanics Tier 4
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER05_DESC|While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.\n\nBen Solo cannot be defeated while Rey is over 50% health.\n\nRey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.\n\nSith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER05_NAME|Special Mechanics Tier 5
EVENT_MECHANICS_GLPALP_TIER06_DESC|While Ben Solo is active, Rey can't be defeated.\n\nBen Solo cannot be defeated while Rey is over 50% health.\n\nIf Sith Eternal Emperor's turn begins with Ben Solo defeated, at the end of the turn Ben Solo revives with 51% of his Max Health.\n\nRey has leadership bonuses granted to her by several of the Jedi spirits who came to her in her hour of need: General Kenobi, Jedi Knight Anakin, Luminara Undulli, Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Grand Master Yoda, Qui-Gon Jinn, Ahsoka Tano, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker.\n\nSith Eternal Emperor has access to his Ultimate ability (even if you have not unlocked it) and gains 10% Ultimate Charge whenever Ben Solo or Rey take damage, and 34% at the end of each of his turns. (NOTE: This is different from the player-obtainable version)

EVENT_REY_GALACTICLEGEND_DESC|Earn Rey!
EVENT_REY_GALACTICLEGEND_M01_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (8x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Rey (Jedi Training, see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- Resistance characters\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The First Order uses counter-attacks and assist calls often. Use single-target abilities to avoid mass retaliation.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Rey (Jedi Training) will have her name and appearance altered for this battle.[-][/c]
EVENT_REY_GALACTICLEGEND_M02_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (4x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Rey (Jedi Training, see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- Resistance characters\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Attempt to critically hit General Hux as often as possible to minimize the uptime of his [c][FFFF33]Dominance[-][/c] effect.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Rey (Jedi Training) will have her name and appearance altered for this battle.[-][/c]

EVENT_WEB_OF_HATE_TIER01_ERA_DESC_V2|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Stormtrooper Luke (Era Level 45)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Chewbacca\n- Stormtrooper Han\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Han and Luke have infiltrated the Death Star and have stolen the armor of Stormtroopers on a mission to save the Princess.\n- Take on Imperial Officers and Stormtrooper enemies and inflict Distracted 10 times to achieve victory.\n- Whenever Stormtrooper Luke uses an ability, Distract a random enemy who didn't already have it for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.\n- Whenever an enemy Taunts, they gain a stack of [c][F0FF23]Focusing[-][/c], and whenever an enemy is defeated, all other enemies gain a stack of [c][F0FF23]Focusing[-][/c].\n- Whenever an enemy is defeated, a new one will take its place.\n- Stormtrooper Luke being defeated will result in immediate loss.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Focusing:[-][/c] +25% Offense and +15 Speed per stack until the end of battle[-][/c]
EVENT_WEB_OF_HATE_TIER02_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Yoda & Chewie (Era Level 55)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Tarfful\n- Clone Scout Trooper\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Defeating the enemy in the second encounter as quickly as possible is the key to victory.\n- Tarfful or Yoda & Chewie being defeated will result in immediate loss.\n- Clone Scout Trooper allies can't be defeated.\n- The Clone Scout Troopers are not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.
EVENT_WEB_OF_HATE_TIER03_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Darth Vader (Duel's End) (Era Level 70)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Obi-Wan can't be defeated and he will start the battle with High Ground. Each time he attacks out of turn, he gains 2 Speed (stacking) and 2% Offense (stacking) until the end of battle and he increases Darth Vader (Duel's End)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]You Will Always Lose[-][/c] to max.\n- Whenever Vader inflicts Damage over Time, he gains a stack of [c][ffff33]Vendetta.[-][/c]\n- Whenever Vader uses [c][ffff33]Your Weakness Still Remains[-][/c], he recovers 10% Health. Whenever he uses [c][ffff33]Then You Will Die[-][/c], he dispels all buffs from Obi-Wan.\n- Whenever Vader gains 10 stacks of Vendetta, he removes High Ground off Obi-Wan and he gains it himself.\n- Whenever Vader begins his turn with High Ground, he resets the cooldown of his Special ability, [c][ffff33]You Will Always Lose[-][/c].\n- Once Vader uses his Special ability, [c][ffff33]You Will Always Lose[-][/c], victory will be achieved.\n- Both Obi-Wan and Vader are immune to Ability Block for this event.\n- Darth Vader (Duel's End) being defeated will result in immediate loss.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Vendetta:[-][/c] +20% Max Health and Potency, and at 10 stacks, gain High Ground
EVENT_WEB_OF_HATE_TIER04_DESC_V2|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Maul (Hate-Fueled)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Through passion, I gain strength.\n- Through strength, I gain power.\n- Through power, I gain victory.[-][/c]

Bolster your collection of Characters and help your Guild toward being the best, most powerful, and wealthiest within the Cantina!\n\n- Only Guild Leaders and Guild Officers may start a Guild Raid\n- Starting a Guild Raid requires Raid Tickets\n- Raid Tickets are produced through "Personal Guild Contribution" Daily Activity\n- At raid end, all guild members receive the same Guild Rewards, delivered via Inbox\n- Guild Rewards are determined by progress on the guild reward track\n- Individual player rewards are determined by progress on the personal reward track\n- Guild Raids have multiple Difficulty Tiers or Difficulty Levels (not both)\n- Difficulty Tiers or Levels may have different settings; pay careful attention to these\n- For raids with Difficulty Tiers, the tier is chosen by Guild Leaders or Officers when the raid starts\n- For raids with Difficulty Levels, the level is selected by the player before each raid attempt\n- Higher Difficulty Levels apply a multiplier to the total Raid Points earned in that attempt\n- Raid Point progress persists for the entire Guild\n- Boss ability cooldowns persist per individual player\n\nGood luck!

FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_BATCH_01|[f0ff23]Batch Manage[-] allows you to sell and upgrade many mods all at once. Use a saved Filter to speed up your mod workflow.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_BATCH_UPGRADE_01|[f0ff23]Reveal All Secondary Stats[-] will automatically upgrade mods to the minimum level that identifies all four secondary stats. This is particularly useful when upgrading multiple mods of different rarities.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_ENHANCE_01|Enhance Mod is a one-stop location for all your mod tinkering needs. Here you can upgrade, slice, calibrate, and sell an individual mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_ENHANCE_02|Remember, mod slicing is only available on Mk V and VI mods. Mod calibration requires a MK VI mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_01|Mod Filters help you find mods that meet your exact stat and attribute needs.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_02|Besides the basic options, you can also filter for mods that [f0ff23]include or exclude[-] specific stats, mods that have all [f0ff23]secondary stats revealed[-], and mods with a preferred [f0ff23]slice count[-] or [f0ff23]slice quality[-].
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_FILTERS_03|Additionally, you can [f0ff23]save mod filters[-]. This handy function allows you to quickly retrieve mods when equipping, selling, or upgrading.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_01|Aha! It's time for some advanced mod alteration techniques. [f0ff23]Mod Calibration[-] will let you [f0ff23]transfer a slice[-] between secondary stats.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_02|You start by selecting a stat for [f0ff23]slice removal[-]. It's best to [f0ff23]choose a stat you don't want[-] on this mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_03|Once you've selected a stat, tap this button to start. Calibration will [f0ff23]remove[-] a random slice from your selected stat and [f0ff23]apply a new slice[-] to a random stat.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_03_PC|Once you've selected a stat, click this button to start. Calibration will [f0ff23]remove[-] a random slice from your selected stat and [f0ff23]apply a new slice[-] to a random stat.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_04|Calibration is a [f0ff23]volatile[-] process. When a slice is reapplied, it could go back to the same stat you remove it from.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_05|Don't forget, you'll need [f0ff23]Micro Attenuators[-] to perform a calibration.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_REROLL_06|There's also a [f0ff23]limit[-] on the number of times a mod can be calibrated. Earn more [f0ff23]calibration attempts[-] by slicing the mod.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_01|Slicing a mod always make it stronger, but how much stronger you ask? The details matter!
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_02|Each secondary stat visualizes its [f0ff23]slices[-] here. The bigger the bar, the closer the slice is to its [f0ff23]maximum possible[-] value.
FEATUREINTRO_MOD_TU30_SLICE_03|Additionally, [f0ff23]slice quality[-] will average together all the slices for a stat and give you a percentage value. Higher values mean the stat is closer to [f0ff23]peak performance[-].
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_01_TEXT|Welcome back, Galactic Champion!\n\nHave you heard about Squad Tournaments?
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_02_TEXT|They're a new addition to the Cantina where you compete with other Galactic Champions to earn [c][f0ff23]extremely rare rewards[-][/c]!
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_03_TEXT|Would you like to go to the Squad Tournament now?
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_03_TITLE|ENTER THE SQUAD TOURNAMENT
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_MATCHMAKING_01_TEXT|Looks like you've set your Defensive Squad and you're almost ready to go!
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_MATCHMAKING_02_TEXT|Scoring within a Squad Tournament is different than other locations within the Cantina.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_MATCHMAKING_03_TEXT|Tournament Ranking Points are earned for defeating each of your opponent's Characters.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_MATCHMAKING_04_TEXT|You also earn them for each of your surviving Characters.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_MATCHMAKING_05_TEXT|Go ahead and choose your opponent now.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_01_TEXT|At the start of a Squad Tournament, all of your Characters are granted a status of [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c]
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_02_TEXT|A Character with a [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status means they are able to enter Battle freely.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_03_TEXT|Each Character participating in a Battle will consume their [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status, requiring a refresh for additional Battles.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_04_TEXT|Characters requiring a refresh may still Battle for a specified cost. You'll be asked to confirm your selection if any cost is involved.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_05_TEXT|The displayed Roster Refresh countdown is to notify you of when all of your Characters will be granted the [c][99ff33]READY![-][/c] status again.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_06_TEXT|Once you've configured your desired Squad, you'll immediately be taken into the Battle.
FEATUREINTRO_SQUADTOURNAMENT_PREBATTLE_07_TEXT|Good luck and may you be victorious!

FTUE_COLISEUM_01|Welcome to the [f0ff23]COLISEUM[-]! Battle strange beasts and dangerous machines from across the galaxy to earn [f0ff23]ERA-EXCLUSIVE REWARDS[-]!

FTUE_COMBAT_SPEED_01|Units take turns based on their [f0ff23]SPEED[-]. The blue [f0ff23]SPEED BAR[-] (under the health bar) indicates how close a unit is to their next turn.
FTUE_CONQUEST_01|You've shown some skill, but are you ready for [c][f0ff23]CONQUEST[/c][-]? If you have it in you to push to the end, you will earn valuable [c][f0ff23]REWARD CRATES[/c][-].
FTUE_CONQUEST_02|You must prove your worth by completing easier difficulties before attempting harder ones. You can preview the challenges that await you before committing to a difficulty.
FTUE_CONQUEST_03|On the left, you can access [c][f0ff23]SECTORS[/c][-] - which unlock in sequence. On the right is helpful information related to your progress in the event.
FTUE_CONQUEST_04|Tap on the info button to see what challenges await you! Once you're ready, select [c][f0ff23]COMMIT[/c][-]. Unless you're afraid of the challenge...
FTUE_CONQUEST_04_PC|Click on the info button to see what challenges await you! Once you're ready, select [c][f0ff23]COMMIT[/c][-]. Unless you're afraid of the challenge...

FTUE_CONQUEST_06|Earn [c][f0ff23]CONQUEST KEYCARDS[/c][-] through victories in combat and by completing [c][f0ff23]FEATS[/c][-]! The more you earn, the more spoils you can collect on the way, and the better your reward at the end of the event.

FTUE_CONQUEST_08|[c][f0ff23]CONSUMABLES[/c][-] are powerful items of limited duration. You can have one of each category active at a time, and your stockpile of them expires at the end of the Conquest event. Don't hold back!
FTUE_CONQUEST_09|After each victory, your allies lose [c][f0ff23]STAMINA[/c][-], reducing their stats. Stamina refills over time, and you can use [c][f0ff23]STIM PACKS[/c][-] from Conquest Shipments to recover faster!

FURY_CLASS_INTERCEPTOR_LIGHTSPEED_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 7\n\n[b]SHIP[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Ability Tier 7

The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. GENERAL_SKYWALKER_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Her reputation as a leader and powerful wielder of the light side of the Force was known by many even in remote places across the galaxy. Although she walked away from the Jedi Order, she continued to travel the stars and practice the many lessons she learned during her time there in order to help others. She was a pivotal figure during many important events of the Clone Wars and after the fall of the Republic.

GLHONDO_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION_V2|Clever, unpredictable, and unburdened by a traditional moral compass, Hondo Ohnaka carved out his legacy as the flamboyant leader of the Ohnaka Gang during the Clone Wars. A Weequay pirate from Florrum, Hondo thrived amidst shifting galactic powers—betraying the Separatists one day and striking deals with the Jedi the next. His reputation for survival is unmatched, often escaping situations that destroyed far more powerful figures. Even as the Empire rose and fell, Hondo resurfaced time and again, inserting himself into conflicts not out of loyalty, but opportunity. Though few would call him trustworthy, many found themselves relying on his expertise when it mattered most. Hondo built his fortune—and his myth—not with the Force or an army, but with instinct, improvisation, and impeccable timing.

INBOX_10TH_ANNIVERSARY_MESSAGE|Greetings, Holotable Heroes!\n\nTen years. A full decade of strategy, triumph, and unforgettable battles across the galaxy far, far away. From the first clash on the holotables to the countless victories that followed, you have been the heart and soul of Galaxy of Heroes.\n\nTogether, we have faced galactic wars, united guilds, forged legends, and built a community stronger than the armor of a Mandalorian. Through every update, event, and thrilling moment, your passion and dedication have kept the Force alive and blazing brighter than ever.\n\nAs we celebrate this monumental 10th Anniversary, we want to thank every player who has made this journey possible. You’ve turned Galaxy of Heroes into more than a game, it’s a legacy.\n\nPlease accept these special anniversary gifts as a token of our deepest gratitude. Here’s to the next chapter in our shared saga, to new heroes, greater challenges, and the adventures yet to come.\n\nThank you for an incredible decade. The Force will always be with you, Holotable Heroes!
INBOX_10TH_ANNIVERSARY_SUBJECT|A Decade of Heroes! Celebrating 10 Incredible Years!
INBOX_2ND_ANNIV_GIFT_MESSAGE|Greetings, Holotable Heroes!\n\nStar Wars: Galaxy of Heroes has reached its 2nd anniversary! Thanks to the tremendous support, commitment, and passion of players like you, this past year has seen the game become more popular, more successful, and bigger than ever.\n\nOn behalf of the entire Capital Games team, we want you to know how humbled and grateful we are for the opportunity to work on this game. We strive every day to make the game better so we may earn your continued support and participation.\n\nPlease enjoy these free gifts as a celebration of our first two years together and we look forward to many more exciting years with you in the Cantina!\n\nThank you!\nThe Capital Games Team

INBOX_SITH_RAID_CHANGES_MESSAGE|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe are reworking the Sith Triumvirate Raid to make non-Heroic tiers faster and increase the rewards in the upper tiers. Rewards for Tier 6 and above now include Mod Salvage and a better chance to get the gear you need to progress to the next tier. We are removing some of the Challenge gear from rewards that has been stacking up in your inventory because you’re already earning it in Daily Challenges.\n\nBoth Nihilus' Annihilate and Traya's lightsabers are hard to anticipate, so we are adjusting these mechanics to be more predictable.\n\n- Nihilus' Basic attack no longer reduces cooldowns in any tier, including Heroic\n\n- Traya's lightsabers no longer dispel or apply debuffs in Tiers 1-6 (this mechanic is still active in the Heroic Tier)\n\nWe're also reducing Raid boss health across the board in every tier except Heroic. As guilds work their way up to Heroic, they will be able to beat the raids they're already doing faster and get a bit of encouragement to give the next tier a shot.\n\nFind the full details on the official Star Wars Galaxy of Heroes Forums!

When he uses the Force to save a fellow worker, Cal becomes the target of the Inquisitors, who seek to stamp out all remaining Jedi. Cal and former Jedi Master, Cere Junda, discover a holocron listing force-sensitive children in an ancient vault on Bogano and seek to keep the information safe from the ruthless Inquisitorius.\n\nThough Cal and team have drifted apart in the five years since securing the holocron, the young Jedi Knight continues to fight the Empire as the galaxy descends further into darkness.

LEADERABILITY_BAYLANSKOLL_TIER_06_DESC_V2|At the start of battle, Baylan Skoll gains 30% Offense and all Mercenary allies gain 20% Tenacity, and 1 stack of Soldier of Fortune for each active Mercenary ally. The first time each other Mercenary ally falls below 50% Health, Baylan Skoll Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled or prevented.\n\nWhile Taunting, Baylan has +50% Defense, +30% Tenacity and Retribution until Taunt expires.
LEADERABILITY_BAYLANSKOLL_TIER_07_DESC_V2|At the start of battle, Baylan Skoll gains 30% Offense and all Mercenary allies gain 20% Tenacity, and 1 stack of Soldier of Fortune for each active Mercenary ally. Then, Mercenary allies double their current stacks of Soldier of Fortune.\n\nWhenever a Mercenary ally gains a stack of Ransom, all Mercenary allies gain 1% Defense (stacking) until the end of encounter and recover 5% Health and Protection.\n\nWhenever a Mercenary ally has Health Steal Up, they gain 25% Critical Damage and Protection Up (50%) until Health Steal Up expires.\n\nWhenever a Mercenary ally is Dazed or Stunned, they dispel it and all Mercenary allies recover 25% Health and Protection.\n\nIf there are no enemy Galactic Legends, whenever a Mercenary ally is inflicted with Fear:\n- All Mercenary allies gain 50% bonus Max Protection and Offense (stacking), until the end of encounter\n- Dispel all debuffs on all Mercenary allies and they recover 50% Health and Protection\n- Deal True damage to all enemies, which can't be evaded or defeat them, Blind them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted, and inflict them with Healing Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted\n\nWhenever a Mercenary ally assists or attacks out of turn, they gain 2 stacks of Soldier of Fortune. The first time each other Mercenary ally falls below 50% Health, Baylan Skoll Taunts for 2 turns, which can't be dispelled or prevented.\n\nWhile Taunting, Baylan has +50% Defense, +30% Tenacity and Retribution until Taunt expires.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas:[-][/c] At the start of battle, Baylan Taunts for 2 turns.\n\nIf there is a non-Galactic Legend Ahsoka enemy, Mercenary allies ignore Protection, are immune to critical hits and Healing Immunity, and they Expose all enemies and inflict them with Healing Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted at the start of each of their turns.\n\nIf there are no Galactic Legend enemies, whenever Baylan Taunts, he inflicts all enemies with Doubt for 1 turn.\n\nIf Baylan is not Taunting, whenever an enemy takes a bonus turn they are inflicted with Healing Immunity for 3 turns, which can't be dispelled.\n\nWhenever an enemy gains Foresight, they dispel it and are inflicted with Buff Immunity for 2 turns instead.\n\nWhenever an enemy gains Inspire, reduce all enemy's Evasion by 50% (stacking) until the end of encounter, and all Mercenary allies gain 80% Defense (stacking) and 50% bonus Protection (stacking) until the end of encounter.\n\nDefeated enemies can't be revived and Mercenary allies can't be instantly defeated.

LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_06_DESC_V2|At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies:\n\n- All Pirate and Smuggler allies are immune to Fear and they gain Foresight for 1 turn\n- Whenever a Pirate ally with Retribution uses a Basic ability, they ignore that enemy's Protection\n- Whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter\n- Whenever Maz gains a stack of Profit, all other Pirate allies gain 1 stack of Profit until the end of the encounter\n- If there were no Galactic Legend enemies at the start of battle: If there is an enemy Sith, Pirate allies take reduced damage from percent Health effects, and whenever they target an enemy Sith with an ability, they deal 300% more damage and ignore Protection, and at the start of each Sith enemy's turn, all Pirate allies gain Foresight for 1 turn
LEADERABILITY_MAZKANATA_TIER_07_DESC_V2|At the start of each encounter and if there were no Galactic Legend allies:\n\n- All Pirate and Smuggler allies are immune to Fear and they gain Foresight for 1 turn\n- Whenever Maz gains a stack of Profit, all other Pirate allies gain 1 stack of Profit until the end of the encounter\n- Whenever a Pirate ally with Retribution uses a Basic ability, they ignore that enemy's Protection\n- Whenever an enemy uses a Basic ability, all Pirate allies gain 5% Turn Meter\n- If there were no Galactic Legend enemies at the start of battle: If there is an enemy Sith, Pirate allies take reduced damage from percent Health effects, and whenever they target an enemy Sith with an ability, they deal 300% more damage and ignore Protection, and at the start of each Sith enemy's turn, all Pirate allies gain Foresight for 1 turn\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas and there are no Galactic Legend allies:[-][/c] Pirate and Smuggler allies gain 30% Max Health and Max Protection, and 30 Speed.\n\nWhenever a Pirate ally scores a critical hit, they gain 5% Tenacity (stacking) until the end of encounter.\n\nIf a Pirate ally is instantly defeated by a non-Galactic Legend enemy, that enemy is Deathmarked for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. LEADERABILITY_QUEENAMIDALA_TIER_06_DESC|All Allies have +20% Defense and +15% Max Health and Max Protection.\n\nAt the start of battle, if all allies are Galactic Republic and there are no Galactic Legend allies:\n\n- Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, they are inflicted with Damage Over Time for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted and remove 10% Turn Meter from all enemies, which can't be resisted.\n- At the start of each ally's turn, they gain 3% Critical Damage (stacking) for each stack of Heal Over Time they have and +3% Offense (stacking) for each stack of Protection Over Time they have, until the end of their turn.\n- Whenever an enemy critically hits an ally, that enemy has -5% Critical Damage, Defense, and Offense (stacking, max -50%), until the end of the encounter, which can't be resisted.
LEADERABILITY_QUEENAMIDALA_TIER_07_DESC|All allies have +20% Defense and +15% Max Health and Max Protection.\n\nAt the start of battle, if all allies are Galactic Republic and there are no Galactic Legend allies:\n\n- Whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, they are inflicted with Damage Over Time for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted and remove 10% Turn Meter from all enemies, which can't be resisted.\n- At the start of each ally's turn, they gain 3% Critical Damage (stacking) for each stack of Heal Over Time they have and +3% Offense (stacking) for each stack of Protection Over Time they have, until the end of their turn.\n- Whenever an enemy critically hits an ally, that enemy has -5% Critical Damage, Defense, and Offense (stacking, max -50%), until the end of the encounter, which can't be resisted.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas and if there are no Galactic Legend allies and all allies are Galactic Republic:[-][/c] Whenever an ally uses a Special ability, they gain bonuses based on their role:\n\n- [c][B5E7F5]Attackers:[-][/c] Gain Offense Up for 2 turns and call another random ally to assist, dealing 20% more damage\n- [c][B5E7F5]Healers and Supports:[-][/c] Gain Protection Up (50%, stacking) and Speed Up for 3 turns\n- [c][B5E7F5]Tanks:[-][/c] Recover 25% Health and Protection

MASTER_KENOBI_LIGHTSPEED_I_DESC|The journey to Jedi Mastery demands courage, sacrifice, and the strength of allies. Instantly elevate Mace Windu, Aayla Secura, Bo-Katan Kryze, Qui-Gon Jinn, IG-100 MagnaGuard, Clone Sergeant – Phase I, Cad Bane, and CC-2224 "Cody" to [b]7 Stars, Level 85, Ability Tier 7, and Relic Level 5[/b] to empower the foundation of Galactic Legend Jedi Master Kenobi!\n\nPurchase limit: 1
MASTER_KENOBI_LIGHTSPEED_I_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 7

MASTER_KENOBI_LIGHTSPEED_I_PROMO|7-Stars & Relic 5!
MASTER_KENOBI_LIGHTSPEED_I_TEXT|Every legend begins with those who stood beside them! Power up the essential allies who forge the legacy of Jedi Master Kenobi with the Jedi Master Kenobi Lightspeed I & II!
MASTER_KENOBI_LIGHTSPEED_I_TITLE|The Path to a Master

MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER01_DESC|\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Grogu can't gain Turn Meter, or be damaged, debuffed, or defeated.\n- Grogu is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.\n- The 501st Veteran will sacrifice everything to protect his team; removing him from the field will be crucial to your success.\n- Be cautious of the 501st Captain's high damage potential.\n- The Dark Side clouds everything and all Jedi will lose Foresight when Clone Troopers use their abilities.

MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER02_DESC|\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The Weequay Pirates will stealth frequently; defeat them quickly when the opportunity arises.\n- The Nikto Bruisers and Nikto Thugs will heal and assist each other, so thinning their ranks will ease the battle.
MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER02_NAME|The Pirate
MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER03_DESC|\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- IG-12 & Grogu or The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) being defeated will result in immediate loss.\n- The Granted ability, [c][FFFF33]Lower the Gate, Arfive[-][/c], allows all allies to fully recover their Health and Protection, gain 100% Turn Meter, and reset their cooldowns.\n- However, using Lower the Gate, Arfive, before The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) completes his fifth turn while fighting against Imperial Armored Commando - Wave 1 and Wave 3 will increase the Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense by 40% per remaining turn for the Imperial Armored Commando - Wave 2 and Wave 4 respectively.
MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER03_NAME|The Return (Part 1)
MISSION_BATTLE_FOR_MANDALORE_TIER04_DESC|\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) will be loaned to you for this tier.\n- Bo-Katan (Mand'alor), IG-12 & Grogu, or The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) being defeated will result in immediate loss.\n- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon can only receive True damage unless he is inflicted with Armor Shred, then any damage type will work.\n- Dark Trooper Moff Gideon is immune to Ability Block and whenever he uses a Special ability, he removes Armor Shred, dispels all debuffs on himself, and uses his Basic ability.

MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER01_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star, 40,000+ Power\n- Anakin's Eta-2 Starfighter\n(See [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- Galactic Republic Capital Ship\n- Galactic Republic Ships\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- 50,000+ Power\n- Crew Relic Level 3\n- Crew Mods rarity Mk VI\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The Soulless One will inflict [c][F0FF23]Marked[-][/c] on the weakest other Droid ally at the start of each ship's turn, making itself difficult to target.\n- Use [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c] effectively in order to weather the storm of Buzz Droids from enemy Vulture Droids.\n- Make effective use of attacks that damage all enemies to avoid being overwhelmed.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Anakin's Delta-7B Starfighter will replace your version of Anakin's Eta-2 Starfighter in this battle.\n- This version of Anakin's Delta-7b has the same abilities as Anakin's Eta-2 and will inherit its stats from the version of Anakin's Eta-2 you bring into battle.\n- This ship is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]
MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER01_NAME|The Battle Up There
MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER02_DESC_V4|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star, 17,700+ Power\n- Ahsoka Tano (Snips)\n- C-3PO\n- General Kenobi\n- Padmé Amidala\n- Shaak Ti\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- 22,000+ Power\n- Relic Level 3\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- General Grievous can't be targeted until both Droidekas have been defeated.\n- While the Droidekas' shields are active, they have [c][F0FF23]Damage Immunity[-][/c].\n- Defeat IG-100 MagnaGuards in order to drop the Droidekas' shields, allowing your squad to damage and defeat them. New MagnaGuards will appear when the Droidekas redeploy their shields.\n- Defeating the Droidekas efficiently will be key to victory; the longer the fight goes on, the more Max Health Grievous gains from his Unique ability.[-][/c]
MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER02_NAME|General Conflict
MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER03_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- General Skywalker\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- General Skywalker's Special abilities work in tandem. Use these combinations to maintain an edge over Asajj Ventress in this one-on-one duel.[-][/c]
MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER03_NAME|Seeing Red
MISSION_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_TIER04_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star, 17,700+ Power\n- Asajj Ventress\n- B1 Battle Droid\n- B2 Super Battle Droid\n- Droideka\n- IG-100 MagnaGuard\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- 22,000+ Power\n- Relic Level 3\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The 501st Clone Troopers can't lose Health while General Skywalker is [c][F0FF23]Advancing[-][/c], but they can lose Protection.\n- General Skywalker and the 501st can punish attacks from your squad that damage all enemies; use these attacks wisely.\n- Determining the best order of defeating the clones when General Skywalker is in [c][F0FF23]Cover[-][/c] is key to victory.[-][/c]

MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_FARMERLUKE_TIER06_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]\n- Luke Skywalker (7-stars),\n- Princess Leia (7-stars),\n- Stormtrooper Han (7-stars),\n- R2-D2 (7-stars)\n\nDefeat the Imperial forces blockading the Millennium Falcon![-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_TIER01_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]\n- Mission Vao (2-stars),\n- Zaalbar (2-stars)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 6+\n\nStranded on the Sith-occupied world of Taris, Revan teamed up with the street-smart Mission Vao and her friend Zaalbar. Together they embarked on a mission to rescue a captive Jedi, but before they could reach her, a fearsome foe barred their way.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_TIER02_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]\n- Mission Vao (3-stars),\n- Zaalbar (3-stars),\n- Bastila Shan (3-stars)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 6+\n\nAfter defeating the Rancor, Revan and the companions found the criminals that had abducted the Jedi Bastila Shan. Before Revan could free her, Bastila escaped from her captors. Together they faced the gangs that had held her.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_TIER03_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]\n- Mission Vao (4-stars),\n- Zaalbar (4-stars),\n- Bastila Shan (4-stars),\n- T3-M4 (4-stars)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 7+\n\nAfter acquiring a modified droid named T3-M4, Revan and the companions infiltrated a Sith base on Taris. There, they hoped to steal the codes necessary to escape the planet. But first they would have to face the forces stationed within the base.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_TIER04_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]\n- Mission Vao (5-stars),\n- Zaalbar (5-stars),\n- Bastila Shan (5-stars),\n- T3-M4 (5-stars),\n- Jolee Bindo (5-stars)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 7+\n\nJoined by the Jedi Jolee Bindo, Revan and the companions wound up on Tatooine. There a group of miners were being attacked by the native Sand People. Faced with the choice of defending the defenseless or letting them be taken captive, Revan moved to face the Sand People aggressors.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_TIER05_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]\n- Mission Vao (6-stars),\n- Zaalbar (6-stars),\n- Bastila Shan (6-stars),\n- T3-M4 (6-stars),\n- Jolee Bindo (6-stars)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 8+\n\nOn the Sith world of Korriban, Revan heard stories of the tomb of an ancient Sith Lord. Within were said to be dark secrets and a terrible evil, so the Sith of Korriban sought to plunder the tomb for themselves. Revan resolved to explore the tomb, not knowing that deep within would lie a great test...[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_HEROJOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTREVAN_TIER06_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Requirements:[-][/c]\n- Mission Vao (7-stars),\n- Zaalbar (7-stars),\n- Bastila Shan (7-stars),\n- T3-M4 (7-stars),\n- Jolee Bindo (7-stars)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended Gear Level:[-][/c] 9+\n\nAfter defeating the Sith that sought to plunder the tomb, Revan turned to leave the dark place behind. However the fierce battle between force users had attracted something evil and hungry...[-][/c]

MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER01_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Darth Revan\n\n[c][ACFEFF]At the beginning of the story, Revan was stranded on a world called Taris. Revan sought glory by seeking to be the champion of the local fighting arena. But to win, the famous champion Bendak Starkiller would have to be defeated.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tip:[-][/c]\n- Some units have a [c][F0FF23]Lore[-][/c] entry in this event which can be inspected by tapping the Lore icon.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER01_DESC_V2_PC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Darth Revan\n\n[c][ACFEFF]At the beginning of the story, Revan was stranded on a world called Taris. Revan sought glory by seeking to be the champion of the local fighting arena. But to win, the famous champion Bendak Starkiller would have to be defeated.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tip:[-][/c]\n- Some units have a [c][F0FF23]Lore[-][/c] entry in this event which can be inspected by clicking the Lore icon.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER02_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Bastila Shan (Fallen) (4-Star)\n- Canderous Ordo (4-Star)\n- Carth Onasi (4-Star)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Gear level VII+\n\nHaving successfully escaped Taris, Revan's team made for Dantooine. In a hidden Jedi Enclave there, Revan was retrained in the ways of the Force. As a test, the Jedi Masters sent Revan out to find a Padawan who was in danger of falling to the dark side.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER03_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Bastila Shan (Fallen) (5-Star)\n- Canderous Ordo (5-Star)\n- Carth Onasi (5-Star)\n- HK-47 (5-Star)\n- Juhani (5-Star)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Gear level VIII+\n\nAfter much effort, Revan's team managed to find what they had been searching for: a fragment of a lost galactic Star Map. But as they exited the cave of the krayt dragon, they ran into the bounty hunter Calo Nord, who had been hired to stop them.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER04_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Bastila Shan (Fallen) (6-Star)\n- Canderous Ordo (6-Star)\n- Carth Onasi (6-Star)\n- HK-47 (6-Star)\n- Juhani (6-Star)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Gear level IX+\n\nDuring their search of Korriban, Revan's allies plundered multiple tombs of Sith Lords. But one tomb in particular, the Tomb of Ajunta Pall, held a legendary weapon. Tempted by this powerful artifact, Revan would have to face the spirit of the ancient Sith Lord himself![-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER05_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Bastila Shan (Fallen) (7-Star)\n- Canderous Ordo (7-Star)\n- Carth Onasi (7-Star)\n- HK-47 (7-Star)\n- Juhani (7-Star)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Gear level X+\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nOn the ocean world of Manaan, Revan needed data kept deep within the Sith Embassy. To get it, Revan's team would have to fight their way through the Sith forces and their powerful defenses.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER06_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Juhani (7-Star)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Gear level X+\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nDuring their journey, Bastila had been abducted by Revan's nemesis, Darth Malak. Unable to endure the endless torment, Bastila was broken and fell to the dark side. Revan and the Jedi companions sought to tie up this loose end and potentially regain their useful ally.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_TIER07_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n- Bastila Shan (Fallen) (7-Star)\n- Canderous Ordo (7-Star)\n- HK-47 (7-Star)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Gear level X+\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nThe stage was set. Revan had journeyed across the galaxy and recovered all the fragments of the ancient Star Map. Before traveling to the Sith's secret weapon, the star forge, and facing Darth Malak, Revan knew a final battle was coming. Jedi fools and the other loyalists to the Republic would either have to be turned to the dark side… or crushed by its power.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER01_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nCal Kestis (Gear XII+)\n\nThe Inquisitors investigate Bracca where they find Cal Kestis, a Jedi Padawan in hiding.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Use the granted ability [c][ffff33]Dodge Roll[-][/c] to remove all stacks of Purge\n- At the start of Second Sister's turn Cal gains a stack of Purge\n- Second Sister begins the battle with 100% Turn Meter[c][F0FF23]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER02_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nCal Kestis (Gear XII+)\nSaw Gerrera (Gear XII+)\nTarfful (Gear XII+)\n\nCal, Saw Gerrera, and Tarfful fight to free the enslaved Wookiees.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Use the granted ability [c][ffff33]Quick Parry[-][/c] to avoid damage and counter attack, stunning the attacker\n- If Cal is defeated the battle ends in defeat[c][F0FF23]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER03_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nCal Kestis (Gear XII+)\n\nCal searches Zeffo for clues to opening the ancient vault.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Cal has the granted abilities [c][ffff33]Dodge Roll[-][/c] and [c][ffff33]Quick Parry[-][/c]\n- Cal begins the final battle with 4 stacks of Purge and at the start of Second Sister's turn gains a stack of Purge\nSecond Sister is immune to Stun\n- Tomb Guardian can only be defeated while Stunned[c][F0FF23]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER04_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nCal Kestis (Gear XII+)\nMerrin (Gear XII+)\n\nCal confronts Taron Malicos on Dathomir, where he seeks a Zeffo Astrium required to open the ancient vault.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Use the granted ability [c][ffff33]Reactive Force Push[-][/c] to avoid negative effects and Stagger enemies\n- Taron Malicos can only be defeated while he has no Turn Meter\n- If Cal or Merrin are defeated the battle ends in defeat[-][/c][c][F0FF23]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTCAL_TIER05_DESC|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nCal Kestis (Gear XII+)\nCere Junda (Gear XII+)\n\nCal and Cere confront Second Sister at Fortress Inquisitorius after she steals the holocron from the ancient vault.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Cal has the granted abilities [c][ffff33]Dodge Roll,[-][/c] [c][ffff33]Quick Parry,[-][/c] and [c][ffff33]Reactive Force Push[-][/c]\n- If Cal or Cere are defeated the battle ends in defeat[c][F0FF23]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER01_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nRelic Level 3\n- Wampa\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Relic Level 5\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nLuke ventures into the snowstorm to investigate a fallen meteor. While searching, he finds an unexpected foe.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Prioritize Tenacity for your Wampa to resist the enemy debuffs.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER02_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nRelic Level 3\n- Commander Luke Skywalker (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Relic Level 5\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nAfter freeing himself from the ice, Luke retrieves his lightsaber and begins to fend off the attacking wampa.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Prioritize Potency for your Commander Luke Skywalker to inflict debuffs.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Commander Luke Skywalker will have his name and appearance altered for this battle.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER03_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nRelic Level 3\n- C-3PO\n- Captain Han Solo\n- Chewbacca\n- Rebel Officer Leia Organa\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Relic Level 5\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nThe Rebels' Echo Base has been struck by the Empire and is being invaded by troopers. Vader is somewhere in the base, and the group must escape before he finds them!\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Each time an enemy takes a turn, Vader gets closer to entering the battle.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER04_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star\n- ANY Capital Ship (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- Han's Millennium Falcon\n- Wedge Antilles's X-wing\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Crew Relic Level 5\n- Crew Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Crew Zeta ability upgrades\n- Fully upgraded ships\n\nAfter escaping Hoth on the Millennium Falcon, Luke's friends attempt to evade the Imperial Fleet through hyperspace.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Jump to hyperspace with all of your ships as soon as you can.\n- Han's Millennium Falcon will not be able to activate the [c][F0FF23]Jump to Hyperspace[-][/c] ability until it's the last ship on your side.\n- If any allied ship is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] A GR-75 and Rebel Y-wing will be granted to you in this tier. The GR-75 replaces your Capital Ship, is not obtainable, and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER05_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nRelic Level 3\n- Commander Luke Skywalker\n- Hermit Yoda\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Relic Level 5\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nLuke makes a landing on the remote planet Dagobah, seeking training from an elusive Jedi Master.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER06_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nRelic Level 3\n- C-3PO (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- Chewbacca (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- Lando Calrissian\n- Rebel Officer Leia Organa (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Relic Level 5\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n\nAfter escaping the Imperial Fleet, Luke's friends arrive at Cloud City, floating above the planet Bespin.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] Rebel Officer Leia Organa will have her name and appearance altered for this battle. Chewbacca & C-3PO are required for this tier but will not be used in battle. They will be replaced by another character whose stats are scaled based on Chewbacca's stats, including mods.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER07_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nRelic Level 3\n- Commander Luke Skywalker\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Relic Level 5\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nBefore Luke is able to finish his training, he heads to Cloud City, where he must face off against Darth Vader.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Vader will use everything in his power to subdue Luke.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_TIER08_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\nRelic Level 3\n- Darth Vader\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Relic Level 5\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\nAs the fight continues, Vader pushes Luke to join him and embrace the dark side of the Force.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- When Damage Over Time effects expire, Vader's granted ability's cooldown is reduced by 1.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_TIER01_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n2-Star Characters\n- IG-11 (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- The Mandalorian\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Level 30+\n- Gear level V+\n- Ability upgrades level 2+\n\nThe Mandalorian's search for his bounty leads him to the planet of Arvala-7 where he confronts a group of thugs with some assistance from the bounty hunter droid, IG-11.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- IG-11's Speed stat is doubled in this battle.\n- Careful use of IG-11's abilities will help you control the battlefield.\n- If the Mandalorian is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] IG-11 will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. IG-11's special ability, [c][F0FF23]Nurse Droid Protocol[-][/c], will be replaced with a different ability that scales based on your IG-11's [c][F0FF23]Nurse Droid Protocol[-][/c] investment. IG-11 will not have access to his unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Child's Favor[-][/c], in this tier. This character is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_TIER02_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n3-Star Character\n- The Mandalorian (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Level 40+\n- Gear level VI+\n- Ability upgrades level 3+\n\nAt the behest of a group of Jawas, the Mandalorian ventures deep into the dunes to confront a terrible beast and retrieve a most valuable prize.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. This character is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_TIER03_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n4-Star Character\n- The Mandalorian (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Level 50+\n- Gear level VII+\n- Ability upgrades level 4+\n\nReturning to Nevarro, the Mandalorian infiltrates his former Client's bunker to retrieve the Child and save them from whatever terrible fate the Imperials have planned.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. His special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wonder of the Force[-][/c], will be maxed out in this tier and will not start on cooldown.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_TIER04_DESC_V2|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n5-Star Characters\n- Cara Dune (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- The Mandalorian (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Level 60+\n- Gear level VIII+\n- Ability upgrades level 5+\n- Mods rarity Mk V+\n\nDanger continues to nip at Mando's heels as he and Cara Dune fend off an attack on a Sorgan village from a group of cut throat Klatooinian raiders.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The enemy will utilize powerful attacks after Spotting your units.\n- If any allied character is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. His special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wonder of the Force[-][/c], will be maxed out in this tier and will not start on cooldown. Cara Dune will have her basic ability altered for this battle. These characters are not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_TIER05_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star Character\n- Kuiil\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Level 75+\n- Gear level IX+\n- Ability upgrades level 6+\n- Mods rarity Mk V+\n\nAs the threat of Imperial power continues to escalate on Nevarro, Kuiil attempts to fend off Imperial Troopers and protect his charge.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- [c][FFFF33]Devoted Protector[-][/c] is a granted ability given to Kuiil during this battle.\n- Prioritize Potency for your Kuiil to inflict more debuffs.\n- Inflicting debuffs lowers the cooldown of [c][FFFF33]Devoted Protector[-][/c].[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_TIER06_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star Characters\n- Cara Dune\n- IG-11\n- Greef Karga (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n- The Mandalorian (see [c][F0FF23]note[-][/c] below)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- Level 85\n- Gear level X+\n- Ability upgrades level 7+\n- Mods rarity Mk V+\n\nThe Mandalorian makes his stand alongside his allies as Moff Gideon and his Imperial forces close in for the kill.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Try to always have a [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c] active during Moff Gideons turn.\n- Moff Gideon will summon Stormtroopers at the end of his turn.\n- Your victory is achieved when Moff Gideon reaches 1% Health.\n- If the Mandalorian is defeated it will end the battle as a loss.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Note:[-][/c] The Mandalorian will have his name and appearance altered for this battle. His special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wonder of the Force[-][/c], will be maxed out in this tier and will not start on cooldown. Greef Karga will have both of his Special abilities altered for this battle. This character is not obtainable and can't be used in any other event or game mode.[-][/c]
MISSION_EVENT_K-2SO_DESC_T1|This mission unlocks at level 20 and is recommended for levels 20+ \n\n2-star or higher characters with at least gear level 3 recommended. \n\n[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Sandtroopers inflict damage over time with their attacks.
MISSION_EVENT_K-2SO_DESC_T2|Recommended for levels 40+ \n\nRequires 3-star or higher characters. \n\n[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Sandtrooper Captain deals increased damage to characters suffering negative effects.
MISSION_EVENT_K-2SO_DESC_T3|Recommended for levels 50+ \n\nRequires 4-star or higher characters. \n\n[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Inflict [c][f0ff23]DAZE[-][/c] with K-2SO to prevent counter attacks.
MISSION_EVENT_K-2SO_DESC_T4|Recommended for levels 60+ \n\nRequires 5-star or higher characters. \n\n[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Daze prevents units from being called to assist in attacks. K-2SO can inflict Daze with his [c][f0ff23]Conductive Charge[-][/c] ability.
MISSION_EVENT_K-2SO_DESC_T5|Recommended for levels 70+ \n\nRequires 6-star or higher characters. \n\n[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Beware Magmatrooper's Thermal Imploder. It can reduce your entire team's turn meter.
MISSION_EVENT_K-2SO_DESC_T6|Recommended for levels 80+ \n\nRequires 6-star or higher characters. \n\n[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Stormtrooper Commanders can heal friendly characters and call an ally to attack when they do so.
MISSION_EVENT_K-2SO_DESC_T7|Recommended for level 85. \n\nRequires 7-star. \n\n[c]-Strategy Tips:[/c] Remember to inflict [c][f0ff23]DAZE[-][/c] to stop enemies from assisting, gaining bonus turn meter, or counter attacking.

MISSION_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_MYTHIC_TIER01_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star, 17,500+ Power\n- Jedi Knight Revan\n- 4 of the following:\n   Bastila Shan\n   Jolee Bindo\n   Mission Vao\n   T3-M4\n   Zaalbar\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- 20,000+ Power\n- Gear level XII\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Darth Malak will ruthlessly drain the captive Jedi held in Stasis Fields to prevent his own defeat and gain permanent buffs.\n- Destroy the Stasis Fields and Assault Droids in order to increase the amount of time before Malak becomes [c][F0FF23]Enraged[-][/c].\n- Destroy the Assault Droids to remove stacks of Malak's [c][F0FF23]Hatred[-][/c] from Revan. Malak can periodically call in new droids, allowing you to manage Malak's [c][F0FF23]Hatred.[-][/c][-][/c]
MISSION_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_MYTHIC_TIER02_DESC_V3|\n[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Required:[-][/c]\n7-Star, 17,500+ Power\n- Darth Revan\n- 4 of the following:\n   Bastila Shan (Fallen)\n   Canderous Ordo\n   Carth Onasi\n   HK-47\n   Juhani\n\n[c][23C8F5]Recommended:[-][/c]\n- 20,000+ Power\n- Gear level XII\n- Mods rarity Mk VI\n- Zeta ability upgrades\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Darth Malak will ruthlessly drain the Captive Jedi held in stasis to prevent his own defeat and gain permanent buffs.\n- Destroy the Captive Jedi and Assault Droids in order to add permanent, undispellable stacks of [c][F0FF23]Ferocity[-][/c] to Darth Revan, dramatically increasing his offensive capabilities.\n- Malak will become [c][F0FF23]Enraged[-][/c] faster if he defeats any of your characters with his [c][F0FF23]Drain Life[-][/c] ability.[-][/c]

MODIFIER_ABILITY_ACTIVATETHEEDROIDS_DESC|End the battle. Gain a star for every 20 enemies defeated. If less than 20 enemies have been defeated, the battle ends in defeat.
MODIFIER_ABILITY_ACTIVATETHEEDROIDS_NAME|Get Out of Here

MODIFIER_ABILITY_ATOLLON_NAME|Face Your Fear
MODIFIER_ABILITY_BOULDER_THROW_DESC|Deal Physical damage to target enemy and Stun them for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.
MODIFIER_ABILITY_BOULDER_THROW_NAME|Boulder Throw
MODIFIER_ABILITY_HOTH_DESC|Remove Deadly Storm from self and gain Critical Chance Up, Offense Up, and Speed Up for 2 turns. (Cooldown: 5)
MODIFIER_ABILITY_HOTH_NAME|Smells Bad on the Outside
MODIFIER_ABILITY_KESSEL_DESC|Remove all stacks of Confuse from self.
