MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_2-2|When at 4 stacks of Insight, Moff Gideon gains the Special ability [c][ffff33]Subversive Volley[/c][-], damaging and inflicting Daze on all enemies, which can't be resisted by enemies with the Leader tag (even if they are not in the Leader slot).
MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_3-1|[c][ffff33]Know Your Adversaries[/c][-] inflicts [c][ffff33]Demoralized[/c][-] on enemies. This debuff will remain on them until the end of the battle or until they or Moff Gideon are defeated.
MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_4-1|[c][ffff33]Tactical Deployment[/c][-] grants all allies Max Health and Max Protection if Moff Gideon's squad consists of one Dark Side Tank, two Dark Side Attackers, and one other Dark Side Support.
MSG_EVENT_MOFFGIDEONS1_5-1|If it looks like his enemies are going to get the drop on Moff Gideon, he can use [c][ffff33]Control the Situation[/c][-] to reduce all Turn Meters to 0, and then your allies gain turn meter helping you act before your opponents.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_1-1|[c][ffff33]Mon Mothma[-][/c] is a Rebel Leader that can summon and greatly boost her allies' stats.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_1-2|[c][ffff33]Advocate For Peace[-][/c] dispels debuffs and recovers Health and Protection for Rebel allies.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_2-1|[c][ffff33]Restore Our Republic[-][/c] can revive defeated Rebel Fighter allies. It also equalizes Health among Rebel allies and rallies Rebel Fighter allies.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_3-1|[c][ffff33]Field Promotion[-][/c] summons a Rebel Trooper ally to aid Mon Mothma. Activating it after the summon is already present will upgrade Rebel Trooper's abilities.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_3-2|When fully upgraded, Rebel Trooper provides notable damage and support to Mon Mothma and Rebel Fighter allies.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_4-1|[c][ffff33]Alliance Chancellor[-][/c] grants stats to Mon Mothma and Rebel Fighter allies based on their combined base stats.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_4-2|This ability also enables Mon Mothma and Rebel Fighter allies to assist each other whenever they use an ability during their turn.
MSG_EVENT_MONMOTHMA_5-1|[c][ffff33]This Is Our Rebellion[-][/c] grants Mon Mothma additional Speed and can prevent her from being targeted.
MSG_EVENT_MORGANELSBETH_1-1|I am excited to announce the arrival of the powerful Nightsister Morgan Elsbeth to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_MORGANELSBETH_1-2|Wield the blade of Talzin while becoming a blessed agent of the Peridea Great Mothers, holding off the enemies through skills and a desire for revenge.
MSG_EVENT_NEST_1-1|[c][F0FF23]CUT THROUGH[-][/c] deals damage, dispels Defensive Buffs, and can't be Evaded.
MSG_EVENT_NEST_2-1|[c][F0FF23]SUDDEN IMPACT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Buff Immunity. If the target has Protection it deals more damage and ignores Armor.
MSG_EVENT_NEST_3-1|[c][F0FF23]KINETITE CHARGE[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, inflicts Daze, and removes Turn Meter from enemies with full Health.
MSG_EVENT_NEST_4-1|[c][F0FF23]FIGHTING INSTINCT[-][/c] grants Nest Counter Attack chance, bonus Protection, and Critical Chance when she takes damage until the end of her next turn.
MSG_EVENT_NIGHTTROOPER_1-1|I am excited to announce the arrival of the dark and foreboding Night Trooper to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_NIGHTTROOPER_1-2|Inhumanly persistent and reanimated through the sinister majik of the Great Mothers of Peridea, these once loyal soldiers of the Empire march onwards, an unending horde of shambling destruction. They could benefit from an air freshener though...
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_1-1|Sith Empire Trooper's basic attack, [c][F0FF23]DISRUPTOR BLAST[-][/c], has a chance to inflict [c][F0FF23]DEFENSE DOWN[-][/c]
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_1-2|[c][F0FF23]CRIMSON BARRAGE[-][/c] is a powerful AoE that bypasses enemy protection
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_1-3|[c][F0FF23]VAIKEN’S LEGACY[-][/c] is a passive ability that triggers extra buffs when Sith allies use their abilities
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_2-1|Sith Assassin's basic attack, [c][F0FF23]EXPLOIT WEAKNESS[-][/c], has a chance to inflict [c][F0FF23]EVASION DOWN[-][/c]
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_2-2|[c][F0FF23]DARK SHROUD[-][/c] grants [c][F0FF23]STEALTH[-][/c]. When stealthed the Sith Assassin is very deadly
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_2-3|[c][F0FF23]ELECTROCUTE[-][/c] deals more damage for each buff consumed off Sith Assassin. It can also [c][F0FF23]STUN[-][/c] enemies
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-1|Darth Nihilus' basic attack, [c][F0FF23]CEASELESS CRAVING[-][/c], will [c][F0FF23]DISPEL[-][/c] all buffs on his target
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-2|Use [c][F0FF23]DRAIN FORCE[-][/c] against debuffed enemies to decrease the cooldown on [c][F0FF23]ANNIHILATE[-][/c]
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-3|[c][F0FF23]ANNIHILATE[-][/c] is a very powerful ability that [c][F0FF23]INSTANTLY DEFEATS[-][/c] a single enemy. It starts on cooldown
MSG_EVENT_NIHILUS_3-4|Darth Nihilus’ leader ability, [c][F0FF23]LORD OF HUNGER[-][/c], makes Sith allies extremely survivable
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_1-1|She survived torture, betrayal, and loss to rise again as a powerful instrument of the Empire. I'm thrilled to bring the relentless and durable Inquisitor, Ninth Sister, to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_1-2|Ninth Sister's Basic attack,[c][ffff33] Too Easy[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy 2 times and inflicts a stack of Purge. If the target is a Jedi, this inflicts a second stack of Purge and can't be resisted.
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_1-3|Purge can be applied up to 6 times to a target enemy. Those stacks are then consumed by Inquisitorius to apply different effects.
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_2-1|Ninth Sister's Special ability,[c][ffff33] Not Worth My Time[-][/c], will consume stacks of Purge on a target enemy, deal Physical damage, apply an equal number of Damage Over Time effects (inflicts damage at the start of their turn) for 1 turn, and grant Ninth Sister an equal number of Heal Over Time effects (recovers Health at the start of their turn) for 1 turn.
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_2-2|If the target enemy is also a Jedi, Ninth Sister will dispel all of their buffs.
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_3-1|Ninth Sister's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Ground Pound[-][/c], deals Physical damage to all enemies, and inflicts Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter), Potency Down (debuffs are harder to inflict), and Defense Down (reduced Defense stat) for 2 turns, which can't be resisted by Jedi.
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_3-2|Ninth Sister then gains Taunt for 2 turns. For each enemy inflicted with Purge and damaged by this ability, Ninth Sister gains 10% Defense (stacking, max 50%) for 2 turns.
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_4-1_V2|Inquisitorius allies are immune to Speed limiting effects. Any time an opponent gains bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn), all Inquisitorius allies gain 2% Potency (debuffs are harder to resist) and 2% Tenacity (increased chance to resist debuffs) (stacking) for the rest of the encounter. If that enemy is a Jedi, they have a 50% chance to gain a stack of Purge (max 6).
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_4-2|While in Territory Wars, all Empire allies gain 20% Defense and all Inquisitorius allies are immune to Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn) and Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn).
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_5-1|For each other Empire ally present at the start of battle, Ninth Sister gains 5% Defense, Max Health, and Tenacity; these effects are doubled for Inquisitorius allies.
MSG_EVENT_NINTHSISTER_5-2|Each time another Empire ally is damaged by a critical hit, she gains Taunt and 50% Critical Avoidance for 1 turn, and her allies gain 20% Critical Avoidance for 1 turn. If the ally is also Inquisitorius, Ninth Sister recovers 5% Health.
MSG_EVENT_OMEGAS3_1-1|I am pleased to announce the arrival of Omega (Fugitive), the new leader of the Bad Batch to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_OMEGAS3_1-2|Defeat your enemies with both old and new allies that she has met throughout her journey.
MSG_EVENT_OPERATIVE_1-1|I am happy to announce the arrival of CX-2 to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_OPERATIVE_1-2|CX-2 operated from the shadows alone, he was a loyal and specialized clone tasked to locate and capture Omega after she escaped Mount Tantiss.
MSG_EVENT_PADAWANOBIWAN_1-1|I am excited to announce the arrival of Padawan Obi-Wan to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_PADAWANOBIWAN_1-2|Skilled with a lightsaber and, at times, a bit unorthodox in his methods, Obi-Wan honed his skills under the tutelage of the wisest Jedi Masters of his time, and grew to become a hero of legend in his own right.

MSG_EVENT_PAPLOO_1-1|[c][F0FF23]VIGILANT STRIKE[/c][-] attacks an enemy and grants Paploo Defense Up
MSG_EVENT_PAPLOO_2-1|[c][F0FF23]DIVERSION[/c][-] inflicts Speed Down, grants Paploo Taunt, and then Speed Up when Taunt expires
MSG_EVENT_PAPLOO_3-1|[c][F0FF23]GALVANIZE[/c][-] removes all debuffs from Paploo and target ally and, if the ally was an Ewok, they gain Turn Meter

MSG_EVENT_PAZVIZSLA_1-1|I am excited to announce the arrival of Paz Vizsla to the holotables! Paz Vizsla was a stalwart warrior clad in resilient beskar armor and a descendant of a long line of leaders from the esteemed House Vizsla.
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-1|Ezra's basic, [c][F0FF23]RUSHING STRIKE[-][/c], has a chance to attack a second time
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-2|[c][F0FF23]FLOURISH[-][/c] can dispel all buffs on an enemy but also provide benefits when the target has no buffs
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-3|[c][F0FF23]WATCH AND LEARN[-][/c] calls an assist from an ally and grants both a bonus effect based on the ally’s class
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_1-4|Ezra's Phoenix passive, [c][F0FF23]PUSH THROUGH[-][/c], gives stacking offense buffs
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_EZRA_ENC03|Now use Ezra Bridger's abilities to defeat Kanan Jarrus in a training duel!
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_GHOST_T1_01|Use Hera's [c][F0FF23]BACKUP PLAN[-][/c] ability on a taunting ally such as Kanan or Chopper. If they are defeated while Backup Plan is active, they will be immediately revived.
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_GHOST_T2_01|Use Ezra's [c][F0FF23]WATCH AND LEARN[-][/c] ability on an attacker such as Sabine and they will both critically strike.
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_GHOST_T3_01|Use Hera's [c][F0FF23]PLAY TO STRENGTHS[-][/c] ability on Zeb to have him inflict Daze outside his turn. When his turn comes around, he can stun the enemy faster since they are already Dazed.
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-1|If you damage the Healthiest enemy with Hera's basic attack, [c][F0FF23]OUTWIT[-][/c], will inflict Expose on target enemy.
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-2|[c][F0FF23]PLAY TO STRENGTHS[-][/c] calls an ally to assist with increased damage and Potency
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-3|Ally with [c][F0FF23]BACKUP PLAN[-][/c] will recover Health each turn and revive if they are defeated
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_HERA_1-4|[c][F0FF23]RISE TOGETHER[-][/c] lets Phoenix Squadron allies share their passive abilities with each other and gain Turn Meter whenever they use a special ability
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-1|Sabine's basic, [c][F0FF23]BLASTERS AKIMBO[-][/c], hits multiple times on debuffed targets with low Turn Meter
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-2|Use [c][F0FF23]DARKSABER STRIKE[-][/c] on high armor targets to permanently reduce their armor
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-3|[c][F0FF23]DEMOLISH[-][/c] applies Expose and Stagger on target enemy
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_1-4|[c][F0FF23]TAKE IT BACK[-][/c], Sabine's passive Phoenix ability, grants her additional Critical Chance and Critical Damage
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_SABINE_ENC04|Use Sabine's [c][F0FF23]DARKSABER STRIKE[-][/c] to reduce TIE Fighter's Armor!
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-1|Zeb's basic, [c][F0FF23]BASH[-][/c], inflicts Daze and can also Stun under certain conditions
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-2|Use [c][F0FF23]STAGGERING SWEEP[-][/c] to setup turn meter manipulation on dangerous enemies
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-3|[c][F0FF23]HONOR GUARD[-][/c] is useful for bolstering the defenses of weaker allies
MSG_EVENT_PHOENIX_ZEB_1-4|Zeb's passive, [c][F0FF23]SHRUG OFF[-][/c], increases survivability and provides additional benefits under debuffs
MSG_EVENT_princesskneesaa_1-1|Daughter of Chief Chirpa and Ewok warrior of Bright Tree Village, Princess Kneesaa has joined the Holotables! She fought alongside the Rebel Alliance in the Battle of Endor.
MSG_EVENT_PUNISHINGONE_1-1|I am excited to announce the arrival of Punishing One to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_PUNISHINGONE_1-2|The Punishing One is a modified JumpMaster 5000, designed and manufactured by the Corellian Engineering corporation and is the personal starship of bounty hunter Dengar.
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-1|Qi'ra, Young Han Solo, and Vandor Chewbacca can become [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-2|[c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] is a special effect that adds bonus beneficial effects to some of their abilities.
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-3|Each character gains [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] and uses it differently. 
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-4|Qi’ra, for example, gains [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] if a single enemy is critically hit more than once, before the next turn.  Qi’ra can use [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] to call on the assistance of all other [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] allies.
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-5|When Vandor Chewbacca is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], he can revive a fallen ally.
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_0-6|When Young Han Solo is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c], he can give [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] to another ally and restore his Protection.
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_1-1|[c][F0FF23]DEADLY DOUBLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Offense Down
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_2-1|[c][F0FF23]SCATTERING BLAST[-][/c] dispels all buffs on the target enemy, and damages and Staggers all enemies
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_3-1|[c][F0FF23]JOINT OPERATION[-][/c] deals damage to an enemy and calls an ally to assist
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_4-1|[c][F0FF23]TOOLS OF THE TRADE[-][/c] increases Scoundrel allies Critical Chance and gives them bonuses when they score a critical hit
MSG_EVENT_QIRA_5-1|[c][F0FF23]INSULT TO INJURY[-][/c] grants Qi'ra bonus Potency or Critical Chance when attacking depending on if her target is debuffed, and Qi'ra can become [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] if a single enemy is Critically hit more than once
MSG_EVENT_QUIGGOLD_1-1|I am pleased to announce that the First Mate of the Meson Martinet, Quiggold, has arrived on the holotables.
MSG_EVENT_QUIGGOLD_1-2|Quiggold is a Tank for the brand new Pirate faction, he is known for his unwavering loyalty to Captain Ithano.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_1-0|Revan was quite the character. Here you see that Revan, Mission Vao, and Zaalbar teamed up to infiltrate a criminal hideout in order to rescue someone named "Bastila Shan." And that hideout, it turns out, was guarded by a Rancor!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_1-1|Raaaawwwwwrrrr!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_1-2|It's okay, Big Z. We've got our new friend. We can do this!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_2-0|After they infiltrated the criminal hideout, Revan and the companions freed Bastila Shan, bravely facing the criminals and other seedy types. Records are inconclusive, but it seems like it happened deep in the bowels of the Taris undercity.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_2-1|They've come to rescue the Jedi! Stop them!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_2-2|The Jedi has “rescued” herself, thank you very much.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_3-0|Ahh yes, this is one of my favorites. In order to get off of Taris, Revan and the companions had to fight their way through a Sith base to obtain orbital defense system codes!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_3-1|T3-M4, get that door open!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_3-2|Beep, boop, bweeeer!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-0|At one point, it seems like Revan was on Tatooine. According to this, part of it was to save some miners who were under attack from Sand People. I wonder what they were on Tatooine for?
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-1|I wonder why they are called Sand People. Do you think they’re made of sand?
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-2|Beep bwooor boop beep boooop?
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-3|I hadn’t thought of that, you might be onto something.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_4-4|They're attacking! Miners, get into the crawler! Everyone else, defend it!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-0|Oh, this sounds fascinating! Revan and the companions were on the planet… Korriban? I’ve never heard of that one. Interesting. It looks like they did a lot while they were there, including a trip into the depths of a Sith tomb where they met a… Sith spirit? What a wild story
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-1|I'll destroy you and the treasures of this tomb will be mine! Soldiers, attack these interlopers!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-2|I sense a strange presence in this tomb. There's something here far more powerful than these Sith.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-3|I see a great… light… could it be… Jedi, here?
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-4|It's a Sith spirit? Wow, you don't see one of those every day. Or ever, really.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-5|The spirit's dark power will be mine! Die, Jedi!
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-6|Your heroism and sacrifice have shown me the light I had so long been blind to...
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-7|I had regretted for so long... all that I had done...
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-8|If... If I could return to the light...
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_5-9|I held on to that darkness for so long. Now I am free... Thank you, Hero.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_6-0|Ahh, and I rather like this one: On the way out of the Tomb Revan faced a vicious Terentatek! These things are deadly apex predators that are rumored to have a preference for Force users...
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_6-1|I've heard about these things, it's a Terentatek.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_6-2|They feed on Force-sensitive beings, be careful.
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_CONTEXT_01|I've been dusting off my old military texts and I've come across an interesting story from the Old Republic era. Have you ever heard of REVAN?
MSG_EVENT_REVAN_CONTEXT_02|The details of Revan's story are clouded in mystery but I've come up with something I think you'll enjoy. It's called "Legend of the Old Republic".
MSG_EVENT_ROGUEONESHIP_1-1|They stole a shuttle, named it Rogue One, and changed the galaxy. Now it’s your turn! I am pleased to announce the arrival of this iconic ship to the holotables.
MSG_EVENT_ROGUEONESHIP_1-2|Rogue One was a versatile transport and gunship used by the Rebel Alliance. An Imperial cargo shuttle, Rogue One slipped past enemy lines and helped spark one of the Rebellion’s greatest victories.
MSG_EVENT_ROSE_1-1|[c][F0FF23]COURAGEOUS SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and grants Tenacity Up to a random Resistance ally.
MSG_EVENT_ROSE_2-1|[c][F0FF23]DAUNTLESS BRAVERY[-][/c] grants Resistance allies Defense Up and Rose gains Turn Meter based on the types of allies and foes
MSG_EVENT_ROSE_3-1|[c][F0FF23]SHOCK PROD STRIKE[-][/c] deals damage and Stuns the target, then inflicts Daze when Stun expires
MSG_EVENT_ROSE_4-1|[c][F0FF23]VALIANT SPIRIT[-][/c] grants Rose stacking bonus Offense for each Exposed enemy
MSG_EVENT_RT_1-1|[c][F0FF23]TAKE AIM[-][/c] deals damage and if Range Trooper is buffed, it deals 30% more damage!
MSG_EVENT_RT_2-1|[c][c][F0FF23]STEADY[-][/c] grants all Empire allies Protection Up and then Range Trooper and a random ally attack the selected target. Imperial Troopers also gain other beneficial effects.
MSG_EVENT_RT_3-1|[c][c][F0FF23]POWER IN NUMBERS[-][/c] grants Range Trooper bonus Tenacity while buffed and while Range Trooper is active, buffed Imperial Troopers have a 50% chance to call another Imperial Trooper to assist when they use an ability.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-1|Sana Starros, Doctor Aphra's sometimes partner, sometimes rival, is headed to the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-2|Sana was a smuggler and mercenary who found herself working for the Rebellion more than once, but has a penchant for leading Scoundrels during her more interesting jobs.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_1-3|Sana Starros' Basic attack, [c][ffff33]Cheap Shot[-][/c], will inflict Vulnerable (will be critically hit if able) on the target. If they already had Vulnerable, then all enemies are inflicted with it instead.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-1|Sana's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Lessons in Coercion[-][/c], will dispel debuffs on non-Tank Rebel allies, as well as herself.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-2|It will also give those allies Critical Chance Up (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit) and Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available), and finally call all Stealthed allies to assist.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_2-3|Rebel Scoundrel Tanks, however, will instead recover 20% Protection when Sana uses this ability.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_3-1|Sana's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]Smart-targeting Scatterblaster[-][/c], will deal damage to all enemies and inflict them with Tenacity Down (lowered chance to resist debuffs).
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_3-2|Enemies who were Target Locked (certain abilities have improved interactions against Target Lock) are dealt damage again, and Staggered (lose 100% Turn Meter if damaged by an attack).
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-1|Sana's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]A Professional I Can Trust...ish[-][/c], gives her counter chance and Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit). Additionally she will assist non-Attacker Rebel Scoundrels who use a Special ability, and recover Protection when doing so.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-2|Sana gains Turn Meter whenever an enemy is Target Locked. At the start of Rebel ally's turns, as well as whenever Sana evades an attack or attacks out of turn, non-Scoundrel allies are inflicted with [c][ffff33]Suspicious[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_4-3|Suspicious allies lose Speed, but gain 100% Critical Chance.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-1|As a Leader, her [c][ffff33]Rebel Sympathizer[-][/c] ability makes Rebel Scoundrel Tanks gain multiple stats, and they may gain Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) when their allies are damaged. Allies may gain bonus stats when they gain bonus Turn Meter.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-2|Rebel Scoundrels who remove Turn Meter from enemies will also make them lose Max Health. When Rebel allies and Sana deal damage more than once in a turn, they gain Max Health, and whenever they critically hit, they inflict Target Lock and can reduce Rebel Scoundrel Tanks' cooldowns by 1.
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-3|In [c][ffff33]Territory Wars[-][/c], Sana's Omicron tier will give immunity to Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter), and, at the start of battle, have Rebel Scoundrel Tanks Taunt (enemies must target this character). Scoundrels start with Tenacity Up, and Sana's Target Lock can't be resisted. 
MSG_EVENT_SANASTARROS_5-4|Additionally her Omicron makes it so whenever Rebel allies and Sana deal damage multiple times in a turn (to one or multiple targets), dispel all buffs on all enemies and inflict Healing Immunity (immune to Health and Protection recovery) on them.
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_1-1|Saw Gerrera, the ruthless militant and eventual leader of the Partisans, has joined the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_1-2|Saw made it his life-long goal to take down the Empire with any method and at any cost.
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_1-3|His Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Critical Shot[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Defense Down (reduced Defense stat). If all allies are Rebel Fighter, the cooldown of [c][ffff33]RPS-6 Rocket Launcher Blast[-][/c] is reduced by 1.
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_2-1|Saw Gerrera's Special ability, [c][ffff33]RPS-6 Rocket Launcher Blast[-][/c], deals Physical damage to all enemies and inflicts Blind (miss the next attack).
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_2-2|This attack decreases the enemy's Offense until the start of Saw's next turn, and heals allies for each Heal Over Time (recovers Health at the start of their turn) dispelled from allies.
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_3-1|Saw Gerrera's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Adapt and Survive[-][/c], gives Rebel Fighter allies bonuses when they fall below 50% Health. They gain additional bonuses when they recover back to full Health or when their buffs are dispelled.
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_4-1|Saw Gerrera's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Freedom Isn't Free[-][/c], grants Saw [c][ffff33]Set Explosive Trap[-][/c], a very powerful one time use Granted ability. Saw also grants his Rebel Fighter allies buffs at the cost of their Health at the end of his turn. Additionally, Rebel Fighter allies gain bonuses depending on how much Health they have.
MSG_EVENT_SAWGERRERA_4-2|With his Omicron active in the Grand Arenas game mode, Saw increases all enemy cooldowns by 1 and gains a bonus turn when using Set Explosive Trap. Allies also inflict Defense Down on the weakest enemy at the start of their turn, and Marked (enemies must target this character) if there's an enemy with Taunt (enemies must target this character) and Explosive Trap has detonated.
MSG_EVENT_SCORCH_1-1|I am happy to announce the arrival of RC-1262 "Scorch" to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_SCORCH_1-2|A sturdy Dark Side Clone Trooper Tank, Scorch pursued the members of Clone Force 99 under orders from Dr. Royce Hemlock.
MSG_EVENT_SCOUTTROOPER_1-1|Masters of stealth and reconnaissance, I welcome Scout Trooper to the holotables! They protected the mighty Death Star's generator during the Battle of Endor and were experts at navigating any terrain with speeder bikes.
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_1-1|Tenacious and cunning, this servant of the Empire will stop at nothing to see the last of the Jedi purged from the galaxy. I'm pleased to say that Second Sister, an Inquisitor for the Empire, has arrived at the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_1-2|Second Sister's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]So Much Fear[-][/c], deals Special damage and has a chance to inflict a stack of [c][ffff33]Purge[-][/c] on her target. If the target is a Jedi, this inflicts a second stack of Purge and can't be resisted.
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_1-3|Purge is a new debuff that stacks up to six times. These stacks are consumed by Inquisitorius abilities for extra effects.
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_2-1|Second Sister's ability [c][ffff33]Shall I End This?[-][/c] deals Special damage to target enemy and has extra Defense Penetration (ignores some of a target's Defense stat). If her target is inflicted with any stacks of Purge, this attack also gains increased Critical Chance (increases chance of an attack being a critical hit) and Critical Damage (increases the damage of critical hits).
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_3-1|Second Sister's ability [c][ffff33]Can't Run Forever[-][/c] deals Special damage to target enemy and consumes up to 5 stacks of Purge, removing Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn) per stack consumed (20% per stack, up to 100%) from her target, and gaining Turn Meter for herself per stack consumed (10% per stack, up to 50%).
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_3-2|If any stacks of Purge are consumed, this ability has a chance to inflict Stun (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn). When 5 stacks of Purge are consumed, the Stun can't be resisted.
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_4-1|Second Sister's Unique Ability, [c][ffff33]Everyone is Expendable[-][/c] grants her permanent buffs whenever an enemy or Empire ally is defeated. She also gains additional Critical Damage and her Special abilities can't be evaded when her target is inflicted with Purge.
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_5-1|Second Sister grants her Empire and Inquisitorius allies increased Offense (increases ability damage). Other Inquisitorius allies have a chance to inflict a stack of Purge on an enemy target with their Basic abilities.
MSG_EVENT_SECONDSISTER_5-2|When fully upgraded and in Territory Wars, all enemies start with 2 stacks of Purge at the beginning of battle and Jedi enemies can't recover Health or Protection from Jedi Unique abilities (Excluding Galactic Legends).
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_1-1|Despite surviving Order 66, she would become an Imperial assassin, one who was all too eager to hunt down her former allies. Welcome to the Holotables the ruthless and cunning Inquisitor, Seventh Sister!
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_1-2|Seventh Sister's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]There You Are[-][/c], deals Physical damage, inflicts Offense Down (decreases ability damage), and inflicts 1 stack of Purge if the target doesn't have any.
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_1-3|Purge can be applied up to 6 times to a target enemy. Those stacks are then consumed by Inquisitorius to apply different effects. 
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_2-1|Seventh Sister's Special ability, [c][ffff33]ID9 Electro Shock-Prod[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy, dispels all buffs, and removes Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_2-2|This ability also inflicts Ability Block (can't use Special abilities during their turn), Daze (can't assist, counter attack, or gain bonus Turn Meter), 1 stack of Purge, and 1 additional stack of Purge for each buff dispelled by this ability.
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_3-1|Seventh Sister's Special ability, [c][ffff33]ID9 Enemy Intelligence[-][/c], recovers Health and Protection on target ally. Additionally, this ability consumes 1 stack of Purge from each enemy, and target ally recovers additional Health and Protection for each stack of Purge consumed this way. 
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_3-2|All allies also recover Health and Protection and gain Critical Hit Immunity (can't be critically hit) and Evasion Up (chance to avoid an enemy attack). Inquisitorius allies gain Foresight (the next incoming attack will be evaded if able) and if the target ally is Inquisitorius, this ability's cooldown is reduced by 1.
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_4-1|Seventh Sister's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Guess Again[-][/c], grants Empire allies increased Evasion. When Inquisitorius allies evade, they recover Health and Protection and gain Advantage (the next attack is guaranteed to critically hit if able). 
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_4-2|While in Territory Wars, whenever an enemy Jedi gains Foresight, all Inquisitorius allies also gain Foresight. At the end of each turn, dispel all buffs on enemy Jedi that have Foresight. Whenever an enemy gains a buff, Seventh Sister has a 10% chance to inflict Purge on that enemy, increased to 20% if enemy is Jedi.
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_5-1|Seventh Sister will assist whenever another Inquisitorius ally uses an ability during their turn. Seventh Sister will also inflict debuffs on the target enemy based on how many stacks of Purge they have.
MSG_EVENT_SEVENTHSISTER_5-2|If Seventh Sister is in the Leader slot, whenever she assists an Inquisitorius ally, that ally also recovers Health and gains Offense Up.
MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_1-1|Shaak Ti is a powerful Leader who trains Clone Trooper allies to excel in combat.
MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_1-2|[c][F0FF23]Courageous Strike[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy, dispels their buffs and grants all allies Offense Up for a turn.
MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_2-1|[c][F0FF23]Assault Team[-][/c] dispels all debuffs on allies and calls all Clone Trooper allies to attack.\n\nThe target ally gains buffs based on their role, and if they are a Clone Trooper, they also gain Turn Meter.
MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_3-1|[c][F0FF23]Training Exercises[-][/c] calls an ally to assist and they attack again if they're a Clone Trooper, then that ally and Shaak Ti recover Health and Protection.\n\nThe ally gains Critical Damage if they're a Clone Trooper or Tenacity if they're a Galactic Republic Jedi.
MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_4-1|[c][F0FF23]Unity Wins War[-][/c] gives Clone Trooper allies Speed, and Galactic Republic allies gain statistics for each Clone Trooper ally.\n\nClone Trooper allies recover Health and Protection when they attack out of turn.
MSG_EVENT_SHAAKTI_5-1|[c][F0FF23]Heightened Reflexes[-][/c] is especially effective when enemies attack Clone Trooper allies.\n\nWhenever Shaak Ti or a Clone Trooper ally takes damage from an attack, they gain Retribution and Shaak Ti gains Turn Meter.
MSG_EVENT_SHINHATI_1-1|I am excited to announce the arrival of the lightsaber combatant, and mercenary partner of Baylan Skoll, Shin Hati to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_SHINHATI_1-2|Shin Hati is confident in her lightsaber skills, and her adept use of the Force amplifies her abilities. This allows her to anticipate and counter attacks with seamless fluidity.
MSG_EVENT_SION_1-1|[c][F0FF23]DARK RAGE[-][/c] deals Physical damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_SION_2-1|[c][F0FF23]TORMENT[-][/c] deals AoE damage, dispels all buffs on enemies, and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_SION_3-1|[c][F0FF23]BREAK WILL[-][/c] deals Physical damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_SION_4-1|[c][F0FF23]HELD BY HATRED[-][/c] removes all debuffs on Sion and recovers some of his Health and Turn Meter. Sion then gains [c][F0FF23]HATRED[-][/c] which has many benefits.
MSG_EVENT_SION_5-1|[c][F0FF23]LORD OF PAIN[-][/c] grants Sion Defense and Tenacity against enemies afflicted with [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c]. If an enemy has [c][F0FF23]PAIN[-][/c] at the start of their turn, Sion gains Taunt.
MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_1-1|[c][F0FF23]LASER BARRAGE[-][/c] deals damage and the B-28 has a chance to gain Defense Up on a Critical Hit
MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_2-1|[c][F0FF23]BOMBING RUN[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies and places Concussion Mines on them
MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_3-1|[c][F0FF23]HIGH-VALUE TARGET[-][/c] grants the B-28 Taunt the first time Sith allies take damage and any time Sith allies drop below 100% Health, and the B-28 recovers Protection any time a Concussion Mine explodes
MSG_EVENT_SITHBOMBER_4-1|[c][F0FF23]BOMBER BACKUP[-][/c] places a Concussion Mine on all enemies when the B-28 enters battle
MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_1-1|[c][F0FF23]STIFLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Healing Immunity
MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_2-1|[c][F0FF23]FIRST STRIKE[-][/c] deals damage, inflicts Health Down, and deals more damage to low health targets
MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_3-1|[c][F0FF23]SWARM TACTICS[-][/c] allows Sith fighter's attacks to bypass Protection on Debuffed enemies
MSG_EVENT_SITHFIGHTER_4-1|[c][F0FF23]EXTREME MANEUVERABILITY[-][/c] grants Foresight when entering battle from Reinforcement
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_1-1|[c][F0FF23]EXPLOSIVE BOLTS[-][/c] deals damage and will DAZE the target enemy for 2 turns
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_2-1|Use [c][F0FF23]FURIOUS BLOW[-][/c] to Stun your target. Speed Down will be applied to the remaining enemies.
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_3-1|[c][F0FF23]PARTNER IN CRIME[-][/c] gives Critical Chance to Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca and stacking Critical Damage when Veteran Smuggler Han takes damage.
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERCHEWIE_4-1|At the start of an enemy turn, [c][F0FF23]LET THE WOOKIEE WIN[-][/c] gives Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca Offense. This effect will stack until he uses an ability.
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_1-1|[c][F0FF23]TRUESHOT[-][/c] has a chance to hit twice and inflict STAGGER. If the target is debuffed, the attack chance is doubled.[/c]
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_2-1|[c][F0FF23]CAN I TRY THAT?[-][/c] has a chance to Stun the primary target and inflict Ability Block on all enemies
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_3-1|[c][F0FF23]PARTNER IN CRIME[-][/c] gives Veteran Smuggler Han bonuses if Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca takes damage or is defeated
MSG_EVENT_SMUGGLERHAN_4-1|[c][F0FF23]SWINDLE[-][/c] gives Veteran Smuggler Han bonuses when enemies gain buffs and when he is inflicted with debuffs or gains buffs
MSG_EVENT_STAP_1-1|Standing for Single Trooper Aerial Platform, I'm pleased to introduce for the very first time on the Holotables, the STAP!
MSG_EVENT_STAP_1-2|Used for scouting missions, this quick repulsorcraft was an invaluable asset for both the Trade Federation and the Separatists during the Clone Wars.
MSG_EVENT_STORMTROOPERLUKE_1-1|I am pleased to announce the arrival of Stormtrooper Luke to the holotables.
MSG_EVENT_STORMTROOPERLUKE_1-2|Clad in Imperial armor, Stormtrooper Luke leads with courage and quick thinking, guiding his allies with the resolve of a true Rebel hero.
MSG_EVENT_T3M4_1-1|[c][F0FF23]DISABLE[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block.
MSG_EVENT_T3M4_2-1|[c][F0FF23]REPAIR KIT[-][/c] dispels the target ally, and if they are a Droid they are Healed.
MSG_EVENT_T3M4_3-1|[c][F0FF23]CARBONITE PROJECTOR[-][/c] deals AoE damage and debuffs the enemy team.
MSG_EVENT_T3M4_4-1|[c][F0FF23]COMBAT LOGIC UPGRADE[-][/c] grants T3-M4 bonus stacking Potency and Critical Hit Chance.
MSG_EVENT_T3M4_5-1|[c][F0FF23]MASTER GEARHEAD[-][/c] grants T3-M4 bonus Defense Penetration and inflicts Target Lock on enemies.
MSG_EVENT_talzin_1-1|[c][F0FF23]ICHOR LIGHTNING[-][/c] deals Special Damage to the selected target, and all targets with [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]
MSG_EVENT_talzin_2-1|[c][F0FF23]DARK MAGICK[-][/c] deals Special Damage to all units and inflicts [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]
MSG_EVENT_talzin_3-1|[c][F0FF23]SPIRIT BLADE ASSAULT[-][/c] calls all Nightsister allies to assist
MSG_EVENT_talzin_4-1|[c][F0FF23]THE GREAT MOTHER[-][/c] grants Nightsister allies Potency, Speed, and causes their abilities to also inflict [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]
MSG_EVENT_talzin_5-1|[c][F0FF23]PLAGUEBEARER[-][/c] causes [F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c] to spread to other units if Mother Talzin is alive
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_1-1|Tarfful, chieftain of the Wookiees, who battled alongside Chewbacca and Jedi Master Yoda in the Battle of Kashyyyk has joined the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_1-2|Tarfful's Basic ability, [c][ffff33]DC-15S Blaster[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and dispels all buffs on them, while providing Wookiee allies with defensive buffs!
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_2-1|Tarfful's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Wookiee Fury[-][/c], gives Wookiee allies additional Defense (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and calls them to assist, Stunning (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) a target enemy.
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_2-2|After Wookiee allies assist, ally Attackers gain Critical Damage Up (increases the damage of critical hits), ally Healers and Supports gain Speed Up (takes turns more often), and ally Tanks Taunt (enemies must target this character).
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_3-1|Tarfful's Special ability [c][ffff33]Rrrruuuurrr[-][/c], dispels all debuffs on all allies, and then they gain Critical Damage Up. Wookiee allies gain Potency Up (debuffs are harder to resist), Tenacity Up (increased chance to resist debuffs), and Max Health. Then, inflict enemies with Provoked (increased counter chance, reduced damage from out of turn attacks, and receive damage when attacking out of turn).
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_4-1|Tarfful's Unique ability [c][ffff33]Better Together[-][/c] gives Tarfful Speed and Tenacity. When an ally has a buff dispelled, Tarfful gains Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn).
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_4-2|If there are at least 3 ally Wookiees, all allies gain Speed when enemies attack out of turn. Whenever a Wookiee ally gains Health Up, all allies recover Health, Protection and gain Advantage (the next attack is guaranteed to critically hit if able). Whenever a Wookiee ally has Retribution (will counter attack when damaged), Wookiee allies apply a stack of Damage Over Time (takes damage each turn) when they use a Basic ability.
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_4-3|If Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca is an ally, when Tarfful uses [c][ffff33]Rrrruuuurrr[-][/c], Veteran Smuggler Han Solo also gains the effects.
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_5-1|Tarfful's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]It's All in the Fur[-][/c], gives Taunt to allied Wookiee Tanks and increases Defense and Max Health to all allies. Wookiee allies gain bonus Offense based on the amount of Defense they have! If there were no Galactic Legend enemies, when Wookiee allies are critically hit, they reflect a portion of that damage back to the enemy.
MSG_EVENT_TARFFUL_5-2|With Tarfful's Omicron active in the Territory Wars game mode, this ability provides additional Defense and buffs to Wookiee allies when they are critically hit. If a Wookiee is defeated in battle, Wookiee allies recover their Health and gain additional Offense.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_1-1|The Mandalorian is a Light Side Bounty Hunter with a special granted ability once when he gains his Payout.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_1-2|[c][F0FF23]Swift Shot[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and the Mandalorian gains Critical Chance Up.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_2-1|[c][F0FF23]Transpierce[-][/c] deals Physical damage to target enemy and calls another target Bounty Hunter ally to assist.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_3-1|[c][F0FF23]Asset Acquisition[-][/c] gives all Scoundrel allies Speed, Tenacity and Critical Chance.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_3-2|The Mandalorian's Contract: Bounty Hunter allies who score critical hits while buffed contribute to the Mandalorian's Contract. Once completed, Bounty Hunter allies gain extra Offense and Health Steal for each buffed ally while attacking.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_4-1|With [c][F0FF23]Disciplined Bounty Hunter[-][/c], each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit, he gains bonus Turn Meter. At the start of encounter, the Mandalorian has Bounty Hunter's Resolve until he is defeated.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_5-1|When the Mandalorian gains his Payout, he gains Critical Damage and the Special ability [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] until the end of battle. If the Mandalorian does not have Critical Chance Up or Critical Damage Up at the start of his turn, [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] can't be used.
MSG_EVENT_THEMANDALORIAN_5-2|[c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] instantly defeats the target enemy, which can't be evaded. Enemies defeated by this ability can't be revived. Each time the Mandalorian scores a critical hit while buffed, the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Disintegrate[-][/c] is reduced.
MSG_EVENT_TIESILENCER_1-1|[c][F0FF23]DISRUPTIVE ADVANCE[-][/c] deals damage and enemies with 50% Turn Meter, or higher, are Stunned
MSG_EVENT_TIESILENCER_2-1|[c] If the TIE silencer has Advantage, [c][F0FF23]OVERWHELMING ADVANTAGE[-][/c] does increased damage and grants Foresight if the opponent dies
MSG_EVENT_TIESILENCER_3-1|[c] If the TIE silencer is damaged, or damages an enemy with Target Lock, [c][F0FF23]FRENZIED RAGE[-][/c] grants Speed and Offense Up (stacking)
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_1-1|Tusken Chieftain, leader of the tribe of Tuskens that took in Boba Fett, has joined the Holotables! 
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_1-2|A strong leader who seeks to protect their people from the encroachment of newcomers to Tatooine, such as the Pykes.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_1-3|Their Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Ceremonial Dance[-][/c], calls an ally to assist, dealing bonus damage, and grants Tuskens 2 stacks of Momentum (abilities gain additional effects).
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_2-1|Chieftain's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Token of Respect[-][/c], dispels debuffs on Tusken allies, grants them Protection Up (grants bonus Protection), and lowers their cooldowns.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_3-1|Chieftain's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Ancestral Claim[-][/c], inflicts Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn) on enemies when they heal.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_3-2|Whenever an enemy takes damage from Damage Over Time, Tusken allies recover Health.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_4-1|Chieftain's Leader ability, [c][ffff33]Nomadic People[-][/c], grants Tusken allies stacks of Momentum when enemies gain bonus Turn Meter (determines how quickly a character can take another turn). Tusken allies gain Defense and Tenacity from stacks of Momentum.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_4-2|Whenever a Tusken ally with 10 or more stacks of Momentum is targeted, that enemy is Stunned (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) and gains stacks of Damage Over Time. The targeted ally then loses their stacks of Momentum.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENCHIEFTAIN_4-3|With their Omicron active in the 3v3 Grand Arenas game mode, Tusken Chieftain makes Boba Fett, Scion of Jango, a member of the tribe. Boba counts as a Tusken and does not lose stacks of Momentum when targeted.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_1-1|Tusken Warrior, a fierce fighter from the tribe of Tuskens that took in Boba Fett, has joined the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_1-2|She is a strong fighter who won't hesitate to protect her tribe from any threat.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_1-3|Her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Gaderffii Smack[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and inflicts Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn). If she has Momentum (abilities gain additional effects), she attacks again.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_2-1|Tusken Warrior's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Tusken Charge[-][/c], grants Critical Damage Up (increases critical damage of attacks) and Momentum, then deals Physical damage, inflicts Defense Down (reduced Defense stat), and dispels all buffs on all enemies.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_3-1|Tusken Warrior's Special Ability, [c][ffff33]Finishing Strikes[-][/c], deals Physical damage and inflicts Damage Over Time. Deal damage an additional time (up to 5 times, 50% less damage, and can't be countered) for each stack of Momentum removed from Tusken Warrior.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_3-2|The ability has extra effects depending on how many Momentum stacks Tusken Warrior has.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_4-1|Tusken Warrior's Unique ability, [c][ffff33]Centuries of Tradition[-][/c], grants her extra damage for each instance of Damage Over Time on all enemies, and all enemies lose Tenacity whenever Damage Over Time expires. Whenever Momentum is removed during an enemies turn, she gains 10 stacks of Momentum.
MSG_EVENT_TUSKENHUNTRESS_4-2|With her Omicron active in the Territory Wars game mode, Tusken Warrior dispels all debuffs on herself, the cooldown of Finishing Strikes is reset, and she gains a bonus turn once she reaches 15 stacks of Momentum.
MSG_EVENT_TUTORIAL_LORE_01|I asked Shar to add some [c][F0FF23]Lore[-][/c] entries for this event. Be sure to let him know if you enjoy them.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-1|Greetings Holotable Heroes! I am pleased to introduce Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian). This cunning scoundrel was able to infiltrate Jabba's Palace and earn the respect of the Hutt himself during a daring rescue operation on Tatooine, and now his skills are yours to command on the Holotables!
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-2|Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Double Dealer[-][/c], deals Physical damage to target enemy and grants Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) a stack of [c][ffff33]Deep Cover[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_1-3|Deep Cover grants extra Defense Penetration (ignores some of the target's Defense stat) and Potency per stack (max 5).
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_2-1|Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]Cutter vibro-ax[-][/c], deals Physical damage to the target enemy. This ability gains Defense Penetration and Offense for each stack of Deep Cover that Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_2-2|When Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) uses this ability while he has 5 stacks of Deep Cover, he will inflict the target enemy with Armor Shred (reduced Defense stat) until the end of battle, multiple stacks of Damage Over Time (inflicts damage at the start of their turn), and this ability has a chance to refresh its cooldowns.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-1|Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s Special ability, [c][ffff33]Covert Coordination[-][/c], dispels debuffs on the target ally and grants them stacks of Deep Cover equal to the amount on Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) along with a variety of buffs. 
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-2|If the target ally is Light Side, they gain Potency Up (debuffs are harder to resist) and Stealth (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available). If the target ally is Dark Side, they gain Defense Up (increased Defense stat, which reduces incoming damage) and Health Up (increases Max Health). If the target ally is Hutt Cartel, they also gain Speed Up (takes turns more often) and Retribution (will counter attack when damaged).
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_3-3|When Covert Coordination is used, the target ally will also be called to assist and they will gain a bonus turn.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-1|Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains Defense Penetration with [c][ffff33]Agent On The Inside[-][/c], and grants Defense Penetration and Potency to any allies with any stacks of Deep Cover. At the start of Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian)'s turn, he gains a stack of Deep Cover. If all allies were Hutt Cartel at the start of battle, Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) immediately gains 5 stacks of Deep Cover.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-2|While Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has 5 stacks of Deep Cover, he gains the granted ability [c][ffff33]Hutt's Favor[-][/c], which consumes all stacks of Deep Cover on Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) and deals Physical damage to the target enemy. This ability will deal more damage based on the number of debuffs the enemy has, and will grant Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) [c][ffff33]Trusted Agent[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-3|Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains Defense Penetration and Offense for each stack of Trusted Agent that he has. While Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) has at least one stack of Trusted Agent active, he will attack again when using his Basic attack.
MSG_EVENT_UNDERCOVERLANDO_4-4|While in Territory Wars, allies gain additional bonuses while they have Deep Cover, and whenever Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) gains a stack of Deep Cover, he grants a stack of Deep Cover to an ally that doesn't have it.
MSG_EVENT_VADERDUELSEND_1-1|Fueled by a burning rage, an unstoppable Sith Lord arrives. I'm thrilled to welcome Darth Vader (Duel's End) to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_VADERDUELSEND_1-2|Feared across the galaxy for his ruthlessness, Darth Vader (Duel's End) marked the final transformation of Anakin - the Jedi hero, into 'Darth Vader'- the Empire's powerful enforcer.
MSG_EVENT_VANE_1-1|A ruthless Lieutenant, feared across the Outer Rim, I'm excited to bring the deadly Pirate, Vane to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_VANE_1-2|Vane was notorious for his unshakable loyalty, sharp tongue, and deadly aim.
MSG_EVENT_VANGUARDTEMPLEGUARD_1-1|Picked discreetly from the ranks of the Jedi, these silent guardians stand ready against any foe. Join me in welcoming Temple Guard to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_VANGUARDTEMPLEGUARD_1-2|Known for their double-bladed yellow lightsabers and distinctive face masks, the Temple Guards were Jedi Knights dedicated to the protection of the Jedi Temple.
MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_1-1|[c][F0FF23]UNCHAINED[-][/c] deals damage, grants Chewbacca Advantage, and ignores Defense.
MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_2-1|[c][F0FF23]FREEDOM FIGHTER[-][/c] deals damage to the enemy twice, target ally recovers health, and both Chewbacca and the Ally gain Protection Up. If Chewbacca is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] this Ability has bonus beneficial effects
MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_3-1|[c][F0FF23]THE BEAST[-][/c] reduces Chewbacca's maximum Protection, but increases his Maximum Health.
MSG_EVENT_VCHEWBACCA_4-1|[c][F0FF23]FEROCIOUS PROTECTOR[-][/c] grants Chewbacca counter chance when buffed, and allows him to recover Protection if allies took damage and he did not.
MSG_EVENT_VEL_1-1|I am excited to announce the arrival of a determined Rebel commander, [c][ffff33]Vel Sartha[-][/c], to the holotables.
MSG_EVENT_VEL_1-2|Measured and unyielding, Vel commands high-risk Rebel missions, knowing every victory against the Empire demands sacrifice.
MSG_EVENT_VISAS_1-1|[c][F0FF23]TELEKINETIC BLAST[-][/c] deals Physical damage and dispels all debuffs on Visas and another random debuffed ally.
MSG_EVENT_VISAS_2-1|[c][F0FF23]DARK HEALING[-][/c] deals Physical damage to all enemies. All allies gain Health Steal Up and recover some of their Health.
MSG_EVENT_VISAS_3-1|[c][F0FF23]PIERCING STRIKE[-][/c] deals Physical damage and grants all allies Defense Penetration Up.
MSG_EVENT_VISAS_4-1|[c][F0FF23]RETURNED TO THE LIGHT[-][/c] grants Visas Counter Chance when she isn’t debuffed.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_1-1|The Vulture Droid is a nimble Separatist Attacker that hinders enemy ships with Buzz Droids and calls in backup when defeated.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_1-2|[c][F0FF23]Unrelenting Attack[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy. This damage doesn't remove Buzz Droids.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_2-1|[c][F0FF23]Discord Missile[-][/c] deals damage to the target enemy and inflicts [c][F0FF23]Buzz Droids[-][/c]. Buzz Droids can't be copied or resisted.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_2-2|A ship inflicted with Buzz Droids has lowered Defense and takes damage over time. They lose a Buzz Droid by taking damage.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_3-1|With [c][F0FF23]Swarming Terror[-][/c], the Vulture Droid will assist every time a Separatist or Droid ally attacks an enemy inflicted with Buzz Droids.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_3-2|If an enemy has at least 1 Buzz Droid on them at the start of their turn, the stack resets.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_3-3|When fully upgraded, the first time the Vulture Droid is defeated, another is summoned if the allied Capital Ship is Separatist.
MSG_EVENT_VULTUREDROID_4-1|[c][F0FF23]Buzz Droid Barrage[-][/c] inflicts all enemies with Buzz Droids when the Vulture Droid reinforces.
MSG_EVENT_WICKET_1-1|[c][F0FF23]INQUISITIVE JAB[/c][-] attacks an enemy and grants Wicket Critical Chance Up
MSG_EVENT_WICKET_2-1|[c][F0FF23]FOREST AMBUSH[/c][-] attacks all enemies and also grants Turn Meter for each critical hit
MSG_EVENT_WICKET_3-1|[c][F0FF23]GUERILLA STRIKE[/c][-] grants Wicket and target Ewok ally Stealth
MSG_EVENT_WICKET_4-1|[c][F0FF23]FURTIVE TACTICS[/c][-] grants Wicket critical damage per Ewok or Stealthed ally, and give him a chance to act again
MSG_EVENT_WRECKERS3_1-1|I am pleased to announce the arrival of Wrecker (Mercenary) to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_WRECKERS3_1-2|Get up close and personal with your enemies and teach them a lesson they won't forget.
MSG_EVENT_XANADU_1-1|[c][F0FF23]HULL BREACH[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts [c][F0FF23]BREACH[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_XANADU_2-1|[c][F0FF23]ROGUE MANEUVER[-][/c] deals damage to all enemies, Target Locks the weakest enemy, then calls an ally to assist.
MSG_EVENT_XANADU_3-1|[c][F0FF23]CLOAK AND DAGGER[-][/c] lowers the Offense of Breached enemies and gives Xanadu Blood Stealth at the start of an Encounter or when an ally is Critically hit.
MSG_EVENT_XANADU_4-1|[c][F0FF23]INTO THE BREACH[-][/c] inflicts BREACH on the target enemy when entering from Reinforcement.
MSG_EVENT_YHAN_1-1|[c][F0FF23]TRICK SHOT[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Speed Down. If target is below 25% Turn Meter gain [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c]. [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] is a special Effect that some characters can use to enhance their Abilities
MSG_EVENT_YHAN_2-1|[c][F0FF23]UPPER HAND[-][/c] grants Han Protection Up, Retribution, and stacking Speed.
MSG_EVENT_YHAN_3-1|[c][F0FF23]JUST IN TIME[-][/c] deals damage and 25% more damage for each Prepared ally. If Han has [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] he grants it to target ally and all Prepared allies gain bonuses
MSG_EVENT_YHAN_4-1|[c][F0FF23]READY FOR ANYTHING[-][/c] grants Han stacking Offense and Critical Chance when starting a turn with Protection Up.
MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_1-1|[c][F0FF23]SILENT SHOT[-][/c] deals damage, inflicts Potency Down, and deals 25% more damage for each [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] ally.
MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_2-1|[c][F0FF23]HOT HAND[-][/c] deals damage and inflicts Ability Block. For each debuffed enemy there is a 50% chance to reduce the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]HOT HAND[-][/c]
MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_3-1|[c][F0FF23]DEALER'S CHOICE[-][/c] dispels an ally, and Young Lando Calrissian gains Turn Meter. If Young Lando Calrissian is [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] he grants it to that ally and all Prepared allies gain Speed Up
MSG_EVENT_YLANDO_4-1|Young Lando Calrissian's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]PERFECT TIMING[-][/c], gives him a chance to become [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c] at the start of his turn, and grants Critical Chance and Critical Damage to himself if he is buffed or [c][F0FF23]PREPARED[-][/c].
MSG_EVENT_YODACHEWBACCA_1-1|I am happy to announce the arrival of Yoda & Chewie to the holotables!
MSG_EVENT_YODACHEWBACCA_1-2|Yoda & Chewie were legendary heroes who fought to defend the Republic during the Clone Wars and beyond.
MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_1-1|The Y-wing is a durable Galactic Republic Tank that has an activated Taunt on its Special ability and can withstand a high amount of damage.
MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_1-2|[c][F0FF23]Twin Laser Cannons[-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy, dealing more damage for each ally with Valor.
MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_2-1|[c][F0FF23]Torpedoes Away![-][/c] deals Physical damage to the target enemy and weakest enemy, and can't be evaded.
MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_2-2|In addition, the Y-wing also gains Taunt and Protection Up for 2 turns.
MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_3-1|With [c][F0FF23]Astromech Advantage[-][/c], the Y-wing has increased Max Protection for each Galactic Republic ally, including reinforcements.
MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_3-2|The Y-wing also recovers Health when a Galactic Republic ally is critically hit, and Taunts when the effects of Unending Loyalty are triggered.
MSG_EVENT_YWINGCLONEWARS_4-1|[c][F0FF23]Backup Procedure[-][/c] grants the Y-wing Taunt when it reinforces.
MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_1-1|[c][F0FF23]STALWART ALLY[-][/c] damages target enemy and Zaalbar recovers Health.
MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_2-1|[c][F0FF23]POWER BLAST[-][/c] damages all enemies and grants Taunt.
MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_3-1|[c][F0FF23]WOOKIEE TOUGHNESS[-][/c] grants Defense (stacking) whenever Zaalbar takes damage until the end of his next turn.
MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_4-1|[c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c] grants Critical Avoidance to Zaalbar and Mission. Zaalbar gains Taunt and Retribution when an ally falls below Max Health.
MSG_EVENT_ZAALBAR_5-1|Mission and Zaalbar start with Critical Avoidance thanks to [c][F0FF23]MISSION'S GUARDIAN[-][/c], while [c][F0FF23]WOOKIEE ENDURANCE[-][/c] will help Zaalbar to survive the onslaught.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-1|Zorii Bliss, the cunning head of the Spice Runners of Kijimi, has joined the Holotables! 
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-2|A scoundrel and smuggler who ran spice, she attempted to remain neutral despite the growing hostility of the First Order, but was forced to choose a side when an old acquaintance came to her for help.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_1-3|Her Basic ability, [c][ffff33]Twin E-851 Blasters[-][/c], deals damage to the target enemy with additional bonuses if Zorii is Stealthed (can't be targeted by enemies, unless only Stealthed targets are available).
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_2-1|Zorii's Special ability, [c][ffff33]Captain's Medallion[-][/c], dispels debuffs on Resistance allies, provides benefits for those debuffs being dispelled, allows her to gain Stealth, and calls Resistance allies to assist.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_3-1|With Zorii's second Special ability, [c][ffff33]I've Done Worse For a Lot Less[-][/c], she will deal damage to an enemy target with extra damage for each Expose (receives additional damage from attacks) that was triggered. If an enemy was Exposed, Zorii Stuns (can't assist or counter attack and miss their next turn) them, and if she defeats an enemy with this ability, she Exposes all enemies.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_4-1|Zorii's first Unique ability, [c][ffff33]There's More of Us[-][/c], provides stat boosts for Resistance allies with different boosts based on the number of allies and enemies. Resistance allies gain Tenacity Up (increased chance to resist debuffs) when any of them gain it, and receive additional benefits while they have Tenacity Up.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_4-2|With her Omicron active in the Grand Arenas game mode, whenever Zorii is Stealthed at the start of her turn, all enemies who don't have Expose will become Exposed.
MSG_EVENT_ZORIIBLISS_5-1|[c][ffff33]Spice Runner Skills[-][/c] provides benefits for allies whenever they trigger an Expose on enemies. It also gives your allies Turn Meter and additional buffs the first time they fall below full Health.
MSG_EVENT_ZUCKUSS_1-1|I am excited to announce that the enigmatic Gand Bounty Hunter [c][ffff33]ZUCKUSS[-][/c] is joining the holotables.
MSG_EVENT_ZUCKUSS_1-2|Zuckuss is a prophetic Findsman and unyielding Bounty Hunter, using mystic visions to turn the tide of any hunt.
MSG_FOTF_DEVASTATOR_01|This event lets you use the ruthless Darth Vader to command his Capital Ship, the Devastator.
MSG_FOTF_DEVASTATOR_02|Vader's Devastator is similar to the Executrix, but provides its bonuses to all ships under your command and dispels all buffs on the target enemy when you call a reinforcement. Use this knowledge to your advantage!
MSG_FOTF_DEVASTATOR_03|Keep in mind that the Devastator is only available to you in this event, so you will not be able to obtain or use it in any other event or game mode.
MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_01|This is the new [c][F0FF23]GALACTIC BOUNTY[-][/c] event! The bounties are arranged from [c][F0FF23]EASY[-][/c] to [c][F0FF23]DEADLY[-][/c].
MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_02|Use your [c][F0FF23]BOUNTY HUNTERS[-][/c] to complete this event and earn character shards!
MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_03|Be careful with the [c][F0FF23]DEADLY[-][/c] bounties though. Only a very powerful squad will be able to complete those.
MSG_GALACTIC_BOUNTY_INTRO_04|You can capture [c][F0FF23]2[-][/c] bounties each time the event is live. Good Luck!
MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_4-1|I’ve escaped warlords, debt collectors, and the Jedi. Hoth? Please. That was just... inconvenient.
MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_5-1|They say legends were forged on Endor. I say...some of us were already legendary!
MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_6-1|So there I am—blizzards, blasters, a Wookiee howling in grief—and these two youngsters want to storm the base. I just came to steal a shuttle!
MSG_GLE_PIRATEKINGHONDO_6-2|They get the credit, I get the carbon scoring. Typical. Save the day, dodge the explosions, no statue!
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_1-1|Let's hope all that training pays off.
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_2-1|Back into the Order, you may come.
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_2-2|They're asking you back Ahsoka. I'm asking you back.
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_2-3|I'm sorry master, but I'm not coming back.
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_3-1|The Emperor will show you mercy, if you tell me where the remaining Jedi can be found.
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_3-2|Revenge is not the Jedi way.
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_3-3|I am no Jedi.
MSG_GLEVENT_AHSOKA_5-1|How inevitable.
MSG_GLEVENT_CINEMATIC_LUKE_T4|See you around, kid.
MSG_GLEVENT_CINEMATIC_PALP_T4|Nothing will stop the return of the Sith.
MSG_GLEVENT_CINEMATIC_PALPLUKE_T3|Now, young Skywalker, you will die.
MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_1-1|Yassa nee choo (Take him away!)
MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_1-2|I'll pay you triple! You're throwing away a fortune here. Don't be a fool!
MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_2-1|You will bring Captain Solo and the Wookiee to me.
MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_2-2|Ya koo tocha ka poonoo nee sok nyee (Your mind powers will not work on me, boy.)
MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_3-1|Oh no! The Rancor!
MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_4-1|Koos numa (Put them in.)
MSG_GLEVENT_JABBA_5-1|Do not underestimate our power.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-1|The great Jabba the Hutt will now listen to your pleas.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-2|Threepio, you tell that slimy piece of worm-ridden filth he'll get no such pleasure from us.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-3|Raaaarrrgh!
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-4|Right?
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_1-5|Jabba, this is your last chance. Free us, or die.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_2-1|Artoo where are you? We need you at the bunker right away.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_2-2|What do you mean, "you're going?"
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_2-3|Bleep bloop
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_2-4|Going where, Artoo? No, wait!\n\nThis is no time for heroics! Come back!
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_3-1|I feel your anger.\n\nI am defenseless. Take your weapon.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_3-2|Strike me down with all of your hatred and your journey towards the dark side will be complete.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-1|I failed you Ben, I'm sorry.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-2|I'm sure you are! The resistance is dead. The war is over. And when I kill you, I will have killed the last Jedi.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-3|Amazing. Every word of what you just said was wrong.\n\nThe Rebellion is reborn today. The war is just beginning.
MSG_GLEVENT_JEDIMASTERLUKE_4-4|And I will not be the last Jedi.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_1|So Uncivilized.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_2|Hello there.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_3|You were the chosen one...
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_3-1|I've recalibrated the code warning all surviving Jedi to stay away.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_3-2|For the clones to discover the recalibration, a long time it will take.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_4-1|If you're not with me, then you're my enemy.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_4-2|Only a Sith deals in absolutes.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_5-1|I have failed you, Anakin. I have failed you.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_6-1|It's over Anakin. I have the high ground.
MSG_GLEVENT_JMK_6-2|You underestimate my power.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-1|Did you hear that? They shut down the main reactor.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-2|BLEEP BLOOP
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-3|We're doomed. There will be no escape for the Princess this time.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-4|This is our most desperate hour.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-5|Help me Obi-Wan Kenobi, you're my only hope.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_1-6|BEEP BLIP BLIP
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_2-1_V2|When you've gotten past the energy field proceed directly to the rendezvous point.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_2-2|Understood? Good luck.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_2-3|Give the evacuation code signal.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_2-4|And get to your transports!
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-1|Oh, no! Chewie they're behind you!
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-2|The security code has been changed.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-3|Artoo, you can tell the computer to override the security systems.
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-4|Artoo, hurry!
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-5|I never doubted you for a second! Wonderful!
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_3-6|Leia! Go!
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_4-1_V2|Co slayat ni (Bring her to me)
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_4-2|We have powerful friends. You're going to regret this!
MSG_GLEVENT_LEIA_4-3|Roe tah oh (I'm sure)
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-3|In the name of the Galactic Senate of the Republic, you are under arrest, Chancellor.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-4|Are you threatening me, Master Jedi?
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-5|The Senate will decide your fate.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-6|I am the Senate.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-7|Not yet.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_1-8|It's treason, then.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-1|You are under arrest, my lord.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-2|...
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-3|Anakin, I told you it would come to this. I was right. The Jedi are taking over!
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-4|The oppression of the Sith will never return. You have lost.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_2-5|Don't let him kill me!
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_3-1|Strike me down with all of your hatred and your journey towards the dark side will be complete.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_4-1|Stand together, die together.\n\nThe lifeforce of your bond, a dyad in the Force.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_4-2|A power like life itself.
MSG_GLEVENT_SITHETERNALEMPEROR_4-3|Unseen for generations... and now the power of two restores the one, true Emperor.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-1|The legend of Revan's story began in orbit around the planet Taris. When Revan's ship was attacked by the Sith, Revan barely made it to an escape pod with a Republic soldier named Carth Onasi.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-2|Together, they crash-landed on Taris and began to look for ways to earn Credits and resources so they could escape. Revan, desiring a challenge and glory, entered the Taris fighting arena under the alias "Mysterious Stranger."
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-3|Here we go folks, the Mysterious Stranger is on a tear! Will anyone be able to stop this whirlwind of doom?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-4|Ladies and gentlemen you're in for a real treat! Coming out of retirement for one more battle: the infamous Bendak Starkiller! Will the Mysterious Stranger be able to keep up the lucky streak, or has it ended?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_1-5|What a fight! What an upset! We have a new champion of the Taris Arena! I give you the oooooone, the ooooonly MYSTERIOUS STRANGER!
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-1|After teaming up with Canderous Ordo and rescuing Bastila Shan, Revan made for Dantooine and the hidden Jedi Enclave located there.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-2|At the Enclave, the Jedi Council retrained Revan in the ways of the Force, hoping to use buried memories as a secret weapon against the Sith. As a test, they sent Revan to find a missing Padawan named Juhani who was in danger of falling to the dark side.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-3|You are not welcome here.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-4|This is the Padawan we were sent to find. Has she... fallen to the dark side?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-5|How can you be so strong? To defeat me here, in my place of darkness...
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_2-6|I was a fool to think myself strong.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-1|Upon departing Dantooine, Revan's task was to find pieces of a “Star Map” scattered across the galaxy. One piece was on Tatooine, but after they found it, a famous bounty hunter named Calo Nord showed up with a score to settle.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-2|I'm impressed you made it this far. You're hard to kill. But this is where your journey ends.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-3|HK-47.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-4|Curious Acknowledgment: Yes, Master?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-5|Blast him.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-6|Anticipatory Reply: With extreme prejudice, Master!
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-7|Observation: Marvelous elimination of the enemy, Master. I applaud you.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_3-8|We have the Star Map fragment, let's return to the Ebon Hawk and plan our next move.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-1|On a world called Korriban… hmm, that planet is mentioned a lot, I wonder if it really exists. Oh, ahem. On a world called Korriban, Revan fought the spirit of a Sith Lord named Ajunta Pall!
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-2|Query: Master, do you suspect this incorporeal meatbag is as susceptible to blaster fire as regular meatbags?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-3|Only one way to find out.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-4|My tomb... shall now be yours.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-5|Bemused Anecdote: Oh, Master, it is a rare joy to be able to terminate something for a second time. What a rush!
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-6|Query: Do you suppose there are other transparent meatbags somewhere we could also exterminate?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_4-7|Let's just get out of here before anything else attacks us.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-1|On Manaan, Revan and the team fought their way through a Sith Embassy looking for secret information.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-2|Observation: This location is positively filled with targets waiting to be blasted. You do take me to the nicest places, Master.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-3|You've got your work cut out for you then, don't you?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-4|Mocking Statement: Master I must protest. Droids are not an adequate enemy for someone of my skills. They don't even leak or scream when blasted.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_5-5|Query: Can we go find some non-droids to blast, Master?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-1|During their journey, Revan's nemesis Darth Malak captured Bastila. Malak used all his cunning and dark power to turn Bastila from the light. Revan resolved to track her down and either destroy a potential new rival... or regain a valuable follower.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-10|Together we can destroy Malak.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-11|Together as Master...
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-12|...And Apprentice. And, perhaps...
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-2|Due to the powerful Force Bond that existed between the two, finding Bastila was all too easy. But turning her from Malak's influence would not be.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-3|I knew you'd come for me, Revan. Malak didn't think you would, but I know you. I know you all too well.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-4|Not even the Jedi Council could separate us, but here we are. Have you come to defeat Malak? To reclaim your place as Dark Lord?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-5|I've come to reclaim what is mine.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-6|Let's see if you can. I'm more powerful now than you can imagine. Here, let me show you...
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-7|I can't believe it, you're so powerful. I thought it impossible, but you're...
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-8|The Dark Lord of the Sith.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_6-9|Yes. I can see it now... feel it. Let's join together once again.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-1|Returning from the temple with Bastila, Revan faced one final challenge before embarking for the star forge to face Darth Malak. Some amongst the party refused to follow the Revan they found before them. They would have to be dealt with.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-10|There's only one thing left to do, my Lord Revan. To the star forge...
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-11|Malak awaits.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-2|I've seen what the Sith have done to the galaxy. I don't want to, but I'll fight you. Even if it costs me my life.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-3|I cannot abide this. I agree with Jolee.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-4|You're a full-on Sith psycho! I KNEW you couldn't be trusted! You're Revan, the Dark Lord of the Sith! How could I ever believe you'd change?
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-5|You are all fools! Revan is the true Dark Lord, and if you won't bow down... you will be cut down!
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-6|HK-47, kill the traitors!
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-7|Statement: Happily, Master!
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-8|That was a fun fight, I haven't had a challenge like that in years.
MSG_JOURNEY_DARTHREVAN_7-9|Annotation: It was most enjoyable when each of them screamed. I found that especially endearing.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_1-1|What's wrong girl? You smell something?
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-1|You alright?
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-2|Why are you still here?
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-3|I heard the Command Center had been hit.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-4|You've got your clearance to leave.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-5|Don't worry, I'll leave, but first I'm going to get you to your ship.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_3-6|Your Highness we must take this last transport. It's our only hope!
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_4-1|They're getting closer!
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_4-2|Oh yeah? Watch this.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_4-3|[Hyperdrive Engine Fails!]
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_4-4|Watch what?
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-1|I feel... cold...
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-2|That place is strong with the dark side of the Force. A domain of evil it is.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-3|What's in here?
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-4|Only what you take with you.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-5|Beeep, bwoooooorrrr, boop beeeeep?!
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_5-6|Something doesn't feel right about this place.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_6-1|I'm just trying to help!
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_6-2|We don't need any of your help.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_6-3|Arrrrogggaaahhh urrrrr waaaaarrr!
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_6-4|There's still a chance to save Han at the east platform.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_6-5|Chewie! Come on!
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_7-1|Obi-wan has taught you well. You have control of your fear.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_7-2|Now... release your anger. Only your hatred can destroy me.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_8-1|You killed my father!
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_8-2|No... I am your father.
MSG_JOURNEY_JEDIKNIGHTLUKE_ENC_02_5-1|Alone you must go. Help I can not. 
MSG_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_3-1|Welcome back, Mando! Now put the package down.
MSG_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_3-2|Step aside. I'm going to my ship.
MSG_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_3-3|You put the bounty down and perhaps I'll let you pass.
MSG_JOURNEY_MANDALORIAN_3-4|The kid's coming with me.
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_1_1|You call this a diplomatic solution?
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_1_2|No, I call it aggressive negotiations!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_2_1|Hello there!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_3_1|I see you got my message.
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_3_2|I decided we would come and rescue you.
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_3_3|It looks like you're doing a good job so far!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_4_1|Seems like they need a lesson in diplomacy!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_4_2|I don't think they're interested in peace talks!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_5_1|Let's not make a habit of this, Anakin.
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_5_2|Whatever you say, Master.
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_5_3|Less talking, more surviving you two!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_6_1|This party's over!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_7_1|Look out! More of them!
MSG_LEGENDARY_PADME_7_2|I see them.
MSG_REEK_DIALOGUE_01|Hostiles ahead. Careful of the Reek and the bounty hunter!
MSG_REEK_DIALOGUE_02|Whether you're beast or otherwise, you're all targets to me.
MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-1|All ships have [c][F0FF23]REINFORCEMENT ABILITIES[-][/c] that trigger when they're called from reserves.
MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-2|In this Battle you can call a very powerful [c][F0FF23]REINFORCEMENT[-][/c] ship: [c][F0FF23]SLAVE 1[-][/c]!
MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-3|When [c][F0FF23]SLAVE 1[-][/c] enters as a Reinforcement it gains Taunt, Retribution, and Protection Up (10%) for 2 turns and Critical Hit Immunity for 3 turns. It also inflicts Ability Block on an enemy ship!
MSG_TUTORIAL_REINFORCEMENTS_V2_1-4|As you increase the Stars of your Capital Ship you unlock more slots for additional Reinforcements.
MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_GET_UNLOCK_01|Once again you've proven yourself against even my best efforts! Now that you've activated General Skywalker, you'll find additional shards available in the Guild Events Store so you can bring him up to maximum power.
MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_PRIMER_01|Now that the 501st clones have been introduced to the holotables, I thought it only fitting that they get their leader, General Skywalker himself.
MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_PRIMER_02|I decided to showcase General Skywalker's battlefield prowess during a pivotal battle for the 501st. I've created a scenario that takes place during the Battle of Kamino, though I may have... embellished some of the details.
MSGGRP_EVENT_CLASH_ON_KAMINO_PRIMER_03|In any case, this one won't be easy! Don't let your guard down.
MSGGRP_EVENT_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_GET_UNLOCK_01|Well done! You continue to impress me with your holotable prowess. Now that you've activated Darth Malak, you'll find additional shards available in the Guild Events Store so you can bring him up to maximum power.
MSGGRP_EVENT_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_PRIMER_01|I've managed to piece together a bit more of Revan's story from my texts.
MSGGRP_EVENT_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_PRIMER_02|Whether you believe Revan was saved by the light or returned to a darker path, all versions of the legend include a final confrontation with a Sith Lord called Darth Malak. I’ve laid out the tale for you in Star Forge Showdown.
MSGGRP_EVENT_STAR_FORGE_SHOWDOWN_PRIMER_03|This one is going to be a true challenge for you! Pay close attention to the effects and mechanics, and think strategically. It's quite different from what I've challenged you with before. Good luck!
