OR Aeromagnifiers\n300 Crystals\n\nTier 7\nEntry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at Relic 9\nRewards:\n5-10x Gyrda Keypads OR Droid Brains\n5x Omicron Materials\n500 Crystals\n\nTier 8\nEntry: Owning Maul (Hate-Fueled) at Relic 10, all other playable characters at Relic 9\nRewards:\n5x Gyrda Keypads\n5x Droid Brains \n5x Coaxial Servomotor\n1000 Crystals
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_ANDOR_NAME|Era of Andor Begins!
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_ANDOR_SUMMARY|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Era of Andor[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nThe critically acclaimed series on Disney+, Andor, gave us thrilling and exciting moments over both seasons, and we’re dedicated to bringing you the best that Star Wars has to offer, so we’re adding seven characters straight from the show to the game over the next three months.\n\nLuthen Rael was the first character we brought to Galaxy of Heroes, and that character continues to play a large role in the Rebel Fighter squad in the Era. Additionally, we are bringing in three powerhouses to rise against the Empire: Kleya, Vel, and Cinta.\n\nOur first Marquee release is [c][F0FF23]Kleya[-][/c]. Kleya was Luthen’s partner on Coruscant, and handled communications with Rebel cells and agents via a fractal radio. She works great by Luthen’s side, as well as the other Rebel Fighters in the Era.\n\nThe second and third Marquee characters are [c][F0FF23]Vel[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Cinta[-][/c]. This dynamic duo stole our hearts (as well as each other’s) and they have incredibly strong synergy with one another, each gaining bonuses based off of things happening to the other.\n\nA brand new sub-faction then comes with the fourth Marquee character, [c][F0FF23]Dedra Meero[-][/c]. The [c][F0FF23]ISB[-][/c] (short for Imperial Security Bureau) also includes the fifth and sixth Marquee units: [c][F0FF23]Major Partagaz[-][/c] and the [c][F0FF23]KX Security Droid[-][/c], with brand new and unique buffs and effects to emphasize their efforts in snuffing out the Rebellion, while pursuing their own ambitions through their Rank and Undermining their colleagues. \n\nRounding out the five-person ISB squad are the Imperial Probe Droid and Director Krennic, also receiving the ISB faction tag and some flavorful improvements to their kits.\n\nAll this is leading up to the Journey Guide unit for the Era: [c][F0FF23]Cassian Andor (Undercover)[-][/c]. While the look of the unit is taken from when he stole the TIE Avenger on Sienar, the character’s kit celebrates many of his alternate identities. He makes a powerful Leader for the new Rebel Fighters, embodying the code-phrase “I have friends everywhere” into synergistic effects.\n\nWe hope you enjoy the Era of Andor! We’re excited to bring you these units and events pulled straight from the show over the next three months.
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_REVENGE_OF_THE_SITH_DESC|Our next Era revisits the 20th Anniversary of Revenge of the Sith, introducing two new squads. First, [c][F0FF23]Dark Side Clones[-][/c] who work well with Empire but especially thrive when being led by none other than Lord Vader. Second, the defending [c][F0FF23]Jedi Vanguard[-][/c] squad who will be partially filled out by existing Jedi already obtainable.\n\nBoth squads will play through their respective experience in Revenge of the Sith Era Battles and all new marquee units will be required for the culmination of this Era, a legendary event for [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Mace Windu[-][/c].
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_REVENGE_OF_THE_SITH_TITLE|Era of Revenge of the Sith
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_THE_CAVALRY_DESC|The Cavalry has arrived!\n\nOur next Era is focused around Season 3 of the Bad Batch, introducing an entirely new Bad Batch squad of 5 marquee units. Starting with Omega fully coming into her own as a leader and ending with an old friend, this squad brings a distinct playstyle from the existing Bad Batch units.\n\nCollect these new units and keep your squad together!
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_THE_CAVALRY_TITLE|Era of the Cavalry
NEWSLETTER_ESCAPE_FROM_JEDHA_DESC|The ESCAPE FROM JEDHA EVENT has arrived and is available EXCLUSIVELY ON GOOGLE PLAY for a limited time! This special event is recommended for players Level 20 and above. Imperial forces block your way, so you will need to muster a squad capable of fighting your way off the planet. To assist you is Rogue One's K-2SO, a reprogrammed Imperial security Droid now turned Rebel agent.\n\nK-2SO is a Rebel tank capable of Dazing and Taunting his enemies while having a chance to counter attack whenever he takes damage and will be a welcome member of your squad as you fight to escape the desert moon.\n\nIf successful, you will earn shards to level up K-2SO! Are you ready to fight the Imperial army and Escape from Jedha?
NEWSLETTER_ESCAPE_FROM_JEDHA_TITLE|A Limited Time, SPECIAL EVENT: Escape from Jedha!
NEWSLETTER_EVENT_MODCELEBRATION_01_DESC|We wanted to thank you all for your feedback on our Mods release last week. Based on your feedback the team worked quickly to make adjustments last Friday to ensure Mods are a fun part of your overall game experience.\n\nTo thank you all for your feedback and patience we are running a Special Event this weekend for players level 50 and above!\n\nBegins: [c][b5e7f5]July 22nd, 10 A.M. PDT[-][/c]\nEnds: [c][b5e7f5]July 25th, 11 A.M PDT[-][/c]\n\n[c][ffffff]INBOX DELIVERIES[-][/c]\nReceive a Cantina gift each day for the next three days of the event. Be sure to login and collect this gift daily!\n\n[c][ffffff]FREE MOD REMOVAL[-][/c]\nTry different configurations on all of your qualifying Characters with no cost to remove any number of Mods.\n\n[c][ffffff]INSTANT UPGRADE INCREASED[-][/c]\nImproved chance of immediately increasing a Mod's level while upgrading.\n\nEnjoy!
NEWSLETTER_EVENT_MODCELEBRATION_01_TITLE|Mods Appreciation\n[c][f0ff23]LIMITED-TIME EVENT[-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_EWOK_EVENT_DESC|The Ewoks have taken over the Cantina for the month of July and they're popping up everywhere!\n\nPlayers can expect a Faction Pass for existing Ewoks, brand new Ewok Marquee Events, and random Ewok Double Drops showing up all over the Cantina. Collect new Ewoks and improve your existing Ewoks to participate in Flash Events later in the month.\n\nWhat to watch for:\n\nEwok Faction Pass - Your favorite, existing fearless warriors are getting a boost to Damage, Survivability and Utility. New Ewok assist mechanics turn these loveable furballs into a new Holotable powerhouse.\n\nNew Ewoks – Three new Ewoks are coming to the game later this month. Get free character shards for each of the new Ewoks in their Marquee Events. Be on the lookout for a very special event where you can experience the 7-Star version of new Ewoks.\n\nDouble Drops - Ewoks have been spotted randomly popping up around the Cantina and spreading Double Drop cheer. Check back daily and see if your favorite Ewok has been spotted making mischief!\n\nFlash Events - Power up your Ewoks all month long and prepare them for Ewok Flash Events. These events drop hard-to-get gear and other great rewards!
NEWSLETTER_EWOK_EVENT_TITLE|It's an Ewok Invasion!
NEWSLETTER_EWOK_FACTION_DESC|The warriors of Endor get some help with a mighty faction pass. Sometimes help comes from unexpected places!\n\nChief Chirpa leads the Ewoks into battle with a revamped mass assist call and empowers them to call even more assists with his leader ability. The Ewok Elder has improved healing, more effective revives, and decreased cooldowns. The Ewok Scout now brings a powerful arsenal that includes increased damage, assist calls, and new critical hit synergies. Teebo's ability kit has NOT been updated with the Ewok Faction pass, but he synergizes even better with his newly reworked Ewok allies.
NEWSLETTER_EWOK_FACTION_TITLE|Ewok Faction Pass!
NEWSLETTER_EXECUTOR_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Bounty Hunters are getting a Capital Ship to lead them into battle on the Holotables! One of the largest and most powerful Imperial vessels ever created, the imposing [c][F0FF23]Executor[-][/c] led the way for the Empire at both the Battle of Hoth and Endor. Under Admiral Firmus Piett, the Super Star Destroyer struck fear in the hearts of enemies before it met it’s demise by plummeting into the Death Star.\n\nIn addition to the ability to destroy the enemy Capital Ship and stun all enemies, the Executor can dispel Outmaneuver and Stealth on enemies and debuffs from Bounty Hunter allies. The all new buff, [c][F0FF23]We Don't Need Their Scum[-][/c], creates some fun interaction between Empire and Bounty Hunter ships, and the Executor allows Bounty Hunters to inflict Target Lock on the targeted enemy whenever they deal damage via their Basic ability. Breach synergy is abundant, as all Bounty Hunter allies are called to assist against an enemy with Breach.  \n\nAchieve dominance on the Holotables by adding the Executor to your ships roster through the all new Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event!
NEWSLETTER_EXECUTOR_TITLE|Bounty Hunters...We Don’t Need Their Scum
NEWSLETTER_EZRA_BRIDGER_EXILE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Ezra Bridger (Exile)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nAfter Purrgil transported Grand Admiral Thrawn’s Star Destroyer, Chimera, to another galaxy, Ezra Bridger found himself exiled on the planet of Peridea. Narrowly escaping Thrawn’s forces, Ezra ended up befriending a local tribe of Noti, protecting them from the ever present threats on the planet. Nearly a decade later, Sabine Wren was able to reunite with Ezra and the pair would face off against Thrawn’s Imperial Remnant forces alongside Ahsoka Tano.\n\nA key piece of the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c] squad, Ezra brings plenty to be reckoned with and a new faction tag for her squad - [c][E7E7E7]Spectre[-][/c]. He also introduces a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Exile[-][/c] that he starts battle with, but as he gains enough stacks of [c][F0FF23]Purrgil Migration[-][/c] through his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Force Is My Ally[-][/c], it will be removed from him and applied to an enemy for the rest of battle so he can reunite with his friends. Many of his abilities work with Jedi and Unaligned Force Users, with extra benefits for Spectre.\n\nHis first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Kanan’s Legacy[-][/c], dishes out defensive boosts for his allies, gives a bonus turn to one of them after calling them to assist, and can even provide Backup Plan to his Spectre allies. He also gains stacks of Resilient Defense, but enemies can’t assist or attack again against him, making these stacks tricky to get through quickly. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Exile[-][/c], provides allies defensive stats while under Exile so they can weather the storm, then grants offensive stats once it’s removed so they can fully lean into their team and unleash.\n\nUnlock Ezra Bridger (Exile) in the upcoming Conquest events!
NEWSLETTER_EZRA_BRIDGER_EXILE_TITLE|Ez Breezy Bridger Boy
NEWSLETTER_FACTION_PASS_SITH_DESC|We recently made a number of changes to characters who have the Sith label. This includes exciting changes to Darth Vader, Savage Opress, Darth Sidious, and more!\n\nFor a complete breakdown of all the changes made please visit the forums. (https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com)
NEWSLETTER_FACTION_PASS_SITH_TITLE|Sith Balance Changes
NEWSLETTER_FALCON_EVENT_PREVIEW_DESC|Han's Millennium Falcon is coming to the holotables! Piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, this ship is the target of an Imperial bounty. Gather your Bounty Hunter ships to hunt down this Legendary ship and earn the blueprints for [c][F0FF23]HAN'S MILLENNIUM FALCON[-][/c]. You will also need to own any valid Capital Ship of the correct star level to enter and complete this event.\n\nStay tuned for more news on the start of this exciting Legendary event!
NEWSLETTER_FALCON_EVENT_PREVIEW_TITLE|She's Fast Enough
NEWSLETTER_FENNEC_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Fennec Shand[-][/c], the notorious bounty hunter and assassin, has taken jobs across the galaxy since the fall of the Republic and continuing on through the events of The Mandalorian. She now makes her way to the Holotables!\n\nFennec worked for many of the top crime syndicates, and that experience shows in her kit, which synergizes with Bounty Hunters and Scoundrels. In addition to her Basic ability dealing multiple instances of damage, it also has the potential to grant her Offense Up. As an homage to her sniper skills, Fennec’s Special, “[c][F0FF23]I Don’t Miss[-][/c],” introduces the new debuff [c][F0FF23]Overconfident[-][/c], which actually works in her squad’s favor, as it increases the Offense, Speed, and Evasion of Dark Side Scoundrel allies, but at the cost of lowered Defense.\n\nLike all Bounty Hunters in Galaxy of Heroes, Fennec Shand receives a Payout after completion of a contract. For Fennec, the payout comes in the form of increased Critical Chance and Critical Damage, along with the new buff [c][F0FF23]Seasoned Veteran[-][/c], which allows her to ignore Taunt and gain additional effects on her abilities.\n\nUnlock Fennec Shand in the Tales From the Outer Rim VII Marquee Event!
NEWSLETTER_FENNEC_TITLE|A Dangerous Place To Be On Your Own
NEWSLETTER_FIFTH_BROTHER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Fifth Brother[-][/c], an Inquisitor who served Darth Vader to hunt down the Rebellion before falling at the hands of Maul, is coming to the holotables!\n\nStaying on theme for the Inquisitorius faction, Fifth Brother makes use of the Purge debuff to grant Inquisitorius allies Bonus Protection and inflict Fear on enemies. Fifth Brother also punishes non-Jedi enemies under a Jedi leader who gain bonus turn meter by inflicting them with the new effect [c][F0FF23]Provoked[-][/c]. Provoked is a debuff that grants a unit counter chance, but they will take damage and do reduced damage when they attack out of turn.\n\nHis Omicron Leader ability gives the Inquisitorius a boost in Territory Wars, where whenever an enemy gains bonus turn meter then allied Inquisitorius will also gain bonus turn meter. Additionally, non-Jedi under a Jedi leader who gain Retribution will lose Retribution and gain Expose instead.\n\nAdd Fifth Brother to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “RUTHLESS EFFICIENCY V” Marquee event, and prove your worth to the Empire!
NEWSLETTER_FIFTH_BROTHER_TITLE|Darkness Will Overtake You
NEWSLETTER_FIN_UNIT_PROMO_DESC|Keep the pressure up with this resistance tank character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Finn's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_FIN_UNIT_PROMO_TITLE|Finn - Learn More
NEWSLETTER_FINALIZER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe First Order's most notorious Star Destroyer, the [c][F0FF23]Finalizer[-][/c], has relentlessly pursued its enemies through the galaxy and is now available for Holotable combat.\n\nUnder the command of General Hux, this new Capital Ship's Ultimate ability is immediately available for deployment, beginning battle without a cooldown, and creating an early advantage for its allies. The Finalizer also introduces a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Hunted[-][/c], which weakens and slows enemy ships, giving the First Order a powerful flagship to lead its fleet.\n\nRid the galaxy of the Resistance once and for all by unlocking Finalizer in the new [c][F0FF23]Advanced Fleet Mastery - General’s Command[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_FINALIZER_TITLE|Hunt Them Down!
NEWSLETTER_FIRST_ORDER_OFFICER_UNIT_PROMO_DESC|Manipulate turn meters with this First Order support character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn the First Order Officer's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_FIRST_ORDER_OFFICER_UNIT_PROMO_TITLE|First Order Officer - Learn More
NEWSLETTER_FIRSTORDER_SPECIALFORCES_KYLO_DESC|This month Kylo Ren is unmasked. This release includes his ship, the TIE silencer, the First Order Special Forces TIE Pilot and his ship, the First Order Special Forces TIE fighter. These units are perfect for crushing the Resistance!\n\nKylo Ren (Unmasked) gives the First Order a survivable Tank whose ability, [c][F0FF23]HALT[-][/c], can Stun his opponents for 2 turns. [c][F0FF23]SCARRED[-][/c] increases his survivability by reducing how much percent Health damage he takes and let him recover Health and Protection. Finally, his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]MERCILESS PURSUIT[-][/c], gives First Order increased Speed, Critical Damage, and Turn Meter gain on Critical Hits.\n\nHis ship, the TIE silencer, is a ruthless attacker with the ability to Stun opponents who have 50% Turn Meter, or more. Additionally, this ship will gain stacks of Speed and Offense Up when damaging, or is damaged by, ships who have Target Lock.\n\nThe First Order SF TIE Pilot is an AoE attacker who inflicts Defense Down, gains Advantage, and focuses on disrupting opponents. His ship, the First Order SF TIE fighter, now brings consistent Target Lock for the First Order and, like its pilot, a significant source of AoE damage.\n\nKylo Ren (Unmasked) and the TIE silencer become the backbone of your First Order squad, while the First Order SF TIE Pilot and his TIE fighter bring more options to the First Order.\n\nNow is the time to build your First Order squads for galactic domination!
NEWSLETTER_FIRSTORDER_SPECIALFORCES_KYLO_TITLE|First Order Fury: Kylo Ren (Unmasked) and the First Order SF TIE Pilot
NEWSLETTER_FLAWED_SIGNAL_DATA_LIGHT_062124_DESC|For a limited time, Flawed Signal Data has been added to Light Side and Dark Side Battle hard nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nLight Side and Dark Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/21/2024 through 06/24/2024.
NEWSLETTER_FLAWED_SIGNAL_DATA_LIGHT_062124_TITLE|Flawed Signal Data is available on Light Side and Dark Side Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_FLEET_BATTLES_UPDATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe’ve made several temporary changes to the Fleet Battles holotable in this update to make Gear XII+ salvage more accessible. \n\nWe’ve updated the type of gear available from Fleet Battles to create a better distinction between what can be earned with regular Energy and Ship Energy. Normal Fleet Battles can now drop Gear XII+ salvage. This enables you to focus your Ship Energy on the Gear XII+ piece you want next, while using your regular Energy to earn lower-level gear. Since we want regular Energy to be the primary way to earn lower-level gear, as part of these changes, we have removed some non-Gear XII+ salvage from normal Fleet Battle nodes.\n\nWe have also changed Ship Energy so it accrues at the same speed and costs the same to refresh as regular Energy. You’ll earn Ship Energy twice as fast now (from 1 Ship Energy every 12 minutes to 1 every 6 minutes) and it will cost less to refresh with Crystals. \n\nSome of these changes may become permanent in the future but we will monitor their impact and announce any further changes. If you have questions or ideas to share, head over to the Official Forums, where you’ll also find the latest updates.\n\nSee you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_FLEET_BATTLES_UPDATE_TITLE|Changes to the Fleet Battles Table
NEWSLETTER_FO_EXECUTIONER_DESC|This month introduces a merciless First Order melee attacker, the First Order Executioner. This brutal dark side unit brings additional damage to any First Order squad and is ideal when paired with Kylo Ren (Unmasked).\n\nThe First Order Executioner's basic, [c][F0FF23]JUDGEMENT[-][/c], will grant him Health Up for a single turn, while his Special, [c][F0FF23]DEATH SENTENCE[-][/c], will increase his Max Health if he doesn't kill his opponent (and various buffs if he does). All of these abilities feed in to his devastating Unique, [c][F0FF23]TOTAL ORDER[-][/c]: the First Order Executioner has bonus Offense equal to 5% of his Max Health.\n\nNow is the time to bring your First Order squad to bear with the First Order Executioner!
NEWSLETTER_FO_EXECUTIONER_TITLE|Behold, the First Order Executioner
NEWSLETTER_FOUR_DAYS_OF_FESTIVITIES_DESC|Our special Four Days of Festivities holiday sale will be held from 12/22 to 12/25 with new bundles every day. A new Holiday Kit is available for purchase daily during the sale period. Each is jam-packed full of Crystals, Credits, Energy, rare Ability Materials, Kyrotech salvage, mod salvage, character shards and more! We also have special Daily Holiday Character Bundles available every day consisting of rare character shards, Crystals, and powerful salvage that will bring them to new heights of power!\n\nEach bundle is only available for 24 hours so don't miss out on this holiday bonanza! 
NEWSLETTER_FOUR_DAYS_OF_FESTIVITIES_TITLE|Four Days of Festivities!
NEWSLETTER_FRAGMENTED_SIGNAL_FLEET_061824_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Fragmented Signal[/b] has been added to [b]Fleet Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Ship Energy.\n\nFleet Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/18/2024 through 06/19/2024.
NEWSLETTER_FRAGMENTED_SIGNAL_FLEET_061824_TITLE|Fragmented Signal is available on Fleet Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_FURY_CLASS_INTERCEPTOR_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nConquest volume 10 begins soon and blueprints for a new ship, the [c][F0FF23]Fury-class Interceptor[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! First seen in Bioware's acclaimed Star Wars: The Old Republic, the Fury-class Interceptor is the ship used in the storylines of Sith Warriors and Sith Inquisitors, and has been seen of late being flown by Darth Malgus. As such Malgus will be the pilot for this ship in Galaxy of Heroes, as we set the stage for a powerful new Sith fleet led by Darth Revan's Leviathan!\n\nFury-class Interceptor introduces an impactful new debuff [c][F0FF23]Suspense[-][/c] that prevents enemies from gaining buffs, and if they gain bonus Turn Meter, Protection Up, or recover Protection then they are inflicted with Defense Down. If it is dispelled then it will increase the enemy's cooldowns, and if it expires then Sith allies gain stacks of We Have Returned to increase their damage. The ship also has a variety of debuffs to help manage the enemies, while buffing its allies through new effects like [c][F0FF23]Stable Bulwark[-][/c] that boosts multiple stats and saves a ship the first time it would be defeated, and [c][F0FF23]Reinforced Determination[-][/c] which provides extra Defense per stack.\n\nEarn Fury-class Interceptor blueprints during the upcoming Conquest events and unlock Darth Malgus through Proving Grounds! This ship will be required for the upcoming Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event for Leviathan, so gather your Sith to fight!
NEWSLETTER_FURY_CLASS_INTERCEPTOR_TITLE|Sith Empire Strikes Back
NEWSLETTER_GAC_DIVISION_UPDATES_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGrand Arena Championship Divisions have received several changes to promote a more balanced and competitive experience. We have redistributed the number of players in Grand Arena Championship divisions to closely reflect the ratio of players that were originally in those divisions at the time of GAC’s launch. The number of squads required and prizing for league promotions has also been adjusted to closely resemble the divisions players were previously in. These changes maintain the level of difficulty you experienced previously and without affecting your rewards.\n\nIn addition to the above changes, the amount of required points scored to promote between divisions and leagues will be different for some divisions and leagues to account for the additional squad battles taking place amongst players in those divisions.
NEWSLETTER_GAC_DIVISION_UPDATES_TITLE|Grand Arena Championship Division Changes
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_10_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nA new season of Grand Arena Championships has started and a few of the feats have more characters than could be easily listed in the feat description.\n\nThe first feat is [c][F0FF23]Commanding Presence[-][/c] which requires you to defeat 12 enemy units in Grand Arena with Jedi who were Generals in the Clone Wars. This includes:\n\nGrand Master Yoda\nMace Windu\nGeneral Kenobi\nGeneral Skywalker\nJedi Knight Anakin\nLuminara Unduli\nPlo Koon\nKit Fisto\nEeth Koth\nKi-Adi-Mundi\nShaak Ti\n\nThe next feat is [c][F0FF23]The Council Will Act As They Deem Necessary[-][/c] which requires you to Defeat 12 enemy units in Grand Arena with members of the Jedi High Council. This includes:\n\nGrand Master Yoda\nMace Windu\nPlo Koon\nKi-Adi-Mundi\nEeth Koth\nShaak Ti\nGeneral Kenobi\nKit Fisto\nJedi Knight Anakin\nGeneral Skywalker
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_10_TITLE|Grand Arena Championships: Jedi
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_11_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nA new season of Grand Arena Championships has started and two of the feats have more characters than could be easily listed in the feat description.\n\nThe first feat is [c][F0FF23]The Coven's Secrets[-][/c], which requires you to defeat 12 enemy units in Grand Arena with characters who sought answers on Dathomir. This includes:\n\nEzra Bridger\nDarth Maul\nGeneral Kenobi\nJedi Knight Anakin\nGeneral Skywalker\n\nThe next feat, [c][F0FF23]Dark Presence[-][/c], requires you to defeat 12 enemy units in Grand Arena with a Dathomir native. This includes: \n\nDarth Maul\nSavage Opress\nAsajj Ventress\nMother Talzin\nTalia\nNightsister Acolyte\nNightsister Initiate\nNightsister Zombie\nNightsister Spirit\nOld Daka
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_11_TITLE|Grand Arena Championships: Dathomir
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_12_DESC|A new season of Grand Arena Championships has started and two of the feats have more characters than could be easily listed in the feat description.\n\nThe first feat is [c][F0FF23]This Is About Revenge[-][/c], which requires you to defeat 6 enemy units in Grand Arena with characters who had ties to the Shadow Collective. This includes:\n\nAurra Sing\nBoba Fett\nBossk\nCad Bane\nDengar\nEmbo\nGreedo\nIG-88\nJango Fett\nZam Wesell\nQi'ra\nDarth Maul\nSavage Opress\nMother Talzin\nHan Solo\nYoung Han Solo\n\nThe next feat, [c][F0FF23]Our Identity[-][/c], requires you to defeat 6 enemy units in Grand Arena with characters who wear Mandalorian armor. This includes: \n\nThe Mandalorian\nBoba Fett\nJango Fett\nSabine Wren\nGar Saxon\nImperial Super Commando
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_12_TITLE|Grand Arena Championships: Bounty Hunters
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_13_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nA new season of Grand Arena Championships has started and two of the feats have more characters than could be easily listed in the feat description. The first feat is [c][F0FF23]Built Loyalty[-][/c], and it’s for winning a Grand Arena battle using five faithful Droid companions. This includes:\n\nHK-47\nT3-M4\nThreepio & Chewie\nC-3PO\nR2-D2\nChopper\nK-2SO\nL3-37\nBB-8\nIG-11\n\nThe next feat, [c][F0FF23]Thank the Maker[-][/c], requires you to defeat 12 enemies in Grand Arena battles with Droids that keep defying destruction and getting rebuilt. This includes:\n\nHK-47\nT3-M4\nIG-88\nThreepio & Chewie\nC-3PO\nR2-D2\nIG-11
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_13_TITLE|Grand Arena Championships: Droids
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_14_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nNow that we have over a dozen Grand Arena Championship themes under our belt, we want to give another opportunity to achieve Portrait rewards from early GACs. So for this next GAC we are rerunning one of our earliest Grand Arena Championships: Resistance.\n\nThis GAC will allow you to earn the Fly Anything, Poe’s Jacket, and Secret Keeper portraits if you missed any of them the first time. Additionally we are adding two Titles into the reward pool: Sharpshooter (earned through the “EL-16 Blaster Rifle” feat) and Blue Leader (earned through the “X Marks the Spot” feat).\n\nAll the feats in this Grand Arena either list the specific characters used in them, or use a searchable character tag (Resistance), so there’s no need to list out requirements for you in this newsletter or the forum post.\n\nHave fun resisting the might of your opponent in battle with this GAC, and see you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_14_TITLE|Grand Arena Championships: Resistance (Re-run)
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_15_DESC|Greetings Holotable Heroes,\n\nA new season of the Grand Arena Championship is upon us, and we're continuing our effort to give everyone another chance at Portrait rewards from earlier GACs. This season we're re-running our early GAC themed around the Sith. You might say they're back for revenge.\n\nIn this GAC you can earn the As You Command, Precursors, and Pulling the Strings portraits if you missed them the first time around. You can also earn two new titles: Shadow (earned through the "Brothers in Arms" feat) and Blademaster (earned through the "Double-Bladed" feat).\n\nSeveral feats this season use more characters than can be easily listed in the feat descriptions. Buckle in, because we're going through all of them.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Welcome to the Darth Side[-][/c] requires you to win a Grand Arena battle using a team of 5 Sith Lords. This villainous group consists of:\n\nCount Dooku\nDarth Malak\nDarth Maul\nDarth Nihilus\nDarth Revan\nDarth Sidious\nDarth Sion\nDarth Traya\nDarth Vader\nEmperor Palpatine\nSith Eternal Emperor\n\n[c][F0FF23]The Sith Fleet[-][/c] requires you to win a Fleet Arena battle with a fleet containing three or more Sith ships. Qualifying ships include:\n\nB-28 Extinction-class Bomber\nEmperor's Shuttle\nScimitar\nSith Fighter\nTIE Advanced x1\n\n[c][F0FF23]Execute Order 66[-][/c] needs you to defeat 12 enemy units in Grand Arena with an Order 66 character, for which the following characters count:\n\nARC Trooper\nCC-2224 "Cody"\nClone Sergeant - Phase I\nDarth Sidious\nEmperor Palpatine\n\nAnd finally, [c][F0FF23]Double-Bladed[-][/c] asks that you defeat 12 enemy units in Grand Arena with a character with a double-bladed lightsaber, which are:\n\nBastila Shan\nBastila Shan (Fallen)\nDarth Maul\nJedi Knight Guardian\nSavage Opress\nSith Assassin
NEWSLETTER_GAC_SEASON_15_TITLE|Grand Arena Championships: Sith (Re-run)

NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CHALLENGE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nIn this update, we’re proud to present [c][F0FF23]Galactic Challenges[-][/c]! This all-new game mode represents a huge step for Galaxy of Heroes, as it lays the foundation of our new content initiative, allowing us to generate fresh content, challenges, and feats on a regular basis going forward.\n\nWith Galactic Challenges, players will be presented with new battles that provide the opportunity to utilize many parts of their character and ship roster in a fun and meaningful way. Galactic Challenge events keep the game fresh and engaging by offering interesting and unique encounters that feature always-changing combinations of modifiers, locations, and conditions, along with multiple tiers of difficulty. Modifiers add a wide range of positive and negative effects to the battle, meaning you’ll have to mix up your strategies to succeed.\n\nThe best part? This is just the beginning. Galactic Challenges will lay a foundation that allows Capital Games to continue expanding the variety of content we are able to offer now and in the future. We’re all really excited at the studio and can’t wait for our passionate community of players to dive in!\n\nSee you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CHALLENGE_TITLE|Are You Ready For A Galactic Challenge?
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CONQUEST_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe latest update to Galaxy of Heroes expands the Galactic War table with a new game mode, [c][F0FF23]Conquest[-][/c]! You will face increasingly difficult foes as you advance from sector to sector, but special [c][F0FF23]Data Disks[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]consumables[-][/c] will help power up your squads along the way. You’ll need a variety of squads and your favorite combination of Data Disks to defeat some of your most difficult challenges yet! Complete feats and battles to improve your reward crate at the end of the event and for this Conquest, earn a very special ship, the [c][F0FF23]Razor Crest[-][/c]! Conquest begins with the first exhibition event on March 1st with another to follow closely thereafter.\n\nUnlock the Razor Crest via the new Conquest mode and put it through the types of battles it’s become famous for enduring... not counting that whole thing on Tython. The famed transport has seen its fair share of adventure, from its start as a military patrol ship to being picked apart by Jawas and put back together by Din Djarin and Kuiil. \n\nWith Breach and Bounty Hunter synergy, the Razor Crest stands ready to raise the faction’s competitiveness in ship battles. The new buff, [c][F0FF23]Reinforced Hull[-][/c], adds to the Razor Crest’s survivability, while cooldown reduction, calling allies to assist, and inflicting enemies with Marked ensures it packs a punch. \n\nGood luck in this month’s Conquest and see you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_CONQUEST_TITLE|Your Galactic Conquest Begins

NEWSLETTER_GALACTIC_LEGENDS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nA new type of character is joining the Holotables, [c][f0ff23]Galactic Legends[-][/c]! [c][f0ff23]Supreme Leader Kylo Ren[-][/c] and [c][f0ff23]Rey[-][/c] are the first Galactic Legends and are some of the most powerful units in Galaxy of Heroes. Each Galactic Legend has a unique [c][f0ff23]Ultimate ability[-][/c] that charges over the course of a battle, such as Rey's [c][f0ff23]Heir to the Jedi[-][/c] or Kylo's [c][f0ff23]Depths of Rage[-][/c]. These powerful abilities can aid a variety of different squads with incredible bonuses to turn the tide of battle.\n\nWant to get started on either Rey or Supreme Leader Kylo Ren? Find all the requirements for either character in the Journey Guide. These events are available permanently once you qualify for them; you can unlock these new characters whenever you are ready.

NEWSLETTER_GAS_EVENT_DESC|[i]"A true leader always leads from the front."[/i] -Anakin Skywalker to Captain Rex\n\n[c][f0ff23]Anakin Skywalker[-][/c] has been many things over the years; pod racer, droid builder, Jedi padawan and even a legendary pilot, but his confidence and his exceptional connection to the Force was clear to anyone who came in contact with him. Now a General in the Grand Army of the Republic, Skywalker fights to stop the growing Separatist threat along side the 501st Clone Troopers. \n\nAs the Chosen One, and due to his mastery of the Force, Skywalker can unleash a barrage of abilities each turn. General Skywalker can take [c][f0ff23]Cover[-][/c] in the heat of battle and wait for the right moment to [c][f0ff23]Advance[-][/c] towards the enemy while his Clone allies lay down fire. Between the shower of [c][f0ff23]Furious Slashes[-][/c] and using [c][f0ff23]Sundering Strike[-][/c] to tear apart his enemy’s defenses, General Skywalker is a force to be reckoned with.\n\nUnlock General Skywalker starting today in the [c][f0ff23]Epic Confrontation, Clash on Kamino[-][/c].
NEWSLETTER_GAS_EVENT_TITLE|A General of the Grand Army of the Republic
NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_KENOBI_DESC|General Kenobi is now available to add to your collection! Acquiring this legendary Jedi Master will take not only your best efforts, but also the best efforts of your guild as he is only available as the Heroic Tier reward in the new Tank Takedown Raid.\n\nGeneral Kenobi was both a shrewd negotiator and tactician during the Clone Wars. These traits translate into him being an ideal leader for both Jedi and Clone squads, granting both increased health and defense to his allies. A front-line combatant, his “Lead the Charge” ability allows him to call all other buffed allies to join in his attacks. In addition to his substantial combat abilities, his negotiating skills enable him to not only dispel all debuffs from his squad, but also grant the opposite buffs for the next 2 turns. With an array of abilities and buffs, General Kenobi is a great addition to any squad!\n\nWill you be adding this hero of the Republic to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_KENOBI_TITLE|General Kenobi now available in the Tank Takedown Raid!
NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_SYNDULLA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]General Syndulla[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nHera Syndulla’s fight against the Empire started when she was a little girl growing up on Ryloth. Later on, she founded the Spectres, a Rebel cell operating out of her personal transport ship the Ghost. She would then lead Phoenix Squadron for the greater Rebellion, and finally was promoted to General shortly before the Battle of Yavin. She held this rank for all of the Galactic Civil War and into the era of the New Republic. In this time period she helped Ahsoka Tano in her quest to locate Grand Admiral Thrawn by reconnecting her with Sabine Wren. Finally, in defiance of her superiors in the New Republic, General Syndulla aided Ahsoka on Seatos, helping her and Huyang in their rescue of Sabine Wren.\n\nGeneral Syndulla enters the field as a Support for Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano’s squad but can also work as a leader for Spectres while you work towards Ahsoka. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Pulling Rank[-][/c], dispels debuffs on a Spectre ally and grants them Offense and Speed per debuff dispelled. This ability also introduces a new buff [c][F0FF23]Perfect Defense[-][/c] that functions as a combination of Defense Up and Tenacity Up. Her other Special, [c][F0FF23]I’m Not Just Going to Sit Around[-][/c], deals True damage to all enemies and inflicts the target enemy with Fracture.\n\n[c][F0FF23]New Republic General[-][/c], her Leader ability, benefits both Spectres as well as Zeb by giving them extra defensiveness and opening Speed to get the battle rolling. Additionally, they can ignore taunt effects to target an enemy with Fracture so you can be sure to take them down.\n\nHer Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Unauthorized Mission[-][/c], provides extra damage for Spectres and extra Defense for them while someone else is taunting. This ability also provides stat bonuses when Perfect Defense expires based on their role. With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, Spectre allies and Zeb gain Counter Chance and Potency, as well as more sustain and control for the battle.\n\nThis release also adds the [c][E7E7E7]final batch[-][/c] of Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano requirements to the Journey Guide.\n\nUnlock General Syndulla in the upcoming “LOST AND FOUND III” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event, and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_GENERAL_SYNDULLA_TITLE|In My Hera Era

NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIAN_SPY_MISSION_DESC|Geonosian Spy is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission D. This stealthy attacker provides great synergies with squads that can apply multiple debuffs to enemy units and take advantage of his “Silent Strike” ability which dispels both debuffs and buffs from the enemy target and Geonosian Spy but deals increasing damage for each effect removed. Additionally, his unique passive “Illicit Insect” gives him increased turn meter every time a Geonosian ally inflicts a negative status effect, ensuring that the Geonosian Spy can take advantage of weakened enemies.\n\nBe sure to add this cunning attacker to your collection and takedown your enemies one negative status effect at a time!
NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIAN_SPY_MISSION_TITLE|Geonosian Spy is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission D!
NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIANS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Geonosians are emerging from the hive with all-new tactics! [c][F0FF23]Sun Fac[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Poggle the Lesser[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Spy[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Soldier[-][/c] have all been reworked to make use of the Hive Mind buff and are ready to join forces in battle.\n\nEach Geonosian has received some big changes to their kit, and while under the influence of Hive Mind, they gain even more deadly effects. With the [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Brood Alpha[-][/c] in the Leader slot, this squad really takes flight, attacking with a persistent swarm of assists while applying a whole host of debuffs to the enemy. This squad has evolved to a whole new level, and they're ready to take on brutal opponents in the Petranaki arena.\n\nFind the full list of changes on the Official Forum. See you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GEONOSIANS_TITLE|Swarms Fill The Skies!
NEWSLETTER_GL_AHSOKA_TANO_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c] has arrived on the Holotables!\n\nWith a long and storied history reaching back to the Clone Wars where she was the Padawan Learner of Anakin Skywalker and continuing all the way to the New Republic where she pursued Grand Admiral Thrawn into a different galaxy, Ahsoka Tano is one of the most prolific people in the Star Wars saga. Holding the life essence of the Daughter, Ahsoka is never far from her Morai companion. Once framed by Barriss Offee, she saw the cracks in the Jedi Order and refused their invitation back when it was shown she was innocent of the crimes. Her specialized training against the Clone Troopers she fought alongside enabled her to survive Order 66 and save her friend Rex. She eventually joined the Rebel Alliance as the mysterious Fulcrum where she fought against Inquisitors and eventually Darth Vader, learning the devastating truth of the person behind the mask. Her defeat at Seatos at the hands of Baylan Skoll was a chrysalis in her life, where she came to terms with Anakin’s fate and found renewed resolve in training Sabine Wren. She followed Morgan Elsbeth’s path to Peridea where she would face-off against Grand Admiral Thrawn’s remnant and his undying legion of Night Troopers, rescuing Ezra Bridger but finding herself stranded in a different galaxy.\n\nAhsoka lands as a Tank Galactic Legend to lead the squad of new Spectre units. With her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Aegis Charge[-][/c], Ahsoka generates bonus Protection for herself and increases the duration of Perfect Defense if she’s buffed with it. [c][F0FF23]Shatterstrike[-][/c], her first Special ability, inflicts Armor Shred and catches her opponent off guard by inflicting stacks of Off Balance. Her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Defiant Resolve[-][/c], bestows the new [c][F0FF23]Morai’s Wisdom[-][/c] buff on targeted Spectre allies and gives her an active Taunt. Her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Commander of the Wayward[-][/c], brings lost companions together with the [c][F0FF23]Reunited[-][/c] granted ability and can severely punish opponents who rely on Protection Up. [c][F0FF23]Daughter of Mortis[-][/c], her Unique ability, grants Ahsoka a percentage of Offense based on her Defense and protects her Spectre allies from Daze.\n\nHer first Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]Worlds Apart[-][/c], tips the odds in Ahsoka’s favor by reducing the cooldown of ally abilities and increasing the cooldown of enemy abilities. Additionally, Spectre allies recover Health and Protection. Once used, this ability becomes unavailable and Ahsoka instead gains her second Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]Relentless Redoubt[-][/c], empowering her allies with the potent [c][F0FF23]Deflective Ward[-][/c] buff which reduces enemy damage to 1 and punishes any foe who focuses on her allies instead of Ahsoka herself.\n\nObtain Ahsoka Tano now through her event, [c][E7E7E7]I Am No Jedi[-][/c], which can be accessed via the Journey Guide! The recent update that prevents losing Galactic Legend tickets upon battle loss also applies for this event. Additionally, Ahsoka will get a tier in the recurring [c][E7E7E7]Ultimate Journey[-][/c] event the next time it returns.
NEWSLETTER_GL_AHSOKA_TANO_TITLE|GLA-morous
NEWSLETTER_GL_HONDO_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c] is plundering his way onto the Holotables!\n\nThe charismatic and opportunistic Weequay Pirate leader, Hondo Ohnaka, has taken command of a new motley crew of scoundrels. Always looking to make a profit, Hondo has proclaimed himself the Pirate King and rallied a band of Pirates under his self-appointed rule.\n\nHondo's [c][F0FF23]Ultimate ability[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Mutual Gains (For Me)[-][/c], is a game-changing move that revives all his Pirate and Smuggler allies while punishing Jedi and Sith enemies with cooldown increases and potent offensive buffs, all while granting Hondo and his crew powerful new effects. The Tenuous Agreement debuff makes enemies deal reduced damage to Hondo's allies, while Favorable Terms provides Critical Chance, Offense, and Protection recovery boosts along with the ability to gain bonus turns for his allies when defeating debuffed foes.\n\nHondo's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Pistol Panache[-][/c], is a flurry of blaster fire that calls random Pirate allies to assist, with increasing damage output based on Profit stacks. His first Special, [c][F0FF23]Loot First, Ask Later[-][/c], Steals and redistributes enemy buffs while inflicting debuffs and granting stacking Mastery to enhance his crew's stats. [c][F0FF23]Charismatic Captain[-][/c], his second Special, provides healing, a dispel, and Turn Meter gain for the Pirate squad.\n\nAs the [c][F0FF23]Pirate King[-][/c] Leader, Hondo bolsters his crew's offensive capabilities while granting them immunity to detrimental effects like Fear, Shock, and Turn Meter removal. His first [c][F0FF23]Unique[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]It's Not Personal. It's Profitable[-][/c], capitalizes on the Profit mechanic, providing stacking offensive bonuses and damage reduction as the fight progresses.\n\nPrepare to join Hondo's daring crew and claim your share of the spoils in the [c][E7E7E7]TALES OF THE PIRATE KING[-][/c] Galactic Legend event that has Hondo retelling his most famous appearances throughout history (note: not all of these appearances have been fact-checked).
NEWSLETTER_GL_HONDO_TITLE|A Pirate's Lot is a Hondo-Rable One
NEWSLETTER_GL_REQ_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe final requirements have been revealed for Galactic Legends [c][f0ff23]Supreme Leader Kylo Ren[-][/c] and [c][f0ff23]Rey[-][/c]! Head over to the Journey Guide to find out which characters and what gear you'll need to start unlocking either of these Galactic Legends as soon as they are available. Stay tuned to the official forums for the announcement of when both Galactic Legends events will begin.\n\nSee you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GL_REQ_TITLE|Galactic Legends Requirements Revealed
Newsletter_Go|GO
NEWSLETTER_GOOGLE_PLAY_REMINDER_DESC|Linking your Star Wars (TM): Galaxy of Heroes account to your Google Play account is the best way to keep your account safe. This prevents your account from being lost should something unfortunate happen to your device.
NEWSLETTER_GOOGLE_PLAY_SUMMER_DEALS_PACK_TITLE|Special Google Play Summer Deal - Magmatrooper Starter Bundle!
NEWSLETTER_GOOGLE_SUMMER_DEALS_PACK_DESC|Head to the store now for a LIMITED TIME starter pack bundle offer including a 2-Star Character, Crystals, Credits, and XP materials!
NEWSLETTER_GP_AND_GC_REMINDER_TITLE|Keep your account safe
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_CHAMPIONSHIPS_DESC_V2|Grand Arena Championships are beginning next week with the exhibition Championship! Compete with other Holotable Heroes and see your progress on the first-ever global leaderboards for individual players in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. We’ll finally be able to answer the question: "Do you have what it takes to be the greatest in the galaxy?"\n\nReach higher Leagues in Championships by defeating opponents in Grand Arena and completing Feats. Feats are unique time-sensitive challenges that reward you for going above and beyond, and they're a great way to progress to new Leagues.\n\nAt the end of each Championship, you'll be able to receive your rewards, review your progress, and prepare for the next one. Your League icon – and of course, bragging rights – remains until the start of the next Championship. Then it resets and you can try again for an even higher position!\n\nWith the release of Grand Arena Championships, we're also adding the last slot of Gear XII pieces so you can upgrade your characters to Gear XIII. The new Gear XII finishers can be found in Grand Arena Championships and the new Territory Battle on Geonosis. Take your characters to new heights of power and dominate your opponents.\n\nFor the full details on Championships and Gear XII finishers, visit the forums.
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_CHAMPIONSHIPS_DESC_V3|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nReady your best squads and prepare to battle for glory, Grand Arena Championships returns on 10/2/2019! In Grand Arena Championships, players compete in several Grand Arena events over the course of multiple weeks to climb the ranks and earn awesome prizes. Face off against players with a similar roster and skill to be the best in the galaxy! Is your team strong enough to become the next Champion?
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_CHAMPIONSHIPS_TITLE|Championships and Gear XII Finishers
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_DESC|Get ready for some serious competition: Grand Arena is here! For the first time, Level 85 players across the game are paired in a 1-on-1 competition that is the ultimate test of skill.\n\n-Use your collection of characters and ships to battle against a player with a similar collection\n\n-Compete to win the most rounds in the event\n\n-Earn Portraits for accomplishing great feats like Prestigious Quests\n\n-Change your Squad Arena payout time twice a year
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_ARENA_TITLE|Grand Arena Is Here!
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_INQUISITOR_DESC|The [c][F0FF23]Grand Inquisitor[-][/c] has arrived to the holotables!\n\nMaster of the Inquisitorius, the Grand Inquisitor is the highest ranking of all Inquisitors who reports directly to Darth Vader. Charged with hunting down Jedi who survived the Great Purge and other Force sensitives, Grand Inquisitor studied the ways of the Jedi in order to understand their fighting style but ultimately fell to Kanan Jarrus.\n\nHis leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Master Inquisitorius[-][/c], provides Inquisitorius allies with a variety of stat boosts based on their role. Jedi who attempt to evade the Inquisitorius are punished with damage through his unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Compassion Leaves a Trail[-][/c]. Grand Inquisitor also introduces a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Torture[-][/c], that increases damage taken and lowers defense when attacked, all the while preventing bonus turn meter.\n\nGrand Inquisitor's Omicron ability upgrades bring Inquisitors to new heights in Territory Wars. When these abilities are fully upgraded Purge will automatically be reapplied when it expires, Jedi enemies take damage when they gain Protection Up, and Grand Inquisitor has a chance to instantly defeat a Jedi enemy.\n\nGather your Inquisitorius for their training in the all new "DARK TIMES" Legendary Event. This event will only be around for a short time before it returns in the future, so don't miss your opportunity to impress your worth to Vader and lead the Inquisitorius to victory.
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_INQUISITOR_TITLE|Purge the Galaxy
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_TARKIN_DESC|Greetings, \n\nGrand Moff Tarkin is now available in the Arena Store. Strengthen your Empire squad and dominate the holotables with this powerful Support character.
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_TARKIN_TITLE|Grand Moff Tarkin now available in the Arena Store
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_WILHUFF_TARKIN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGrand Moff Wilhuff Tarkin, architect of the Doctrine of Fear and the person who ordered the destruction of Alderaan, is a figure whose legacy is defined by ruthless precision and unwavering loyalty to the Empire.\n\nWe’re updating Grand Moff Tarkin’s kit to better position him as a leader for the new Dark Side Clone Troopers introduced in this era; after all, what better way to ensure these relics of the Clone Wars serve their purpose for the Empire?\n\nHis Basic, first Special ability, and Leader ability have all received mechanical updates that grant new synergy with Dark Side Clone Troopers, including a powerful new interaction that allows [c][F0FF23]Ultimate Firepower’s[-][/c] damage to trigger twice under the right conditions and a visual tracker for Potency gained from his Basic.\n\nAnd finally, we’ve added a brand-new [c][F0FF23]3v3 Omicron[-][/c] for his Leader ability, giving you the opportunity to field two powerful 3v3 Dark Side Clone Trooper squads; one led by Lord Vader, and the other by Tarkin himself.\n\nThis update is live for all current and future owners of Tarkin. Add him to your roster today, and bring fear and destruction to those who dare oppose the Empire!
NEWSLETTER_GRAND_MOFF_WILHUFF_TARKIN_TITLE|These Boots are Made for Tarkin
NEWSLETTER_GRANDMASTERS_TRAINING_DESC|Do you have what it takes to train against a Jedi Grand Master?\n\nAdd Grand Master Yoda to your collection through completing some of his trials.\n\nRaise him to Seven Stars through besting them all.\n\nTry it now!
NEWSLETTER_GRANDMASTERS_TRAINING_TITLE|Grand Master Yoda\n[f0ff23][i]Now Available[/i][-]
NEWSLETTER_GREAT_MOTHERS_DATACRON_DESC|Greetings Holotable Heroes,\n\nAs a first time reward for the 7-star Tier of Great Mothers’ Marquee event, players will earn a one-of-a-kind Datacron at level 9 that targets Great Mothers. There is no other way to get a Great Mothers Datacron in the Rambunctious Rage Datacron set so make sure to grab it!\n\nThis datacron comes with pre-established stat bonuses, but a player can reroll these to random stat bonuses that are within the Rambunctious Rage set if they so desire using the same Datacron materials as that set.\n\nWhile players have the ability to dismantle this Datacron, note that this is irreversible and there is no other way to get a Great Mothers Datacron at this time.\n\nAt the end of the lifetime of the Rambunctious Rage Datacron set, this Datacron will automatically dismantle along with the rest of the set.
NEWSLETTER_GREAT_MOTHERS_DATACRON_TITLE|Great Mothers’ Exclusive Datacron
NEWSLETTER_GREAT_MOTHERS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]The Great Mothers[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables!\n\nThe three Great Mothers of the Nightsisters, Klothow, Aktropaw, and Lakesis, spin, manipulate, and cut the threads of fates of allies and foes alike. Using their majik, this coven was instrumental in maintaining Grand Admiral Thrawn’s forces during his exile on the planet Peridea.\n\nThe Great Mothers are an Elite Marquee, indicating a higher power level than a typical marquee but at the same accessibility. Additionally, the Great Mothers are considered a Large character and will prevent the use of the ally slot or other large characters on the squad. Nightsisters, reign!\n\nTheir Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Threads of Destiny[-][/c], introduces the granted abilities of [c][F0FF23]Fate Weaving[-][/c], which inflicts [c][F0FF23]Doomed[-][/c] on an enemy, and [c][F0FF23]Gift of Shadows[-][/c] to grant [c][F0FF23]Blessed[-][/c] to a Nightsister ally. Their Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Energy Threads[-][/c], reduces the Max Health of a targeted Doomed enemy and grants a Blessed ally with Stealth and Foresight, setting up for big damage from Nightsister Acolyte and Spirit. [c][F0FF23]To The Old Ways[-][/c], their Unique ability, provides many more instances of Stealth and Foresight for Nightsister allies, gives stacking damage and Protection recovery for themselves and Blessed allies when enemies are critically hit, and grants Turn Meter to Blessed allies when a Doomed enemy gains Turn Meter.\n\nWith Omicron upgrades in the Territory War game modes, the Unique and Leader abilities gain extra effects such as saving a Nightsister ally from initial defeat, boosting key stats, and inflicting Fear when a Doomed enemy is defeated. \n\nUnlock Great Mothers in the upcoming “VEIL OF SHADOWS II” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming Epic Confrontation for [c][E7E7E7]Baylan Skoll[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_GREAT_MOTHERS_TITLE|Mother May I?
NEWSLETTER_GREEF_CARA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nTwo new arrivals have showed up in the cantina and they look like they must be from the Outer Rim!\n\nFirst up is [c][F0FF23]Cara Dune[-][/c], a veteran Rebel Shock Trooper who has reinvented herself as a mercenary since leaving military life behind. This tough, no-nonsense brawler hasn’t forgotten how to fight an enemy like the Empire and can be difficult to take down in battle. While Cara can find a place as a deadly ambusher on a Scoundrel squad, she’s equally at-home under a Rebel leader, defending her allies as a front-line combatant.\n\nAlso joining the Holotables is [c][F0FF23]Greef Karga[-][/c], a notorious scoundrel and the go-to-guy for connecting Bounty Hunters with clients on Nevarro. Greef is always trying to spot the most lucrative solution to whatever predicament he finds himself in, and his abilities reflect this. He prefers to hang back while other Bounty Hunters work to achieve their Payouts and he supports the squad with mass assist calls and frequent recovery of Health and Protection.\n\nSee you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_GREEF_CARA_TITLE|Some Of My Favorite People Are Bounty Hunters
NEWSLETTER_GREEN_LANTERN_01_DESC|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, Apple, and WWF are working together to protect life on our planet. From now until April 24, WWF will receive 100% of the proceeds from your Ewok bundle purchases. Head to the store now to see these bundles being offered. \n\nIf you would like more information on how your purchase will help our planet please visit: http://appstore.com/appsforearth
NEWSLETTER_GREEN_LANTERN_01_TITLE|#AppsforEarth Event
NEWSLETTER_GREEN_LANTERN_02_DESC|The time to save the Forest Moon of Endor is now! Form a squad of at least three Ewoks to battle the forces of the Empire. \n\nFinishing the event each day will award you with various prizes, such as additional character Shards for your Ewoks.
NEWSLETTER_GREEN_LANTERN_02_TITLE|Save the Forest Moon Event
NEWSLETTER_GRIEVOUS_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nThe feared Jedi hunter General Grievous is now available in the Shard Shop!\n\nGeneral Grievous is an Attacker who is at his best when leading a squad of Droids. His unique abilities lower the health of enemies or boost his own maximum health for each living Droid ally.\n\nWill you be among the first to form a powerful Droid squad led by General Grievous to hunt down the Jedi?
NEWSLETTER_GRIEVOUS_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|General Grievous available in the Shard Shop
NEWSLETTER_GUILD_BANK_CURRENCY_CAP_DESC|A new cap has been placed on the total amount of Guild Bank Coins that can be earned each day. The new cap is 30,000 Guild Bank Coins earned by a guild per day. Once the cap has been reached, any additional Guild Bank Coins earned by players that day will not be counted.\n\nThe new cap will still allow Guilds with a full roster of 50 to have each of their members contribute their full energy contribution each day (600/600).\n\nThe cap will reset every 24 hours.
NEWSLETTER_GUILD_BANK_CURRENCY_CAP_TITLE|New Cap: Daily Earned Guild Bank Coins
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_BOOMADIER_DESC|Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,\n\nKnown for their accuracy and precision, the [c][F0FF23]Gungan Boomadiers[-][/c] have entered the holotables! Adding to the Gungan squad alongside Boss Nass and Captain Tarpals, the Boomadier brings a satchel full of boomas, small plasma bombs, to the battle.\n\nDuring the Battle for Naboo Boomadiers played a key role in supporting their brethren on the field. Launching boomas into swarms of Trade Federation Battle Droids in an effort to stem the seemingly infinite waves of attackers, Boomadiers formed the backbone of the Gungan offense.\n\nLike all Gungans, Boomadier looks to the Shield Generator supplied by Boss Nass to amp up his survivability. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Grand Army Specialist[-][/c], gives him Defense Penetration and Offense, and, while the Shield Generator is active, ensures that enemies can’t be revived as well as giving himself a boost to his offensive output when he uses a Special ability. Boomadier’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Catch This![-][/c], deals extra damage to Shocked enemies (well hello, Captain Tarpals!). [c][F0FF23]Cluster Booma[-][/c] really takes advantage of debuffed enemies through dealing extra instances of damage, and the [c][F0FF23]Horn of Otoh Gunga[-][/c] has the ability to recover stacks of Plasma Shielding on the Shield Generator as well as swapping Turn Meter with another Gungan ally.\n\nUnlock the Gungan Boomadier in the upcoming “BATTLEFIELD: NABOO III” Marquee event, as well as [c][E7E7E7]earn daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. And don’t forget that Boomadier is required for the [c][E7E7E7]Legendary event for Jar Jar Binks[-][/c], as well as being part of one of the best squads for the [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_BOOMADIER_MOD_060324_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Gungan Boomadier[/b] shards have been added to [b]Mod Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Mod Energy.\n\nMod Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/3/2024 through 06/6/2024.
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_BOOMADIER_MOD_060324_TITLE|Gungan Boomadier is available on Mod Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_BOOMADIER_TITLE|Big Bombad Booma
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_PHALANX_CANTINA_060324_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Gungan Phalanx[/b] shards have been added to [b]Cantina Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/3/2024 through 06/6/2024.
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_PHALANX_CANTINA_060324_TITLE|Gungan Phalanx is available on Cantina Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_PHALANX_DESC|Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe penultimate piece to the Gungan squad, the [c][F0FF23]Gungan Phalanx[-][/c], is coming to the Holotables!\n\nOn the grassy plains of Naboo, the Gungan Phalanx used their energy shields to protect key battlefield elements from the onslaught of Battle Droid blaster fire, giving the Gungans a fighting chance against overwhelming odds, holding out until the droid control ship in orbit could be defeated.\n\nIn combat the Phalanx uses his personal electropole with his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Fierce Poke[-][/c]. This will not only inflict Defense Down but, when Phalanx attacks out of turn, give Protection Over Time to a Gungan ally. To control the battle, as well as protect the invaluable Shield Generator, the Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Heyo, Watch Out[-][/c], does area of effect damage and inflicts Tenacity Down, additionally it makes the Gungan Phalanx Taunt, ensuring he is the target of incoming attacks. Using their second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Raise da Shield[-][/c], Phalanx will dispel himself of debuffs and give out a new buff [c][F0FF23]Shield Up[-][/c]. Shield Up is similar to Protection Up, adding bonus Protection to the target, the difference being it scales off of a unit’s Max Protection instead of their Health. [c][F0FF23]Let Mesa Help[-][/c] is Phalanx’s Unique ability, allowing them to reactively Taunt when the Shield Generator becomes the focus of enemy attacks. When Phalanx assists, this ability will give the ally who Phalanx is assisting Foresight for one turn, further ensuring the survivability of the squad.\n\nGungan Phalanx is bringing to Galaxy of Heroes the very first [c][E7E7E7]Omicron for the Galactic Challenge[-][/c] game mode. This ability is specifically designed to help tackle some of the more difficult feats in that game mode.\n\nGungan Phalanx will be unlockable in the upcoming “BATTLEFIELD: NABOO IV” Marquee event which follows our new, experimental, Marquee structure that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. Gungans will be the kings of the hill in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c], and the [c][E7E7E7]Legendary Jar Jar Binks[-][/c] will require Phalanx in order to unlock him in his event, so don’t miss out!
NEWSLETTER_GUNGAN_PHALANX_TITLE|Phalanx for Being a Friend
NEWSLETTER_HAN_ACTIVATED_DESC|Congratulations to Yukikase! The first player in the world to unlock Han Solo from the Heroic Guild Raid. This smuggler turned Rebel hero was one of the great leaders of the Rebel Alliance. \n\nHan Solo is a hard hitting critical attacker that always shoots first. Han’s unique ability gives him a free attack at the start of combat that stuns his target before any other unit can take an action. Capable of buffing his entire team with his lucky nature (Critical Chance Up), dealing extra damage to slower enemies, and his unique shoot first ability, Han Solo is capable of turning the tide of battle from the very first shot. \n\nJoin Yukikase in adding this Rebel hero to your Squad by defeating the Heroic Rancor Raid to collect his shards!
NEWSLETTER_HAN_ACTIVATED_TITLE|Congratulations Yukikase! First to Unlock Han Solo!
NEWSLETTER_HAN_SOLO_DESC|Greetings,\n\nHan Solo, one of the most iconic characters in the galaxy, is now available! Collect shards for this hero by clearing The Pit on Heroic tier. \n\nHan Solo's abilities will be hidden until the first player activates him. The first player to activate Han Solo will have their name featured prominently in an announcement for all players to see. \n\nWill you be the first to activate Han Solo? Is your Guild ready to defeat the Rancor on Heroic tier?
NEWSLETTER_HAN_SOLO_TITLE|New Character: Han Solo
NEWSLETTER_HANS_MILLENNIUM_FALCON_DESC|She may not look like much, but you would be hard-pressed to find a more legendary ship than Han’s Millennium Falcon, which has eluded Star Destroyers, bested Darth Vader, and destroyed a Death Star -- all with a somewhat unpredictable hyperdrive. On the holotables, the Falcon is a Rebel Attacker that strengthens Home One and the Rebel fleet as a whole by enabling relentless assist calls. Piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, the Falcon also [c][F0FF23]Outmaneuvers[-][/c] its enemies with extra Evasion, and can't be targeted while other allies are present.
NEWSLETTER_HANS_MILLENNIUM_FALCON_TITLE|Never Tell Me The Odds
NEWSLETTER_HERO_REY_DESC|Rey (Jedi Training) is arriving soon in Galaxy of Heroes! This Resistance hero is embarking on a journey that will change both her and the Galaxy. Rey (Jedi Training) enables many new strategies and is a powerful addition to any roster of heroes. Her powerful and devastating abilities synergize well with Resistance members, but can be used in many different squads.\n\nThis Resistance Hero will unlock through the Hero's Journey event as a Seven Star character. To unlock Rey (Jedi Training), players will require a Seven Star Rey (Scavenger), Finn, Veteran Smuggler Han Solo, Veteran Smuggler Chewbacca, AND BB-8. In celebration of the Hero's Journey event, we've brought back BB-8's Legendary Event.\n\nWe've updated BB-8's Legendary Event to include a new, additional event - the Mythic Event! Upon completing the Legendary "Pieces and Plans" Event, the Mythic "Pieces and Plans" Event will open to players and run for two days during the course of the Legendary Event. In the Mythic version, players will be able to replay the original Legendary Event final tier, play a new, more difficult tier where they can take any characters in, and a third tier that reverses the encounter! Best of all, the new Mythic Event is recurring - meaning everytime the Legendary Event returns, so does the Mythic Event.
NEWSLETTER_HERO_REY_TITLE|Rey's Hero's Journey and Introducing the Mythic Event
NEWSLETTER_HEROES_HOLIDAY_DESC|Celebrate the holidays with EA’s Star Wars games by joining the new Heroes Holiday community event! During our first ever community event, all eligible players must defeat Boba Fett in the Training Droid Challenge an average of two times per day on Sunday, Monday, and Thursday between Dec 23rd and January 1st. If our community can complete this challenge, all players will be given 10 shards for Rey! Are you ready to battle Boba Fett? Let the contest begin! More details available in the forums.
NEWSLETTER_HEROES_HOLIDAY_TITLE|The Heroes Holiday Community Challenge is here!
NEWSLETTER_HOLIDAY_BONUS_CRYSTALS_2020_DESC|Special, limited Crystal offers are available now! Welcome the holidays with bonus Crystals on select Crystal Bundles in the store! For a limited time, you can gain a one-time 25% bonus on the Chest of Crystals and Box of Crystals! If you purchase the Box of Crystals and Chest of Crystals during this period, you will then unlock a 50% bonus on your next purchase of the Box of Crystals for a limited time only.\n\nThis special promotion will only run from 12/21/20 to 1/4/2021 so act now before it's gone.
NEWSLETTER_HOLIDAY_BONUS_CRYSTALS_2020_TITLE|Holiday Special! Up to 50% Bonus Crystals on Select Crystal Bundles!

NEWSLETTER_HONDO_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c], notorious pirate with escapades spanning from the Clone Wars to the days of the Resistance, is coming to the holotables!\n\nKnown for serving himself above all else, Hondo introduces the first use of the [c][FFFFFF]Neutral[-][/c] alignment tag to the game. This alignment is distinct from Light and Dark side so will not count for either, but he will be available for use in all Territory Battles.\n\nHondo also introduces the [c][F0FF23]Captive[-][/c] debuff that sets an enemy's speed to zero (excluding Galactic Legends and Raid Bosses) and the longer the enemy stays captive, the more stats Hondo receives for his frustration of waiting for his [c][F0FF23]Ransom[-][/c] to be paid. Ransom provides bonuses to Hondo depending on how many stacks he has. In Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade on his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]That's Just Good Business,[-][/c] Hondo will gain additional stats when there is a Captive enemy and starts the battle with bonus turn meter.\n\nThrough his second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]I Guess We Won't Be Friends[-][/c], Hondo makes sure he always gets his cut by gaining bonus turn meter whenever anyone does and will become stronger if all his allies have fallen and he is left to protect himself.\n\nAdd Hondo Ohnaka to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “GOOD BUSINESS” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_HONDO_TITLE|Oh, The Stories I Could Tell. So Many of Them True.
NEWSLETTER_HONOR_GUARD_ZEB_DESC|Karabast! Pirates are attacking Chopper Base and Zeb needs your squad's help to defend it in this limited-time Event.\n\nGarazeb Orrelios, or Zeb for short, buffs his allies by providing Tenacity Up and attacks his foes with his Bash and Staggering Sweep abilities. Under the lead of Hera Syndulla, Zeb grants the Shrug Off ability to all members of Phoenix Squadron allowing them to recover Protection at the start of their turn.\n\nAdd this powerful Lasat to your collection by participating in the Honor Guard Event this month!
NEWSLETTER_HONOR_GUARD_ZEB_TITLE|HONOR GUARD EVENT – Garazeb Orrelios
NEWSLETTER_HUNTER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes!\n\nThe commanding officer of Clone Force 99 has joined the Holotables! The clone nicknamed [c][F0FF23]Hunter[-][/c] leads the elite but unconventional squad known as the [c][F0FF23]Bad Batch[-][/c] for the Grand Army of The Republic.\n\nHunter can lead a squad of Clone Troopers but doesn't usually work with the “regs” and prefers to have his Bad Batch allies at his side. He has chosen a different path compared to other clones and prefers covert tactics. Hunter ambushes his foes with [c][F0FF23]Shrouded Approach[-][/c], an ability that allows him and his Clone Trooper allies to gain Stealth while allies with the new Bad Batch faction tag also gain Critical Chance Up and Offense Up. Under Hunter’s leadership, Bad Batch allies have increased Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency and can take down those pesky clankers or Separatist enemies with ruthless efficiency.\n\nUnlock Hunter in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 I[-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_HUNTER_TITLE|Maps can be wrong. Hunter never is.
NEWSLETTER_HUNTERS3_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Hunter (Mercenary)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nAfter losing Tech, and Omega being captured by the Empire, Hunter and Wrecker took on the role of Mercenaries. They took jobs in pursuit of leads to learn where Omega was being held, using information in lieu of payment whenever possible.\n\nHunter’s Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Take a Shot[-][/c], Marks an enemy so allies can consistently attack a unit to gain Target Practice stacks and succeed at their rescue objective. [c][F0FF23]This Will Hurt[-][/c], his second Special, has a long cooldown but deals big damage and inflicts Protection Disruption and Shock as well as granting stacking Defense Penetration for Bad Batch allies.\n\nHis Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Focus Co-operation[-][/c], provides multiple effects for both Marked enemies as well as Target Practice and refreshes the cooldown of This Will Hurt once a Bad Batch ally loses Captive. In the Territory Wars game mode with an Omicron upgrade, this ability has even more impact against Marked enemies, benefits for Hunter when he gains Target Practice, and allows for much more frequent use of This Will Hurt.\n\nUnlock Hunter (Mercenary) in the upcoming “[c][E7E7E7]The Cavalry Has Arrived III[-][/c]” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
NEWSLETTER_HUNTERS3_TITLE|If You Ever Need Us, We'll Be There
NEWSLETTER_HUYANG_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Huyang[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nAn ancient droid that arrived at the Jedi Temple over twenty-five millennia ago in a noisy blue box, Huyang brings his knowledge of the Jedi and lightsabers to the Galaxy of Heroes battlefields. He has helped Padawans for generations in creating their first lightsabers, and most recently worked with Ahsoka Tano in her quest to find Grand Admiral Thrawn, and subsequently Ezra Bridger.\n\nA rare Attacker Light Side Droid, Huyang brings damage to both the upcoming Ahsoka Tano squad as well as 50R-T led droids. [c][F0FF23]Auxiliary Grapplers[-][/c], his first special, unleashes a flurry of punches that do more damage per Spectre ally. The other special, [c][F0FF23]Stay Together[-][/c], provides key buffs like Damage Immunity for Light Side Droids and Spectre allies and calls a mass assist. In Territory Battles with an Omicron upgrade, this ability dispels all enemy buffs and ally debuffs, recovers Health and Protection for Light Side allies, and reduces the cooldown of Light Side Droid and Spectre abilities.\n\nHuyang dishes out Jedi Lessons through his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Lightsaber Architect[-][/c], which also gives him [c][F0FF23]History of the Galaxy[-][/c] as allies lose Exile. This status upgrades twice to provide increasing Force Connection when Jedi, any Ahsoka, and Padawan Sabine Wren use an ability while they have Jedi Lessons.\n\nUnlock Huyang in the upcoming “LOST AND FOUND II” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event, and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_HUYANG_TITLE|Allons-y, Huyang is here!
NEWSLETTER_HYPERDRIVE_7TH_ANN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nIn celebration of the upcoming 7th anniversary, the Hyperdrive Bundle 50% sale is coming back to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! Following the game update on 11/16, the Hyperdrive Bundle will once again be available for purchase at half-off its standard price. The Hyperdrive bundle unlocks a massive stockpile of Core gear, Ability Material, Currencies, Energy, as well as 65 characters and 13 ships at 5 stars.\n\nDon't miss out on this amazing offer; the Hyperdrive Bundle is only on sale until 11/30.
NEWSLETTER_HYPERDRIVE_7TH_ANN_TITLE|Hyperdrive Bundle - 50% Off For A Limited Time
NEWSLETTER_HYPERDRIVE_BUNDLE_SALE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nFor the first time ever the Hyperdrive Bundle is on sale for 50% off! Starting November 17th, celebrate the 50th anniversary of LucasFilm and get this huge bundle at a discount. The Hyperdrive bundle unlocks a massive stockpile of Core gear, Ability Material, Currencies, Energy, as well as unlock 65 characters and 13 ships at 5 stars.\n\nDon't miss out on this amazing offer; the Hyperdrive Bundle is only on sale until November 24th.
NEWSLETTER_HYPERDRIVE_BUNDLE_SALE_TITLE|Hyperdrive Bundle - 50% Off For A Limited Time

Following the game update on 9/7, the Hyperdrive Bundle will once again available for purchase at half of its standard price. The Hyperdrive bundle unlocks a massive stockpile of Core gear, Ability Material, Currencies, Energy, as well as unlock 65 characters and 13 ships at 5 stars.\n\nDon't miss out on this amazing offer; the Hyperdrive Bundle is only on sale until 9/14.\n\nNOTE: Exclusive offer only available to players who have not previously purchased the Hyperdrive bundle.

NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_CANTINA_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Iden Versio[/b] has been added to [b]Cantina nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nBattles are rewarding bonus drops from 01/05/2024 through 01/09/2024.
NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_CANTINA_TITLE|Iden Versio is available on Cantina nodes!
NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Iden Versio[-][/c], the tenacious Imperial pilot who escaped the destruction of the Death Star during the Battle of Yavin, is landing on the holotables! A cunning mission planner, Iden was installed as the Commander of Inferno Squad and went to great lengths in her attempts to crush the Rebel Alliance.\n\nIden Versio is more than capable of calling the shots during battle, as evidenced by the fact her abilities often rely on the exclusion of other leaders in her squad. Iden strengthens Imperial Troopers, especially in Grand Arenas where her Omicron ability increases Imperial Trooper Health and Protection, and allows them to recover Health, Protection, and gain Turn Meter when enemy's attack out of turn. Iden also brings the new buff, [c][F0FF23]We Adapt, Or Die[-][/c], to the holotables, which can grant allies boosts to their Critical Chance, Offense, and Speed, as well as a self revive should the buffed ally be defeated. Iden’s resilience is also worth noting, given she revives with full Health and Protection if there is another active Imperial Trooper ally when she is defeated.\n\nUnlock Iden Versio, the fan-favorite [i]Star Wars Battlefront II[/i] protagonist, by playing the all-new [c][F0FF23][i]Embers of the Empire[/i][-][/c] Marquee Event, and make today the day “the Rebellion dies!”
NEWSLETTER_IDEN_VERSIO_TITLE|They Have Hope. We Have Me.
NEWSLETTER_IG11_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]IG-11[-][/c], the former assassin droid-turned-nurse, is coming to the holotables! As a nanny who takes a different approach to “tough love,” IG-11 is a steadfast protector of the Child and trusted colleague to Kuiil.\n\nIn addition to having a pack filled with ridiculously cute cargo, IG-11 brings some nursing skills to battle by granting allies additional Max Health. He also serves as a protector by Taunting and stealing the enemy's health to keep his allies safe. IG-11 adds even more utility to Droids and Scoundrels, as he assists during their turns and dispels debuffs.\n\nTake IG-11 for a spin after unlocking him via Galactic Challenges!
NEWSLETTER_IG11_TITLE|To Nurse and Protect
NEWSLETTER_IG12_GROGU_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]IG-12 & Grogu[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables! Constructed from the shell of the bounty hunter droid IG-11, IG-12 served as a vehicle to the diminutive Force-user.
