Grogu had access to the droid’s bacta spray which enabled him to heal his Mandalorian allies, and was able to communicate audibly through two buttons, Yes, and No.\n\nIG-12 & Grogu bring plenty of support and healing for Light Side Mandalorians, especially The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) and Bo-Katan (Mand’alor). Basic ability [c][F0FF23]No.[-][/c] and Special ability [c][F0FF23]No. No. No.[-][/c] debuff enemies to keep them subdued, while their Special ability [c][F0FF23]Yes.[-][/c] provides health and defense, and dispels debuffs.\n\nTheir Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Yes. Yes. Yes.[-][/c] has other Light Side Mandalorians assisting whenever IG-12 & Grogu use an ability, with different effects based on the ability used. This ability also gives IG-12 & Grogu the Scoundrel tag when under the leadership of The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor). With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, IG-12 & Grogu receive more assists and can quickly step in to help an ally falling low on Protection.\n\nUnlock IG-12 & Grogu during the upcoming “METAL MEDIATOR” Marquee event and prepare for the Epic Confrontation for Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) coming soon!
NEWSLETTER_IG12_GROGU_TITLE|Yes. Yes. Yes.
NEWSLETTER_IG90_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]IG-90[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nIG-90 is the second character in the Era of Anniversary, inspired by the droid that helped launch Galaxy of Heroes ten years ago: IG-86.\n\nA ruthlessly efficient assassin droid, IG-90 served as one of Doctor Aphra's more reliable companions during her various archaeological adventures and schemes. This deadly droid's precise targeting systems and advanced combat protocols made him an invaluable asset in both protection and offensive operations.\n\nIG-90's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]STATEMENT: Point Delivered[-][/c], showcases his deadly precision with multiple attacks while supporting his allies, particularly when paired with Doctor Aphra. His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Devastating Barrage[-][/c], allows him to coordinate devastating attacks with other Dark Side Droids while providing tactical support by Marking an enemy and maintaining battlefield control with the Hacked Commando Droid.\n\nThrough his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]QUERY: Dead or Alive?[-][/c] and the Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Calculated Suppression[-][/c], IG-90 excels at supporting both Droid and Bounty Hunter teams, providing significant offensive capabilities while maintaining team survivability. In Territory Wars, he becomes even more formidable, offering powerful synergies with Doctor Aphra and providing crucial support to Scoundrel and Bounty Hunter allies.\n\nUnlock IG-90 in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"SEEING RED"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! IG-90 is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled).
NEWSLETTER_IG90_TITLE|Aphra’s Secret Weapon
NEWSLETTER_IMPERIAL_SUPER_COMMANDO_UPDATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Imperial Super Commando[-][/c] has received a touchup to their kit! They will now have increased synergy with Dark Side Mandalorian allies, specifically Gar Saxon.\n\nThe following changes have been made to their abilities:\n\n- [c][F0FF23]Upper Hand[-][/c] Unique ability now has the following effect: Whenever a dark side Mandalorian ally attacks out of turn, they deal additional True damage and recover 10% Protection. Whenever Imperial Super Commando or Gar Saxon attack out of turn, the other attacks as well (limit once per turn).\n- The new Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Super Commando Beskar Armor[-][/c] reads: Imperial Super Commando and Gar Saxon gain +30% Defense, +50% Critical Avoidance, +20% Max Health, and +20% Max Protection. The first time either character would be defeated each encounter, they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented.
NEWSLETTER_IMPERIAL_SUPER_COMMANDO_UPDATE_TITLE|Imperial Super Commando Touchup
NEWSLETTER_IMPERIAL_TIE_BOMBER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe [c][F0FF23]Imperial TIE Bomber[-][/c] is making its way to the Holotables, ready to enforce the Empire's will on those who dare to rebel. Often serving in the first line of attack, TIE bombers drop vast quantities of munitions, delivering devastating attacks with frightening accuracy.\n\nAlthough the TIE bomber is the first ship in Galaxy of Heroes to apply [c][F0FF23]Burning[-][/c], its main strength lies in being a defensive stalwart for Imperial factions. Crippling the enemy's offense and exhibiting bravado by taunting is all in a day's work as these crewless ships seek glory for the Empire. Add the TIE bomber to your fleet and show those Rebel scum the Empire will not tolerate insubordination.\n\nJoin the [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] for the Imperial TIE Bomber and earn blueprints as a bonus reward on all [c][F0FF23]Cantina Battles[-][/c] nodes for a limited time starting June 4th!
NEWSLETTER_IMPERIAL_TIE_BOMBER_TITLE|Set the Skies on Fire
NEWSLETTER_INCOMPLETE_SIGNAL_DATA_CANTINA_062124_DESC|For a limited time, Incomplete Signal Data has been added to Cantina Battle nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/21/2024 through 06/24/2024.
NEWSLETTER_INCOMPLETE_SIGNAL_DATA_CANTINA_062124_TITLE|Incomplete Signal Data is available on Cantina Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_INQUISITOR_ASSAULT_BATTLE_DESC|To prepare for the arrival of the Grand Inquisitor, the Inquisitorius are hunting down Force Users! A new assault battle, "[c][F0FF23]FANATICAL DEVOTION[-][/c]", is entering the event rotation. Gather your Inquisitors and head to the events table on 6/16.\n\nPurge the galaxy and remember... there are things more frightening than death.
NEWSLETTER_INQUISITOR_ASSAULT_BATTLE_TITLE|A Fanatical Devotion
NEWSLETTER_INQUISITOR_BARRISS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Inquisitor Barriss[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nOnce a compassionate Jedi healer and Ahsoka Tano's closest friend, Barriss Offee's disillusionment with the Jedi Order led her down a dark path. After her betrayal and imprisonment, she was eventually recruited into the Inquisitorius, where her healing abilities were twisted into tools of corruption and control. Now serving the Empire, she uses her knowledge of the Force to drain enemies and sustain her fellow Inquisitors.\n\nInquisitor Barriss' Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Enfeebling Strike[-][/c], inflicts stacking Purge on enemies while healing Unaligned Force User allies and building her own Siphon. Her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Force Corruptor[-][/c], strips buffs from all enemies and Siphons Critical Damage from her primary target, with additional benefits when enemies have maximum Purge stacks. [c][F0FF23]Flicker of the Light[-][/c], her second Special ability, equalizes Health percentages among Unaligned Force User allies and provides substantial healing that scales with how much Purge has been consumed or resisted throughout the battle, while also sharing her Critical Damage with Inquisitorius Attackers.\n\nHer Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Those Left Behind[-][/c], grants Inquisitorius allies increased Health and sustained healing based on her own Max Health, while rewarding the team when enemies gain, resist, or are cleansed of Purge. In 3v3 Grand Arenas without Grand Inquisitor, this ability provides significant offensive bonuses and causes critical hits to apply Purge, while giving Second Sister Protection and frequent assists. Inquisitor Barriss' first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Reflexive Mercy[-][/c], prevents all revivals in battle and punishes enemies who critically hit her allies, while providing massive defensive bonuses when Ninth Sister is Taunting. Her final ability, [c][F0FF23]Patience[-][/c], grants her significant stat increases with a full Inquisitorius squad and allows her to gain Turn Meter when allies are critically hit, assists when allies damage enemies with Purge, and punishes enemies who attack her out of turn.\n\nUnlock Inquisitor Barriss in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"FROM LIGHT TO SHADOW"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Inquisitor Barriss is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled). 
NEWSLETTER_INQUISITOR_BARRISS_TITLE|The Barriss Necessities
NEWSLETTER_INQUISITORIUS_UPDATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday’s Update introduces a new Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Patience[-][/c] to all Inquisitors! If all allies are Inquisitorius and there are at least 3 allies present, allies will gain additional Max Health, Max Protection, and Potency, will inflict Purge on enemies who attack out of turn, and will gain bonus Turn Meter whenever Purge is dispelled or is consumed. Additionally, each Inquisitor will receive a bonus specific to them as part of the Unique.\n\nTo celebrate the Inquisitorius, we are rerunning their Marquee events 4/28 - 5/10. These events cannot be completed again if they were already completed.\n\nGo forth and bring glory to the Empire!
NEWSLETTER_INQUISITORIUS_UPDATE_TITLE|Inquisitorius Unique Ability and Marquee Reruns
NEWSLETTER_JABBA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGalactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jabba the Hutt[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! The first group of requirements to unlock Jabba the Hutt's event have been added to the Journey Guide.\n\nJabba the Hutt Requirements Group 1:\n\n- Krrsantan - Relic 5\n- Han Solo - Relic 8\n- Gamorrean Guard - Relic 3\n- Outrider - 7 stars\n- Greedo - Relic 6\n\nTo prepare for his arrival, we are also introducing a new [c][F0FF23]Hutt Cartel[-][/c] tag that will be added to the following units: Boba Fett, Embo, Cad Bane, Greedo, Gamorrean Guard, and Mob Enforcer.
NEWSLETTER_JABBA_GL_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGalactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jabba the Hutt[-][/c] has slithered onto the Holotables! One of the most powerful crime lords in the galaxy, Jabba strikes fear with an ominous laugh.... and a pet Rancor.\n\nHis Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]His High Exaltedness[-][/c], provides multiple statistical and mechanical benefits for Bounty Hunter, Smuggler, and Hutt Cartel allies. He also provides important synergy to allies with [c][F0FF23]My Kind of Scum[-][/c] and can't be directly targeted by enemies while this buff is present in his squad.\n\nJabba utilizes the new buff, [c][F0FF23]Hired Muscle[-][/c], to bestow his allies with extra Tenacity and immunity to Daze and Fear (when in the presence of the mighty Jabba, what else could seem so fearsome?). Additional benefits are also provided based on the allies' role.\n\nHis Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Illustrious[-][/c], turns an enemy's benefit into a boon for his allies by providing bonus Turn Meter for his team whenever an enemy gains it for theirs.\n\nStay on Jabba's good side, because his Ultimate ability, [c][F0FF23]There Will Be No Bargain[-][/c], instantly defeats the target enemy and provides Health and Protection recovery for Bounty Hunter, Hutt Cartel, and Smuggler allies with Hutt Cartel allies also gaining bonus Turn Meter. Although they are not instantly defeated, raid bosses and Galactic Legends will still suffer dearly at the hands of Jabba's Ultimate when it is used against them.\n\nObtain Jabba the Hutt now through the all-new event [c][F0FF23]Greetings, Exalted One[-][/c], which can be accessed via the Journey Guide.
NEWSLETTER_JABBA_GL_TITLE|I Seek An Audience With Your Greatness
NEWSLETTER_JABBA_TITLE|Galactic Legend Jabba the Hutt is coming!
NEWSLETTER_JANGO_FETT_DESC|Master assassin, father of Boba Fett, and one of the galaxy’s best Bounty Hunters, Jango Fett has joined the Holotables! Jango is a strong leader for any Bounty Hunter squad with his powerful attacks and amazing buffs for your entire team. Complete Jango’s Contract to give all allied Bounty Hunters an incredible buff: [c][f0ff23]BOUNTY HUNTER’S RESOLVE[-][/c] will revive your Bounty Hunters when they are defeated and allow them to ignore Taunt.\n\nCad Bane received a rework recently and now he’s getting his modified Rogue-class starfighter, Xanadu Blood! This stealthy support ship uses [c][f0ff23]BREACH[-][/c] to weaken its foes while protecting its allies. Form the ultimate Bounty Hunter fleet with Xanadu Blood, Slave I and the Hound’s Tooth.\n\nThere was another Bounty Hunter still looking for a Contract out in the galaxy, and she’s found it. The shapeshifter Zam Wesell has a few new tricks up her sleeve and maybe even a Thermal Detonator or two. Zam’s explosive new reworked kit means she loves to team up with anyone that can lob more detonators in the enemy squad’s direction. In addition, all characters that use Thermal Detonators received an upgrade: All Thermal Detonators can no longer be dispelled!
NEWSLETTER_JANGO_FETT_TITLE|Any Job for the Right Price
NEWSLETTER_JAPAN_GACHA_PACK_TITLEV2|Make your characters more powerful with the new Embersteel pack!
NEWSLETTER_JAR_JAR_BINKS_DESC|Mesa greeting yousa Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe lovable jester from The Phantom Menace, [c][E7E7E7]Jar Jar Binks[-][/c], is coming to the Holotables!\n\nJar Jar Binks was an outcast Gungan who serendipitously ran into Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi on Naboo during the Trade Federation’s invasion. This fast friendship led to the Jedi and Queen Amidala finding common ground between the Gungans and the Naboo, forming a formidable alliance that brought a new era of unity between the two residents of the planet.\n\nJar Jar is the final piece of the Gungan Squad, and requires all four other Gungans to be Relic 5 to unlock his Legendary event. Like Grand Inquisitor, Jar Jar’s event, [c][E7E7E7]Bombad General[-][/c], will consist of challenging encounters meant to put your Gungan squad and knowledge of their abilities to the test. These encounters are fun nods to the events of The Phantom Menace, meant to put a smile on your face as you go through them.\n\nJar Jar’s abilities each have a longshot chance at something special firing off, however much more likely against Separatist enemies. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]How Wude![-][/c], has a 1 in 10,000 chance of simply instantly defeating a random enemy. Additionally, How Wude! can inflict Deathmark, make an ally immune to damage, or give the squad Tenacity Up, but the effect is randomly determined when the ability is used.\n\nHis Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wesa Warriors[-][/c], can inflict a new debuff, [c][E7E7E7]Frustration[-][/c] (a state of mind many people who have interacted with Jar Jar have found themselves in). Frustration prevents enemies from assisting or counter attacking, punishes gaining bonus Turn Meter by removing stacks of Recharge from the Shield Generator, and Ability Blocks them until they make another attack. Wesa Warriors can also alter debuffs on enemies into undispellable versions of themselves.\n\nJar Jar Binks’ Unique abilities ([c][F0FF23]Mesa Okeyday[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Mooie-Mooie, I Love You[-][/c]) play into his ability to find the positive outcome out of any situation, giving him Blind whenever he gains Foresight and then turning his attacks that miss into mass assists from the rest of the Gungan squad.\n\nJar Jar Binks completes the Gungan squad, and his event is only open for a limited time so make sure your Gungans are up to the task. The Gungan squad looks forward to taking on the Trade Federation in the [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo[-][/c] raid, so fire up your shield generator and load your satchels full of boomas, okeyday?
NEWSLETTER_JAR_JAR_BINKS_TITLE|Exsqueeze me...
NEWSLETTER_JAWA_ENGINEER_DESC|Greetings, \n\nA new character is now available in Guild Store, Jawa Engineer. This unit is a high-speed Healer with a Critical Chance buff for both Jawas and Droids. \n\nWill you add this Jawa to your squad to form the ultimate Droid and Jawa synergy?
NEWSLETTER_JAWA_ENGINEER_TITLE|New Character: Jawa Engineer
NEWSLETTER_JAWA_SCAVENGER_CHIEF_NEBIT_DESC|Chief Nebit and Jawa Scavenger are now available in Arena Shipments and Cantina Shipments, respectively.\n\nChief Nebit is a Jawa Tank and a natural choice for Jawa and Droid squads, granting them additional Critical Chance and the ability to lower the Critical Chance of their targets. His cunning also gives him the ability to call his allies to assist his attacks, grant stealth to his allies, and reduce their cooldowns. This synergy gives a great advantage to any Jawa or Droid in his squad.\n\nJawa Scavenger is a versatile Support who can inflict a variety of status effects on his enemies and buff his allies. Utilizing his ability, “Scrap Bomb”, Jawa Scavenger is able to detonate all Thermal Detonators and debuff affected enemies making them easy targets for his squad mates. In addition his unique ability, “Salvaged Equipment”, randomly grants Offense Up and Defense Up to his allies whenever he is stealthed.\n\nComplete your Jawa party with these two desert dwellers!
NEWSLETTER_JAWA_SCAVENGER_CHIEF_NEBIT_TITLE|Chief Nebit & Jawa Scavenger
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_FALLEN_ORDER_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes!\n\nA Special Marquee Event (Trust Only in the Force) to welcome new players to the holotables is going on now.\n\nDuring the event, you can play to unlock five Marquee Event characters (Cal Kestis, Cere Junda, Tarfful, Saw Gerrera, and Merrin). A bonus login calendar for additional items is also going to be available for new players to get you started on your journey. This login calendar is available to collect in the store starting at level 10 for new accounts.\n\nEvent requirements: \n- To be able to access the login calendar (CAL KESTIS WELCOME CALENDAR), players must be new installs at the time of the event.\n- Marquee Events will become accessible starting at level 20. New players can access the event by collecting the login calendar for an XP boost.\n- Marquee Events will be available for rewards to all players who do not already have 55+ shards of these heroes.\n\nEvent Start: 3.27.2025 11:00AM Pacific\n\nEvent End: 4.10.2025 11:00AM Pacific\n\nLooking forward to seeing you on the holotables!\n\n- STAR WARS™: Galaxy of Heroes team
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_FALLEN_ORDER_TITLE|Trust Only In The Force - Special Event
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_CAL_KESTIS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight Cal Kestis[-][/c], the persistent explorer and freedom fighter of the epic Jedi: Survivor game from Respawn, is coming to the holotables!\n\nCal works differently than any other character in the game, centering on changing his Lightsaber Configuration throughout battle. On each of his turn's, Cal must use his Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Less Civilized Age[-][/c] which grants him a bonus turn, where he will select [c][F0FF23]Double-Bladed[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Dual-Wield[-][/c], or eventually [c][F0FF23]Crossguard[-][/c] for his Configuration based on the Special ability he uses. Double-Bladed lays down a spread of debuffs to manage enemies while Dual-Wield provides Cal and his allies with protective benefits.\n\nEach Configuration provides a different passive bonus and which you choose is up to what situation you find yourself in during battle, but avoid staying with one Configuration too long because changing Configurations will accelerate your ability to use the Crossguard Configuration, which instantly defeats the first target enemy and does big single target damage!\n\nHis Omicron upgrades in Territory Battles make him reign supreme in that game mode. His Double-Bladed Special ability now applies Stun and Armor Shred to all enemies, his Crossguard Special ability ignores Protection and really cranks up the damage, and his Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Weight of the Galaxy[-][/c] amplifies the defensive abilities of his allies as well as opening Turn Meter and Frenzy. Use these overwhelming abilities in the Special Mission on Bracca to unlock Zeffo, the new Bonus Zone in the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle! On [c][F0FF23]Zeffo[-][/c], you’ll encounter exciting new enemies like Tomb Guardians and the relentless bounty hunters of the Haxion Brood.\n\nOutside of Territory Battles, his Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Jedi Survivor[-][/c] protects Jedi from key weaknesses allowing players more flexibility with their powerful Jedi while in other game modes.\n\nUnlock Jedi Knight Cal in the new limited time Hero’s Journey event!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_CAL_KESTIS_TITLE|It’s Time to Set You Free
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nDespite his humble beginnings as a Tatooine moisture farmer making runs to Tosche Station for power converters, we always knew [c][F0FF23]Luke Skywalker[-][/c] was destined for greater things. His victory over Jabba the Hutt was a mere hint at the strong bond Luke shared with the Force as a [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight[-][/c], a lesson the Empire would later learn firsthand during the Battle of Endor. Luke's leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Return of the Jedi[-][/c], helps to restore balance to the Force by granting bonuses and dispelling negative effects from allies, while also setting all enemies to his base Speed.\n\nUnlock [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker[-][/c] by participating in the all new "[c][F0FF23]The Journey Continues - Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker[-][/c]" event.
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_REHEAT_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nJedi Knight Luke has been added to the Journey Guide and his event, The Journey Continues is back for a limited time! His quiet upbringing on Tatooine belied his destiny to become a Jedi Master but Luke faced many challenges as a Jedi Knight that shaped his connection with the Force. Feel like you could take on the whole empire by yourself? Unlock Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker and get ready for Galactic Legend, Jedi Master Luke Skywalker!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_REHEAT_TITLE|Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker Joins the Journey Guide
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_KNIGHT_LUKE_TITLE|Return of the Jedi
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_MASTER_MACE_WINDU_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nA powerful Jedi Master and senior member of the Jedi Council, [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Mace Windu[-][/c] brings new tactical mechanics to the holotables! As the commander of the elite Jedi Vanguard, Mace employs systematic investigation and revelation to dismantle formidable opponents.\n\nHis Leader ability, Solver, directs the squad to apply stacks of the new [c][F0FF23]Investigation[-][/c] effect, triggering other Jedi Vanguards’ abilities. Once a foe reaches 5 stacks, they become [c][F0FF23]Revealed[-][/c] - a devastating debuff that strips away their Critical Damage, and keeps them under a near-constant Expose, all the while allowing his squad to target the Revealed enemy by ignoring Taunt effects. \n\n[c][F0FF23]Shatterpoint[-][/c], Mace’s signature technique, returns on his Basic ability sharing the same name, and will reduce Vanguards’ cooldowns if the target was already inflicted with it. \n\nHis first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Decapitation Strike[-][/c], deals extra damage to enemy Leaders and Revealed foes while his second Special, [c][F0FF23]The Hammer of Ryloth[-][/c], punishes Investigated adversaries and dispels debuffs on his Jedi Vanguard squad.\n\nHis [c][F0FF23]Arrest Warrant[-][/c] Unique lets Mace bypass Taunt, deal bonus damage to Revealed enemies, and Vanguard Tanks Taunt when foes are Revealed. Mace’s Omicrons are in the Territory Wars  game mode, powering up Jedi Vanguards to be a top-tier team in that mode.\n\nFace the greatest dangers in the galaxy with the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"BESET ON ALL SIDES"[-][/c] Legendary event to unlock [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Mace Windu[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_MASTER_MACE_WINDU_TITLE|Balanced Master of the Force
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_MASTER_OBI_WAN_EVENT_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGalactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Jedi Master Kenobi[-][/c] has joined the holotables!\n\nBrimming with references to iconic Revenge of the Sith moments, Galactic Legend Jedi Master Kenobi has a kit that is as powerful as it is reverent to Episode III. Health and Protection recovery, Defense Penetration, Foresight, and Mastery, along with Speed and Health increases for allies are just the tip of the lightsaber. In addition to Galactic Republic characters, he also acts as a robust leader when paired with Light Side Unaligned Force Users.\n\nWhen it comes to the opposition, Jedi Master Kenobi inflicts enemies with [c][F0FF23]Vulnerable[-][/c] and calls allies to assist, showcasing the intelligence and camaraderie he regularly displayed during battle.\n\nWorthy of both the Jedi Master and Galactic Legend titles, if you’re not excited for this version of Obi-Wan, “then, you are lost!”
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_MASTER_OBI_WAN_EVENT_TITLE|Hello There
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_AAYLA_SECURA_DESC|Gather up your party and prepare for a special 7-day Event to earn Jedi shards! This limited time event will be available at levels 55, 65 and 75 and will have you overcome 4 different battles to earn both credits and shards of members of the Jedi Order. \n\nMake sure your squad is ready for the return of the Grand Master's Training event by completing this week’s limited time event!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_AAYLA_SECURA_TITLE|Force Champions: Aayla Secura
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_KIT_FISTO_DESC|The Force Champions event continues with 4 different battles and more shards! Available at levels 55, 65 and 75 this limited time event gives you another chance to add and power-up the Jedi in your collection!\n\nKeep adding and powering up these guardians of peace and justice so that you're prepared for the return of the Grand Master Yoda Event!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_KIT_FISTO_TITLE|Force Champions: Kit Fisto
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_MACE_WINDU_DESC|The last Force Champions event before the return of Grand Master Yoda is here! Available at levels 55, 65 and 75. This is your chance to triumph in 4 different battles to earn both credits and Jedi shards!\n\nMake sure your Jedi squad is ready for Grand Master Yoda’s return by completing this week’s limited time event and powering up your Jedi characters!
NEWSLETTER_JEDI_TRAINING_MACE_WINDU_TITLE|Force Champions: Ima-Gun Di
NEWSLETTER_JG_DARTH_MALAK_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nDarth Malak's event, [c][f0ff23]Star Forge Showdown[-][/c], is now permanently playable in the Journey Guide for players who meet the requirements.\n\nDarth Malak is a powerful Sith tank who uses Force Lightning to torture his enemies and drains their life in order to sustain himself. He tracked down the Star Forge under the orders of the Sith Emperor and eventually usurped the title of Dark Lord of the Sith from Revan, his old friend and Sith Master.\n\nHead over to the Journey Guide to find out which characters and what gear you'll need to unlock his event.\n\nSee you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_JG_DARTH_MALAK_TITLE|Darth Malak now in the Journey Guide!
NEWSLETTER_JOCASTA_NU_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Jocasta Nu[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nOnce the Chief Librarian for the Jedi Archives, after surviving the Purge Jocasta dedicated herself to preserving key Jedi knowledge. Don’t let her identity as a Librarian fool you - she wields the formidable [c][F0FF23]Lightsaber Rifle[-][/c] that uses her lightsaber as ammunition to fire powerful beams of energy before eventually exploding.\n\nJocasta Nu arrives as a key component to the new [c][FF00FF]Jedi Vanguard[-][/c] faction that will be filled out in the next Era with marquee units and a Legendary. She enters the fight with her lightsaber but as Jedi Vanguard allies use Special abilities she [c][F0FF23]transforms[-][/c] and wields the Lightsaber Rifle.\n\nHer Basic ability will [c][F0FF23]spread certain debuffs[-][/c] that are on the target enemy to their allies and her Unique ability also spreads debuffs to enemies who debuff her. Her Special ability will dispel enemy buffs and accelerate her transform, then once she has transformed it will [c][F0FF23]Siphon Max Protection[-][/c] from the target enemy. Once she has transformed, if she is about to be defeated she attempts a [c][F0FF23]desperate move[-][/c] that can only save her if it defeats all enemies.\n\nHer Omicrons apply to the Grand Arenas game mode, where her Special ability can [c][F0FF23]set an enemy’s Health to 66[-][/c] and her Basic ability spreads buffs that she has onto other allies. Additionally, her Unique Omicron will also accelerate her transformation by reducing the cooldown for any ally Vanguard ability used, not just Specials.\n\nUnlock Jocasta Nu in the [c][E7E7E7]upcoming Conquest events[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_JOCASTA_NU_TITLE|Don’t Underestimate a Librarian
NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nUnsure how to unlock the greatest heroes and villains in the galaxy? The [c][F0FF23]Journey Guide[-][/c] is here to help - and it's available now! As part of this update, all existing Legendary, Journey, and Ancient Journey events have moved into the Journey Guide and are now replayable. Future versions of these events, as well as Epic Confrontations, will move into the Journey Guide sometime after their initial release. That means you can try many of these exciting events right now or any time you are ready!\n\nThe Journey Guide also reveals the newest type of character to the holotables: [c][F0FF23]Galactic Legends[-][/c]. The Galactic Legend designation will be reserved for the most famous and powerful characters in the galaxy, and the Journey Guide will be your path to unlocking them in future releases.\n\nSpeaking of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, the holotables have received some nefarious reinforcements in preparation for the conclusion of the Skywalker saga. The new [c][F0FF23]Sith Trooper[-][/c] is a powerful attacker with both Sith and First Order faction synergies. Alongside the Sith Trooper, [c][F0FF23]General Hux[-][/c] is also coming to the holotable. Both these new units heavily utilize Advantage and can quickly turn the tide of battle by bombarding the enemy with critical hits. General Hux can use Advantage to trigger a variety of beneficial effects for First Order allies, but watch out for his new Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Dominance[-][/c], which stops his foes from counter-attacking while boosting the counter chance for his allies.\n\nEarn these units in upcoming marquee events starting soon!
NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_TITLE|Your Legendary Guide
NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_UPDATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Journey Guide has been updated with a streamlined experience and a brand new look! The Ships and Characters buttons have been combined into a single Collections button and you can now access the Journey Guide directly from the Cantina screen.\n\nWe have reorganized the Journey Guide into a gallery sorted by types of events and tiers of difficulty. Now you can quickly access all of the relevant information you need to unlock an exciting new character or ship. All requirements for each tier and the rewards are front and center so you can easily find what you need to complete your next battle.\n\nIn addition, there is a new option in the Journey Guide called [i]Begin Journey[/i] for each unit that will assist you in tracking its requirements. Once selected, you can find all the units needed for the entire event in a tab on the Collections screen and the units and gear required for the next step of the journey are clearly marked throughout the game with new icons.\n\nWe hope you enjoy the new streamlined Journey Guide experience! See you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_JOURNEY_GUIDE_UPDATE_TITLE|Journey to the Journey Guide
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT_DESC|Rogue One's JYN ERSO has arrived, available as a reward in the new HERO OF THE REBELLION Squad Tournament! This tournament will take place on December 17th. You will need to be at least level 30 to have a chance to compete and win this iconic character.\n\nJyn Erso is a Rebel Attacker eager to bring the fight to the Empire. Her “Into the Fray” ability gives Rebel allies a Potency buff from the start of the encounter, with a chance to also inflict Expose whenever they inflict a debuff on enemies and recovering some Protection when they gain buffs. Not content to fight from the sidelines, Jyn leads from the front with her “Press the Attack” ability which deals damage to her enemy with a chance of giving her Advantage for 2 turns. If she finds her squad under fire, Jyn is also capable of utilizing a unique “Rebel Counterattack” ability, dealing AOE damage to her enemies, reviving a random Rebel ally, granting full Turn Meter to an ally of her choice!\n\nDominate the leaderboard in the Hero of the Rebellion tournament on December 17th to add Jyn Erso to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT_TITLE|HERO OF THE REBELLION Squad Tournament with Rogue One’s JYN ERSO!
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_DESC|The Hero of the Rebellion Squad Tournament returns next week! You will need to be at least level 30 to have a chance to compete and earn shards for Rogue One's JYN ERSO.\n\nJyn Erso is a Rebel Attacker eager to bring the fight to the Empire. Her “Into the Fray” ability gives Rebel allies a Potency buff from the start of the encounter, with a chance to also inflict Expose whenever they inflict a debuff on enemies and recovering some Protection when they gain buffs.\n\nNot content to fight from the sidelines, Jyn leads from the front with her “Press the Attack” ability which deals damage to her enemy with a chance of giving her Advantage for 2 turns. If she finds her squad under fire, Jyn is also capable of utilizing a unique “Rebel Counterattack” ability, dealing AOE damage to her enemies, reviving a random Rebel ally, granting full Turn Meter to an ally of her choice!n\nDominate the leaderboard in the Hero of the Rebellion tournament and add Jyn Erso to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_JYN_ERSO_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_TITLE|HERO OF THE REBELLION Squad Tournament returns next week!
NEWSLETTER_K2SO_DESC|A Limited Time, Google Play Exclusive!\nA reprogrammed Imperial security Droid turned Rebel agent, K-2SO is FREE to Google players! Collect him from the [i]Rogue One Heroes[/i] pack in the Store.\n\nK-2SO is a Rebel tank capable of Dazing and Taunting his enemies while having a chance to counter attack whenever he takes damage. Assigned to Cassian Andor for several missions, he can also provide extra synergy if paired in the same squad, calling on Cassian to assist him with his Conductive Charge ability.\n\nHead to the Store to collect your FREE K-2SO and participate in the limited time Event, ESCAPE FROM JEDHA to earn shards and level him up!
NEWSLETTER_K2SO_TITLE|Rogue One’s K-2SO is now available EXCLUSIVELY ON GOOGLE PLAY!
NEWSLETTER_KELLERAN_BEQ_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Kelleran Beq[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! Known for training younglings before the fall of the Galactic Republic and renowned for his mastery of the lightsaber, he was the Jedi who heroically saved Grogu during Order 66 at the Jedi temple.\n\nKelleran works very well with other Galactic Republic Jedi, especially those not being used on a Galactic Legend squad. His Unique ability [c][F0FF23]The Sabered Hand[-][/c] pays homage to his lightsaber skills by converting some of his Health into Protection, then using that Protection to increase damage for himself and his allies through the [c][F0FF23]Padawan Lessons[-][/c] status effect and his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Jedi Bravery[-][/c].\n\nEver the protector, with an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode while all allies are Galactic Republic and there are no Galactic Legends on his squad, his Leader ability [c][F0FF23]By The Will Of The Council[-][/c] gives big Defense to his allies while he is active yet keeps him alive while his allies have Protection.\n\nUnlock Kelleran Beq during the upcoming “JEDI TEMPLE CHALLENGE” Marquee event and prepare for the Epic Confrontation for Bo-Katan (Mand'alor) coming soon!
NEWSLETTER_KELLERAN_BEQ_TITLE|The Best Jedi
NEWSLETTER_KIT_FISTO_CANTINA_MISSION_MESSAGE|Kit Fisto is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission F! This Nautolan Jedi is a versatile attacker with a multi-attack, great counters and the ability to buff an entire team with Potency Up.\n\nWill you add this Jedi Master to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_KIT_FISTO_CANTINA_MISSION_TITLE|Kit Fisto is now available in Cantina Battles!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_01_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nRose Tico and Captain Phasma have been updated with Omicron Ability tiers! Both characters have a new tier added to one of their abilities that will boost their effectiveness in a specific game mode. The new top tier of each of these abilities will require the new Omicron material to unlock.\n\nRose Tico's Unique, [c][F0FF23]Valiant Spirit[-][/c], has been updated with a new tier that enhances Resistance allies in Grand Arena Championships. While in Grand Arena, Valiant Spirit will not only boost Rose's Offense for each Exposed enemy but will also apply this effect to Resistance squad mates. In addition, all Resistance allies will gain Turn Meter whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit while in Grand Arena.\n\nCaptain Phasma now has a new tier added to her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Fire at Will[-][/c], which boosts First Order squads while in Territory Wars. In this mode, Fire at Will provides Health and Protection recovery when a First Order ally attacks out of turn and stacking Offense and Turn Meter whenever a First Order ally gains Advantage.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_01_TITLE|Omicron Additions for Rose Tico and Captain Phasma
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_02_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds a new mode specific Omicron ability tier to Rebel Officer Leia Organa and Chief Nebit!\n\nRebel Officer Leia Organa's new Omicron tier on her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Battlefront Command[-][/c], increases the effectiveness of Rebels in Territory Battles and particularly during longer multi-encounter battles. Under this improved Leader ability, Rebel allies fully recover Health and Protection at the start of each encounter and whenever a Rebel ally is defeated. In addition, all friendly Rebels gain their Rebel ally's Offense when a Rebel ally is defeated.\n\nWatch out! He's holding a thermal detonator! The Jawa squad explodes on to the Territory Wars map with Chief Nebit's freshly updated Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Raiding Parties[-][/c]. In this mode, Jawas now dispel buffs whenever they deal damage to an enemy and inflicts Thermal Detonators for every buff dispelled. All those Thermal Detonator are really going to add up as Jawa allies recover Health and Protection, and gain Turn Meter whenever an enemy takes damage from a Thermal Detonator. When those Thermal Detonators explode, they also have a chance to apply another Thermal Detonator to keep the cycle going on and on!\n\nBoth of these Leader ability upgrades are now available for Omicron materials.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_02_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tiers for Rebel Officer Leia Organa and Chief Nebit
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_03_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Qui-Gon Jinn and Zam Wesell!\n\nQui-Gon Jinn has a new Omicron tier added to his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Agility Training[-][/c], which powers up Jedi allies while battling in Grand Arena Championships. Jedi allies will attack with incredible force in this mode as they gain up to 60 times their Speed as Offense! Additionally, Jedi allies fully recover their Health and Protection, and gain four times Qui-Gon's Offense when Qui-Gon Jinn is defeated while in Grand Arena.\n\nZam Wesell is also getting a boost in Grand Arena Championships with her upgraded Unique, [c][F0FF23]Shapeshifter[-][/c]. In Grand Arena battles, Zam will receive triple the stat bonuses from her Unique and provide Bounty Hunter allies with a portion of her Offense, Max Protection, Max Health, and Speed after those stats are increased.\n\nBoth of these new ability tiers are available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_03_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tiers for Qui-Gon Jinn and Zam Wesell
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_04_DESC|Chief Chirpa has a new Omicron tier added to his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Simple Tactics[-][/c], which bolsters Ewok allies while battling in Grand Arena Championships. Release the full furry frenzy of Endor as Ewok allies gain additional Speed, deal more damage with their Basic abilities, and have 100% chance to call an Ewok ally to assist when using a Special ability in this mode.\n\nDarth Sidious and his fearsome squad of Sith are getting a boost in Territory Wars with his upgraded Unique, [c][F0FF23]Sadistic Glee[-][/c]. In Territory Wars, Darth Sidious' ability, [c][F0FF23]Demoralizing Blows[-][/c], is as disheartening as ever with a reduced cooldown based on the number of Sith allies and now provides 50 Speed to Darth Sidious for several turns. Additionally when paired with all Sith allies, friendly non-Galactic Legend Sith gain max Health based on Darth Sidious' Potency.\n\nBoth of these new ability tiers are available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_04_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tiers for Chief Chirpa and Darth Sidious
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_05_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Imperial Probe Droid and Hera Syndulla!\n\nImperial Probe Droid has a new Omicron tier added to their Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Imperial Logistics[-][/c], which upgrades this self destructing droid in Territory Battles. With this upgrade, Imperial Probe Droid can be revived after using [c][F0FF23]Self-Destruct[-][/c], and revives at the start of each encounter while in this mode. The Self-Destruct ability is also more potent in Territory Battles and deals additional damage to the target enemy equal to 200% of Imperial Probe Droid's Max Health and other Empire allies gain Offense equal to 300% of Imperial Probe Droid's Offense.\n\nHera Syndulla and Phoenix allies will excel in Territory Wars under her upgraded Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rise Together[-][/c]. When Hera uses [c][F0FF23]Backup Plan[-][/c] in Territory Wars, all Phoenix allies gain the Backup Plan buff and whenever a Phoenix ally uses a Special ability, all Phoenix allies gain additional stacking Offense. Additionally, Phoenix allies also gain increased counter chance, Max Health, and Speed while in Territory Wars.\n\nBoth of these new ability tiers are available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_05_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tiers for Imperial Probe Droid and Hera Syndulla
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_06_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Carth Onasi!\n\nCarth Onasi has a new Omicron tier added to their Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Soldier of the Old Republic[-][/c], which boosts Old Republic squads in Territory Battles. With this upgrade, Old Republic allies gain even more stats (Max Health, Defense, and counter chance) for each Old Republic ally while in Territory Battles. Additionally, whenever an Old Republic ally uses a Special ability, they inflict multiple Damage Over Time effects on their target and whenever an Old Republic ally attacks out of turn, they recover Health and Protection and gain stacking Offense until the end of the encounter.\n\nThis new ability tier for Carth Onasi is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_06_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Carth Onasi
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_07_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Admiral Ackbar!\n\nAdmiral Ackbar has a new Omicron tier added to their Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rebel Coordination[-][/c], which upgrades this daring Rebel leader in Grand Arena Championships. With this upgrade, all allies gain Tenacity Up at the start of battle in Grand Arenas. Additionally in Grand Arenas and if all allies are Rebel, allies gain Turn Meter whenever a buff expires, and all allies recover Health, call the other two weakest allies to assist, and reduce their cooldowns whenever an ally uses an ability that isn't an attack.\n\nAdmiral Ackbar's new ability tier is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now! 
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_07_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Admiral Ackbar
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_08_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to Princess Leia!\n\nPrincess Leia has a new Omicron tier added to her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Against All Odds[-][/c], which powers up Rebel squads in Grand Arena Championships. Whenever Leia attacks in this mode, she has a chance to grant all Rebel allies Retribution and Tenacity Up while all other Rebel allies recover Health and Protection.\n\nPrincess Leia's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_08_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Princess Leia
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_09_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nDirector Krennic has a new Omicron tier added to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Immeasurable Power[-][/c], which powers up Krennic and Death Trooper in Grand Arena Championships. In this mode, Krennic gains additional Defense Penetration, Health, and Offense and shares these bonuses with Death Trooper. While Death Trooper is active, both Krennic and Death Trooper ignore Taunt and whenever Krennic attacks, Death Trooper's cooldowns are reduced and is called to assist.\n\nDirector Krennic's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_09_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Director Krennic
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_10_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to the fierce bounty hunter, Embo!\n\nEmbo has a new Omicron tier added to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Way of the Kyuzo[-][/c], which powers up Bounty Hunter squads in Territory Wars. While in this mode, Bounty Hunter allies gain additional Max Protection, and at the end of Embo's turn, Bounty Hunter allies recover Protection based on Embo's Max Protection. While Embo has Protection, Bounty Hunter allies gain additional Defense and Turn Meter whenever a Bounty Hunter ally receives damage while debuffed.\n\nEmbo's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_10_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Embo
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_11_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to the feared beast of Hoth, [c][F0FF23]Wampa[-][/c]!\n\nWampa has a new Omicron tier added to his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Cornered Beast[-][/c], which powers up Wampa when deployed alone in Grand Arenas. While in this mode, if there are no other active allies at the start of battle, Wampa gains additional Defense, Max Health, Max Protection, and Offense, and double those bonuses instead if there is only one active enemy at the start of battle. Whenever Wampa is damaged by an attack, the attacking enemy is inflicted with Damage Over Time debuffs, and the cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Furious Foe[-][/c] is reduced.\n\nWampa's new ability tier is available for upgrade with Omicron materials now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_11_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Wampa
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_12_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nMace Windu's kit has been updated with reworked abilities along with a new Special and Unique!\n\nThe debuff [c][F0FF23]Shatterpoint[-][/c] is the centerpiece of Mace’s updated kit. Attacking enemies with Shatterpoint reduces the target enemy's Attack, Defense, and Max Health for the rest of the encounter, and enables Mace to swap Turn Meter with Galactic Republic allies, stun his enemies, or recover his squad's Health and Protection depending on which ability he uses. This rework introduces a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Resilient Defense[-][/c], which works similarly to Taunt but only lasts for a certain number of attacks.\n\nMace also has a new Omicron ability tier which enables other Light Side allies to apply Speed Down and Shatterpoint to a random enemy while in Territory Wars. Additionally, in this mode all allies gain Turn Meter whenever an ally damages an enemy with Shatterpoint.\n\nAs part of this rework, we have returned all ability materials used to upgrade any of Mace Windu's abilities to your inbox.\n\nSee you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_12_TITLE|Mace Windu Rework and New Omicron Ability Tier
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_13_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]T3-M4[-][/c]’s kit!\n\nT3-M4 has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Master Gearhead[-][/c] Unique ability, which elevates the Droid faction by providing healing and Target Lock support in Territory Wars.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked, T3-M4 will gain Stealth for 2 turns at the start of the encounter. Droid allies will benefit from receiving increases to their Armor Penetration and Max Health as well as a boost to Defense while buffed and debuffed, and for each Target Locked enemy. At the start of T3-M4's turn a random enemy who does not already have Target Lock will be inflicted with it for two turns, which can't be evaded. Then, all allies recover some Health and Protection for each Target Locked enemy.\n\nThis new ability tier for T3-M4 is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_13_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for T3-M4
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_14_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Jyn Erso’s[-][/c] kit and upgrades her Unique Zeta!\n\nJyn Erso has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Fierce Determination[-][/c] Unique ability, which boosts Rogue One allies in Territory Wars.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked, Rogue One allies gain additional Max Health, Potency, and Speed and whenever a Rogue One ally's buff expires during an enemy's turn, Jyn gains Turn Meter. In addition, whenever Jyn critically hits an enemy and all allies were Rogue One at the start of battle, all allies recover Health and gain an additional bonus depending on their role while in this mode.\n\nThe Zeta tier of her Unique, [c][F0FF23]Fierce Determination[-][/c], has also received an update. Rogue One allies are immune to Buff Immunity in all modes with this upgrade!\n\nThis new ability tier for Jyn Erso is available for upgrade with the new Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_14_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Jyn Erso
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_15_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Luke Skywalker (Farmboy)'s[-][/c] kit! Luke Skywalker (Farmboy) has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Draw a Bead[-][/c] Unique ability, which increases Defense, Max Health, and Tenacity in Territory Wars. Additionally at the start of each of his turns, Luke will be granted stacking Offense and Defense until the end of the encounter.\n\nBut wait, there’s more! When Luke is prevented from using an ability, he will recover a large amount of Health and Protection.\n\nThis new ability tier for Luke Skywalker (Farmboy) is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_15_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Luke Skywalker (Farmboy)
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_16_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Tusken Raider's[-][/c] kit!\n\nTusken Raider has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Strength in Numbers[-][/c] Unique ability, which boosts Tuskens in 3v3 Grand Arenas.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked and a full Tusken squad, Tusken allies gain additional Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Speed for each Tusken ally. Additionally, under these conditions, Tusken Raider will summon another Tusken Raider, both frequently gain Taunt, and both will either revive or be summoned again if they are defeated while there are other remaining Tuskens.\n\nThis new ability tier for Tusken Raider is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_16_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Tusken Raider
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_17_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]First Order TIE Pilot's[-][/c] kit!\n\nFirst Order TIE Pilot has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Keen Eye[-][/c] Unique ability, which boosts First Order allies in Grand Arenas.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked, a full First Order squad, and no Galactic Legend allies, First Order TIE Pilot will gain Advantage when they gain bonus Turn Meter and whenever they gain Foresight they will also grant it to their team. Furthermore under these conditions, whenever allies have Advantage they gain Critical Damage and Speed, when they lose Advantage they recover Health and Protection, and when they do not have Advantage they gain Tenacity.\n\nThis new ability tier for First Order TIE Pilot is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_17_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for First Order TIE Pilot
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_18_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nIn today's Update, [c][F0FF23]Juhani[-][/c] has a new Omicron tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Cathar Resilience[-][/c] Unique ability which boosts certain Unaligned Force User allies in Territory Wars.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked, Juhani will start the battle with Taunt and introduces [c][F0FF23]Redeemed[-][/c], a new buff that will be granted to herself as well as random Light Side and Dark Side Unaligned Force User allies (excluding Empire, First Order, and Galactic Legends). Redeemed units gain Speed, assist and dispel debuffs on other Redeemed allies, and gain Turn Meter when other Redeemed allies are damaged.\n\nThis new ability tier for Juhani is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_18_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Juhani
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_CASSIAN_ANDOR_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Cassian Andor's[-][/c] kit! Cassian has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Groundwork[-][/c] Unique ability, which disguises him as an enemy unit in Territory Battles. While disguised, Cassian retains his Unique ability and is considered a member of Rogue One, but will also inherit the kit of the unit he is posing as. Additionally, whenever Cassian uses an ability, he gains Turn Meter for each debuffed enemy, and whenever he uses a Special ability, he inflicts Ability Block, Buff Immunity, Healing Immunity, and Defense Down, and K-2SO is called to assist.\n\nThis new ability tier for Cassian Andor is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_CASSIAN_ANDOR_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Cassian Andor
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_DARTH_TRAYA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Darth Traya's[-][/c] Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Lord of Betrayal[-][/c] in the Grand Arenas game mode!\n\nWith this upgrade, Sith allies will gain Critical Damage, Max Health, and Offense both at the start of battle as well as whenever Traya dispels a debuff from them. Additionally, Darth Nihilus, Darth Sion, and Darth Talon will refresh their cooldowns the first time they start falling too low on health. This allows them to quickly storm back into the battle with Talon starting her Dark Frenzy, Nihilus lashing out an Annihilate, or Sion reinforcing himself with Hatred.\n\nThis new ability tier for Darth Traya is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_DARTH_TRAYA_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Darth Traya
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_DROIDEKA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Droideka's[-][/c] Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Deflector Shield Generator[-][/c] in the Territory Wars game mode! Admiral Trench assembling the Separatist leaders has inspired General Grievous to power up his droids for battle.\n\nWith this upgrade, Droideka starts the battle with damage immunity and will gain charge for ally turns in addition to enemy turns. When an ally is marked (as Grievous loves to do to his minions) the leader will gain Turn Meter and Droideka will gain Max Health. The first time Droideka is Marked and defeated while an ally is active, all allies will revive to serve Grievous once again.\n\nThis new ability tier for Droideka is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_DROIDEKA_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Droideka
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_FINN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nIn today's Update, [c][F0FF23]Finn[-][/c] has a new Omicron ability tier added to his [c][F0FF23]Balanced Tactics[-][/c] Leader ability which boosts non-Galactic Legend Resistance allies in Territory Battles.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked, these allies gain additional Max Health and Protection and revive at the start of each encounter. Finn also begins each encounter with Determination and gives allies counter chance and immunity to critical hits while he has this buff. Furthermore, Resistance allies inflict Expose when using a Special ability and when damaging an enemy who has Expose, also deal additional damage to other enemies.\n\nThis new ability tier for Finn is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_FINN_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Finn
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_FULCRUM_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nIn today's Update, [c][F0FF23]Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)[-][/c] has a new Omicron ability tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Perseverance[-][/c] Unique ability which boosts her in Territory Wars.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked, she gains additional stats which are increased significantly if she starts the battle with no allies. Additionally, dispelling debuffs through Perserverance will grant her the opposite buff (if any) as well as Protection Up and Turn Meter for each debuff dispelled this way.\n\nThis new Omicron ability tier for Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum) is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_FULCRUM_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Ahsoka Tano (Fulcrum)
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_GAMORREAN_GUARD_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Gamorrean Guard[-][/c] has received a touchup to their kit! These changes will help him serve as a Hutt Cartel Tank who synergizes with Galactic Legend Jabba the Hutt.\n\nHis new Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Loyal Enforcer[-][/c] grants him additional Max Health for each Hutt Cartel ally. If the leader is Hutt Cartel, Gamorrean Guard can Taunt when an ally falls too low on health, and if Jabba is the leader Gamorrean Guard will also recover health whenever Jabba uses a Special ability.\n\nWhen this ability is fully upgraded with an Omicron, in Territory Battles Gamorrean Guard and his Hutt Cartel allies gain multiple defensive stat boosts and other Hutt Cartel allies will gain Damage Immunity the first time they fall too low on health.\n\nUpgrade your Gamorrean Guard now and protect the Hutt Cartel!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_GAMORREAN_GUARD_TITLE|Gamorrean Guard Kit Touchup 
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_LUMINARA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Luminara Unduli's[-][/c] kit! Luminara has a new Omicron tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Master Healer's Blessing[-][/c] Special ability for the Grand Arena game mode. This upgrade will now provide a Dispel and Tenacity Up to allies, as well as Speed for Luminara. Additionally, the Healing Over Time stacks that this ability grants will now recover Protection when they trigger, provide Critical Avoidance and immunity to Turn Meter reduction while they are present, and if an enemy dispels them Luminara will reduce the cooldown of this ability to get them back up quickly. While longterm players should enjoy the return of Luminara as a plug and play healer to their squads, note that these effects do not work on units that have Protection Up.\n\nThis new ability tier for Luminara Unduli is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_LUMINARA_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Luminara Unduli
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_OMEGA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Omega's[-][/c] kit! Omega has a new Omicron tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Part of the Squad[-][/c] Unique ability, which boosts Bad Batch allies in Territory Battles and should especially help in taking down the pesky Reek.\n\nThis upgrade provides Bad Batch allies with extra sustainability through additional Max Health, Bonus Protection at the start of encounter, and reduced damage from percent Health effects. Omega will also deal damage more times with her Basic ability, bursting through droid battalion stacks and increasing the overall damage output for the team. \n\nThis new ability tier for Omega is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_OMEGA_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Omega
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_POGGLE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Poggle the Lesser’s[-][/c] Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Hive Tactics[-][/c] in the Territory Wars game mode!\n\nWith this upgrade (if all allies are Geonosian) at the start of battle and the first time an ally is summoned, allied Geonosians will gain the new [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Brood[-][/c] buff which increases their damage, survivability, and tenacity. These stats increase for each Geonosian ally, ensuring the swarm stays strong together and is more reliable in battle. Furthermore, this buff also provides a one-time revive aimed to shut down some existing counters that rely on picking a key character off early.\n\nThis new ability tier for Poggle the Lesser is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now!
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_POGGLE_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Poggle the Lesser
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_SAVAGE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds an Omicron ability tier to [c][F0FF23]Savage Opress'[-][/c] kit! Savage has a new Omicron tier added to their [c][F0FF23]Brute[-][/c] Unique ability, which grants him additional Defense, Health, Offense, and Speed in Grand Arenas. Additionally, Savage gains stacks of Resilient Defense and Turn Meter for each debuff on other Sith allies. When Savage is critically hit, he and Sith allies will recover Health and Protection and gain Health Steal, Offense, and Turn Meter.\n\nThis new ability tier for Savage Opress is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_SAVAGE_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Savage Opress
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_VENTRESS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nIn today's Update, [c][F0FF23]Asajj Ventress[-][/c] has a new Omicron ability tier added to her [c][F0FF23]Rampage[-][/c] Unique ability which boosts Nightsister allies in Grand Arenas.\n\nWith the new Omicron ability unlocked, whenever an ally or enemy is defeated Nightsister allies gain Turn Meter and recover Protection. Additionally, these defeats also reset the cooldown of Asajj's Endless Wrath ability which will inflict Healing Immunity and reduce enemy Defense and Max Health (excluding Galactic Legends).\n\nThis new ability tier for Asajj Ventress is available for upgrade with the Omicron material now.
NEWSLETTER_KIT_UPDATE_VENTRESS_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Asajj Ventress
NEWSLETTER_KIX_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe last surviving Clone Trooper and newest member of Captain Ithano’s crew, Kix, is heading to the holotables.\n\nWe've got an unexpected new Pirate joining forces with Captain Ithano and the other Pirate gangs. Wearing decades-old Clone Trooper Phase I armor, Kix, the former medic of General Skywalker’s 501st, brings his skills in healing alongside a ruthless battlefield acumen to the Pirate squads!\n\nThis battle-hardened veteran really packs a punch when it comes to keeping his Pirate pals alive and kicking. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Rapidfire Blast[-][/c], can dispel debuffs while granting Tenacity Up. Each critical hit also provides Health and Protection recovery.\n\nAs a Healer, where Kix really shines is with his incredible medical skills. His [c][F0FF23]Explosive Response[-][/c] Special ability lets him shake off all debuffs and then Steal Health and Protection-style buffs from the enemy to share with allies. If the target is Sith, he'll even increase their cooldowns, because why not make it extra difficult?\n\nThe headliner ability is Kix's [c][F0FF23]Emergency Medpac[-][/c]. This Special ability can revive a fallen Pirate ally at 50% health and protection, granting them Taunt if they are a tank or Stealth otherwise. On top of that, Pirate allies recover Health and Protection! The revive shenanigans only get crazier from there depending on Kix's Profit stacks, including granting Damage Immunity if his Profit is high enough.\n\nHis Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Republic Medic Corps[-][/c], is an entire toolkit of support wizardry. Kix gets massive speed boosts for injured Pirates, Stealths himself when damaged, and provides all sorts of escalating bonuses like bonus Protection, turn meter gain, offense boosts, and even revive prevention if he has enough profit stacks!\n\nUpgrade this with the Omicron ability and Kix becomes an absolute terror in Territory Wars. Revived allies get bonus turns, cooldown resets, and either Taunt or Stealth. If allies stay dead, the team gets stacking stat boosts. \n\nThis grizzled clone is the ultimate Pirate life insurance policy. Earn Kix in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TROUBLE ON THE HORIZON III"[-][/c] Marquee event as the Pirates continue to assemble their fearsome crew! Kix is also part of the second batch of requirements for Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka (which is now in the Journey Guide), so make sure you're ready for his release at the end of the Era.
NEWSLETTER_KIX_TITLE|Clone Wars Tested. Ithano Approved.
NEWSLETTER_KLEYA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Kleya[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nAs partner to Luthen Rael for most of her life, Kleya Marki has become an instrumental part of turning the rebellion into a Rebel Alliance. Using a secret fractal radio in the back of Luthen’s antiquities shop she coordinated Rebel cells and agents for years right under the Empire’s noses.\n\nKleya introduces a new mechanic used by both the Rebels and ISB in this Era: [c][F0FF23]Undermine[-][/c]. Undermine is a blue Status Effect that gives the affected unit +25 Speed, -25% Critical Avoidance and Critical Chance, and the inability to gain bonus Turn Meter. Additional effects triggered off Undermine are sprinkled throughout all the kits for the Era of Andor.\n\nKleya’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]What Revolution Looks Like[-][/c], shows exactly how deadly she is with a blaster, always critically hitting if all of her allies are Rebel Fighters, and dealing even more damage to Undermined enemies. She can inflict Undermine via her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Know What I Want[-][/c], as well as call allies to assist, dealing even more damage to the enemy. [c][F0FF23]This Is Do or Die[-][/c], her second Special ability, deals damage to all enemies as well as Burning them. Additionally, there is an effect with your allied Luthen Rael that has a great chance of snatching victory from the jaws of defeat via the new buff [c][F0FF23]Rebel Network[-][/c].\n\nHer Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]I Don’t Have Lately, I Have Always[-][/c], gives Kleya bonuses when Undermined enemies inflict debuffs on her, and she can’t be targeted if there is an active allied Luthen Rael. With her Omicron ability in 3v3 Grand Arenas, Kleya borrows the Axis and Curator effects that were first seen on Luthen, with some minor modifications. Pulling off the effect involving an allied Luthen Rael and Kleya’s Special ability This Is Do or Die becomes much easier as Kleya gets the cooldown reset and a bonus turn when the conditions are right.\n\nUnlock Kleya in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]THE GALLERY OF SECRETS[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Kleya is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Cassian Andor (Undercover). 
NEWSLETTER_KLEYA_TITLE|Cautious Kleya
NEWSLETTER_KNEESAA_DARK_DESC|For a limited time, Princess Kneesaa has been added to Dark Side Battle nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nDark Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 08/19/2023 through 08/22/2023.
NEWSLETTER_KNEESAA_DARK_TITLE|Princess Kneesaa is available on Dark Side Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_KNEESAA_FLEET_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Princess Kneesaa[/b] has been added to [b]Hard Fleet Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Ship Energy.\n\nHard Fleet Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 10/20/2023 through 10/23/2023.
NEWSLETTER_KNEESAA_FLEET_TITLE|Princess Kneesaa is available on Hard Fleet Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_KRAYT_DRAGON_HUNT_DESC|Prepare yourselves, Holotable Heroes.\n\nSharpen your gaderffii, arm your whistling birds, and prime your thermal detonators! It's time to take on the fearsome, legendary leviathan of the Tatooine wastes in the newest raid to come to the holotables, the [c][F0FF23]Krayt Dragon Hunt[-][/c]. Inspired by its appearance in the second season of The Mandalorian, the [c][F0FF23]Krayt Dragon[-][/c] is a formidable foe that will assail your squads with its [c][F0FF23]Corrosive Venom Spray[-][/c], grind them down in its [c][F0FF23]Crushing Maw[-][/c], and even swallow them whole. Assemble your best squads of Hutt Cartel, Mandalorians, Tuskens, Jawas, and Old Republic characters as you and your guild work together to make the sands of Tatooine safer for those who call them home.\n\nTo accompany this raid's release, we have also reworked how guilds interact with raids. We've consolidated all [c][F0FF23]Raid Ticket[-][/c] currencies into one, and guilds now run one raid at a time, with rewards granted by each individual raid increased significantly to compensate. You'll no longer compete with your guild members for raid rewards but will work together to earn raid points for a collective reward at the end of the raid. In the Krayt Dragon Hunt, you'll also earn personal rewards as you earn points for your guild, so make sure to get those attempts in!\n\nThe Krayt Dragon Hunt is also the first raid to use our new system of [c][F0FF23]Difficulty Modifiers[-][/c], so players can take on a challenge appropriate to their squad's power level, whether that be Gear X or Relic 8. To celebrate the raid's release, we've also completely filled the coffers of every guild with the new, consolidated Raid Ticket currency, so jump into the new raid system and start earning rewards right away!
NEWSLETTER_KRAYT_DRAGON_HUNT_TITLE|Let the Hunt Begin
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_AND_DEATH_TROOPER_DESC|Two new characters have arrived, DIRECTOR KRENNIC and the DEATH TROOPER! These powerful Imperial characters have great synergy together and are specialized in taking out Rebels.\n\nDirector Krennic is a potent support character that uses powerful debuffs against his foes, including the all-new debuff STAGGER! This debuff is inflicted using his DEATH TROOPER ASSAULT ability, and removes 100% turn meter when the Staggered enemy takes damage. When Director Krennic uses his EXPERIMENTAL WEAPONRY ability, he will inflict a different type of debuff on each type of character, such as stunning Attackers, inflicting ability block on Healers, and placing Buff Immunity on Tanks.\n\nDeath Trooper is a powerful attacker and the perfect addition to a squad with Director Krennic in it. Whenever the Death Trooper scores a critical hit, he and Director Krennic recover Health. The DEATH TROOPER'S GRENADE ability removes all buffs from enemies and inflicts healing immunity on them, punishing squads that rely on buffs. TERMINATE is the Death Trooper’s most powerful ability, guaranteeing a critical hit if the enemy has any debuffs on them and making them unable to be revived if defeated by it once upgraded.\n\nUnlock both of these powerful new units in the all-new SPECIAL OPERATIONS Marquee Event!
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_AND_DEATH_TROOPER_TITLE|NEW CHARACTERS - Director Krennic and Death Trooper
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_EVENT_DESC|Get ready to earn shards for Director Krennic and one of his Death Troopers in an all-new limited time event!\n\nThroughout this four phase event, you will have the chance to play with Director Krennic and his Death Trooper, and later battle against them. If you manage to defeat Krennic and his Death Troopers, you will be rewarded with a chance to unlock them both!\n\nThese Special Operation events each have multiple tiers of difficulty and will be available starting at Level 20. These events can only be completed once.
NEWSLETTER_KRENNIC_EVENT_TITLE|Special Operations Event
NEWSLETTER_KRRSANTAN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Krrsantan[-][/c], the vicious Wookiee warrior, is coming to the holotables!\n\nKrrsantan is a Bounty Hunter Tank who specializes in protecting his Hutt Cartel allies. His Special ability [c][F0FF23]Dismember[-][/c] introduces a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Disarm[-][/c]. Disarm reduces a unit's Critical Damage and Offense and inflicts them with Damage Over Time whenever they use a Basic ability. Hutt Cartel allies stack Offense when critically hit through his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Formidable Ferocity[-][/c], and Krrsantan can gain Taunt and recover Health and Protection through his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Ferocious Fusillade[-][/c].\n\nHis Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Champion of the Fighting Pits[-][/c], grants him additional Defense and Max Health, along with Health and Protection recovery when he loses Taunt. If all allies are Hutt Cartel, he also Taunts at the beginning of the encounter and will revive at the end of the allied Leader's turn the first time he is defeated. The Omicron for this ability focuses on Grand Arenas where he gains additional Max Protection and, if all allies are Hutt Cartel, he is immune to Ability Block and cooldown increase.\n\nAdd Krrsantan to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “ONE INFAMOUS WOOKIEE” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_KRRSANTAN_TITLE|Mercenary, Bounty Hunter, Champion
NEWSLETTER_KUIIL_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nOne of the Galaxy’s most mechanically-inclined ugnaughts, [c][F0FF23]Kuiil[-][/c], is making his way to the holotables! Although Kuiil had worked for years to escape Imperial servitude to find solace on Arvala-7, fate came calling with other plans. Soon Kuiil found himself rescuing a Mandalorian, reprogramming a menacing IG unit, and protecting an adorable, tiny green creature.\n\nKuiil’s Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Have Spoken[-][/c], introduces the new [c][F0FF23]Mechanic’s Savvy[-][/c] buff, which works with Scoundrels and Droids. Scoundrels will benefit from increased Critical Damage perks, while Light Side Droids receive increased Offense and revive capabilities. One Droid in particular, IG-11, will help Kuiil during battle by ensuring he can’t be critically hit or Stunned while they stand together in arms.\n\nAdding Kuiil to your collection of heroes is easier than facing off with a feral blurrg. For the first time ever, you’ll be able to unlock a new character by heading over to the Galactic Challenges.
NEWSLETTER_KUIIL_TITLE|I Have Spoken
NEWSLETTER_KYLE_KATARN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Rebel Fighter and reluctant Jedi, [c][F0FF23]Kyle Katarn[-][/c], joins the holotables! Kyle Katarn always felt a connection to the Force during his time working as a covert Rebel agent. It took many years for Kyle to realize he was force-sensitive and, after facing down the Sith himself, he finally accepted his destiny of becoming a Jedi Knight. During battle, Kyle Katarn builds up his [c][F0FF23]Force Connection[-][/c] to gain a new buff, [c][F0FF23]Jedi Knight[-][/c], which grants his abilities additional effects and his allies increased Offense and Defense.\n\nKyle Katarn works well with Rebel Fighters or Jedi squads, and excels when used in Territory Battles. In this mode, his new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Force Influence[-][/c], which stops the enemy from counterattacking, assisting, or gaining buffs, can't be resisted.\n\nWhile Kyle Katarn is not a leader himself, his unique, [c][F0FF23]Blue Milk Run[-][/c], powers up his Rebel Fighter allies and increase their Offense when they attack out of turn. While in Territory Battles, these bonuses and the bonuses from Jedi Knight are also extended to Jedi allies.\n\nConfront the dark side and earn shards of Kyle Katarn in the all new Marquee event, Dark Forces!
NEWSLETTER_KYLE_KATARN_TITLE|This Should Be A Total Blue Milk Run
NEWSLETTER_KYLO_REN_UNIT_PROMO_DESC|Dominate the hologames with this First Order attacker character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Kylo's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_KYLO_REN_UNIT_PROMO_TITLE|Kylo Ren - Learn More
NEWSLETTER_LANDO_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nShards for Lando Calrissian can now be obtained from Cantina Battles 1-E and 5-F.\n\nWe hope you all enjoy another way to collect Shards for Lando Calrissian!
NEWSLETTER_LANDO_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|Lando Calrissian in Cantina Battles
NEWSLETTER_LANDO_L3_DESC|To celebrate the release of the new film, Solo: A Star Wars Story, Young Lando Calrissian, L3-37 and Lando's Millennium Falcon join Young Han Solo, Vandor Chewbacca and Qi'ra on the Holotables! Power up these new units and complete the new Solo team.\n\nRounding out the [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] squad, Young Lando Calrissian and L3-37 bring their own spin to hustling the holotables. Young Lando deals more damage with his basic attack for each [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] ally. He can also grant his [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] buff to another ally while providing all other [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] allies with Speed Up. L3-37 can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to gain stacking Max Health from her basic attack and can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to grant health and protection to Scoundrel and Droid allies. L3-37 also brings her penchant for [c][F0FF23]Self-Modification[-][/c] to the table and can upgrade her Counter Chance, Critical Avoidance, and Defense over the course of battle.\n\nNot only do these two new Scoundrels make excellent additions to the [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] squad, but they are also the crew for Lando's Millennium Falcon! This Millennium Falcon delivers a devastating new Reinforcement Ability to the holotable – when the Falcon enters combat it gains Critical Damage Up, copies all buffs on all other ships, and takes a turn for each reinforcement previously called! Collect and power up these all new characters in the final set of the Preparation Perfection Marquee event series!
NEWSLETTER_LANDO_L3_TITLE|Young Lando Calrissian, L3-37, and Lando's Millennium Falcon have arrived!
NEWSLETTER_LEIA_ORGANA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGalactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Leia Organa[-][/c] has arrived on the Holotables to lead the Rebellion! Raised as a Princess on the planet Alderaan, Leia would eventually use the cover of being a Senator while being a key member of the Rebel Alliance in their fight against the Empire. Leia found herself as a General in the Rebellion, leading troops in the field more often than from the command center.\n\nLeia excels as a tactical leader and thrives best when used on Offense.
