Her Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Righteous Retribution[-][/c] and Special abilities [c][F0FF23]Rebel Ambush[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Tactical Offensive[-][/c] provide differing effects based on the target enemy’s role, and Tactical Offensive sets up for key big hits especially when used with Captain Drogan. These abilities also introduced [c][F0FF23]Ambush[-][/c] stacks to reduce Speed and eventually become [c][F0FF23]Ambushed[-][/c] to disabled enemy Protection and Protection effects!\n\nHer Leader ability [c][F0FF23]I Know[-][/c] leans into her insightful leadership and control of the battlefield. Out of turn attacks from enemies do less damage and stack Mastery for non-Scoundrel Rebel allies, and cooldown manipulation is controlled to keep enemies from gaining an advantage. In addition to strong synergy with Burning, this ability also provides [c][F0FF23]Second Wind[-][/c] to keep a non-Scoundrel Rebel ally from being defeated when they lose Protection the first time.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Forever our Princess[-][/c] rings true as her Unique ability, which highlights her identity as a key target for enemies to take out, a feat not so easily accomplished. When she is not damaged, she gains [c][F0FF23]Fearless[-][/c], which not only fuels her Ultimate ability but also stacks her Max Health and reduces enemy Mastery. Speaking of her Ultimate, [c][F0FF23]These are my Friends[-][/c] introduces Fracturing the entire enemy squad, and if it defeats anyone Rebel allies are revived ready to get back into the action.\n\nObtain Leia Organa now through the event [c][F0FF23]Rebel With A Cause[-][/c], which can be accessed via the Journey Guide!
NEWSLETTER_LEIA_ORGANA_TITLE|Somebody Has To Save Our Skins
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_80_DESC|Greetings!\n\nAre you once again ready to make your heroes stronger, faster and smarter than ever before? Let the training begin - the maximum level is being raised to level 80!\n\nHave thoughts about the level cap increase? Share them in the forums.\n\nStart training today to be the first player to reach level 80 and dominate the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_80_TITLE|Level Cap Increase to 80
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_85_DESC|Greetings!\n\nAre you once again ready to make your heroes stronger, faster and smarter than ever before? Let the training begin - the maximum level is being raised to LEVEL 85!\n\nStart training today to be the first player to reach level 85 and dominate the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_85_TITLE|Level Cap Increase to 85
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_DESC|Greetings!\n\nAre you ready to make your heroes stronger, faster and smarter than ever before? Let the training begin - the maximum level is being raised to level 70!\n\nHave thoughts about the level cap increase? Share them in the forums.\n\nStart training today to be the first player to reach level 70 and dominate the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_LEVEL_CAP_INCREASE_TITLE|Level Cap Increase
NEWSLETTER_LEVIATHAN_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes,\n\nBefore his capture and subsequent memory-wipe by the Jedi Council of the Old Republic, Darth Revan led a powerful Sith Empire fleet from his flagship, [c][F0FF23]Leviathan[-][/c]. When the situation would warrant it, Darth Revan himself would lead boarding parties of Sith soldiers onto enemy capital ships while his squadrons engaged the enemy on the battlefield. His goal with these boarding actions was simple: cripple the enemy ship from within and lead his soldiers to a final showdown on the enemy’s bridge, wresting control of it and adding its firepower to his own fleet.\n\nWith the Raddus we had you destroying the enemy’s capital ship at the expense of your own. With Executor and Profundity, we allowed you to keep your capital ship while removing the enemy’s from the battlefield. Leviathan brings this escalation to the logical conclusion. What’s better than destroying the enemy capital ship? Taking it for yourself! Leviathan’s abilities will have you progressively taking over the enemy capital ship by first using [c][F0FF23]Sabotage the Hangars[-][/c] to destroy their next reinforcement, then using [c][F0FF23]Sabotage the Engines[-][/c] to slow it down, then finally using [c][F0FF23]Seize the Bridge[-][/c] to take full control of the ship for yourself (except for its Ultimate ability and their remaining reinforcements).\n\nAchieve dominance on the Holotables by adding Leviathan to your ships roster through the all new Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event!
NEWSLETTER_LEVIATHAN_TITLE|Sith Happens
NEWSLETTER_LOBOT_UPDATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Lobot[-][/c] has received a rework to his kit! He will now have increased synergy with Light Side Droid allies when under a Light Side Droid Leader.\n\nThe following changes have been made to his abilities:\n\n- "[c][F0FF23]Calculated Aggression[-][/c]" Basic ability now has a 100% Defense Down chance (previously 80%) and Light Droid allies gain Defense Up if the ally in the Leader slot is a Light Side Droid. If the enemy already had Defense Down, inflict Target Lock, and if they were already Target Locked, Lobot gains Foresight.\n\n- "[c][F0FF23]Optimize[-][/c]" The text has been updated to reflect the functionality (no gameplay changes were made)\n\n- "[c][F0FF23]Lobot-tech Headgear[-][/c]" The text has been updated to reflect the functionality and the name has been changed (no gameplay changes were made)\n\n- "[c][F0FF23]Parallel Processing[-][/c]" Unique ability now gives an additional random Light Side Droid ally Foresight whenever one gains Foresight. Light Side Droid allies gain increased Critical Damage and Potency when debuffs are dispelled on them and whenever bonus Turn Meter is gained, Lobot gains Speed Up. While Lobot has Speed Up he has increased Critical Chance and removes Turn Meter when he uses his Basic ability.\n\n- NEW: "[c][F0FF23]Cloud Computing[-][/c]" An additional Unique ability has been added to Lobot. This ability provides Lobot with the Droid tag when under a Light Side Droid Leader and inflicts Target Lock on enemies that inflict debuffs on Light Side Droid allies. Using Basic abilities against Target Locked enemies will call Lobot to assist and Light Side Droid allies with Foresight have increased Critical Chance and can inflict Speed Down.
NEWSLETTER_LOBOT_UPDATE_TITLE|Lobot Rework
NEWSLETTER_LOGIN_CALENDAR_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Title Update brings a number of changes to Galaxy of Heroes! One of the first things you will notice is an update to something you see everyday when you login to the game, the [c][F0FF23]Login Calendar[-][/c]! We have reworked the Login Calendar with a new look and now additional calendars can be activated for extra daily rewards. These Login Calendars can be free or purchasable and may coincide with special occasions or monthly themes.\n\nYou can activate multiple at a time and gather rewards from each calendar every day. Don’t forget to login each day to collect your rewards!\n\nCheck out the other newsletters for the rest of the changes that were released with this Title Update.
NEWSLETTER_LOGIN_CALENDAR_TITLE|Title Update - Login Calendars
NEWSLETTER_LORD_OF_HUNGER_DESC|Introducing the "Lord of Hunger", a 4 part Event! In the first 3 Events, fight alongside Darth Nihilus, the Sith Empire Trooper, and the Sith Assassin. In the final Event, bring your best squad to fight against them.\n\nThe Events unlock at level 20 with four tiers of difficulty at 20, 40, 60, and 80. There are no restrictions on the characters you may put in your squad, so bring your most powerful characters to earn shards for Darth Nihilus, Sith Empire Trooper, and the Sith Assassin.\n\nDo you have what it takes to defeat The Lord of Hunger and add him to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_LORD_OF_HUNGER_TITLE|"Lord of Hunger" Event
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGalactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Lord Vader[-][/c] marches onto the Holotables! Having purged the weakness of Anakin Skywalker, the former Jedi is now the newest Lord of the Sith and apprentice to the vile Darth Sidious.\n\nRising from the ashes of the Republic, Lord Vader will provide the Empire faction with a dedicated Galactic Legend. With his anger fueling his attacks, Lord Vader is not to be underestimated. His Ultimate allows him to gain additional effects, ensures that enemies defeated during Lord Vader's turn can't be revived, and makes him immune to Ability Block.\n\nIn addition to increasingly more damaging attacks and massive synergy with both Empire and Dark Side Unaligned Force Users, Lord Vader can deal damage to all enemies while applying Daze and Damage Over Time. Lord Vader's attacks can't be evaded and he is immune to Turn Meter manipulation, all of which is just the beginning of his extensive and powerful kit. Cue the heavy breathing!\n\nObtain Lord Vader now through the all-new [c][F0FF23]Hero’s Fall[-][/c] event, which can be accessed via the Journey Guide. While it is the same structure as Jedi Master Kenobi’s Galactic Legend event, we feel the title “Hero's Fall” is only fitting for this event in contrast to the Hero's Journey events in our game.
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_REQUIREMENTS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nGalactic Legend [c][F0FF23]Lord Vader[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! The first group of requirements to unlock Lord Vader's event have been added to the Journey Guide.\n\nLord Vader Requirements Group 1:\n\nHunter - Relic 5\nTech - Relic 5\nWrecker - Relic 5\nTusken Raider - Relic 5\nPadmé Amidala - Relic 8\n\nLord Vader Requirements Group 3 Sneak Peak:\n\nGeneral Skywalker - Relic 8
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_REQUIREMENTS_TITLE|Galactic Legend Lord Vader's 1st Requirements Added To The Journey Guide
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_TITLE|Lord Vader... Rise
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_ULTIMATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWith the Galactic Legend Lord Vader getting his retinue of Dark Side Clones, we are augmenting the way he gains Ultimate Charge.\n\nUntil now when debuffed Dark Side allies received damage Lord Vader gained 2% Ultimate Charge, increased to 3% if that ally was an Unaligned Force User.\n\nWith this update when debuffed Dark Side allies receive damage Lord Vader gains 2% Ultimate Charge, increased to 3% if that ally was an Unaligned Force User or Dark Side Clone Trooper when all other allies were Dark Side Clone Troopers at the start of battle.\n\nThis adjustment does not impact Lord Vader with his original units and greatly improves Lord Vader’s performance with the new Dark Side Clone Troopers. Go forth and Execute Order 66!
NEWSLETTER_LORD_VADER_ULTIMATE_TITLE|Lord Vader Ultimate Charge Addition
NEWSLETTER_LUKE_FLASH_EVENT_DESC|The month of May sees the introduction of our new Flash Events! Unlike other events, Flash Events only last one to four hours in each instance and repeat several times a day, so be sure to catch them when they launch! Flash Events difficulty and rewards are based off your account level. All initial runs of a Flash Event have more generous rewards, so be sure to participate early and often!\n\nOur first Flash Event takes you to the harsh desert planet of Tatooine. This lawless world holds many dangers and mysteries, especially for moisture farmers. To participate in this multi-tiered event, task Luke Skywalker with inspecting the perimeter of the farm as you join forces with Jawas to square off against marauding Tusken Raiders.
NEWSLETTER_LUKE_FLASH_EVENT_TITLE|NEW Flash Events!
NEWSLETTER_LUTHEN_RAEL_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Luthen Rael[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nThe mysterious runner of various spy networks and excellent monologue speaker, Luthen dedicated himself to the Rebellion despite knowing he would not see it fulfilled. Working with Mon Mothma, Saw Gerrera, and eventually recruiting Cassion Andor to the Alliance, he allied with many people but would also sacrifice others for his belief in the long term necessity for the fall of the Empire.\n\nDeeply involved with the Rebellion in multiple ways, Luthen will adapt to the situation he is in. If Saw Gerrera is the Leader, Luthen will gain the Axis effect. Otherwise Luthen gains the Curator effect to reinforce Rebels such as Mon Mothma’s squad. As [c][F0FF23]Axis[-][/c], Luthen acts much more offensively, while as [c][F0FF23]Curator[-][/c] he focuses more on keeping his allies alive and supported.\n\nLuthen summons a Rebel Commander to keep himself hidden, however his interaction with this summon also depends on which effect he has. As Axis, this summon becomes an Expendable Asset that is marked and benefits allies when defeated. As Curator, the summon is instead supported and prioritized being kept alive.\n\nWith Omicron upgrades in the Grand Arenas game mode, his Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Tools of my Enemy[-][/c] provides him with Speed and reduces his enemy’s Defense, his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]What Do I Sacrifice?[-][/c], increases ally Offense and provides a way to ignore Taunt, and his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Dreams With Ghosts[-][/c], increases crucial stats for the team.\n\nUnlock Luthen Rael in the upcoming Conquest events!
NEWSLETTER_LUTHEN_RAEL_TITLE|Keepin’ It Rael 
NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nThe daily login and brand new character for March is the Magmatrooper from Star Wars Battlefront! Log in each day this month in order to obtain enough Shards to unlock him.\n\nBe sure to play with your sound on when you have the Magmatrooper in your squad to hear the sound of his Thermal Imploder ability!
NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|Daily Login Character for March: Magmatrooper
NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_SHIPMENT_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nThe Magmatrooper from Star Wars Battlefront is now available in Galatic War Shipments! We hope you all enjoy another way to collect Shards for Magmatrooper!
NEWSLETTER_MAGMATROOPER_SHIPMENT_TITLE|Magmatrooper in Galatic War Shipments
NEWSLETTER_MANDALORE_TB_DESC|This is the way Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe are back continuing to explore the galactic map in the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle, discovering a new hyperspace route to [c][F0FF23]Mandalore[-][/c], the home planet of the Mandalorians that was brought under Imperial control shortly after the Empire’s inception.\n\nMandalore is home to heroes from all sides of the conflict, most notably Bo-Katan Kryze, Sabine Wren, and Din Djarin (aka the Mandalorian). The Mandalorian Clans form the backbone of their culture. The head of Clan Kryze, Bo-Katan, ruled Mandalore until she was overthrown by Gar Saxon of Clan Saxon who pledged the planet’s loyalty to the Galactic Empire.\n\nUnlock Mandalore via the [c][F0FF23]Tatooine Special Mission[-][/c] requiring Relic 7 Bo-Katan (Mand’alor) and The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) as you take down one of the fearsome Krayt Dragons on the desert planet. 25 successful completions of the mission in your guild are required to unlock access to Mandalore each Territory Battle.\n\nMandalore itself is home to multiple [c][F0FF23]Combat Missions[-][/c], two of which require Relic 8 characters and the third requiring a squad of Relic 9 characters led by [c][F0FF23]Bo-Katan (Mand’alor)[-][/c]. One of the Relic 8 missions will require [c][F0FF23]Dark Trooper Moff Gideon[-][/c], but beyond the minimum Relic levels there are no other restrictions on who you can bring. A Fleet mission will require a 7-star [c][F0FF23]Gauntlet Starfighter[-][/c].\n\nDetails on the units needed to fill the Operations, as well as the planet’s modifiers and Operation ability can be found in a post on our forums.\n\nMandalore continues our efforts to expand the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle while challenging your collection to bring to life the exciting moments you remember, so strap on your Beskar armor and fight like a Mandalorian. This is the way!
NEWSLETTER_MANDALORE_TB_TITLE|Unite the Clans!
NEWSLETTER_MANDO_BESKAR_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)[-][/c] is heading to the Holotables in spectacular, shiny fashion! From his meek beginnings as a foundling to his transformation into a fully Beskar-clad protector of the Child, Din Djarin embodies the toughness required to survive in the frontier of the Outer Rim. Whether they’re brought in warm or brought in cold, The Mandalorian always delivers his bounty.\n\nEquipped with [c][F0FF23]Whistling Birds[-][/c], The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) is prepared to lead Scoundrels into battle, while adding survivability to the faction by dispelling debuffs and equalizing Protection. His immunity to Ability Block and some help from a little, adorable friend add to an already impressive array at Mando’s disposal.\n\nUnlock The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) by heading to his Hero’s Journey, immediately and permanently available in the Journey Guide now!\n\nThis is the way.
NEWSLETTER_MANDO_BESKAR_TITLE|Heavy Metal Hero
NEWSLETTER_MANDO_DESC|Known to many as [c][F0FF23]the Mandalorian[-][/c], this mysterious man of few words works as a Bounty Hunter at the far edge of the galaxy. No one really knows where he came from or how he's so well-equipped for battle but few question his ability to bring in a target. Whether taking a [c][F0FF23]Swift Shot[-][/c] with his blaster pistol or readying his Amban sniper rifle to instantly disintegrate his enemy, the Mandalorian is always prepared to take on whatever gets in his way.\n\nUnlock the Mandalorian this week in the new event, [c][F0FF23]Tales From The Outer Rim[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_MANDO_TITLE|Bounty Hunting Is A Complicated Profession
NEWSLETTER_MARA_JADE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nOne of the most feared assassins of Legends, [c][F0FF23]Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand[-][/c], is storming the holotables! As the Emperor's Hand, Mara Jade carried out missions some may have viewed as impossible against Rebels and corrupt Imperials alike. Even when tasked with the assassination of Luke Skywalker, Mara Jade never backed down as she pursued her objective with fervor.\n\nAs an Unaligned Force User, Mara Jade strengthens the Empire faction, particularly in Territory Wars where her Omicron ability powers up an Emperor Palpatine-led squad. Utilizing Stealth and Turn Meter to her advantage, Mara Jade also inflicts a bevy of debuffs on enemies, such as Daze, Offense Down, Shock, Stagger, Stun, Tenacity Down, Vulnerable, and - fittingly - Blind on Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker. Like Darth Talon, Mara Jade also gains the [c][F0FF23]Loyal Hand[-][/c] effect, as well as introducing [c][F0FF23]Useful Pawn[-][/c], an effect that gives her increased Critical Chance, Critical Damage, and Offense at the cost of making some of her allies weaker.\n\nAdd this powerful fan-favorite character from Legends to your roster through the all-new “[c][F0FF23]By The Emperor’s Hand[-][/c]” Marquee event, and unleash the ultimate predator on your holotable foes!
NEWSLETTER_MARA_JADE_TITLE|No questions. No regrets.
NEWSLETTER_MARAUDER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Bad Batch’s ship, [c][F0FF23]Marauder[-][/c], is coming to the Holotables! This Omicron-class attack shuttle served as the Bad Batch's personal transport and gunship while the members of Clone Force 99 were hiding from the Republic.\n\nMarauder is a powerful ally in the updated Endurance fleet which also received a rework with today’s update. Marauder helps spread Endurance’s [c][F0FF23]Valor[-][/c] buff to the entire fleet while Clone Trooper ships with Valor gain additional bonuses from Marauder’s abilities.\n\nWith two new unique buffs, [c][F0FF23]The Bad Batch[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Plan 99[-][/c], Marauder will be a tough ship to take down. [c][F0FF23]The Bad Batch[-][/c] increases its Offense and Defense, prevents this ship from being stunned, and reduces damage from percent Health effects. [c][F0FF23]Plan 99[-][/c] grants additional Defense and Tenacity and prevents the ship from being defeated once.\n\nUnlock Marauder during the upcoming Galactic Chase event!
NEWSLETTER_MARAUDER_TITLE|The Marauder's Our Home
NEWSLETTER_MARCH_TW_UPDATE_DESC|It’s time for Geonosians to get some new unique abilities, and for the return of the Clone Troopers in the next Territory War!\n\nGeonosians are hunkering down and bringing out the big guns. The passive, [c][f0ff23]Industry of War[-][/c], will help keep these bugs alive with extra Health and Protection but using Special abilities will decrease the cooldown of [c][f0ff23]Heavy Artillery[-][/c], an ability that can destroy even the strongest opponents with ease.\n\nClone Troopers are back with [c][f0ff23]Army of the Galactic Republic[-][/c], which boosts damage and survivability while also dispelling debuffs on other Clone Trooper allies.\n\nCheck out the forums for more details on these abilities and see you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_MARCH_TW_UPDATE_TITLE|Territory War - Special Abilities Round 2
NEWSLETTER_MARROK_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Marrok[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nThe mysterious former Inquisitor-turned-Mercenary was recruited by Morgan Elsbeth to help in her effort in recovering Grand Admiral Thrawn from his exile in a galaxy far, far away. Not much is known about Marrok, save for the fact that he is a ruthless combatant who wields the traditional double-bladed lightsaber of the Inquisitorius.\n\nMarrok is part of the new Mercenary squad led by Baylan Skoll, however he also has synergy with his fellow Inquisitors. His [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c] Unique ability provides him with stacks of Soldier of Fortune when Mercenaries apply Purge and removes them when it is consumed. His other Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Masked Hunter[-][/c], provides turn meter to Mercenary allies when their debuffs are resisted and Damage Immunity the first time they get low on health. It also gives Mercenaries the ability to apply Purge in order to synergize better with his kit. Furthermore, it allows Marrok to assist Mercenary Special abilities, which gets more potent as he gains more Soldier of Fortune stacks.\n\nWith an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Battles game mode, Marrok earns more Soldier of Fortune stacks at the beginning of battle, prevents revives while he’s active, and Inquisitorius allies become immune to percent Health damage effect (hello, Reva shards!)\n\nUnlock Marrok in the upcoming “LIGHTSABER FOR HIRE II” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Epic Confrontation Baylan Skoll[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_MARROK_TITLE|Marrok the Gathering
NEWSLETTER_MASTER_QUI_GON_CANTINA_062124_DESC|For a limited time, Master Qui-Gon shards have been added to Cantina Battle nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/21/2024 through 06/24/2024.

NEWSLETTER_MASTER_QUI_GON_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Master Qui-Gon[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nThe maverick Jedi and former Padawan to Count Dooku, Qui-Gon Jinn found himself and his own apprentice embroiled in the dispute between the Trade Federation and the planet of Naboo. Stranded on Tatooine, their ship in need of a new hyperdrive, Master Qui-Gon took to the streets of Mos Espa and not only successfully won a new hyperdrive in a bet with a Toydarian junk dealer, but also the freedom of one of his slaves, the Force-sensitive Anakin Skywalker.\n\nAs the final piece of Queen Amidala’s squad, Master Qui-Gon brings in plenty of support to help keep the Queen and her decoy around while Padawan Obi-Wan deals out the damage. He willingly takes a chance to keep his allies safe in Stealth by using Special ability [c][F0FF23]Feel, Use your Instincts[-][/c]. Keeping an eye out for opportunities, his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I’ll Take That Bet[-][/c], rolls a chance cube that can deal Special damage based on his increased Max Health and Queen's Protection, as well as spread Tenacity Up to his allies and Tenacity Down to his enemies if it goes his way (and it somehow tends to go his way….)\n\nHis Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Stay Close to Me[-][/c], provides Queen Amidala with opening Turn Meter and Master Qui-Gon will assist Jedi who attack during his turn, such as his Padawan Obi-Wan. With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, this ability can provide plenty of defensive capabilities for his squad as well as potential additional damage for out of turn attacks from his allies.\n\nMaster Qui-Gon will be unlockable in the upcoming “ALL THE QUEEN’S MEN II” Marquee event which follows our new experimental Marquee structure that[c][E7E7E7] gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. Unlock Master Qui-Gon and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_MASTER_QUI_GON_TITLE|Always Bet on Blue
NEWSLETTER_MAUL_CONQUEST7_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nConquest 7 returns with Maul from Season 7 of The Clone Wars! Turns out, [c][F0FF23]Maul[-][/c] didn’t die when a young Kenobi defeated him. He’s lost the title of Darth since he's no longer a Sith apprentice and thus also lost the Sith tag in-game. Maul is now an Unaligned Force User and will strengthen a number of Dark Side squads, but the real surprise here is that he has the Mandalorian tag! While not a Mandalorian by birth, his kit pays tribute to his time as the usurper of the throne of Mandalore. When Maul is in the Leader slot, he has the [c][F0FF23]Mand'alor[-][/c] status effect until he is defeated and then passes the mantle on to the character that defeated him.\n\nMaul has had a rough time since we last saw him face off against Qui-Gon Jinn and is out for revenge. He has a new status effect called Anguish, which damages himself while boosting his Offense, enabling one of his abilities and providing additional effects. After all these years of rage and anguish, there is one thing Maul hates more than anything else: Kenooooobi! Maul gains extra stacks of Anguish whenever he faces off against any version of Kenobi in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes.\n\nReclaim your rightful place in the galaxy and earn Maul shards in the upcoming Conquest 7!
NEWSLETTER_MAUL_CONQUEST7_TITLE|Maul's Well That Ends Well
NEWSLETTER_MAUL_EVENT_REQUIREMENTS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe have put together this information in order to properly prepare everyone for the upcoming event to unlock Maul (Hate-Fueled).\n\nThe event is four tiers in length. The first two tiers are playable alongside Inquisitor Barriss’ release.\n\nTier 1:\nRequired to unlock -\nStormtrooper Luke (4 stars)\nIG-90 (4 stars)\nYoda & Chewie (4 stars)\nAsajj Ventress (Dark Disciple) (4 stars)\nInquisitor Barriss (4 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use this unit in the tier) -\nStormtrooper Luke (Era Level 45)\n\nRewards enough shards to unlock Maul (Hate-Fueled) at 4 stars.\n\nTier 2:\nRequired to unlock -\nStormtrooper Luke (5 stars)\nIG-90 (5 stars)\nYoda & Chewie (5 stars)\nAsajj Ventress (Dark Disciple) (5 stars)\nInquisitor Barriss (5 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use this unit in the tier)  -\nYoda & Chewie (Era Level 55)\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Maul (Hate-Fueled) to 5 stars.\n\nThe final two tiers are playable alongside Darth Vader (Duel’s End)’s release.\n\nTier 3:\nRequired to unlock -\nStormtrooper Luke (6 stars)\nIG-90 (6 stars)\nYoda & Chewie (6 stars)\nAsajj Ventress (Dark Disciple) (6 stars)\nInquisitor Barriss (6 stars)\nDarth Vader (Duel’s End) (6 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use this unit in the tier)  -\nDarth Vader (Duel’s End) (Era Level 70)\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Maul (Hate-Fueled) to 6 stars.\n\nTier 4:\nRequired to unlock - \nStormtrooper Luke (7 stars, Era Level 85)\nIG-90 (7 stars, Era Level 85)\nYoda & Chewie (7 stars, Era Level 85)\nAsajj Ventress (Dark Disciple) (7 stars, Era Level 85)\nInquisitor Barriss (7 stars, Era Level 85)\nDarth Vader (Duel’s End) (7 stars, Era Level 85)\n\nYou will borrow a 7 star, Era Level 75 Maul (Hate-Fueled) to play this tier with. You will not be using your own Maul (Hate-Fueled).\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Maul (Hate-Fueled) to 7 stars.\n\nNote: These requirements are only for the first run of the Journey Guide Event (the one that takes place during the Era). When Maul (Hate-Fueled)’s Event eventually returns the requirements to play each tier will be significantly higher.
NEWSLETTER_MAUL_EVENT_REQUIREMENTS_TITLE|Maul (Hate-Fueled) Event Requirements
NEWSLETTER_MAUL_HATE_FUELED_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Maul (Hate-Fueled)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nAfter his defeat at the hands of Obi-Wan Kenobi on Naboo, Maul survived through sheer hatred and the dark side of the Force, clinging to life in the depths of Lotho Minor. His body broken and replaced with crude spider-like mechanical legs fashioned from scrap, his mind shattered by years of isolation and torment, Maul became a creature of pure rage and vengeance. Driven by an all-consuming need for revenge against the Jedi who cut him down, this fractured shadow of his former self represents the terrifying power of hatred to sustain life beyond all reason.\n\nMaul's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Fractured Fury[-][/c], inflicts stacking Bleed while building stacks of Edge of Madness, and once per encounter can Fracture an enemy during his turn. His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Relentless Malice[-][/c], deals damage to enemies multiple times while applying more Bleed, and at higher Edge of Madness thresholds deals devastating True damage based on his Max Health. With his Territory Wars Omicron active, this ability deals even more instances of damage and can reset the cooldown of his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Howl of the Broken[-][/c]. This ability calls all Dark Side Attacker allies to assist while inflicting Healing Immunity and Daze on all enemies, and inflicts Fear when Maul has sufficient Edge of Madness stacks. His Territory Wars Omicron spreads Bleed to all enemies, removes Turn Meter, and increases enemy cooldowns.\n\nMaul's first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Hatred Sustains[-][/c], allows him to gain Edge of Madness stacks whenever he takes damage with a chance to gain massive Turn Meter, and prevents him from being instantly defeated. As his Health drops through specific thresholds, he gains cumulative bonuses through Web of Descent stages that increase his Offense, Speed, and Defense while preventing healing above those thresholds. His Territory Wars Omicron starts him with maximum Edge of Madness stacks and increases his chance to gain Turn Meter when damaged. His final ability, [c][F0FF23]Always Remember, I am Fear[-][/c], grants Maul scaling stats based on team composition, converts all his Protection into Max Health, and provides Hatred and Anguish at battle start. His attacks cannot be evaded or countered,  and without allied Galactic Legends present, he prevents revivals of enemies defeated by Dark Side allies while Marking and protecting the healthiest Unaligned Force User ally each turn.\n\nUnlock Maul (Hate-Fueled) in his Journey Guide event starting on January 13th. See the Maul (Hate-Fueled) Event newsletter for the requirements needed to unlock and play the Journey Guide event.
NEWSLETTER_MAUL_HATE_FUELED_TITLE|Speaking in Code

Claim the [b]May the 4th Mega Starter Card[/b], a limited-time bundle filled with powerful character shards, gear, and more—completely free!\n\nDon't miss your chance to immediately boost your strength and unlock legendary characters who will be needed to complete a special event that becomes available once you hit level 20.\n\nVisit the store now to claim your exclusive welcome gift and take your first step towards galactic greatness.\n\nThis limited time bundle is available from 05/01/2025 through 05/17/2025.

NEWSLETTER_MAZ_KANATA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThis year marks the 10th anniversary of The Force Awakens, and we’re celebrating by bringing [c][F0FF23]Maz Kanata[-][/c] to the Holotables!\n\nThe ancient and wise Maz Kanata has lived for over a thousand years, collecting secrets and amassing a fortune through her dealings across the galaxy. With the title of Pirate Queen she brings her formidable skills and experience to lead another crew of Pirates in search of fortune and glory.\n\nMaz's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Steadfast Shot[-][/c], inflicts Healing Immunity and Pinned, which Sith enemies can’t avoid. Her first Special, [c][F0FF23]Eyes Everywhere[-][/c], dispels debuffs from her Pirate allies, and, if she has no Galactic Legend allies*, calls all Pirates to assist, granting them Turn Meter and cooldown reduction.\n\nHer powerful [c][F0FF23]Keeper of Secrets[-][/c] Special ability steals Stealth from enemies, granting it to non-Tank Pirates. If she has no Galactic Legend allies**, it also Exposes enemies and increases cooldowns. With an Omicron upgrade in Grand Arenas without a Galactic Legend ally***, it steals extra Profit, increases enemy cooldowns, and can Deathmark enemies.\n\nMaz's [c][F0FF23]Ancient Wisdom[-][/c] Unique removes the Profit cap on her allies and ensures her opponents have plenty of Profit for her allies to plunder. She then punishes enemies for losing their Profit by reducing their Offense and Speed. When upgraded with an Omicron in Grand Arenas, Maz gains Mastery from Profit and allows Pirate allies to deal True Damage with debuffs.\n\nAs the [c][F0FF23]Pirate Queen[-][/c] Leader, Maz makes her Pirate allies immune to Fear while granting them Foresight and Turn Meter. Her allies can ignore Protection, the squad takes reduced damage, and deals vastly increased damage to Sith enemies. An Omicron in Grand Arenas further empowers the Pirates with massive stat increases, Tenacity from critical hits, and the ability to instantly defeat Deathmarked non-Galactic Legend enemies.\n\nUnlock the ancient and formidable Maz Kanata in the upcoming Conquest events and prepare another Pirate crew for the Order 66 raid!\n\n* “What? Maz and I go way back! Why would she snub me like this?” - Hondo\n** “Again? Maybe she just forgot. She is very old, you know.” - Hondo\n*** “Ok, now I am taking this personally.” - Hondo
NEWSLETTER_MAZ_KANATA_TITLE|It’s Maz, duh!

NEWSLETTER_MERRIN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Merrin[-][/c] is coming to the holotables from the acclaimed Jedi: Fallen Order game! The last known surviving Nightsister on Dathomir, Merrin initially resisted Cal Kestis visiting her planet but eventually helped him defeat the fallen Jedi Master Taron Malicos.\n\nMerrin leans into Plague and revives for Nightsisters, making them a difficult team to try to take out. Her Special ability,[c][F0FF23] Shadow Stride[-][/c], introduces a new status, [c][F0FF23]Magick Stealth[-][/c], which temporarily hides her from the active battle but upon return she dispels her sisters and revives a Nightsister ally. Her first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Last of the Nightsisters[-][/c], gives her a unique playstyle where she does not have any Speed, but rather gains all of her Turn Meter from her sisters being defeated or debuffed. An Omicron upgrade to this ability in the Grand Arenas game mode provides more Turn Meter as well as Plague inflicted to all enemies when she takes a turn.\n\nHer second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Vengeful Bond[-][/c], helps Merrin dispel her allies, provides Protection recovery to Nightsisters when an enemy is damaged, and inflicts Plague on all enemies when a sister is revived.\n\nUnlock Merrin in the new "STORIES OF SURVIVAL III" Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Hero's Journey for Jedi Knight Cal Kestis! Merrin will also be required for a new Special Mission on Dathomir in the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle in an upcoming release.

"Big Z” can hold his own as a reliable tank while shredding the enemy team's defenses!\n\nIn addition to these Scoundrels, T3-M4 has rolled his way onto the holotable! This unique Droid brings his fellow droids some much needed support with healing and some powerful buffs.\n\nT3-M4 and his Marquee event are available exclusively on Android for a limited-time! NEWSLETTER_MOB_ENFORCER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Mob Enforcer[-][/c] has received a rework to her kit! In addition to synergy with Hutt Cartel she will also change roles from a Tank to Support to better reflect her identity. \n\nThe following changes have been made to her abilities:\n\n- "[c][F0FF23]Dirty Fighting[-][/c]" Basic ability now has a 100% Defense Down chance (previously 80%) and inflicts additional debuffs when the ally in the Leader slot is Hutt Cartel and if the target already had Defense Down.\n- "[c][F0FF23]Thermal Detonator[-][/c]" Special ability will now explode all Thermal Detonators on the target before applying one and has a chance to grant her a bonus turn.\n- "[c][F0FF23]Underworld Moxie[-][/c]" Unique ability now grants her additional stat bonuses for each Hutt Cartel, Scoundrel, and Smuggler ally, as well as reducing the cooldown of "Thermal Detonator" when an ally falls below 30% Health.
NEWSLETTER_MOB_ENFORCER_TITLE|Mob Enforcer Rework
NEWSLETTER_MOD_CALIBRATION_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nOur latest Title Update introduces a number of quality of life changes for Mods and a new feature, [c][F0FF23]Mod Calibration[-][/c]! Mod Calibration allows you to tune your Mods even further by transferring slices between stats to create the best Mod for your roster. Each Mk VI Mod can be Calibrated a limited number of times using the new currency, Micro Attenuators, and gives you the chance to improve your good Mods into great Mods.\n\nManaging your Mods is easier than ever! Quickly explore your Mod inventory with new tools for batch upgrading and saving filters for Mods. The new Mod Enhance screen is now a one stop spot to slice, upgrade, sell, and now Calibrate your Mods.\n\nThere are a ton more Quality of Life improvements in this update that help you quickly find your most important Mods. We have highlighted Speed secondaries in the Store and batch manage views, added a new set of filter options, and show the average Slice Quality for each upgraded Mod.\n\nAll of these changes help open up managing Mods to more players while respecting the investment players have had in the system over the years. We hope you enjoy the new and improved Mods experience and would love to hear your feedback on the Official forums!\n\nSee you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_MOD_CALIBRATION_TITLE|Title Update: Mod Calibration and Quality of Life
NEWSLETTER_MODS_6_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n6-D through 6-A mods are available for slicing! Earn Mk II slicing materials from Galactic Challenges and upgrade your 6-E mods all the way up to 6-A! Use the new Mk II Pulse Modulator, Thermal Exchange Unit, Variable Resistor, and Microprocessor to enhance your best mods and bring your top squads to a whole new level. Check out the forums for a list of recipes for crafting 6-D through 6-A mods.\n\nSee you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_MODS_6_TITLE|6-A Mod Slicing Is Now Available!
NEWSLETTER_MODS_UPDATE_DESC|Mods 2.0 is here! Whether you're a Mod expert or you’re confused about where to get started, this update will vastly improve your Mods game. We’ve added many quality of life improvements, upgraded some of less used Mod stats and introduced a new feature, Slicing!\n\nImprove your best Mods even more with Slicing! Slicing increases the rarity or tier of a Mod and boosts their stats. Earn Slicing materials from the all new Stage 9 Mod Battles.\n\nFinding great Mods for each character is quick and simple with the new Mod Recommendations tool. You can also search through your mods or swap them between characters more easily than ever thanks to Mod Loadouts, Advanced Filters, and Sorting.\n\nAll that and so much more! Find the full list of patch notes on the Official Forum
NEWSLETTER_MODS_UPDATE_TITLE|Mods 2.0 is Here!
NEWSLETTER_MOFF_GIDEON_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Moff Gideon[-][/c] has arrived to impose his will on the Holotables! The formidable Moff, once an officer in the Imperial Security Bureau and now wielder of the legendary Mandalorian Darksaber, uses his unique talents to lead Imperial Troopers into battle.\n\nAlways tactical and looking for every advantage, Moff Gideon controls the battlefield by utilizing AoE attacks, Turn Meter manipulation, and applying both Daze and a new debuff that leaves his foes [c][F0FF23]Demoralized[-][/c].\n\nWith the Darksaber in hand, Moff Gideon turns his attention to chasing down the Child. Use his unrelenting focus and astute battlefield knowledge to lead your squad of Imperial Troopers onto the Holotables and bring glory to the Empire by unlocking Moff Gideon in an all-new Marquee event. Long live the Empire!
NEWSLETTER_MOFF_GIDEON_TITLE|Burn Them Out
NEWSLETTER_MON_MOTHMA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Mon Mothma[-][/c], the Chancellor of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, is arriving on the Holotables! Mon Mothma's leadership and fearlessness propelled her to the top of the Empire’s “Most Wanted” list and served as an inspiration to all members of the Rebellion. Ever mindful of the consequences of war, but always willing to stand for justice, Mon Mothma is a welcome addition to Rebel squads as she uses the [c][F0FF23]Field Promotion[-][/c] ability to summon increasingly stronger Rebel units to battle.\n\nThankfully, many Bothans don’t have to die for you to add Mon Mothma to your band of Rebels. You can obtain this Rebel non-combatant leader by completing the new Marquee Event, [c][F0FF23]The Alliance Chancellor[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_MON_MOTHMA_TITLE|[i]For I Am Not Alone[/i]
NEWSLETTER_MORGAN_ELSBETH_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Morgan Elsbeth[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nOne of the few remaining Nightsisters after they were wiped out by the Separatists, Morgan sought revenge for her people. A skilled combatant with cunning ambition, she was a key ally for Grand Admiral Thrawn and led the search that would eventually find him stranded on Peridea. For the Empire, but even more so for Dathomir, she dedicated her life to give her people a second chance and Thrawn a way to escape.\n\nMorgan comes in as another Tank for Nightsisters, especially setting the stage for a new team to be led by the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Great Mothers[-][/c]. Her first Special ability [c][F0FF23]My Loyalty, My Life[-][/c] dispels all buffs on all enemies, recovers Health and Protection for Nightsister allies. If Morgan is Taunting, this ability also grants them Turn Meter and Tenacity Up. [c][F0FF23]Let None Pass[-][/c], her second Special, deals damage and calls all Nightsister allies to assist. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, it also reduces Nightsister ally cooldowns, deals more damage, lays down debuffs on the target, and buffs her allies.\n\nHer Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Preordained Destiny[-][/c] dishes out a ton of stats for her Nightsister allies, especially for Nightsisters gaining Foresight or Stealth. Morgan also protects her allies by taunting as well as through further boosts to their stats if she should fall. To keep this new Nightsister squad unique and not disrupt the existing powerful Talzin led Nightsisters, Morgan prevents revives.\n\nUnlock Morgan Elsbeth in the upcoming “VEIL OF SHADOWS I” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming Epic Confrontation for [c][E7E7E7]Baylan Skoll[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_MORGAN_ELSBETH_TITLE|Gimme Morgan
NEWSLETTER_NEST_DESC|To celebrate the release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Enfys Nest has arrived to the holotables! Use this powerful marauder to crush your enemies and scatter their squads.\n\nEnfys Nest is a new, powerful attacker that will bring powerful new offensive capabilities to your PvP squads. Nest has a penchant for using an enemy's defenses against them. Her basic attack, [c][f0ff23]Cut Through[-][/c], dispels all defensive buffs and [c][f0ff23]Sudden Impact[-][/c] will do extra damage if an enemy has any Protection. Always the opportunist, Nest's [c][f0ff23]Kinetite Charge[-][/c] will Daze her enemies and either boost Nest's Turn Meter or drain the enemy's based on their Health totals! Nest is also an elusive enemy, gaining stacking Protection for each hit she endures with her [c][f0ff23]Fighting Instinct[-][/c], while also stacking Critical Chance and Damage to turn the tables. This relentless warrior is an excellent addition to any Scoundrel squad!
NEWSLETTER_NEST_TITLE|Enfys Nest has arrived!
NEWSLETTER_NEW_BAD_BATCH_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes!\n\nA special event to welcome new and returning players to the holotables is going on now.\n\nCelebrate the latest Era release of STAR WARS: The Bad Batch characters with a limited time event. During the event, players can collect the original Clone Force 99 Marquee Event characters to join the holotables: Hunter, Wrecker, Echo, Tech, and Omega.\n\nA bonus login calendar containing freebies is also going to be available for new players to get you started on your journey. This is available to collect in the store starting at level 10 for new accounts.\n\nEvent requirements:\n- To be able to access the login calendar (NEW BAD BATCH EVENT CALENDAR), players must be new installs at the time of the event.\n- Marquee Events will become accessible starting at level 20. New players can access the event by collecting the login calendar for an XP boost.\n- Marquee Events will be available for rewards to all players who do not already have 55+ shards of these heroes.\n\nEvent Start: 3.13.2025 11:00AM Pacific\n\nEvent End: 3.27.2025 11:00AM Pacific\n\n-STAR WARS™: Galaxy of Heroes team
NEWSLETTER_NEW_BAD_BATCH_TITLE|Clone Force 99 - Special Event
NEWSLETTER_NIGHT_TROOPER_DATACRON_DESC|Greetings Holotable Heroes,\n\nAs a first time reward for the 7-star Tier of Night Trooper’s Marquee event, players will earn a one-of-a-kind Datacron at level 9 that targets Night Trooper. There is no other way to get a Night Trooper Datacron in the Unexpected Resurgence Datacron set so make sure to grab it!\n\nThis datacron comes with pre-established stat bonuses, but a player can reroll these to random stat bonuses that are within the Unexpected Resurgence set if they so desire using the same Datacron materials as that set.\n\nWhile players have the ability to dismantle this Datacron, note that this is irreversible and there is no other way to get a Night Trooper Datacron at this time.\n\nAt the end of the lifetime of the Unexpected Resurgence Datacron set, this Datacron will automatically dismantle along with the rest of the set.
NEWSLETTER_NIGHT_TROOPER_DATACRON_TITLE|Night Trooper Exclusive Datacron
NEWSLETTER_NIGHT_TROOPER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nNight Trooper is coming to the Holotables!\n\nNightsister Majik has given the Chimaera’s Imperial Stormtroopers a new lease on life, animating them into persistent foes that are difficult to fully put down. Still clad in the armor they were exiled with (albeit with an abundance of repairs done over the years), these soldiers continue to be fiercely loyal to their commander, Grand Admiral Thrawn.\n\nNight Trooper and the upcoming Death Trooper (Peridea) both work extremely well with the new Imperial Remnant leader Captain Enoch, who is also coming soon. They are also options to use with Nightsisters, especially the Great Mothers. Night Trooper introduces two effects that will be useful for Enoch’s squad: [c][F0FF23]Blight[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Alert[-][/c]. Blight is a new debuff that is removed when a unit fully heals (however they have reduced Health Steal) and will deal damage whenever the unit loses Turn Meter from an enemy. Alert is a new buff that works somewhat as a positive form of Daze by increasing the amount of bonus Turn Meter gained when it’s gained and assisting allies when they use a Special ability.\n\nStack [c][F0FF23]Blight[-][/c] on Night Trooper using their Basic, [c][F0FF23]Shambling Shot[-][/c], then spread it to your target and bring a host of other nasty effects with their second Special, [c][F0FF23]Share My Suffering[-][/c]. Utilize their first Special, [c][F0FF23]March of the Undying[-][/c], to gain Alert. With their Unique, [c][F0FF23]Inevitable End[-][/c], Night Trooper further punishes enemies when they recover Health and has additional synergy with Blight. \n\nUnlock Night Trooper in the upcoming “UNDYING LEGION I” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and grants an [c][E7E7E7]exclusive datacron[-][/c] if your Night Trooper reaches 7*.\n\nUnlock Night Trooper and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_NIGHT_TROOPER_TITLE|Abra-Cadaver!
NEWSLETTER_NIGHTSISTER_EVENTS_DESC|This month three new Nightsister allies will join their dark sisters on the Holotable. Along with these new additions, the existing Nightsisters have received a faction rework.\n\nMother Talzin is a powerful Nightsister witch that brings new abilities to her coven. Her ability, [c][F0FF23]DARK MAGICK[-][/c], inflicts the new unique stacking debuff, [c][F0FF23]PLAGUE[-][/c]. This new debuff can only be removed with healing and inflicts percent health damage while preventing enemies from dispelling debuffs!\n\nAdditionally, the new Nightsister Spirit ability, [c][F0FF23]POSSESSION[-][/c], will dispel all buffs on an enemy and Stun them. The Nightsister Zombie gains Taunt at the end of each of her turns and revives if she is defeated while any other Nightsister allies are active.\n\nMother Talzin will be obtainable in her Marquee event, "The Rituals of Revenge". Players can also find shards of Mother Talzin in the "Defense of Dathomir" event; fight Separatist enemy forces with your Nightsister squad as you defend Dathomir! Finally, take your strongest units in the "Ghosts of Dathomir" event and investigate rumors of the Dathomir undead. In the "Ghosts of Dathomir" event, you can earn shards of the Nightsister Zombie and the Nightsister Spirit.\n\n"Defense of Dathomir" and the "Ghosts of Dathomir" events will be rare, recurring Special Events - so play as much as you can, while you can!
NEWSLETTER_NIGHTSISTER_EVENTS_TITLE|The Call from Beyond - Nightsisters Rise!
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_AND_SITH_DESC|Now is the time of the Sith! Three new members of this order are now available to add to your collection: Darth Nihilus, Sith Assassin, and Sith Empire Trooper.\n\nDarth Nihilus is a powerful support character that buffs his Sith allies and can instantly defeat an enemy after a number of rounds using the ability, ANNIHILATION. The Sith Assassin is able to stealth and uses powerful attacks to stun enemies, while the Sith Empire Trooper is able to taunt and ignores enemy protection when attacking.\n\nAdd these powerful characters to your squad and become truly feared at the holotables.
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_AND_SITH_TITLE|NEW CHARACTERS: Darth Nihilus, Sith Empire Trooper, Sith Assassin
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_TEASER_DESC|Prepare your best squads for the Lord of Hunger Event, coming this month!
NEWSLETTER_NIHILUS_TEASER_TITLE|Darth Nihilus comes to Galaxy of Heroes
NEWSLETTER_NINTH_SISTER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe [c][F0FF23]Ninth Sister[-][/c], formerly a Jedi known as Masana Tide, is coming to the holotables to reinforce the Inquisitorius! Having survived Order 66, Masana became the Ninth Sister after being captured and tortured by the Empire until she cracked. Notably, Ninth Sister earned a permanent distinguishing feature, losing her left eye during a training session with Darth Vader.\n\nLike Second Sister, Ninth Sister interacts with the [c][F0FF23]Purge[-][/c] debuff. She can use it to inflict Damage Over Time on her enemies while granting herself Heal Over Time, adding to her sustainability. Ninth Sister also has special callouts in her kit that make her extra powerful against Jedi enemies. In addition to inflicting debuffs on her foes, Ninth Sister utilizes Taunt to protect her allies, and gains Defense, Max Health, and Tenacity when surrounded by other Empire units.\n\nNinth Sister’s Omicron ability gives her additional utility in Territory Wars, where Empire allies gain Defense and all Inquisitorius allies are immune to Ability Block and Stun.\n\nUnlock Ninth Sister in the all-new [c][F0FF23]Ruthless Efficiency II[-][/c] Marquee event.
NEWSLETTER_NINTH_SISTER_TITLE|Touching the Dark Side
NEWSLETTER_OLD_BEN_KENOBI_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Greetings,\n\nObi-Wan Kenobi (Old Ben) character Shards are now available from Cantina Battles 2-F and 6-B in addition to Chromium Packs. \n\nThere are also two new characters available in Chromium Packs: Chief Chirpa and Magmatrooper.
NEWSLETTER_OLD_BEN_KENOBI_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|Character Announcements
NEWSLETTER_OLD_BOBA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Boba Fett, Scion of Jango[-][/c] is coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! This veteran Bounty Hunter is the first character to have mode specific abilities, like [c][F0FF23]Dangerous Reputation[-][/c], which greatly boosts himself and his squad's effectiveness in Territory Wars. Boba Fett, Scion of Jango uses his [c][F0FF23]Momentum[-][/c] during battle to grant his abilities additional effects and take down enemy squads with ruthless efficiency. You do not want to get between Boba Fett and his quarry.\n\nCan't wait to get your hands on the highly prized Mandalorian armor? Earn shards of Boba Fett, Scion of Jango in the next Conquest event!
NEWSLETTER_OLD_BOBA_TITLE|Let's Just Say They Might Recognize My Face
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_DESC|Greetings,\n\nTo help prepare players for the Guilds and Raids update at the end of this month we are releasing a special limited time event.\n\nThis event will require you to form a squad of 3 from a list of pre-selected characters each day of the week. There will be 3 difficulty levels for each day, rewarding Ability Materials and Credits upon completion. If players can complete the hardest difficulty they will be rewarded with an Omega Ability Material!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV_DESC|Log in every Saturday in November for the Omega Battle Events! Earn rare Ability Material Omega pieces during these limited time events!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV_TITLE|Omega Events Every Saturday in November!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV5_DESC|The Omega Battle Event is this weekend! Please note this event will run for 24 HOURS ONLY.
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_NOV5_TITLE|Omega Ability Material Event - One Day Only!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_REGULAR_SCHEDULE_MESSAGE|Log in every 1st and 3rd weekend of the month for the Omega Battle Events! Earn rare Ability Material Omega pieces during these limited time events!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_REGULAR_SCHEDULE_TITLE|Omega Events are now on a regular schedule!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_BATTLES_TITLE|Omega Ability Material Event
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Omega[-][/c], the enhanced clone from Kamino, has made her way to the holotables to round out the Bad Batch faction. Her interest in Clone Force 99 eventually led to her joining the ragtag bunch...as well as her being the catalyst for an impromptu food fight. Although Omega often felt like a misfit, the Bad Batch embraced her and became the family she never had.\n\nUnder a Bad Batch lead, Omega gains Speed and Offense. When stealthed, she also assists Bad Batch allies when they use a Special ability. Her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Adaptive Learner[-][/c] introduces a new buff and new status effect to the game, [c][F0FF23]Target Practice[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Zeroed In[-][/c]. The buff grants damage bonuses while the status effect allows her to ignore Taunt on enemies affected by Zeroed In. Omega can also inflict Blind and Daze on enemies with her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Disarming Shot[-][/c].\n\nOmega is the piece of the puzzle the Bad Batch didn’t know they needed, but accepted wholeheartedly. On the holotables, she adds some high single-target damage output to an already fun faction. Play the new marquee event to unlock Omega and complete your Bad Batch squad.
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_EVENT_REDEPLOY_DESC|The Omega Battles have returned! Starting this weekend, and for the next 3 weekends, you’ll be able to participate in events to earn the coveted Ability Material Omega.\n\nThe events have been modified some to allow you to bring additional squad members, and your enemies will be a little tougher since your characters have had time to power-up as well!\n\nJump in these events today and earn those rare Omega materials!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_EVENT_REDEPLOY_TITLE|Return of the Omega Battles
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_FUGITIVE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Omega (Fugitive)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nOmega is a female clone of Jango Fett and a member of the Bad Batch. She was captured by the Empire and taken to Mount Tantiss, where dark experiments were taking place. It was here she would eventually escape along with the lurca hound Batcher and the ex-Bad Batch, ex-Imperial, Crosshair. After the escape, the facility found out she had a high M-Count and was the perfect test subject for Project: Necromancer. An incredibly high bounty was put on her capture and return, making her, and subsequently the rest of the Bad Batch, fugitives.\n\nOmega leads an entirely new Bad Batch squad that heavily uses Stealth and introduces Rescue objectives, a way to save an ally from being defeated if you complete the objective in time. [c][F0FF23]Big Sister[-][/c], her first Special ability, provides plenty of sustainability for the squad while her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Our Way Out[-][/c], dishes out buffs and Turn Meter.\n\nHer Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Learn and Watch[-][/c], keeps Stealthed allies protected and rewards focusing an enemy down by providing Target Practice when enemies take consecutive hits. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, enemies will also take damage based on their Max Health for each Target Practice stack present on your allies if they damage an ally while Exposed or with bonus Protection. Her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Odd Little Clone[-][/c], also utilizes Target Practice as her Rescue objective to get her out of Captive and prevent her from being defeated.\n\nUnlock Omega (Fugitive) in the upcoming "[c][E7E7E7]The Cavalry Has Arrived I[-][/c]" Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_FUGITIVE_TITLE|You Can M-Count on Her!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_LIGHT_060324_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Omega Ability Materials[/b] have been added to [b]select Light Side and Dark Side Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nLight Side and Dark Side Hard Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/3/2024 through 06/6/2024.
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_LIGHT_060324_TITLE|Omega Ability Materials are available on select Light Side and Dark Side Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_LIGHT_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Omega Ability Materials[/b] has been added to [b]Hard Light Side Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nHard Light Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 10/20/2023 through 10/23/2023.
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_LIGHT_TITLE|Omega Ability Materials are available on Hard Light Side Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_OMEGA_TITLE|Take a Bow
NEWSLETTER_OMICRON_UPGRADES_DESC|Omicrons that only work in 3v3 or 5v5 Grand Arena Championships now cost 10 Omicron materials instead of 20. Players who already upgraded these abilities will receive 10 Omicron materials refunded to their inbox for each ability.\n\nThe following ability recipes have been updated:\n\n- BT-1 "Homicidal Counterpart" Unique ability\n- 0-0-0 "Specialized in Torture" Special ability\n- Tusken Raider "Strength in Numbers" Unique ability\n- Tusken Chieftain "Nomadic People" Leader ability\n- Doctor Aphra "Rogue Archaeology" Special ability\n- Doctor Aphra "Suspended Doctorate" Leader ability\n- Doctor Aphra "Droid Savant" Unique ability
NEWSLETTER_OMICRON_UPGRADES_TITLE|Update to Certain Omicron Upgrades
NEWSLETTER_OMICRONS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nMode specific abilities are coming to characters in Galaxy of Heroes! New units and some existing characters will have a new final tier added to their abilities that boosts those units to the next level in a specific mode. This new type of ability tier will require a unique material called [c][F0FF23]Omicron[-][/c]. However the effects contained in this tier are restricted to only being active in a specific game mode, like Grand Arena or Territory War. Omicrons are available primarily as rewards from Galactic Challenges, but can also be earned in Conquest and from Cantina nodes.\n\nOmicrons allow users to create multiple diverse metas in the game and give characters interesting effects that are contained to specific game modes. For example Boba Fett, Scion of Jango has effects in his abilities that only activate in Territory War. In that game mode you will see a higher-performing Boba Fett if you have customized him by unlocking his Omicron abilities.\n\nWhile many upcoming characters will have mode specific ability tiers, we will also be adding Omicron tiers to older characters at a slow but steady pace. By adding a new final Omicron tier to an existing ability, we are looking to improve these characters in specific game modes and reignite the excitement they brought to the game when they were first introduced. \n\nCheck out the Official Forums for which characters will be updated and for additional details on mode specific abilities.
NEWSLETTER_OMICRONS_TITLE|New Mode Specific Ability Material: Omicron
NEWSLETTER_ORDER_66_RAID_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nCelebrate 20 years of Revenge of the Sith with the new featured [c][F0FF23]Order 66 raid[-][/c]! Lord Vader storms the Jedi Temple with his Dark Side Clone Troopers, ensnaring Jedi as he goes. \n\nYou and your Guild arrive at the Jedi Temple after Operation Knightfall has commenced and the Jedi are fighting for their lives. Lord Vader has cornered some fleeing Jedi and they will be executed if not saved in time. Surrounded by Dark Side Clone Troopers, players must punch through their wall in order to distract Lord Vader and allow the Jedi an opportunity to run away. Not being able to save all the Jedi could draw Lord Vader’s gaze to you instead. \n\nAllowed characters for this raid include [c][F0FF23]the new Bad Batch squad, Dark Side Clones Troopers with Grand Moff Tarkin[-][/c], certain [c][F0FF23]Jedi Vanguard[-][/c], as well as upcoming [c][F0FF23]Pirates[-][/c]! Additionally, Jedi Master Mace Windu, Jocasta Nu, Kelleran Beq, Grand Moff Tarkin, CC-1119 “Appo”, and Omega (Fugitive) are Hero units that receive extra bonuses, making Jedi Master Mace Windu’s squad and upcoming Pirates perform extremely well. \n\nA new faction tag has been added to your roster to view eligible units.  \n\nHurry to the Jedi Temple!
NEWSLETTER_ORDER_66_RAID_TITLE|Do What Must Be Done, Lord Vader.
NEWSLETTER_OT_CHEWBACCA_DESC|This loveable, shaggy giant has fought in practically every major recent galactic conflict. He is a military strategist, skilled Dejarik player and an expert smuggler, known for his short temper but also his fierce loyalty to his friends. None other than the co-pilot of the Millennium Falcon, Chewbacca - as seen in the Original Trilogy - will be joining the Holotable!\n\nBounty Hunters will be on the lookout for this wanted Wookiee. Earn Chewbacca in a special Bounty Hunter event coming soon!
NEWSLETTER_OT_CHEWBACCA_TITLE|The Mighty Chewbacca
NEWSLETTER_OUTRIDER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nDash Rendar’s ship, the [c][F0FF23]Outrider[-][/c], is docking with the holotables! As a heavily modified YT-2400 light freighter, the Outrider was a top-notch smuggling vessel and (according to Dash himself) almost as famous as the Millennium Falcon.\n\nThe Outrider deals multiple instances of damage with its [c][F0FF23]Illegal Laser Cannons[-][/c] Basic and [c][F0FF23]Concealed Concussion Missiles[-][/c] Special abilities. In addition to damage, the Outrider can inflict enemies with Critical Damage Down and Target Lock, as well as dispel buffs and reduce Defense. Outrider lifts its allies by doling out Health and Protection Recovery, Speed Up, Tenacity Up, and Turn Meter, and dispelling debuffs.\n\nOutrider introduces the new [c][F0FF23]Suprosa Supercomputer[-][/c] effect and the new [c][F0FF23]Data Transmission[-][/c] granted ability, which together provide Rebel allies with powerful bonuses based on their role.\n\nUnlock the Outrider during the upcoming Galactic Chase event to add this ship to your fleet collection!
NEWSLETTER_OUTRIDER_TITLE|Not By Clean Living
NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_OBI_WAN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Padawan Obi-Wan[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nObi-Wan Kenobi's journey to become one of the most famed Jedi across the galaxy started with rebellious acts and more than a few broken rules. Few Jedi Masters wanted to take this headstrong human from Stewjon as a Padawan, but Grand Master Yoda knew of one such individual who could potentially take Obi-Wan's unorthodox behavior and hone it. Qui-Gon Jinn took this charge and under his watchful eye young Obi-Wan learned that sometimes the right words could sway the situation as expertly as a steady blade.\n\nObi-Wan and the upcoming Master Qui-Gon make a strong kernel for the new Queen Amidala squad. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Practiced Aggression[-][/c], synergizes with Amidala’s Heal Over Time buffs by doing more damage for each stack he has. Critical hits synergize with multiple parts of his kit, such as his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Redirected Blast[-][/c], which removes Turn Meter from his target enemy and temporarily gives him a great deal of Speed whenever he critically hits.\n\nHis Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Nobility in Restraint[-][/c], introduces [c][F0FF23]Discipline[-][/c], a new effect that gives him even more Heal Over Time stacks and allows him to ignore Protection. This ability also has him assist Master Qui-Gon whenever he uses an ability, and he will unleash big damage if his Master should fall. With an Omicron upgrade in Conquests, Obi-Wan grants his allies beneficial stats, has a chance to interrupt each enemy turn, and dishes out a variety of buffs and debuffs to assist in completing feats.\n\nPadawan Obi-Wan will be unlockable in the upcoming “ALL THE QUEEN’S MEN I” Marquee event which follows our new experimental Marquee structure that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event. Unlock Padawan Obi-Wan and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_OBI_WAN_LIGHT_DARK_062124_DESC|For a limited time, Padawan Obi-wan Shards have been added to Light Side and Dark Side Battle Hard nodes as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nLight Side and Dark Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/21/2024 through 06/24/2024.
NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_OBI_WAN_LIGHT_DARK_062124_TITLE|Padawan Obi-wan shards are available on Light Side and Dark Side Battle Hard nodes!
NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_OBI_WAN_TITLE|Negotiations Were Short
NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_SABINE_WREN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Padawan Sabine Wren[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nSabine Wren found herself under the tutelage of Ahsoka Tano after the start of the Galactic Civil War, where she was trained as her Padawan Learner. After a falling out, Sabine and Ahsoka went their separate ways but eventually would reunite in an effort to locate Ezra Bridger, who disappeared alongside Grand Admiral Thrawn at the Battle of Lothal.\n\nWhile she works well with her fellow Light Side Mandalorians, Sabine really excels with Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano and brings big damage to that team. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Frantic Strike[-][/c], inflicts Pinned and introduces a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Off Balance[-][/c] that acts as a combination of Expose and Stagger by losing both Health and Turn Meter when damaged by an attack. [c][F0FF23]Fallback Tactic[-][/c], her second Special, has more Critical Damage for each buff and debuff on the target enemy.\n\nThrough her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Sentinel of Lothal[-][/c], Sabine gains Ancestral Resolve while under a Mandalorian leader and Force Connection from her Spectre allies, especially her master, Ahsoka. As Sabine gains more Force Connection, she also ramps up her Critical Damage. With an Omicron upgrade in the Territory Wars game mode, Sabine deals even more damage through Force Connection stacks, Ahsoka uses her Ultimates faster, and Ezra gains Purrgil Migration faster.\n\nThis release also adds the [c][E7E7E7]third batch[-][/c] of Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano requirements to the Journey Guide.\n\nUnlock Padawan Sabine Wren in the upcoming “[c][E7E7E7]LOST AND FOUND I[-][/c]” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event, and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Galactic Legend Ahsoka Tano[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_PADAWAN_SABINE_WREN_TITLE|Say Wren
NEWSLETTER_PADME_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Padmé Amidala, the brave former Queen of Naboo turned tenacious Galactic Senator, is coming to the holotables! During the Clone Wars, Padmé’s quick thinking allowed her and her friends to repeatedly outsmart their enemies.\n\nEnter the Geonosis arena with a squad of Separatists to earn Padmé in the Legendary event, Aggressive Negotiations!
NEWSLETTER_PADME_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|Diplomacy and Danger
NEWSLETTER_PADME_LIVE_DESC|[c][F0FF23]Padmé Amidala[-][/c], the courageous Queen-turned-Senator from Naboo, has arrived on the holotables! Don’t expect her to sit idly by while her planet (and the galaxy) are under attack from a threat far bigger than anyone realizes.\n\nAs a Senator during the Clone Wars, Padmé stayed true to her ideals with risky diplomatic missions for the Galactic Republic. Always willing to do what it took to defend democracy, Padmé could be counted on to dodge assassination attempts, commandeer a speeder, or rescue a Jedi or two.\n\nThis fearless diplomat is also an excellent shot with a blaster when need be. In battle, Padmé leads her Galactic Republic allies by using Protection Up to grant them [c][F0FF23]Courage[-][/c] and deal bonus damage. Take your Separatists into the Geonosis arena in the Aggressive Negotiations Legendary event to earn Padmé.
NEWSLETTER_PADME_LIVE_TITLE|No, I Call It Aggressive Negotiations
NEWSLETTER_PADWAN_OBI_WAN_DATACRON_DESC|Greetings Holotable Heroes,\n\nAs a First Time reward for the 7-star Tier of Padawan Obi-Wan’s Marquee event, players will earn a one-of-a-kind Datacron at level 9 that targets Padawan Obi-Wan. There is no other way to get a Padawan Obi-Wan Datacron in the Together. As One. Datacron set so make sure to grab it!\n\nThis datacron comes with pre-established stat bonuses, but a player can reroll these to random stat bonuses that are within the Together. As One. set if they so desire using the same Datacron materials as that set.\n\nWhile players have the ability to dismantle this Datacron, note that this is irreversible and there is no other way to get a Padawan Obi-Wan Datacron at this time.\n\nAt the end of the lifetime of the Together. As One. Datacron set, this Datacron will automatically dismantle along with the rest of the set.
NEWSLETTER_PADWAN_OBI_WAN_DATACRON_TITLE|Padawan Obi-Wan Exclusive Datacron
NEWSLETTER_PAO_DESC|The daily login character for April is the amphibious Drabata, Pao!\n\nPao has the ability to lower his enemies defense with his Sonic Grenade ability or bolster his allies Turn Meter with his special battle cry Sa’kalla! In addition to Pao’s abilities, he also has his cooldowns reduced each time a Rebel ally uses a basic attack.\n\nLog in daily this month to unlock Pao!
NEWSLETTER_PAO_TITLE|Daily Login Character for April – PAO
NEWSLETTER_PAZ_VIZSLA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Paz Vizsla[-][/c], warrior descendent of House Vizsla and wielder of very large blasters, is coming to the Holotables!\n\nUpholding the honor of both his House and the Creed, Paz Vizsla is a stalwart Mandalorian warrior who protects those around him with determination and heavy firepower.\n\nAs he uses his Basic, [c][F0FF23]Stalwart Barrage[-][/c] and first Special, [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Broadside[-][/c], he builds stacks of [c][F0FF23]Heat[-][/c] which empower his abilities. Once he reaches max stacks of Heat, he instead generates [c][F0FF23]Overheat[-][/c] which further enhances his abilities and can be spent using his second special, [c][F0FF23]Vengeful Incineration[-][/c], to deal extra damage. This combined with his many defensive boosts and synergies with other Mandalorians, especially Light Side Mandalorians via his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Legacy of House Vizsla[-][/c], makes him a formidable fortress to break through.\n\nUnlock Paz Vizsla during the upcoming “DEFENDER OF THE CREED” Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Epic Confrontation for Bo-Katan (Mand'alor)!
NEWSLETTER_PAZ_VIZSLA_TITLE|Paz-ative Reinforcement
NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_FLASH_EVENT_DESC|It's time to rise up in the Phoenix Squadron Flash Event! Earn gear and power up your [c][F0FF23]PHOENIX SQUADRON[-][/c] as you embark on a mission to Lothal to deal a blow to the [c][F0FF23]EMPIRE'S[-][/c] carefully laid plans. But be warned, this [c][F0FF23]REBEL[-][/c] show of force has not gone unnoticed. It's imperative that your Squadron engage in this mission and arise victorious as a looming threat is beginning to close in, keen to ensure that the Rebellion become the architects of their own demise.\n\nThese events come back every three days starting on June 9th and will appear at 10am, 2pm, 6pm, and 9pm (player local time).\n\nThe Rebellion is counting on you!
NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_FLASH_EVENT_TITLE|RISE UP! Phoenix Flash Events
NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_SQUADRON_REBELS_DESC|Phoenix Squadron has arrived!\n\nThroughout the month of March players will be able to partake in events to earn shards of characters from Star Wars Rebels™ such as Chopper, Hera, Kanan, Zeb, Ezra, and Sabine.\n\nParticipate in the first of the Rebels events on March 9th, Supply Sabotage, to unlock Hera and the amazing synergies she brings to the entire Phoenix faction!\n\nBe sure to collect all of the members of Phoenix Squadron this month as you’ll need them to participate in a special Event in April featuring their ships, Ghost and Phantom II.\n\nFor complete details on Phoenix Squadron and their Events be sure to check out the blog at https://www.ea.com/games/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes/news/phoenix-squadron-has-arrived
NEWSLETTER_PHOENIX_SQUADRON_REBELS_TITLE|Characters from Star Wars Rebels™ are here!
NEWSLETTER_PILLARS_OF_WAR_DATACRON_DESC|Hello, Holotable Heroes!\n\nAs part of the 10th Anniversary celebration for Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, we’re proud to introduce our latest Datacron Set: [c][ffff33]Pillars of War[-][/c]. This set shines a spotlight on the legends who helped shape the early days of the game, giving several classic squads new power to stand tall once again.\n\nThe core Datacrons feature major boosts for Darth Vader, Cad Bane, Ugnaught, Jedi Consular, and more. Each affix is designed to help these veterans rise to modern challenges while keeping their original play styles intact. To make this set more accessible, the Gear requirements for the core set have been reduced. Affixes now unlock at Gear 10, Gear 12, and Relic 1, instead of the usual Relic 1, 3, and 5. This change gives more players a chance to celebrate the anniversary with their favorite legacy characters.\n\nFocused Datacrons in this set celebrate some of the earliest teams to rule the holotables. Expect to see familiar synergies return with a few new surprises!\n\n- Captain Phasma leads a rejuvenated First Order squad with Geonosian Soldier and Scavenger Rey contributing flurries of assists and sharp strikes.\n- Lando Calrissian teams up with Stormtrooper Han and the Wedge & Biggs duo for fast openings and devastating AoE damage.\n- Boba Fett joins forces with Dengar and Zam Wesell to remind everyone that Bounty Hunters still rule the Outer Rim. \n- Finally, HK-47 takes the Leader role once again, joined by Poggle the Lesser, IG-86, IG-88, and Poe Dameron for a level of calculated destruction that is truly something to be...Feared. 
NEWSLETTER_PILLARS_OF_WAR_DATACRON_TITLE|The Meta Awakens
NEWSLETTER_PIRATES_BONUS_DROPS_NAME|Bonus Drops? We're Pirates! We don't even know what that means!!!
NEWSLETTER_PIRATES_BONUS_DROPS_SUMMARY|Bonus Drops? We're Pirates! We don't even know what that means!!!\n\nWell, this time it means bonus drops, and they’re only for the prepared.\n\nFor a limited time, select PvE battles will feature [b]special bonus drops[/b] from 9/5/2025 to 9/7/2025.\n\nTo unlock these exclusive rewards, you’ll need the following characters at [b]Relic 3[/b]:\n[b]Brutus, Kix, Captain Ithano, and Quiggold[/b].\n\nEach character at R3 unlocks a unique bonus drop. Bring all four to maximize your haul.\n\nThe window will be brief. Relic up and be ready when the nodes go live.\n\nDon’t miss it. Ready your squad!
NEWSLETTER_PIRATES_ERA_DESC|Arrrgh! Our next Era is all about Pirates!\n\nFirst, start celebrating 10 years since [c][F0FF23]The Force Awakens[-][/c] with Pirates familiar to Maz’s Cantina. This Pirate squad can be led by Captain Ithano or by the upcoming Conquest reward... [c][F0FF23]Maz Kanata[-][/c] herself! Second, we have Pirates seen in [c][F0FF23]Skeleton Crew[-][/c] who come to score their share of the profits.\n\nPirates will heavily interact with the status effect [c][40E0D0]Profit[-][/c], previously seen on Nute Gunray’s kit but used by Pirates in new unique ways. They also introduce a new mechanic, [c][40E0D0]Steal[-][/c], where they can Steal buffs from enemies then grant those buffs to allies and benefit in other ways when they pull it off.\n\nAll marquee units will be part of the requirements for the culmination of this Era... [c][F0FF23]Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c]!\n\nPirates also don’t let an opportunity pass them by and are allowed units in the Order 66 raid, with Maz and Hondo performing particularly well. \n\nThe new Era rewards those who know the pirate code: assemble your crew, claim the loot.
NEWSLETTER_PIRATES_ERA_TITLE|Era of Piracy
NEWSLETTER_PLAYTOGIVE_2017_DESC|Games permeate all areas of our lives today – across multiple devices and platforms, and reach players of all ages and genders around the world. With millions of hours spent in play every day, games are a powerful platform for positive, inclusive connections. That is why EA is partnering with several charities to give back to our player communities and support a more inclusive environment in video games. Tap below to learn more about EA Play to Give 2017.
NEWSLETTER_PLAYTOGIVE_2017_TITLE|Players Unite for Inclusive Play
NEWSLETTER_POE_UNIT_PROMO_DESC|Soak up damage with this resistance tank character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Poe's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_POE_UNIT_PROMO_TITLE|Poe Dameron - Learn More
NEWSLETTER_POWER_FORMULA_CHANGE_DESC|The Power rating has long been a prominent display of a unit's general effectiveness. Though this rating is intended to be a useful way to identify how strong a unit is, it has become less and less effective for this purpose over time.
