This is primarily due to the formula being based entirely on the raw base stats of the unit, which doesn't account for all upgrades such as abilities.\n\nIn the interest of making the Power formula more reliable as a reference point for a unit's effectiveness, we've modified the formula to recognize every upgrade made to a unit. This change will result in your units appearing to have a much higher power, however this will NOT have any impact on their performance in combat. The changes are purely intended to be a shorthand representation of a unit's general effectiveness.
NEWSLETTER_POWER_FORMULA_CHANGE_TITLE|Power Formula Change
NEWSLETTER_PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT_EZRA_DESC|Ezra Bridger is ready to continue his Jedi training at Chopper Base!\n\nThis young Jedi specializes in powerful, high-damage attacks to quickly dispatch his enemies. Under Hera Syndulla’s lead, Ezra grants other members of Phoenix Squadron a powerful stacking buff that increases their offense at the end of their turns if they aren’t debuffed.\n\nTake part in the Practice Makes Perfect Event to unlock Ezra Bridger and his incredible Phoenix Squadron synergies!
NEWSLETTER_PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT_EZRA_TITLE|PRACTICE MAKES PERFECT EVENT – Ezra Bridger
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_KNEESAA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Princess Kneesaa[-][/c], the brave warrior Ewok who fought alongside the Rebel alliance in the Battle of Endor, is coming to the holotables!\n\nThe daughter of Chief Chirpa, Kneesaa brings Chirpa-led Ewoks back into relevance by providing extra damage for their death-by-papercut style gameplay. Kneesaa assisting Ewoks when they use a Special ability, these out-of-turn attacks deal True damage and inflict Damage Over Time, and Ewoks stack Offense when they are critically hit. She also shores up some of their current weaknesses by bolstering Ewoks against Daze and Stun, as well as Kneesaa gaining Turn Meter when another Ewok takes damage, additionally cleansing them to get them back into the fight.\n\nWith an Omicron upgrade in Territory Wars, Kneesaa starts the battle with 100% Turn Meter to really get things going, then she doesn’t stop as she reduces her cooldowns every time she attacks, including out of turn. Additionally, Kneesaa becomes fully immune to Daze and Stun. Finally, Ewoks will gain Turn Meter if any other debuffs try to shut them down.\n\nUnlock Princess Kneesaa in the new “SPIRITS FROM THE FOREST MOON” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_KNEESAA_MOD_061624_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Princess Kneesaa[/b] shards have been added to [b]Mod Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Mod Energy.\n\nMod Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/16/2024 through 06/17/2024.
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_KNEESAA_MOD_061624_TITLE|Princess Kneesaa shards are available on Mod Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_KNEESAA_TITLE|Ewok & Roll
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_LEIA_DESC|Princess Leia is now available in the Arena Store! This fearless Rebel leader is a powerful attacker type character with extra attacks and the ability to buff an entire team with Critical bonuses.\n\nWill you be adding one of the greatest leaders of the Rebel Alliance to your collection?
NEWSLETTER_PRINCESS_LEIA_TITLE|Princess Leia is now available in the Arena Store!
NEWSLETTER_PROFUNDITY_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Rebels are uploading precious information to a new Capital Ship on the Holotables! A pivotal fighter in the Battle of Scarif, Admiral Raddus succeeded in taking down the shield to receive the crucial Death Star plans that the Rebellion needed in their most desperate hour.\n\nThe [c][F0FF23]Profundity[-][/c] charges its Ultimate ability [c][F0FF23]Admiral, We Have the Plans[-][/c] by increasing its Download progress from other Rebel ships. When the Ultimate is activated, the Profundity will drop the Tantive IV which the enemy capital ship will not be able to resist and jump into lightspeed to follow, leaving its ships stranded on the battlefield. With potent Special abilities, [c][F0FF23]Unconventional Maneuver[-][/c] will inflict more debuffs as it deals more instances of damage and [c][F0FF23]The Rebel Fleet Has Arrived[-][/c] will inflict Marked on Stealthed enemies. Through the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]I Say We Fight[-][/c], all units are immune to Turn Meter manipulation and Rebel Cargo ships are immune to critical hits.\n\nAchieve dominance on the Holotables by adding the Profundity to your ships roster through the all new Journey Guide Fleet Mastery event!
NEWSLETTER_PROFUNDITY_TITLE|He's Returned to His Ship. He's Going to Fight.
NEWSLETTER_PROTECTIONSTAT_DESC|Protection provides Characters with additional survivability and first becomes available when a Character reaches [c][9341ff]Gear Lvl VII[-][/c].\n\nWhen battling against a Character with Protection, the Protection meter must be depleted prior to affecting the Character's health.\n\nVisit the forums for discussion on this new statistic!
NEWSLETTER_PROTECTIONSTAT_TITLE|New Statistic Added: Protection
NEWSLETTER_PUNISHING_ONE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Punishing One[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nPiloted by Dengar, this Bounty Hunter ship is a modified JumpMaster 5000. Punishing One sports an asymmetrical profile and impressive firepower that perfectly suits Dengar’s style.\n\nPunishing One flies into Executor’s starting lineup to give an edge in mirror matches as well as against Profundity. When enemies attack it out of turn (especially Light Side enemies like those pesky Rebels), the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]JumpMaster 5000[-][/c] recovers Health and Protection for Punishing One and reduces the cooldown of its Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Wanted: Dead[-][/c], which inflicts Deathmark. The Unique also prevents enemies from recovering Health or Protection while they have Deathmark.\n\nIts Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Quad Laser Cannon[-][/c], deals additional damage for each Breach, Marked, and Target Lock present on the enemy, and its Special ability, Disruptive Combo, dispels all buffs on enemies and then calls a Bounty Hunter ally to assist.\n\nUnlock Punishing One in the upcoming “PUNISHING PURSUIT” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out Punishing One blueprints, Dengar shards, and daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
NEWSLETTER_PUNISHING_ONE_TITLE|You're a Punishing One, Dengar
NEWSLETTER_PVP_ARENA_PAYOUTS_ADJUSTMENTS_DESC|Greetings,\n\nWe recently made an adjustment to the way Arena rewards work. Payouts for your rank in Squad Arena now reward 100 less Arena Tokens, but you will now receive 100 more when completing the daily challenge by participating in 3 Arena battles.
NEWSLETTER_PVP_ARENA_PAYOUTS_ADJUSTMENTS_TITLE|Adjustments to Arena Rewards
NEWSLETTER_PVP_TOURNAMENT_KICKOFF_EVENT_DESC|Prepare your squads for the upcoming Squad Tournaments with a special limited-time Squad Tournament Kickoff Weekend! All weekend long you will receive DOUBLE DROPS on Light and Dark Hard battles, Mod Challenges and Cantina Battles! In addition, you will receive a 25% BONUS across all crystal packs in the store (one-time bonus for each pack)!\n\nTake advantage of this limited-time bonus weekend, and get your best squads ready to battle for the top of the leaderboards in our first PVP Squad Tournament! The new Squad Tournaments unlocks at level 30.
NEWSLETTER_PVP_TOURNAMENT_KICKOFF_EVENT_TITLE|Prepare for Upcoming Squad Tournaments!
NEWSLETTER_QIRA_DESC|To celebrate the release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Qi'ra has arrived to the Holotables! Acquire, power up, and fight with this new Scoundrel leader. Use Qi'ra, Young Han Solo, and Vandor Chewbacca to maximize their powerful [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c] abilities!\n\nQi'ra is a new Scoundrel leader that increases the faction's Critical Chance and helps with their recovery and sustain in a fight. Qi'ra's leader ability also increases Scoundrel's power by their Role. Attackers gain more Offense, Tanks gain Critical Avoidance, and Supports gain Speed. Qi'ra can also use [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c] to dispel all buffs on her enemies! This resourceful Scoundrel is an excellent addition to any Scoundrel squad and can be used to devastating effect with other allies that use [c][f0ff23]Prepared[-][/c]! 
NEWSLETTER_QIRA_TITLE|Qi'ra has arrived!
NEWSLETTER_QUALITY_OF_LIFE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe made some big improvements to the Cantina since you last visited. The updated holotables contain many highly requested Quality of Life changes from you, the community! You’ll notice immediately that battles are much easier to see with an option that lets you toggle the way buffs and debuffs are shown. We have also added an exciting new feature for guild leaders that allows them to Sim a raid for their entire guild, speeding up the rewards for guilds who are already easily clearing The Pit.\n\nThere's so much more in this update but I can’t let you go without mentioning the new "Leader" tag for characters with Leader abilities. This means you have another useful way to filter your characters and decide who to focus on upgrading or who to use in your next Grand Arena!\n\nHead over to the official Galaxy of Heroes forums for the full list of changes.
NEWSLETTER_QUALITY_OF_LIFE_TITLE|Quality of Life Update!
NEWSLETTER_QUEEN_AMIDALA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Queen Amidala[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! Elected Queen of the Naboo, she firmly fought for her people and democracy even in the face of the imposing Trade Federation as they blockaded her planet. She demonstrates an admirable commitment to doing the right thing as well as an iconic wardrobe comparable to none.\n\nQueen Amidala summons a [c][F0FF23]Handmaiden Decoy[-][/c] through her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Ascension Gun[-][/c], to Taunt and protect her allies with the buff [c][F0FF23]Queen’s Protection[-][/c] that provides useful stats such as Health, Protection, and Speed. Her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]My Place is with My People[-][/c], provides synergy with Heal Over Time and Protection Over Time, increasing ally offensive stats per stack. This ability also punishes enemies for attacking out of turn by inflicting Damage Over Time, and also reduces the enemy’s offensive stats when they critically hit her or her squad.\n\nWith Omicron upgrades to her abilities [c][F0FF23]I am Queen Amidala[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]My Place is with My People[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Loyal Bodyguard[-][/c] in the Grand Arenas game mode, her team gains extra instances of Heal Over Time and Protection Over Time as well as more benefits from these stacks. Additionally, [c][F0FF23]Loyal Bodyguard[-][/c] will summon the Decoy at start of battle to ensure the team is set up safely.\n\nUnlock Queen Amidala during the next Conquest events and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Battle for Naboo raid[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_QUEEN_AMIDALA_TITLE|Slay, Queen
NEWSLETTER_QUIGGOLD_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Quiggold[-][/c] is setting sail and joining the Pirates on the Holotables!\n\nA loyal First Mate to Captain Ithano, Quiggold is foremost a tank, but is also a formidable combatant and skilled ship's gunner. With his trusty deck sweeper cannon, he can clear the way for his Pirate allies to plunder and pillage.\n\nQuiggold's [c][F0FF23]Deck Sweeper[-][/c] Basic ability Steals Taunt from his opponents, granting it to himself while inflicting Defense Down. If no Taunt is stolen, Quiggold will gain Taunt at the cost of 1 stack of Profit.\n\nHis Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Buccaneer[-][/c], Steals Foresight and Tenacity Up from enemies, sharing them with Pirate allies. It also deals damage and inflicts the Tenacity Down and Blind debuffs. If no buffs are stolen, Quiggold's allies gain sturdy Defense and Protection buffs.\n\nQuiggold's first Unique, [c][F0FF23]First Mate[-][/c], allows him to pre-Taunt to start the battle, and grants potent stat increases based on his Pirate allies. When injured, Quiggold fortifies himself, and stacking Profit grants Bulwark, making him Stun-immune at high stacks.\n\nHis other Unique, [c][F0FF23]Prayer Necklace[-][/c], empowers Quiggold while Taunting by providing Retaliate stacks. In Territory Battles with his Omicron ability, he starts with ample Profit, granting massive defensive stats. Enemies defeated by his Pirate allies become unable to be revived and the first time any Pirate loses half health, they gain undispellable Damage Immunity for 2 turns.\n\nUncover Quiggold's treasures in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TROUBLE ON THE HORIZON II"[-][/c] Marquee event as the Pirates continue to assemble their fearsome crew! Quiggold will also be a requirement for Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka, so make sure you’re ready for his release at the end of the Era.
NEWSLETTER_QUIGGOLD_TITLE|How Much Do Pirates Pay For Corn?
NEWSLETTER_QUIGONJINN_CANTINA_SHIPMENTS_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nQui-Gon Jinn is now available in Cantina Shipments. Previously, Qui-Gon Jinn was only available by opening Chromium Packs. We will continue to move characters from being exclusively in Chromium Packs as we add new characters to the game.\n\nWe hope you are all excited to have another way to acquire character shards for Qui-Gon Jinn!
NEWSLETTER_QUIGONJINN_CANTINA_SHIPMENTS_TITLE|Qui-Gon Jinn In Cantina Shipments
NEWSLETTER_R2D2_EVENT_DESC|In celebration of May the Fourth, R2-D2 arrives to Galaxy of Heroes!\n\nThe versatile Support Droid, R2-D2, has been seen on the Death Star! Gather your best EMPIRE forces and defeat the famous crew of the Millennium Falcon to capture R2 in THE DARING DROID, a very rare multi-tiered event!\n\nCan you foil the REBELS' plans and capture this Legendary astromech?
NEWSLETTER_R2D2_EVENT_TITLE|R2-D2 arrives in the Daring Droid Event!
NEWSLETTER_R2D2_LEGENDARY_REOCURRING_EVENT_DESC|Luke Skywalker's Hero's Journey returns for the first time! Luke is also bringing back his astromech friend, R2-D2, in the updated "The Daring Droid" Legendary event. Just like BB-8's Legendary Event, "The Daring Droid" has had a Mythic Event added. In the Mythic version, players will be able to replay the Legendary Event's final tier, a more difficult tier, where they can take any characters in, and a tier that reverses the encounter! Battle against the Empire with the team from a A New Hope!\n\nLike all Legendary Events going forward, R2-D2's Mythic Event will return every time the Legendary event is run. So don't wait, Commander Luke Skywalker and R2-D2 are ready to join your party!
NEWSLETTER_R2D2_LEGENDARY_REOCURRING_EVENT_TITLE|Commander Luke Skywalker Returns and the Mythic "Daring Droid"
NEWSLETTER_RACE_TO_UNLOCK_KYLO_REN_DESC|The Race to Unlock Kylo Ren has begun! Now that Star Wars: The Force Awakens is in theaters and new heroes have been added to the game, we’re celebrating by giving players new ways to unlock Kylo Ren. Beginning today, Chromium packs will have a chance to unlock Kylo Ren and Kylo Ren shards. Starting tomorrow, you will also be able to get shards from Cantina Mission 4C. On top of this, for the next 7 days, all players will receive a Kylo Ren shard each day in their inbox. Will you be the first to unlock Kylo Ren? Let the race begin! More details available in the forums.
NEWSLETTER_RACE_TO_UNLOCK_KYLO_REN_TITLE|The Race to Unlock Kylo Ren
NEWSLETTER_RADDUS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nLegendary Resistance Cruiser, the [c][F0FF23]Raddus[-][/c], has exited hyperspace and landed on the Holotables. Named after the Mon Calamari admiral who gave his life capturing the Death Star plans in the Battle of Scarif, the Raddus was equipped with experimental deflector shields designed to outlast even the heaviest First Order bombardment. These shields provide the fleet with an incredible amount of protection and allows allied ships to take quite a beating before succumbing to enemy fire. Ultimately, the ship lived up to its name when Commander Amilyn Holdo sacrificed the Raddus and herself, using the Holdo Maneuver, to stop the First Order from wiping out the Resistance. Unlock this Resistance Capital Ship in the new [c][F0FF23]Advanced Fleet Mastery - Admiral's Maneuver[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_RADDUS_TITLE|Fire On That Cruiser!
NEWSLETTER_RANCOR_UPDATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nHas your Guild mastered the Heroic Raids? It's time to step it up with a brand new Challenge Tier for the The Pit Raid! Face off against an even more challenging version of the Rancor and earn better rewards such as the all new Relic 8 materials. Use these materials to upgrade your best squads to Relic 8 and challenge your strongest Arena opponents. As part of this update, Guilds can now sim The Tank Takedown if they meet the requirements of completing the Heroic Tank Takedown 50 times and have 35 members with 7* General Kenobi.\n\nGalactic Challenges are also receiving an update that changes how rewards are earned. Earn Key Cards by completing tiers and feats to unlock a reward box based on your progress. At the end of each event, you'll receive a reward box based on the number of Key Cards you unlocked.\n\nSee you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_RANCOR_UPDATE_TITLE|Dare To Challenge The Rancor
NEWSLETTER_RANGE_TROOPER_DESC|Attention Holotables Heroes! We've got some exciting changes in today's update: a new Imperial Trooper appears, a reworked Grand Master Yoda, and the all new Fleet Battles table!\n\nUnlock the new PvE Table, Fleet Battles, at Level 60 to start earning Ship shards, Reinforcement Materials and even [b] Ship Omega Ability Materials[/b]! With a new energy dedicated exclusively to ship combat, the Fleet Battles table is a great place to test out new strategies and collect your favorite Star Wars ships.\n\nUnleash your Jedi team's potential with the newly reworked Grand Master Yoda! Yoda's improved abilities transform the Jedi into a powerful offensive force that punishes enemies for trying to apply debuffs!\n\nExpand your ranks of Imperial Troopers with some of the coolest looking armor around, the Range Trooper! Protecting his Empire allies and supporting their fellow troopers with many ways to assist when they use an ability. See the Range Trooper in action in Solo: A Star Wars Story in theaters now.
NEWSLETTER_RANGE_TROOPER_TITLE|Fleet Battles, Grand Master Yoda, and the Range Trooper have arrived!
NEWSLETTER_RAVENS_CLAW_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nKyle Katarn’s ship, the [c][F0FF23]Raven's Claw[-][/c], is docking with the holotables! Replacing his original ship the Moldy Crow, the Raven's Claw was used in a period of his life where he had to relearn his abandoned Force abilities.\n\nThrough strong synergy with Home One in the Raven's Claw's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Guiding Foresight[-][/c], non-Scoundrel Rebel allies gain Foresight and can ignore Taunt effects while they have it. Raven's Claw also provides Defense Up and Offense to non-Scoundrel Rebel allies through its [c][F0FF23]Battle Flow Manipulation[-][/c] Unique ability. Furthermore, it can inflict Daze and Target Lock on enemies with its [c][F0FF23]Out of the Sun[-][/c] Special ability and dispel buffs with its Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Force-Guided Laser Cannons[-][/c] when it attacks twice with Foresight.\n\nUnlock the Raven's Claw during the upcoming Galactic Chase event to add this ship to your fleet collection!
NEWSLETTER_RAVENS_CLAW_TITLE|Just a Guy with a Lightsaber... and a Ship
NEWSLETTER_RAY_DARK_SIDE_VISION_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Rey (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nRey once found herself in a vision of a possible destiny where she had been completely corrupted by the Dark Side of the Force. With a unique, folding, double-blade lightsaber, this manifestation of hatred and evil represented everything Rey fought against. However, dark forces would continually try to push her towards this destiny...\n\nRey arrives as the long awaited lifter for Supreme Leader Kylo Ren to help him ramp damage much quicker and to provide him with some much needed survivability. One Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Corrupted Reflection[-][/c], grants Kylo extra Ultimate Charge while the other Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Malevolent Lineage[-][/c], grants him more Siphon. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, Malevolent Lineage also recovers Health and Protection for First Order allies and reduces the Max Health and Max Protection of enemies with bonus Protection, Protection Up, or Shield Up.\n\nWhen Rey defeats an enemy, allies that had been defeated by that enemy will be revived through her first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Don’t Be Afraid of Who You Are[-][/c]. Her second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]In Our Nature[-][/c], hides Rey at the start of battle and allows First Order allies to ignore Taunt while they have Advantage. This ability also removes Turn Meter from everyone, which plays well with Kylo’s Unique that makes allies much tankier when they lose Turn Meter. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, this ability also prevents allies from being defeated while she is untargetable.\n\nUnlock Rey (Dark Side Vision) in the[c][E7E7E7] upcoming Conquest events[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_RAY_DARK_SIDE_VISION_TITLE|You Gotta Get AngRey
NEWSLETTER_RAZOR_CREST_FARM_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Razor Crest[-][/c] blueprints have left Conquest Merchants to open up room for upcoming units. While this ship will no longer be available in the Conquest store for Crystals, you can now pick up blueprints in Shipments for Crystals or for Fleet Arena tokens in the Fleet Arena Store. Razor Crest blueprints will continue to be available for Conquest Currency in the Conquest Store.
NEWSLETTER_RAZOR_CREST_FARM_TITLE|Razor Crest Farming Location Update
NEWSLETTER_REBEL_B_WING_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Rebel B-wing[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nThe B-wing starfighter was one of the most powerful fighters in the Rebel Alliance’s arsenal. This was especially true when Captain Drogan was at the controls. With its unique composite-beam laser and heavy weapons payload, this sturdy craft proved to be a formidable opponent against Imperial ships, particularly excelling in operations under Admiral Ackbar’s command via Home One.\n\nThe B-wing’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Gyhril R-9X Heavy Laser Cannons[-][/c], works exceptionally well with Home One as its Capital Ship, guaranteeing Target Lock application and gaining offensive power. Its Special abilities, [c][F0FF23]Blockade Buster![-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Composite-beam Laser[-][/c], allow it to deal devastating area damage while supporting allies and disrupting enemy formations with powerful debuffs.\n\nThrough its [c][F0FF23]Tactical Maneuver![-][/c] unique ability, the B-wing becomes a cornerstone of Rebel fleets, gaining significant durability and offensive capabilities while under Home One’s command. It excels at coordinating with allies through Master Plan and can help reduce Home One’s ability cooldowns when counterattacking. As a reinforcement, it provides crucial tactical advantages to the Rebel fleet and can dramatically turn the tide of battle by granting Home One an immediate bonus turn.\n\nFinally, Home One itself is getting an update. If Rebel B-wing starts in reinforcements on a fully non-Scoundrel squadron, Home One will be able to reinforce B-wing at the start of the battle, giving you instant space superiority against most opponents.\n\nUnlock the Rebel B-wing in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]SKY SABER![-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards![-][/c] for the duration of the event!
NEWSLETTER_REBEL_B_WING_TITLE|The B Stands for B’awesome
NEWSLETTER_REBEL_YWING_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe iconic [c][F0FF23]Rebel Y-wing[-][/c] is flying onto the Galaxy of Heroes Holotables! Prized for its durability and versatility, the Y-wing has gone through several iterations while serving as a valuable contributor to various fleets since its galactic debut. It is sure to bolster any Rebel fleet with its new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Shield Disruption[-][/c], which weakens enemies, making them more susceptible to attacks. The Rebel Y-wing also acts as a powerful crewless tank, giving its squad more survivability while distracting enemy units.
NEWSLETTER_REBEL_YWING_TITLE|The Starfighter that Broke the Empire's Back
NEWSLETTER_RELIC_9_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday’s release brings Relic 9 to the holotables, updates Territory Wars, and kicks off a number of changes coming to Gear availability.\n\nFirst up, Relic 9 can now be crafted from 2 new materials, the Gyrda Keypad from the Jawa Scavenger and the new Droid Brain material that is exclusively available from Territory Wars reward boxes.\n\nThe new Relic 9 prize is not the only change coming to Territory Wars. This mode has expanded with additional Defenses in the upper divisions, extra reward boxes (outside of the Droid Brain with Relic materials), and a new system for matchmaking your Guild against another of similar power.\n\nLast but certainly not least, there are many upcoming changes aimed at increasing the availability of Gear! As part of the first steps towards those Gear changes, we have expanded Territory Wars to also reward Aeromagnifiers and flatten the rewards from the Challenge tier of The Pit to reward more players with this Relic 8 material. This sets the stage for a whole host of Gear changes, the details of which are available on the Official Forum right now.\n\nSee you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_RELIC_9_TITLE|Relic 9, Territory Wars, and Upcoming Changes to Gear
NEWSLETTER_RELICS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nTake your squad to the next level and power up your characters with [c][F0FF23]Relic Amplifiers[-][/c] from the Star Wars universe! Each character has a special Relic that provides stat boosts based on their role and aptitudes. Enhance the power of relics such as Han Solo's pistol, Yoda’s walking stick or Kylo Ren's lightsaber, and other legendary items from the movies and TV shows.\n\nUpgrade these unique items through the new [c][F0FF23]Jawa Scavenger holotable[-][/c]. Bring the Scavenger your unused gear and turn it into the scrap parts you need to bolster your Relics. Head over to the official forums for more information on these exciting new artifacts.\n\nTo celebrate the launch of Relics, Normal nodes in Light Side, Dark Side, and Fleet Battles are rewarding double drops on 9/13, 9/14, and 9/15.\n\nSee you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_RELICS_TITLE|Amplify your Squad
NEWSLETTER_REMOVING_SELL_FEATURE_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nYou may have noticed that Mining Droids were removed from the game recently and replaced with direct Credit rewards. This was done in order to streamline the game, removing an unnecessary step.\n\nWith the latest major update, the Sell feature has been removed entirely from the game. Any Mining Droids not yet sold will be credited directly to your account as Credits. A message will be sent to your Inbox if your account fits this criteria.\n\nFor complete details on this update please visit our forums at https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_REMOVING_SELL_FEATURE_TITLE|Sell Feature Removed
NEWSLETTER_RESISTANCE_HERO_FINN_DESC|Rally the Resistance and stop the First Order from seizing the galaxy in the upcoming marquee event, [c][F0FF23]HEROES OF THE RESISTANCE[-][/c]. Inspired by the indomitable will of his allies, [c][F0FF23]Resistance Hero Finn[-][/c] becomes super charged with new effects and protects his allies from the crushing grip of the First Order. Earn shards of Resistance Hero Finn and find out if FN-2187 is ready to lead in the Resistance to victory! 
NEWSLETTER_RESISTANCE_HERO_FINN_TITLE|A Hero of the Resistance
NEWSLETTER_RESISTANCE_POE_FINN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nOne of the leaders of the Resistance, [c][F0FF23]Resistance Hero Poe[-][/c], joins the holotables! Poe overpowers his enemies with debilitating effects and an onslaught of blaster fire. He has proven himself to be a valuable asset to the Resistance, despite his signature bravado in battle. When [c][F0FF23]INSPIRED[-][/c] by his ally, Resistance Hero Finn, Poe weakens the enemy squad with an assortment of debuffs that leaves them Vulnerable to Critical Hits. Help the Resistance combat the First Order and unlock Resistance Hero Poe in an upcoming Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_RESISTANCE_POE_FINN_TITLE|HAPPY BEEPS HERE, BUDDY, C'MON!
NEWSLETTER_REVA_DESC|The Inquisitorius are looking to bolster their ranks once again with the addition of [c][F0FF23]Third Sister[-][/c] from the Obi-Wan Kenobi series on Disney+. Third Sister's shards are earned via a Special Mission on Tatooine in Phase 3 of the new Territory Battle, Rise of the Empire.\n\nThird Sister brings to the table a brand new Leader ability in [c][F0FF23]Harbored Aggression[-][/c], allowing Inquisitors to explode out the gate by applying five stacks of Purge at the start of the battle. Following up with her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]No More Hiding[-][/c], she will Ability Block enemies with Purge all the while dispelling herself of any pesky debuffs.\n\nHer Special abilities, [c][F0FF23]Unyielding Onslaught[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Reckless Sweep[-][/c], will also take advantage of Purged enemies. Unyielding Onslaught will deal additional damage while Reckless Sweep will inflict Healing Immunity and give Inquisitorius allies Turn Meter. Meanwhile, her Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Driven by Revenge[-][/c] grants her Hatred, ensuring she will revive after being defeated, and the first time she is defeated, she gains Hatred again, meaning odds are good she'll come back into the fight twice in any given battle!\n\nWith three Omicron abilities in Grand Arenas, she looks to make the Inquisitorius squad live up to their deadly reputation in that game mode.\n\nCollect this powerful character through the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle, and exact revenge on your enemies on your own terms.
NEWSLETTER_REVA_TITLE|Hard to Kill
NEWSLETTER_REVAN_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Have you heard the tale of the Hero who led the Jedi to victory against the Mandalorians in the ancient war? How the Savior of the Republic faced down the armies of Mandalore and took their leader’s mask? Or, perhaps, the story of a great fall and a return to the light? Learn all about one of the great mysteries and myths of the Old Republic. Prepare to follow the journey of... Jedi Knight Revan!\n\nAre you ready to face the dark side with Jedi Knight Revan? You will need the following characters at 7 stars to complete the event and unlock Jedi Knight Revan:\n\n-Bastila Shan\n-Jolee Bindo\n-T3-M4\n-Mission Vao\n-Zaalbar\n\nPacks and Bundles for Old Republic characters are available to help you prepare for this rare event.
NEWSLETTER_REVAN_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|An Ancient Journey of Redemption
NEWSLETTER_REVAN_B28_DESC|[i]"Savior, conqueror, hero, villain. You are all things, Revan… and yet you are nothing. In the end, you belong to neither the light nor the darkness. You will forever stand alone." - Darth Malak[/i]\n\nThe legendary Jedi Knight Revan has joined the Holotables! This warrior of legend is an extremely powerful Jedi leader and tactician who controls the battlefield with a wide mix of powerful abilities. Revan was rumored to have been very influential in shaping the history of the Jedi Order, and was part of many pivotal battles to stop the growing threat of the Sith.\n\nThis update also introduces the B-28 Extinction-class Bomber! This tactical bomber is capable of launching vast amounts of ordnance in order to wreak havoc and sow terror into the minds of the Sith’s enemies. The B-28 was used by the Sith Empire in the Great Galactic War and is most well known for laying waste to the Republic capital, Coruscant.
NEWSLETTER_REVAN_B28_TITLE|Who I Am Is Not Important, My Message Is
NEWSLETTER_REX_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nToday we are happy to announce a new character initially only available in Chromium Packs: CT-7567, or as most of you know him, Rex!\n\nRex is a leader who supports Clone squad members by boosting their turn meter with his unique abilities. In addition to supporting Clone Troopers, Rex also has an ability that does more damage to enemies the higher their maximum health is.\n\nWill you be among the first to form a squad with Rex as a leader?
NEWSLETTER_REX_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|Announcing Rex!
NEWSLETTER_REY_UNIT_PROMO_DESC|Crush the competition with this high damage attacker character inspired by Star Wars: The Force Awakens. Learn Rey's strategy in our forums today. https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_REY_UNIT_PROMO_TITLE|Rey - Learn More
NEWSLETTER_RISE_TOGETHER_EVENT_DESC|Take part in the RISE TOGETHER event to unlock the Phoenix Squadron’s ships: Ghost and Phantom II.\n\nGhost is an elusive Rebel ship that synergizes with Stealthed allies to deliver devastating attacks. Phantom II acts as a decoy for Ghost, while also providing ally support and debuffing enemies.\n\nThis event will combine ground and space combat! See first-hand how fearsome the Phoenix Squadron is under the lead of Hera Syndulla and her unique-sharing leader ability. Afterwards, use the devastating Ghost and Phantom II in a new ship Event.\n\nBe sure to add these powerful ships and their amazing abilities to your fleet by participating in these limited-time events.
NEWSLETTER_RISE_TOGETHER_EVENT_TITLE|RISE TOGETHER EVENT - Ghost and Phantom II
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_CHROMIUM_DESC|A new selection of characters has been rotated into Chromium Packs, including Rogue One's Jyn Erso, Chirrut Îmwe, Cassian Andor and K-2SO!\n\n*For a full list of the changing Chromium Characters, check out the SWGOH forum (https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com)
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_CHROMIUM_TITLE|New Chromium Pack Characters
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Rogue One[-][/c] is infiltrating the Holotables!\n\nThe ship that carried Jyn Erso, Cassian Andor, and a team of Rebel commandos to Scarif will be bringing a much needed lift to Profundity fleets. At first blush Rogue One is a powerful reinforcement ship, but upon closer examination, Admiral Piett will need to watch his back as many of the mechanics of the ship are meant to hard counter Executor fleets.\n\nWith its [c][F0FF23]Covert Barrage[-][/c] Basic, Rogue One can repeatedly strike an enemy ship, locking them down with Target Lock, which can't be resisted against Imperial foes. [c][F0FF23]I'm the Pilot[-][/c], one of its Special abilities, calls the Outrider to assist when paired with the Profundity Capital Ship. Its other Special, [c][F0FF23]Spoofed Clearance Codes[-][/c], bolsters Rebel allies' Tenacity and can inflict Imperial enemies with Accuracy Down.\n\nRogue One's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]SW-0608[-][/c], grants it increased survivability when paired with Profundity. And when the battle starts, if Rogue One is in Reinforcements against an Imperial Capital Ship, Rebel allies gain Breach Immunity and Protection Up for a limited time.\n\nUpon being called from Reinforcements with, [c][F0FF23]Well, There Is Now[-][/c], Rogue One can inflict Healing Immunity on all enemies. Against the Empire, it increases enemy cooldowns and, when paired with Profundity against non-Sith foes, increases Download progress.\n\nOwnership of Bodhi Rook and Pao will be required to crew Rogue One, but their shards, alongside the blueprints needed to unlock Rogue One, are available in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"THE SPARK OF SCARIF"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for its duration!
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_EVENT_BISTAN_MESSAGE|Play every day to unlock Bistan early and increase his star count by the end of the month!\n\nA new daily event for the month of November is now available! You will need to put together a crack team of Rebels (recommended for levels 20 and above) in order to battle on Scarif and earn extra shards towards unlocking Bistan!\n\nBe sure to participate each day in order to add this Rogue One character to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_EVENT_BISTAN_TITLE|Rogue One Daily Event!
NEWSLETTER_ROGUE_ONE_TITLE|Bodhi Rook Gets a Ship
NEWSLETTER_ROSE_HOLDO_DESC|In the darkest hour of the Resistance, Admiral Holdo and Rose Tico rise up to defeat the First Order!\n\nA seasoned tank with powerful ally support and enemy debuffs, Admiral Holdo is the premier support tank for any Resistance-led squad. Her basic, [c][F0FF23]MEASURED SHOT[-][/c], gives the least healthy Resistance ally Foresight, which heals them when it expires. When she uses her special, [c][F0FF23]REPRIEVE[-][/c], target other ally has their debuffs dispelled and they'll gain Health and Protection in return.\n\nRose Tico is an attacker who grants allies buffs and can stun the target enemy. Her unique, [c][F0FF23]VALIANT SPIRIT[-][/c], grants Rose Offense for each Exposed enemy and Rose gains Turn Meter when another Resistance ally scores a Critical Hit.\n\nBoth of these valiant heroes are ready to join your Resistance squad and lead you to victory!
NEWSLETTER_ROSE_HOLDO_TITLE|Admiral Holdo and Rose Tico Join the Resistance!
NEWSLETTER_ROTJ_RAID_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nCelebrate 40 years of Return of the Jedi with the new featured raid, the [c][F0FF23]Speeder Bike Pursuit[-][/c]! Dash through the forest moon of Endor chasing down wave after wave of the Empire’s elite Scout Troopers while dodging their incoming attacks.\n\n[c][FF69B4]This raid features entirely new gameplay where everything you know has changed![-][/c]\n\nNew abilities (unique to this raid) replace your character’s existing abilities and are used to remove stacks of [c][F0FF23]Damage, Distraction, Sideswipe,[-][/c] or [c][F0FF23]Timber[-][/c]. Removing all the stacks of any one of these will defeat your enemies in spectacular ways! Earn points in the raid by defeating units as well as evading and repairing damage to yourself. Utilizing [c][F0FF23]Jam[-][/c] on your units will also help prevent stronger reinforcements coming in for the enemy.\n\nThese new abilities and ways to defeat enemies also mean that the best squad compositions might make for some unlikely allies. Try out different squads that you might not have considered before!\n\nThis update also adds an Omicron upgrade to Scout Trooper’s Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Imperial Vanguard[-][/c] to give her a lift in the Speeder Bike Pursuit raid as well as other raids.\n\nLastly, this raid will have a longer cadence in between runs but rewards have been adjusted to stay consistent.\n\nWe are excited to introduce new experiences to our players and this is our most ambitious twist on gameplay yet. Make sure to read what is different in this raid, take some time to adjust, and enjoy! For more details, see our post on the forums.
NEWSLETTER_ROTJ_RAID_TITLE|Watch Out For That Tree
NEWSLETTER_ROYAL_GUARD_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nRoyal Guard has received a touchup to their kit! These changes will help Royal Guard serve as a strong Empire tank who synergizes with Galactic Legend Lord Vader and other Empire characters.\n\nThe following abilities for Royal Guard have been updated:\n\n“Force Pike” Basic ability has been increased to a 100% Stun chance (previously 80%).\n\n“Imperial Phalanx” Special ability now states “All Dark Side allies gain Defense Up and Heal Over time for 2 turns and Empire allies gain Health Up and Retribution for 2 turns. Royal Guard gains Taunt for 1 turn.”\n\n“Unyielding Defender” Unique ability now states, “At the start of the encounter, if the allied Leader is Empire, Royal Guard gains Max Health equal to 5% of the allied Leader's Max Health and then doubles his Health until the end of the encounter. At the end of each turn, if another ally took damage that turn, all Empire allies recover 6% Health. In addition, Royal Guard Taunts for 1 turn whenever another ally falls below 50% Health.”\n\nAs part of these changes, all resources that you have used to upgrade TIER VIII of Royal Guard's unique, Unyielding Defender, have been returned to your inbox.
NEWSLETTER_ROYAL_GUARD_TITLE|Royal Guard Kit Touchup 
NEWSLETTER_SANA_STARROS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Sana Starros[-][/c], the Trustworthy-ish Smuggler who has fought alongside the best (and worst) the galaxy has to offer, is coming to the holotables!\n\nEven though Sana did not join the Rebellion she often assisted them, especially fellow Scoundrels. Her Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Rebel Sympathizer[-][/c] highlights this by providing extra Max Health to these allies when they do Area of Effect damage, dishing out additional damage when they remove turn meter, and reducing their cooldowns in certain scenarios if they are a Tank.\n\nWith an Omicron ability upgrade in Territory Wars, her leader ability also makes Rebel Scoundrel allies immune to Daze, start the battle with Taunt if they are a Tank, and dispel all buffs and inflict Healing Immunity whenever they do Area of Effect damage.\n\nSana also synergizes with Target Lock by inflicting it whenever an enemy is critically hit by a Rebel or Sana, then her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Smart-targeting Scatterblaster[-][/c] will deal extra damage and Stagger Target Locked enemies. Her unique ability [c][F0FF23]A Professional I Can Trust...ish[-][/c] grants Sana turn meter whenever an enemy is inflicted with Target Lock.\n\nSana's intentions introduce a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Suspicious[-][/c], which lowers Speed but increases Critical Chance for her non-Scoundrel allies. Her Unique ability also has her assist non-Attacker Rebel Scoundrels, and when she does so Rebels and her recover Health and Protection.\n\nAdd Sana Starros to your roster by unlocking her in the all-new “PARTNER IN CRIME” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_SANA_STARROS_TITLE|A Reluctant Ally
NEWSLETTER_SATELE_SHAN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nOur newest Conquest character, [c][F0FF23]Grand Master Satele Shan[-][/c], is coming to the Holotables!\n\nA legendary Grand Master of the Jedi Order, Satele Shan was one of the most powerful Force users of the Old Republic era. Descended from the bloodline of Bastila Shan and Revan, she led the Jedi through countless conflicts against the Sith Empire, demonstrating unparalleled tactical brilliance and an unwavering commitment to protecting the Republic.\n\nGrand Master Satele Shan is a Tank that excels at protecting her allies while punishing enemies who threaten her team. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Double Strike[-][/c], deals increased damage while Taunting and inflicts powerful debuffs on Marked enemies while building stacking Protection. Satele uses her powerful [c][F0FF23]Force Stun[-][/c] to lock down priority targets. Additionally, she provides exceptional benefits when used alongside Jedi Knight Revan and Bastila Shan, including granting Jedi allies stacks of Jedi Lessons. Her second Special, [c][F0FF23]Into the Fray[-][/c], dispels all enemy buffs before damaging them and supporting Old Republic allies with Protection recovery and powerful buffs.\n\nSatele's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Legendary Defiance[-][/c], makes her incredibly difficult to defeat by preventing her Health from dropping below full while she has Protection and allowing her to Taunt in response to threats against her team. Her Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Grand Master of the Old Republic[-][/c], enhances Old Republic allies with increased stats, cooldown reduction when attacking out of turn, and special synergy with Bastila Shan's Legendary Battle Meditation. With Omicron upgrades active in Grand Arenas, Satele becomes even more formidable, punishing enemies and providing game-changing immunities to her entire squad.\n\nUnlock Grand Master Satele Shan in the upcoming Conquest events!
NEWSLETTER_SATELE_SHAN_TITLE|Grand Master of the Old Republic
NEWSLETTER_SAW_GERRERA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Saw Gerrera[-][/c], the Onderonian resistance fighter who went from liberating his home planet from Separatists to joining a galaxy-wide rebellion against the Empire, is coming to the holotables! Saw has a storied past, popping up in Bad Batch, Andor, Rebels, and Rogue One, but most notably making a surprise appearance in Jedi: Fallen Order running into Cal Kestis on Kashyyyk.\n\nSaw is a powerful leader of Rebel Fighters and his abilities sync perfectly with some of those characters who are still looking for a decent home, especially through Heal Over Time synergy. While on an all Rebel Fighter squad, his Leader ability [c][F0FF23]Freedom Isn’t Free[-][/c] and Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Adapt and Survive[-][/c] will fortify Tanks and protect everyone else with stacking beneficial stats as they lose and recover Health.\n\nHis Special ability [c][F0FF23]RPS-6 Rocket Launcher Blast[-][/c] removes Turn Meter and temporarily reduces enemy Offense for each character on the field that had buffs. His Granted ability [c][F0FF23]Set Explosive Trap[-][/c] when he is the leader sets a trap for the enemies that counts down as allies take turns or use specials. When this trap detonates, enemies are devastated with debuffs and damage based on Saw’s substantial Max Health.\n\nUnlock Saw in the new “STORIES OF SURVIVAL V” Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Hero’s Journey for Jedi Knight Cal Kestis! A new mission requiring Saw and Rebel Fighters will also soon be added to Kashyyyk in the Territory Battle: Rise of the Empire.
NEWSLETTER_SAW_GERRERA_FLEET_NORM_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Saw Gerrera[/b] has been added to [b]Normal Fleet Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Ship Energy.\n\nBattles are rewarding bonus drops from 12/12/2023 through 12/14/2023.
NEWSLETTER_SAW_GERRERA_FLEET_NORM_TITLE|Saw Gerrera is available on Normal Fleet Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_SAW_GERRERA_MOD_051124_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Saw Gerrera[/b] has been added to [b]Mod Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Mod Energy.\n\nMod Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 05/11/2024 through 05/13/2024.
NEWSLETTER_SAW_GERRERA_MOD_051124_TITLE|Saw Gerrera is available on Mod Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_SAW_GERRERA_TITLE|Greater Than the Sum of His Partisans
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_DAILY_BATTLE_MESSAGE|Play every day to unlock the Scarif Rebel Pathfinder early and increase his star count by the end of the month!\n\nA new daily event for the month of September is now available. You will need to put together a crack team of Rebels (recommended for levels 30 and above) in order to board and assault an Imperial vessel and rescue a captured Scarif Rebel Pathfinder (character shard).\n\nBe sure to participate each day in order to add Rogue One’s first character to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_DAILY_BATTLE_TITLE|Rogue One Daily Event!
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_CANTINA_DESC|The Scarif Rebel Pathfinder is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 1 Mission D! This brave Rebel tank is capable of self-healing and taunting to protect his allies. His determination to his allies and the Rebel cause gives him the ability, “Do or Die,” which allows him to self-revive as long as he has a buff when defeated, making him a hero to his allies and a menace to his enemies.\n\nAdd this Rogue One character to your collection today!
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_CANTINA_TITLE|Scarif Rebel Pathfinder is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 1 Mission D!
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_MESSAGE|Rogue One’s first character has arrived! Login daily this month to unlock the Scarif Rebel Pathfinder. This brave Rebel tank is capable of granting Turn Meter to his allies while Taunting to protect them. His determination to his allies and the Rebel cause gives him the ability, “Do or Die,” which allows him to self-revive as long as he has a buff when defeated, making him a hero to his allies and a menace to his enemies.\n\nBe sure to login daily during the month of September and add the first Rogue One character to your collection.
NEWSLETTER_SCARIF_REBEL_TITLE|September’s Daily Login: Rogue One’s Scarif Rebel Pathfinder
NEWSLETTER_SCBI_CROSS_PROMO_DESC|Build your dream city in the world's most popular city builder, made for mobile. Watch your city come to life as you complete quick, fun challenges and experience vivid 3D-quality graphics. Customize your city with famous landmarks, expand onto the beach, and launch disasters to rebuild in new ways!
NEWSLETTER_SCBI_CROSS_PROMO_TITLE|Bring your city to life!
NEWSLETTER_SCORCH_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]RC-1262 "Scorch"[-][/c] is breach charging his way to the Holotables!\n\nPreviously a lethal member of the elite Republic Commando Delta squad, Scorch specialized in demolitions and heavy weapons. After the fall of the Republic, Scorch led the security forces of Tantiss Base under the supervision of Doctor Hemlock by order of Governor Tarkin.\n\nThe final Dark Side Clone Trooper in the Era of Revenge of the Sith, Scorch takes up position as Lord Vader’s Tank, rounding out the new squad for this powerful Galactic Legend.\n\nScorch's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Exterminate with Extreme Prejudice[-][/c], allows him to dispel debuffs from Empire allies while punishing enemies inflicted with the new Order 66 debuff. His first Special, [c][F0FF23]Breaching Charge[-][/c], deals AoE damage and inflicts multiple stacks of Damage Over Time, ensuring sustained pressure on the enemy team.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Entrenched[-][/c], Scorch's other Special ability, grants him a powerful Taunt along with stacking Defense boosts through the new Bulwark buff. This ability also provides Protection Up to other Dark Side Clone allies, solidifying Scorch's role as a durable frontline Tank.\n\nScorch's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Following Protocol[-][/c], enhances his Taunting capabilities and synergizes incredibly well with allies like Lord Vader and Grand Moff Tarkin. In Grand Arenas with the Omicron upgrade, this ability unlocks even more potent bonuses for Scorch and his Dark Side Clone Trooper brethren, adding additional stacks of Bulwark and Taunting when his Clone brothers are on the verge of defeat.\n\nUnlock the defensive might of RC-1262 "Scorch" in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"Executing Orders IV"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for its duration!
NEWSLETTER_SCORCH_TITLE|Tank You, Lord Vader
NEWSLETTER_SCOUT_TROOPER_CANTINA_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Scout Trooper[/b] has been added to [b]Cantina nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 10/20/2023 through 10/23/2023.
NEWSLETTER_SCOUT_TROOPER_CANTINA_TITLE|Scout Trooper is available on Cantina nodes!
NEWSLETTER_SCOUT_TROOPER_DARK_061024_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Scout Trooper[/b] shards have been added to [b]Dark Side Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nDark Side Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/10/2024 through 06/11/2024.
NEWSLETTER_SCOUT_TROOPER_DARK_061024_TITLE|Scout Trooper shards are available on Dark Side Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_SCOUT_TROOPER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Scout Trooper[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! Imperial Scout Troopers are elite soldiers, tasked with maintaining security for the highest value targets in the Empire. They are outfitted with some of the best equipment the Empire has to offer, like the 74-Z speeder bike, EC-17 hold-out blaster, macrobinoculars, and specialized armor that gives them real-time data in the helmet while at the same time offering flexibility superior to the standard Stormtrooper armor.\n\nWith the addition of Scout Trooper, the Imperial Remnant squad is finally complete with the missing Support piece. When the allied Leader is Imperial Remnant, Scout provides a source of Emperor’s Trap (provided Piett is not there), stacks the damage of her [c][F0FF23]Imperial Precision[-][/c] Special ability, and gains turn meter when an enemy starts their turn. When critically hit she will Stealth and recover Health and Protection, keeping herself alive to support her team and utilizing Stealth throughout her abilities for extra oomph.\n\nWith the launch of the upcoming [c][F0FF23]Speeder Bike Pursuit Raid[-][/c], Scout Trooper will receive an Omicron ability upgrade to make her a key character for that game mode!\n\nEarn Scout Trooper during the upcoming “Eyes of the Emperor” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_SCOUT_TROOPER_TITLE|Scream and Scout
NEWSLETTER_SCYTHE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nConquest Volume 8 begins soon and in preparation for the Grand Inquisitor's event to return in December, we have blueprints for a new ship, [c][F0FF23]Scythe[-][/c], that will be available for a limited time in this mode! Crewed by both the Grand Inquisitor and Fifth Brother, the ship turns Tarkin's Executrix into a flurry of TIE fighters to quickly outnumber opponents.\n\nWhen under Executrix command, the Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Two Moves Ahead[-][/c] summons two crewless TIE fighters at the start of battle and inflicts Marked on ally TIE fighters while they have Foresight. Additionally this ability increases ally empire ship Max Health, Offense, Potency, and Speed. Scythe's Special abilities [c][F0FF23]Intimidating Fly-over[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Predatory Instincts[-][/c] help the Scythe and TIE fighters stick around with health recovery and Protection Up, as well as a dispel of enemy buffs that provides stacks of [c][F0FF23]Formation[-][/c] to allies which further boosts their Health, Offense, and Potency.\n\nThe Reinforcement ability [c][F0FF23]Surprise and Fear[-][/c] is aptly named as it inflicts Fear on all enemies and summons two TIE fighters to help recover fallen spots in the battle.\n\nEarn Scythe blueprints during the upcoming Conquest events and prepare for the return of Grand Inquisitor in December!
NEWSLETTER_SCYTHE_TITLE|Form Up!
NEWSLETTER_SECOND_SISTER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe [c][F0FF23]Second Sister[-][/c], formerly known as Trilla Suduri, is storming on to the holotables! As an Inquisitor who had previously been trained in the ways of the Force by a Jedi but felt betrayed by her master and the Jedi Order, Second Sister is a fierce lightsaber duelist who uses her skill in combat along with her intellect to subdue her foes.\n\nSecond Sister’s Omicron ability is focused on Territory Wars, and she introduces the [c][F0FF23]Inquisitorius[-][/c] faction along with a new debuff, [c][F0FF23]Purge[-][/c]. When upgraded, her Omicron ability debuffs enemies at the start of battle with Purge and prevents Jedi enemies from recovering Health or Protection from their Unique abilities. Purge can also be used to remove enemy Turn Meter, ensures that Second Sister's Special abilities cannot be evaded, and increases her Critical Chance. As a Leader, Second Sister grants Empire allies increases to their Offense and Critical Damage, and when an ally is Marked all other allies are Marked.\n\nAdd Second Sister to your roster via the all-new “[c][F0FF23]Ruthless Efficiency I[-][/c]” Marquee Event, and win Lord Vader’s approval by hunting down members of the treasonous Jedi Order!
NEWSLETTER_SECOND_SISTER_TITLE|You Will Refer to Me as Inquisitor
NEWSLETTER_SERVER_MAINTENANCE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes!\n\nOur servers will undergo maintenance starting approximately March 29th 00:00 PDT / March 29th 07:00 UTC.\n\nThe game will be down for a period of roughly one hour as we work on the servers. Our goal is to be back online as soon as possible.\n\nUpdates will be provided on the forums https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/categories/game-updates
NEWSLETTER_SERVER_MAINTENANCE_TITLE|Server Maintenance
NEWSLETTER_SEVENTH_SISTER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Seventh Sister[-][/c], an Inquisitorius who harbors a mysterious past, is coming to the holotables! Although her identity before becoming known as Seventh Sister is murky, this newest member of the Inquitorius faction was rumored to have been a Jedi who somehow survived Order 66.\n\nSeventh Sister’s Omicron ability is focused on Territory Wars. In addition to bringing support and healing to the Inquisitorius faction, Seventh Sister is accompanied by her Droid, ID9. Like other members of her faction, she has a Leader ability designed to make her powerful against Jedi enemies, and she will make use of the [c][F0FF23]Purge[-][/c] debuff.\n\nHer kit has the ability to dispel buffs and remove Turn Meter from enemies, and inflict Ability Block and Daze. Seventh Sister also provides allies with Critical Hit Immunity, Evasion Up, Health, and Protection. Inquisitorius allies also get Foresight. Seventh Sister also assists whenever an Inquisitorius ally uses an ability during their turn.\n\nUnlock Seventh Sister in the all-new “[c][F0FF23]RUTHLESS EFFICIENCY III[-][/c]” Marquee Event, and bring glory to the Empire by extinguishing the last of the Jedi!
NEWSLETTER_SEVENTH_SISTER_TITLE|My Pet Told Me You Were Here
NEWSLETTER_SHAAK_TI_DESC|Jedi Master [c][F0FF23]Shaak Ti[-][/c] personally oversaw the training and development of clone forces on Kamino during the Clone Wars. This wise general and member of the Jedi High Council expected much from the clones, but she was also known for valuing their lives as individuals, not just rank and file troops. In battle, Shaak Ti is a fierce Leader who significantly increases the power of Clone Trooper allies. She can call an [c][F0FF23]Assault Team[-][/c] to attack, and her [c][F0FF23]Heightened Reflexes[-][/c] are especially effective against enemies who deal damage to multiple Clones at once.\n\n[c][F0FF23]The Shaak Ti event, bundle, and packs unlock for players at level 60![-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_SHAAK_TI_TITLE|Unity Wins War, Gentlemen
NEWSLETTER_SHARD_SHOP_EXCLUSIVE_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nWe hope you're enjoying the latest update. For those of you who have unlocked the Shard Shop, we would like to let you know that in a few weeks there will be a brand new character whose shards can be purchased in the Shard Shop. We're telling you now so you can make a better decision about whether to save up your extra Shards or spend them.\n\nThanks for playing Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes!
NEWSLETTER_SHARD_SHOP_EXCLUSIVE_TITLE|Shard Shop Character Coming Soon
NEWSLETTER_SHIN_HATI_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Shin Hati[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nBaylan Skoll’s apprentice, Shin Hati, has a past wrapped in mystery. Under Baylan's guidance, she was trained to become "something more" than just a Jedi. Together, they journeyed to the planet Peridea, where Shin's unmatched ambition began to shape her destiny. Ultimately, it was this ambition that led her to diverge from her master and forge her own path.\n\nShin kicks off the new [c][F0FF23]Mercenary[-][/c] squad and their key mechanic, [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c]. Each Mercenary will interact with this effect in unique ways. For Shin, she will provide Critical Chance and Critical Damage to her Mercenary allies for each stack of Soldier of Fortune they have through her [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c] Unique ability. This ability also gives her stacks when she critically hits and removes them when she herself is critically hit. When she has enough stacks of Soldier of Fortune, her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You Have No Power[-][/c], unlocks the granted ability, [c][F0FF23]Clean Escape[-][/c], to give strong defensive boosts for her and her allies.\n\nHer Special abilities, [c][F0FF23]I’ve Eyes On Them[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]We’ll Take It From Here[-][/c], provide ways to keep her safe from critical hits and open her enemies up to critical hits so she can gain more Soldier of Fortune stacks. She also has some interaction with Purge to set up synergy with the next Mercenary for the squad who also happens to be an Inquisitor - Marrok.\n\nThis release also adds the Mercenary tag to the appropriate existing characters. Check the filter in your character collection screen to see which characters received the tag.\n\nUnlock Shin Hati in the upcoming “LIGHTSABER FOR HIRE I” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event and prepare for the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Epic Confrontation Baylan Skoll[-][/c]!
NEWSLETTER_SHIN_HATI_TITLE|Shin-ply the Best
NEWSLETTER_SHIP_CHANGES_DESC|Ships just got even better!\n\n[b]Fleet Combat Just Got Personal:[/b]\nNow you can see the crew behind your ships as they fight to defeat their enemies.\n\n[b]Ship Health Bars:[/b]\nTo better differentiate between the health of ships, we have reduced the number of health bar segments. Ship Health has NOT been changed.\n\n[b]Target Lock:[/b]\nTo make it easier to remember which Ship Abilities can inflict Target Lock and have bonuses due to Target lock, we have added visual messaging on the Ability buttons.
NEWSLETTER_SHIP_CHANGES_TITLE|New Changes to Ships
NEWSLETTER_SHIP_FORUM_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Ships are coming soon! To learn more about the ways you can prepare for their arrival, check out the forum post here: https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/discussion/74238/ships-preview-post
NEWSLETTER_SHIP_FORUM_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|Ships are coming to Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes!
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_AVAILABLE_TOURNAMENT_DESC|A new character from Rogue One has arrived! Available exclusively through the new Squad Tournaments you will need to be at least level 30 in order to have a chance of unlocking this Empire tank for your collection.\n\nThe Shoretrooper is a fearless tank who will Taunt at the start of every encounter. His tactical aptitude also gives him the ability, “Regroup,” allowing him and his allies to recover health and gain Critical Hit Immunity. "Regroup" also gives him Taunt, allowing his allies even further reprieve.\n\nBe sure to dominate the Squad Tournaments this week and add this Rogue One character to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_AVAILABLE_TOURNAMENT_TITLE|Rogue One’s Shoretrooper available in Squad Tournaments
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_PVP_TOURNAMENT_DESC|The new Squad Tournaments are here! Unlocked at level 30, you will need to gather your most powerful squad together and set up your best defensive squad in order to compete for rare prizes in this limited time event! You will battle against other players' chosen squads in order to earn points and climb the tournament leaderboard. The higher you climb the better prizes you will receive including "The Pit" Raid Prize Boxes, Credits, Omega Ability Materials, and more! And if you're able to climb and maintain a top position on the leaderboard you can also earn shards for the new Rogue One Shoretrooper!\n\nGather your squad and dominate the new Squad Tournaments to earn your prizes!
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_PVP_TOURNAMENT_TITLE|New Squad Tournaments are here!
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_DESC|The [c][ffff33]Shores of Scarif[-][/c] Squad Tournament is returning for its second appearance! Tournaments now use ALLY POINTS for squad refresh instead of Crystals! Battle your opponents, earn points and climb the leaderboard to earn prizes including “The Pit” Raid Prize Boxes, Credits, Omega Ability Materials, and shards for the Rogue One Shoretrooper. 
NEWSLETTER_SHORETROOPER_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_TITLE|The [c][ffff33]Shores of Scarif[-][/c] Squad Tournament returns!
NEWSLETTER_SITH_MARAUDER_DESC|Shadows gather upon Malachor as strength is found in rage. The Sith Marauder enters the holotable to prepare your squad for the Sith Triumvirate Raid. Join forces with this terrifying attacker in order to infiltrate the Jedi temple and cut through Jedi defenses in his very own Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_SITH_MARAUDER_TITLE|Shadow of Malachor
NEWSLETTER_SITH_SUPREMACY_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Mark VI Interceptor[-][/c], piloted by Sith Empire Trooper and the final piece to the upcoming dominant Sith fleet, is coming to the holotables!\n\nPlayers familiar with the B1 Battle Droid will recognize [c][F0FF23]Devouring Swarm[-][/c] closely resembling Droid Battalion. Mark VI Interceptor has one health, no protection, loses stacks of Devouring Swarm (which also provides Offense) when it takes damage, and cannot be defeated until it loses all stacks. Pay close attention to the stacks it has, because if it gets enough stacks its Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Deadly Stack[-][/c] will instantly defeat the target, showcasing [c][F0FF23]the first instant defeat on a Basic in the game[-][/c]!\n\nWhile Mark VI Interceptor’s Special abilities [c][F0FF23]Can’t Outrun This[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]The Devouring Sacrifice[-][/c] help it gain stacks of Devouring Swarm, a large amount come from carefully timing it as a reinforcement when the ally Capital ship is Sith Empire (meaning Leviathan).\n\nUnlock the Mark VI Interceptor in the upcoming Galactic Chase event and prepare for the Leviathan!
NEWSLETTER_SITH_SUPREMACY_TITLE|Sith Supremacy
NEWSLETTER_SITH_TRIUMVIRATE_RAID_DESC|The Ancient Sith Triumvirate has arrived in Galaxy of Heroes! Darth Nihilus, Darth Sion, and Darth Traya await only the boldest of players in the depths of the Trayus Academy. \n\nOur newest raid, THE SITH TRIUMVIRATE, invites players to join their fellow guild members and assemble their finest squads to best the Lords of Hunger, Pain, and Betrayal. Only the strongest can defeat the Heroic Tier and earn shards of the legendary Lord of Betrayal herself: DARTH TRAYA.\n\nDo you dare face THE SITH TRIUMVIRATE?\n\nContinue the Shadow of Malachor Marquee Event series and unlock VISAS MARR and the dreaded Lord of Pain: DARTH SION. \n\nVISAS MARR is a healer with two potent buffs: Health Steal Up and Defense Penetration Up. VISAS MARR also has powerful anti-Sith synergy and will prove invaluable to those looking to lay siege to the Trayus Academy. \n\nDARTH SION is the fearsome Lord of Pain and a new Sith tank. Using his powerful PAIN debuff, Sion can cripple foes while making himself more powerful as he works to activate his HATRED buff - which prevents him from being defeated! \n\nAdd these characters to your collection today!
NEWSLETTER_SITH_TRIUMVIRATE_RAID_TITLE|Welcome to the Trayus Academy
NEWSLETTER_SKIFF_GUARD_LANDO_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian),[-][/c] who went under cover in Jabba's Palace to help save Han, is coming to the holotables!\n\nSkiff Guard heavily uses the new buff [c][F0FF23]Deep Cover,[-][/c] which provides Defense Penetration and Potency. If Skiff Guard has enough stacks of Deep Cover, his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Cutter Vibro-ax[-][/c] inflicts Armor Shred with a chance to refresh the cooldown of the ability. He can also support another ally with his Special ability [c][F0FF23]Covert Coordination,[-][/c] which dispels debuffs on them then calls them to assist and grants them a bonus turn.\n\nHis Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Agent on the Inside[-][/c] gives a new granted ability [c][F0FF23]Hutt's Favor[-][/c] when he gains enough stacks of Deep Cover. This granted ability does bonus damage to the target enemy based on their Max Health for each debuff on them. In Territory Wars with the Omicron upgrade, this ability also increases the stats for allies with Deep Cover and allows it to spread more often to them.\n\nAdd Skiff Guard (Lando Calrissian) to your roster by unlocking him in the all-new “[c][F0FF23]GUARD DUTY[-][/c]” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_SKIFF_GUARD_LANDO_TITLE|We'll Find Han, I Promise
NEWSLETTER_SM_33_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]SM-33[-][/c] is hobbling his way to the Holotables!\n\nFrom the Disney+ series [c][F0FF23]Skeleton Crew[-][/c], SM-33 is a First Mate droid with a scrappy attitude and fierce loyalty to his captain. Built for battle, this mechanical warrior is ready to take on any foe that threatens his crew.\n\nSM-33 introduces the [c][FF00FF]Pirate[-][/c] faction! This brand new faction will be expanded upon in the next Era, more news on this plundering new faction in the coming months!\n\nSM-33's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Rattling Uppercut[-][/c], deals damage and Staggers enemies and, if the target previously damaged his Pirate Leader, SM-33 dishes out even more punishment with Ability Block and Daze. [c][F0FF23]Limb From Limb[-][/c], his devastating Special attack, strikes multiple times with increased damage based on SM-33's missing Health. If the target previously harmed his Pirate Leader, SM-33 can reduce the enemy's Max Protection.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Forearm Bucklers[-][/c] is SM-33's powerful dispel and self-buff ability. By clearing enemy buffs and dealing damage, and stacking Heat. At higher Heat levels, SM-33 inflicts Damage Over Time and Burning effects that can't be avoided or dispelled. In Territory Wars with an Omicron enabled, SM-33 even dispels his own debuffs and grants Critical Avoidance Up to himself and bonus Protection to Pirate allies.\n\nSM-33's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]First Mate of the Onyx Cinder[-][/c], provides him stat boosts based on Scoundrel and Pirate allies. When enemies target his Pirate Leader, SM-33 gains Turn Meter and stacking Critical Damage. After using Forearm Bucklers, he gains Heat stacks each turn, and the first time he's damaged, he gets a bonus turn and Forearm Bucklers’ cooldown is reset. In Territory Wars with his Omicron enabled, his Pirate Leader and SM-33 gain offensive stats, and the enemy that damaged the Leader is weakened against SM-33's allies.\n\nUnlock this scrappy droid by obtaining his shards in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]Conquest[-][/c] events!
NEWSLETTER_SM_33_TITLE|A Pirate’s Life for SM-33
NEWSLETTER_SMUGGLERS_HAN_CHEWBACCA_DESC|Welcome our newest additions to Galaxy of Heroes - Veteran Smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca! This powerful duo have incredible synergies between them, making them devastating allies on the battlefield.\n\nThese Veteran Smugglers have each other's back, sharing the Unique ability: Partner in Crime. Whenever one of these old friends is damaged, the other becomes much more dangerous by gaining additional Critical Damage. And, if you defeat one of these Smugglers, the other immediately takes two turns back to back.\n\nAdd these The Force Awakens characters to your roster today!
NEWSLETTER_SMUGGLERS_HAN_CHEWBACCA_TITLE|Veteran Smugglers Han Solo and Chewbacca Arrive!
NEWSLETTER_SOCIAL_SEP_15_DESCRIPTION|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes features several ways to connect with your friends and with other players.\n\nAllies - Remember, your Allies' characters will be available to help you in Campaign battles, and their Leader Abilities will apply to your squad. When you use allies in a battle, you will earn Ally Points which you can use to open packs!\n\nStar Wars: Galaxy of Heroes Forum - Visit the Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes Forums to connect with other players, discuss strategy, and even submit questions for Capital Games to answer in our weekly Q&A.\n\nVisit the official Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes web site to view the forums - http://starwars.ea.com/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes
NEWSLETTER_SOCIAL_SEP_15_TITLE|Stay Connected
NEWSLETTER_SOLO_VANDOR_DESC|To celebrate the upcoming release of the new Solo: A Star Wars Story film in theaters, Young Han Solo and Vandor Chewbacca have arrived to the holotables! Acquire, power up, and fight with these new Scoundrels and plan your own galactic heists!\n\nFew heists turn out exactly as planned - but when you've got the natural skill of a Young Han Solo or the courage of Vandor Chewbacca, you're [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] for anything!\n\nWhen Young Han Solo or Vandor Chewbacca gains the new [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] effect, they can increase the power of some of their abilities or expend [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to unleash devastating new effects. Young Han Solo can also grant [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to other allies, further increasing the power of his attacks. Vandor Chewbacca can use [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] to revive defeated Light Side Scoundrel allies! [c][F0FF23]Prepared[-][/c] will deliver new and exciting combat experiences to your squads.\n\nCollect and power up the all new Scoundrels, Young Han Solo and Vandor Chewbacca, today in an all new set of Marquee Events!
NEWSLETTER_SOLO_VANDOR_TITLE|Young Han Solo and Vandor Chewbacca have arrived!
NEWSLETTER_SPECTRE_ONE_KANAN_DESC|The powerful Jedi survivor, Kanan Jarrus, is ready to join the fray! Unlock Kanan by completing the Spectre One Event this month.\n\nKanan is a taunting Jedi that can cleanse debuffs from his allies and grant Protection Up. Kanan, under a Hera Syndulla leader, will grant other Phoenix Squadron members healing at the start of their turns if they are debuffed and give them a chance to counter attack.\n\nYou need to collect Kanan Jarrus in order to take advantage of the incredible Phoenix Squadron synergies, so jump into the Spectre One Event and add him to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_SPECTRE_ONE_KANAN_TITLE|SPECTRE ONE EVENT – Kanan Jarrus
NEWSLETTER_SQUAD_ARENA_CRYSTAL_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update moves the Crystal rewards from Squad Arena to Grand Arena Championships. As we seek to reinforce that Grand Arena Championships as THE competition in Galaxy of Heroes to rank and reward the players who best use the strongest rosters in SWGOH, these changes provide more evenly matched opponents, better rewards that incentivize combat, and an overall more straightforward ladder experience. All level 85 players will receive a daily Crystal reward based on their standing in Grand Arena Championships and earn additional Crystals based on their results at the end of each Round, Event, and Season. Squad Arena will have a larger focus on preparing players for Grand Arena Championships by providing additional Gear in Squad Arena Shipments.  Fleet Arena rewards remain unchanged at this time.\n\nPlayers below level 85 will receive Crystals they previously earned in Squad Arena from Daily Quests.\n\nSee the Official Forums for more information.
NEWSLETTER_SQUAD_ARENA_CRYSTAL_TITLE|Squad Arena Crystal Rewards Moved to Grand Arena Championships
NEWSLETTER_SQUAD_MANAGEMENT_TOOLS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nOrganize your growing roster faster than ever with the new Squad Management tools. You will notice that the Character/Ship Inventory screen has received a visual update and we have added several new tabs on the left hand side to assist you in finding and arranging your squads.\n\nLearn where to focus your resources next with the Recommended tab, which provides squad recommendations based on your account and Journey Guide progress. You can also find initial and advanced squad suggestions for each character in the game by tapping the new info button on that character's screen.\n\nCreate new tabs to organize your squads right from the Inventory screen. Easily move, rename or copy squads to other tabs with the tap of a button. You can even add units that aren't unlocked to help you plan for the next event or your newest squad!\n\nThis update also adds a Leader Synergy indicator to the pre-battle squad screen. Now you can quickly determine if your squad's leader ability partially or completely applies to the rest of your squad members or as you scroll through unassigned units in the pre-battle squad screen.\n\nEnjoy the new tools and see you on the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_SQUAD_MANAGEMENT_TOOLS_TITLE|New Squad Management Tools
NEWSLETTER_STAP_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]STAP[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables! The Single Trooper Aerial Platform (STAP) is piloted by a single B1 Battle droid and has been a staple of the armies of the Separatists all the way back to the days of the Trade Federation’s invasion of Naboo. This reconnaissance craft is swift, agile, and packs a heavy punch in its forward firing twin blaster cannons.\n\nSTAP reinforces the droid armies of General Grievous through a new debuff [c][F0FF23]Pinned[-][/c] that shuts down turn meter gain and lowers Speed. Pinned is applied on target locked enemies through STAP’s Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Checkpoint Secure![-][/c] then the Special ability [c][F0FF23]Die, Jedi Dogs![-][/c] does extra damage to Pinned enemies. Finally, the Special ability [c][F0FF23]We Need To Recharge![-][/c] provides additional assists to ensure Pinned spreads around the battle.\n\nThe Unique [c][F0FF23]Single Trooper Aerial Platform[-][/c] inflicts max health damage for Separatist Droids when they inflict target lock or pinned. With an Omicron upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, STAP comes out blasting with a bonus turn at the start of battle and after each enemy’s first turn!\n\nUnlock STAP during the upcoming “REPULSORCRAFT RECONNAISSANCE” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_STAP_TITLE|UnSTAPpable
NEWSLETTER_STAR_WARS_CELEBRATION_DESC|It's time to celebrate [i]Star Wars[/i]!\n\nThis year’s [i]Star Wars[/i] Celebration fires off with the RISE TOGETHER Event, awarding players blueprints for Phoenix Squadron’s ships the Ghost and Phantom II. For those that may have missed them last month we’re also bringing back the bundles and packs for all Phoenix Squadron members.\n\nIn addition to the above festivities there will be Double Drops in the Cantina for 5 days, so be sure to join in the celebration!
NEWSLETTER_STAR_WARS_CELEBRATION_TITLE|[i]Star Wars[/i] Celebration
NEWSLETTER_STARFORTRESS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe iconic [c][F0FF23]MG-100 StarFortress SF-17[-][/c] is arriving on the holotables! This rugged Resistance bomber will bolster its faction’s fleet by serving as a staunch tank as it searches for the enemies’ [c][F0FF23]Sweet Spot[-][/c].\n\nCrewed by Rose Tico and Resistance Trooper, the StarFortress is capable of inflicting enemies with Target Lock, Evasion Down, and Daze, as well as removing buffs and Turn Meter from its targets. The StarFortress increases the survivability of the Resistance Fleet via its consistent Taunts, and can also recover Protection, Health, gain Critical Hit Immunity, and counter attack. Once in position, the StarFortress deploys its Concussion Mines to deal Max Health damage to enemies and disrupt the enemy fleet.\n\nUnlock MG-100 StarFortress SF-17 during the upcoming [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] event to add this Resistance tank to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_STARFORTRESS_TITLE|Galactic Chase: MG-100 StarFortress SF-17
NEWSLETTER_STARKILLER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe legendary [c][F0FF23]Starkiller[-][/c] arrives on the holotables! The son of two Jedi, Starkiller had an extremely powerful connection to the Force and served as Vader's personal assassin and secret apprentice. Legend has it Starkiller once used his abilities to bring down a Star Destroyer, and now as a Dark Side Unaligned Force User brimming with conflict, he’s ready to lift up a squad of Force Users on the holotables.\n\nCapable of feats such as inflicting an entire enemy team with Stun as he deals damage to them, providing his allies full Health and Protection recovery, and being immune to Fear, Starkiller is ready for battle. He also introduces the new effects [c][F0FF23]Force Energy[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Unleashed[-][/c], and his Granted ability, [c][F0FF23]Size Means Nothing[-][/c], is sure to make an impact. Starkiller’s Omicron abilities elevate his team in Grand Arenas to new heights.\n\nCrush your holotable foes by adding Starkiller to your roster via the all-new Legacy event, “[c][F0FF23]The Force Unleashed[-][/c],” that is always available in the Journey Guide. Now go, and remember that the dark side is always with you.
NEWSLETTER_STARKILLER_TITLE|Your Hatred Has Become Your Strength
NEWSLETTER_STORMTROOPER_LUKE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper Luke[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nIt’s been a long time coming, but Stormtrooper Han is finally getting his partner-in-disguise, Stormtrooper Luke.
