During their daring rescue of Princess Leia from the Death Star, Luke Skywalker and Han Solo disguised themselves as Imperial Stormtroopers in a brazen attempt to bluff their way past the cell block guards.\n\nThis version of Luke excels at leading Rebel squads, particularly alongside Princess Leia and Stormtrooper Han. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]TK-421[-][/c], deals damage with high variance and can prevent enemies from gaining buffs. [c][F0FF23]Short for a Stormtrooper[-][/c] dispels enemy buffs while protecting Rebel allies and can grant Princess Leia devastating offensive capabilities. His second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Where Could He Be?[-][/c], coordinates devastating assist attacks while providing Stealth and offensive benefits to his Rebel allies.\n\nWhen questioned about the escape plan by Princess Leia, Han famously referred her to Luke and said, “He’s the brains, sweetheart.” Stormtrooper Luke's leadership ability, [c][F0FF23]The Brains[-][/c], provides powerful stat increases to Rebel allies and brings with it the debuff [c][F0FF23]Distract[-][/c] that prevents enemies from gaining bonus Turn Meter. His unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Something Just Moved Past My Leg[-][/c], provides strategic advantages through Speed, Protection, and coordinated Stealth and Taunt effects that help protect his squad. With his Omicron ability Stormtrooper Luke is particularly effective in 3v3 Grand Arenas when paired with Princess Leia and Stormtrooper Han, making him a valuable addition to your roster!\n\nUnlock Stormtrooper Luke in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"SITUATION NORMAL"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Stormtrooper Luke is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled), the spider-like robotic version of the former Sith Lord as seen in The Clone Wars. To enter the first tier of the Maul event, Stormtrooper Luke will need to be Era Level 45 or higher.
NEWSLETTER_STORMTROOPER_LUKE_TITLE|I’m Here to Rescue You
NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIPTION_PACK_ANNOUNCE_DESC|Limited time offer - Purchase the Daily Crystal Delivery and you’ll receive crystals in your inbox on each day of the promotion. On top of that you’ll receive bonus crystals upon purchase. \nSave them up for data cards or spend them to expedite character upgrading! \nDeliveries expire at the end of the day, so make sure to log in each day and collect them. \n\nHead to the Crystal store for more details.
NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIPTION_PACK_ANNOUNCE_TITLE|Daily Crystal Delivery Available!
NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIPTION_PACK_MORE_CRYSTALS_DESC|LIMITED TIME OFFER: Get 30% more crystals in the Crystal Subscription pack – available now in the Store until the end of December.
NEWSLETTER_SUBSCRIPTION_PACK_MORE_CRYSTALS_TITLE|Get More Crystals in Crystal Subscriptions
NEWSLETTER_SUN_FAC_DESC|A new character has been added to Chromium Packs, Sun Fac. This Geonosian Tank punishes attackers with a variety of negative status effects. \n\nWill you be among the first to add this powerful Geonosian to your squad?
NEWSLETTER_SUN_FAC_TITLE|New Character: Sun Fac
NEWSLETTER_SUPPLY_SABOTAGE_HERA_DESC|Hera Syndulla has arrived and is ready to lead Phoenix Squadron into action! Earn shards for Hera by completing the first Star Wars Rebels Event, Supply Sabotage, this month.\n\nHera's powerful Leader ability unlocks the full power of her fellow Phoenix Squadron members. Using Hera as the leader will grant all Phoenix Squadron teammates each other’s Unique abilities, giving the squad a massive boost in battle!\n\nMake sure you participate in the Supply Sabotage Event to unlock Hera; she is the key to granting amazing synergies to Phoenix Squadron!
NEWSLETTER_SUPPLY_SABOTAGE_HERA_TITLE|SUPPLY SABOTAGE EVENT – Hera Syndulla
NEWSLETTER_TARFFUL_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWookiees finally have a squad! [c][F0FF23]Tarfful[-][/c] is coming to the holotables from the acclaimed Jedi: Fallen Order game! Tarfful helped Yoda escape Kashyyyk after Order 66 and later provided Cal Kestis important information he needed on his quest to find the Jedi Holocron.\n\nTarfful brings Wookiees together by finally making Defense an important stat to utilize. His Special ability [c][F0FF23]Wookiee Fury[-][/c] will provide Wookiee allies with stacking Defense, then his Leader ability [c][F0FF23]It’s All in the Fur[-][/c] will grant them Offense equal to their Defense for their turn. The Omicron upgrade to this Leader ability in the Territory Wars game mode will really turn up the rage with extra tankiness, stacking Defense when critically hit, and the first time each Wookiee ally is defeated the survivors will refresh their cooldowns and stack Offense.\n\nHis second Special ability [c][F0FF23]Rrrruuuurrr[-][/c] shows that it’s not a good idea to hit a Wookiee by inflicting Provoked on enemies. The Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Better Together[-][/c] also emphasizes some Wookiee’s value for their companions, such as Mission Vao and Veteran Smuggler Han Solo, and provides various benefits so they can stay together on the team.\n\nUnlock Tarfful in the new “STORIES OF SURVIVAL IV” Marquee event and prepare for the upcoming Hero’s Journey for Jedi Knight Cal Kestis!
NEWSLETTER_TARFFUL_FLEET_051124_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Tarfful[/b] has been added to [b]Fleet Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Ship Energy.\n\nFleet Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 05/11/2024 through 05/13/2024.
NEWSLETTER_TARFFUL_FLEET_051124_TITLE|Tarfful is available on Fleet Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_TARFFUL_FLEET_HARD_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Tarfful[/b] has been added to [b]Hard Fleet Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Ship Energy.\n\nBattles are rewarding bonus drops from 12/12/2023 through 12/14/2023.
NEWSLETTER_TARFFUL_FLEET_HARD_TITLE|Tarfful is available on Hard Fleet Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_TARFFUL_TITLE|Wookiee What We Have Here
NEWSLETTER_TARKIN_UPDATE_DESC|The Imperial march moves to the stars! Grand Moff Tarkin becomes the Daily Login for June and receives a devastating faction pass making him a ruthless foe.\n\nHead your Squad with Tarkin's leader ability Tighten The Grip, which now adds Defense Down on enemies that go below 100% health on an EMPIRE characters turn. Each Basic attack now increases his Potency, while Ultimate Firepower now does additional damage based on Potency, allowing you to set up a devastating attack. This is complimented by his Special ability, Intimidation Tactics, which temporarily grants himself a 50% Potency up buff. Lastly, Tarkin's ability arsenal is rounded out with Callous Conviction, gaining defense equal to his Potency!\n\nRevisit the Galactic Empires unyielding commander of the Death Star and add him to your Squad today!
NEWSLETTER_TARKIN_UPDATE_TITLE|Grand Moff Tarkin
NEWSLETTER_TARON_MALICOS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe fallen Jedi [c][F0FF23]Taron Malicos[-][/c], who walked a dark path on Dathomir after surviving Order 66, is coming to the holotables as the next Conquest unit with Volume 11!  A brutal boss in the acclaimed Jedi: Fallen Order game, Malicos  is an aggressive attacker who forsakes defenses to improve his offensive capabilities, growing in power the more he attacks.\n\nMalicos focuses on lifting other Unaligned Force Users, which brings a big boost to the Cere led squad and also provides flexibility for Lord Vader’s squad. His kit centralizes around him teetering on the [c][F0FF23]Edge of Madness[-][/c], a new debuff, that eventually can be consumed to create [c][F0FF23]Madness Manifested[-][/c]. These debuffs help empower his offensive capabilities while reducing his defensive stats in a risk versus reward playstyle. His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Die, Whelp![-][/c] hurls boulders at his foes, devastating them with debuffs such as Vulnerable with additional effects while in the Grand Arenas game mode.\n\nEarn Taron Malicos during the upcoming Conquest events!
NEWSLETTER_TARON_MALICOS_TITLE|Dark Wanderer 
NEWSLETTER_TB_CANCELLED_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nDue to technical difficulties the current run of Territory Battles has been cancelled. Players will receive rewards in the near future based on recent historical Territory Battle performance.\n\nWe plan to resume Territory Battles upon the next scheduled instance.\n\nWe apologize for the inconvenience.
NEWSLETTER_TB_CANCELLED_TITLE|Territory Battles Cancelled
NEWSLETTER_TB_GEONOSIS_DESC|Wat’s up Holotable Heroes,\n\nJoin the new Territory Battle, [c][F0FF23]Geonosis: Separatist Might[-][/c] starting this week! Will your guild choose to defend against the invading clone trooper army and earn brand new rewards, or will you continue to fight over the Rebel base on Hoth? Battling across the dusty Geonosian territories will be no easy task, but succeed and your guild can earn shards of [c][F0FF23]Wat Tambor[-][/c], leader of the Techno Union, and a new currency to buy blueprints of General Kenobi’s capital ship, [c][F0FF23]Negotiator[-][/c]. Prepare your strongest Dark Side units to take on waves of Clone Troopers, call in Droid reinforcements and even slay a terrifying monster from the Petranaki arena.\n\nCheck out the other newsletter for more details about the new characters and ships added with this update!
NEWSLETTER_TB_GEONOSIS_TITLE|The Separatists Need You!
NEWSLETTER_TB_GEONOSIS_UNITS_DESC|We’ve added 3 new units to the Holotables today!\n\nGeneral Kenobi was known as “the Negotiator” during the Clone Wars, but his Venator-class Star Destroyer also went by the same name. Unlock General Kenobi’s [c][F0FF23]Negotiator[-][/c] with a new currency from the next Territory Battle, Geonosis: Separatist Might, by fighting alongside the Separatists to stop the invading clone army. Kenobi brings along a few friends as well: Two Arquitens-class light cruisers flank Negotiator and provide fire support, plus the capital ship can call in a formation of Y-wings to assault the enemy fleet!\n\nThe Techno Union is at your disposal thanks to [c][F0FF23]Wat Tambor[-][/c]. His deep connections to the galaxy’s most advanced technology firms will provide your squad with a variety of tech upgrades that can transform your strategy. This powerful support character is unlocked from a Special Mission in the Geonosian Territory Battle and you’ll need to bring in a team of Geonosians for the fight.\n\nA veteran of many fierce battles, the [c][F0FF23]Geonosian Brood Alpha[-][/c] is a strong Leader for the Geonosian faction who drives his swarm to victory with a flurry of attacks. This battle tactician never fights alone and can summon a Geonosian Brute to assist in engaging the enemy. The new [c][F0FF23]Hive Mind[-][/c] buff from Geonosian Brood Alpha sustains the team through heavy burst damage by constantly equalizing Health and Protection among Geonosian allies. The Geonosian Brood Alpha will be needed to enter the Special Mission to earn Wat Tambor shards.
NEWSLETTER_TB_GEONOSIS_UNITS_TITLE|What’s New On The Holotable!
NEWSLETTER_TB_HOTH_EMPIRE_DESC|Territory Battles takes a darker turn with the arrival of the Empire on the planet Hoth in Imperial Retaliation.\n\nThis release includes the explosive Imperial Probe Droid, the formidable Colonel Starck, and the fearsome Hoth predator, the Wampa.\n\nNow for the first time in Galaxy of Heroes, players can acquire a creature! Enemies will cower before the imposing might of the Wampa who attacks relentlessly, with each hit increasing his strength. Opponents who do not stop the Wampa fast enough will find themselves quickly overwhelmed and defeated.\n\nAlso incoming, the Imperial Probe Droid is the first character that inflicts Target Lock, providing the Empire a source of Expose. Colonel Starck provides Empire allies powerful critical buffs and is a fearsome addition to any Imperial Trooper squad.\n\nWampa can be found in the Guild Event Store. The Imperial Probe Droid can be found on the Imperial Retaliation map as a reward and limited time Packs and Bundles. Colonel Starck can be found in Guild Shipments and limited time Packs and Bundles.
NEWSLETTER_TB_HOTH_EMPIRE_TITLE|Imperial Retaliation
NEWSLETTER_TB_MERRIN_MISSION_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's update adds a new mission on Dathomir to the Territory Battle: Rise of the Empire. Rally Merrin and your Nightsisters to earn MkII Guild Event Tokens for your whole guild!
NEWSLETTER_TB_MERRIN_MISSION_TITLE|New Rise of the Empire Mission
NEWSLETTER_TB_NEW_MISSION_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's update adds a new mission on Bracca to the Territory Battle: Rise of the Empire. Take on Second Sister with Cere Junda and Cal Kestis or the upcoming Cal Kestis (Survivor) to earn MkII Guild Event Tokens for your whole guild!
NEWSLETTER_TB_NEW_MISSION_TITLE|New Rise of the Empire Mission
NEWSLETTER_TB_REPUBLIC_OFFENSIVE_DESC|[i]"More happening on Geonosis, I feel, than has been revealed."[/i] -Yoda\n\nWar rages across the surface of Geonosis as Count Dooku attempts to repel the Republic invasion. Gather your finest Clone Troopers and Galactic Republic characters and head to the Petranaki Arena to battle the terrifying Reek, but watch your back, the Nexu also stalks your squad and could be hiding around any corner. Stop these vicious beasts from ripping apart the Galactic Republic with an army of Clone Troopers or Padme and her close allies. Unlock new Clone Wars era characters and ships such as [c][F0FF23]Ki Adi Mundi[-][/c] or General Grievous' heavy cruiser, [c][F0FF23]Malevolence[-][/c], in this new [c][F0FF23]Territory Battle, Republic Offensive[-][/c].\n\nCan your guild liberate Geonosis from Separatists' grip?
NEWSLETTER_TB_REPUBLIC_OFFENSIVE_TITLE|The Galactic Republic Offensive
NEWSLETTER_TB_SAW_GERRERA_MISSION_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's update adds a new mission on Kashyyyk to the Territory Battle: Rise of the Empire. Rally Saw Gerrera and your Rebel Fighters to earn Mk II Guild Event Tokens for your whole guild!
NEWSLETTER_TB_SAW_GERRERA_MISSION_TITLE|New Rise of the Empire Mission
NEWSLETTER_TECH_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe next Bad Batch Clone Trooper to join the Holotables is [c][F0FF23]Tech[-][/c]! The highly technical trooper in scout armor serves as the brains of the Bad Batch and provides his allies support by handling the more delicate parts of their operations. He has modified his armor with advanced electronic systems that allow him to calculate complex trajectories, translate alien languages, and access many different types of computer systems.\n\nWhile Tech is leaner compared to his clone counterparts, he is no less skilled in combat. He can use his [c][F0FF23]Brilliant Idea[-][/c] ability to deal damage to his enemies and dispel all debuffs from Clone Trooper allies while all Bad Batch allies gain Foresight, Stealth, and Tenacity Up. \n\nUnlock Tech in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 II[-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_TECH_TITLE|The Brains of the Bunch
NEWSLETTER_TEMPLE_GUARD_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Temple Guard[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nA silent sentinel charged with protecting the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the Temple Guard embodied the principles of the Jedi Order, upholding peace and justice through stoic determination and unwavering patience.\n\nAs the Tank for the Jedi Vanguard team, Temple Guard finds themselves at the front of the battle, taking the hits meant for their teammates. Their Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Unbroken Blade[-][/c], has them attacking additional times if they are Taunting or the target has Defense Down. Their first Special, [c][F0FF23]Fear Leads To Anger[-][/c], damages all enemies and Ability Blocks them, healing and protecting Jedi and Jedi Vanguard allies based on the number of enemies Ability Blocked.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Stoic Determination[-][/c], Temple Guard's second Special, grants them Critical Avoidance Up and Taunt while Stealthing another Light Side ally and removing Turn Meter from enemies. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Patience... Is A Virtue[-][/c], provides them with inherent Critical Avoidance and Defense, increasing with their Relic Amplifier level and further enhanced by Critical Avoidance Up.\n\nAt the start of battle, Temple Guard gains benefits based on their allies' factions and roles, providing Taunt, Protection Up, and more for Galactic Republic Jedi and Jedi Vanguard squads. When a Jedi Vanguard ally loses all of their Protection for the first time, Temple Guard Taunts and gains Critical Avoidance Up. In the Grand Arenas game mode, Galactic Republic Jedi allies receive substantial offensive and defensive boosts, which are even greater if all allies are Jedi Vanguard.\n\nTemple Guard is a required unit for unlocking Jedi Master Mace Windu, so you’ll want to unlock Temple Guard in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"TWILIGHT OF THE JEDI I"[-][/c] Marquee event. The Marquee event [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
NEWSLETTER_TEMPLE_GUARD_TITLE|Guardians of Peace and Justice
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLE_RISE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes!\n\nOur latest Territory Battle, [c][F0FF23]RISE OF THE EMPIRE[-][/c], is hitting the Holotables. Starting on December 12th, your guild can select this new Territory Battle if the guild has a total of 200 million GP or more. The surviving Jedi are in hiding, Palpatine has been declared Emperor, the rumblings of Rebellion have begun to stir, and the Hutt Cartels are keeping their heads low and profits high. Every alignment and the entire galaxy are in play in this Territory Battle, meaning your entire roster will be tested in various locations throughout the Star Wars universe. Battles will be fought harkening back to the time period from the end of Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith on Mustafar and Coruscant, and taking you all the way to the time of the Rebellion in Star Wars: A New Hope on Scarif, Tatooine, and the Empire's first Death Star. Battles on the ground and in space are located within the same zone, so your guild will need to fight everything on all fronts if they hope to get three stars in any given phase.\n\nOperations are the new name for Platoons and now support both Characters and Ships so careful planning must be made to ensure they are filled to strengthen or weaken the Operation Abilities tied to that phase. A mix of existing Planetary Modifiers (from Galactic Challenges) and new ones will ensure every combat and special mission is its own unique challenge, so remember to share your winning strategies with your guild.\n\nAs with all Territory Battles, many missions will require specific units or factions. As you battle across the galaxy, you will find missions requiring you to bring the Grand Inquisitor, Jabba the Hutt, Scythe, or Doctor Aphra, at or better than specific Relic levels.\n\nThe Rise of the Empire Territory Battle runs for 6 days, with 24-hour phases, to have your guild complete their battles and deployments. The earliest phases are tuned for Relic Level 5 characters and ship crews, with the difficulty increasing each phase. Grab your lightsabers, warm up your X-wings, and make sure you're on Jabba's good side, the Rise of the Empire Territory Battle starts soon!
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLE_RISE_TITLE|The More You Tighten Your Grip, the More Star Systems Slip Through Your Fingers
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLES_DESC|We are super excited to share our newest feature, Territory Battles! This is an epic, multi-phase battle that pitches the entire collection of characters and ships of every guild member against a progressively challenging, living battlefield.\n\n-Increase your Galactic Power with every unit earned and upgraded\n\n-Work collaboratively with your Guild to bring in over 7,000 units into battle and earn the best rewards together (All members earn equal rewards)\n\n-Earn brand new characters Hermit Yoda and Rebel Officer Leia Organa\n\n-Make your characters stronger than ever with Gear Tier XII\n\n-Unlock special abilities like the Ion Cannon in Platoon Missions\n\n-Find a Guild faster with Guild Search\n\nHave fun and thanks for joining the fight!
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_BATTLES_TITLE|Territory Battles Has Arrived
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_WARS_DESC|Get prepared for the ultimate Guild vs. Guild showdown, Territory Wars, a new guild event that pits your Guild and collection against other Guilds and their collections for the true test of who is on top!\n\n-Prepare your territories for invasion by setting defenses\n\n-Conquer enemy territories as you annihilate their defenses\n\n-Use all new Guild Leader/Officer commands to direct your guildmates in both Territory Wars and Battles\n\n-Climb the leaderboard and show the world your guild's power\n\n-Anticipate regular changes to keep gameplay varied and exciting! These could include unique unit bonuses and Platoon Missions.\n\nIf you're not already part of a Guild, there are so many other advantages to joining one now:\n\n-Earn exclusive gear and characters like Hermit Yoda, General Kenobi, Han Solo, and Rebel Officer Leia Organa!\n\n-Territory Battles: Coordinate your forces to crush the rebellion on Hoth (or push back the Empire)\n\n-Raids: Fight the Rancor in his pit and an AAT on Geonosis\n\n-Request and Donate gear\n\nGo find a Guild Now!
NEWSLETTER_TERRITORY_WARS_TITLE|Territory Wars 
NEWSLETTER_THE_ARMORER_DESC|Hello Holotable Heroes,\n\nIt's hammer time. [c][F0FF23]The Armorer[-][/c] makes her way from the forge to the Holotables! Her expertise in forging Beskar, in addition to her wealth of traditional Mandalorian knowledge, ensured The Armorer would become a quick and steadfast ally of certain Outer Rim bounty hunters.\n\nWith her tools in hand, The Armorer is ready to distribute the new [c][F0FF23]Beskar Armor[-][/c] buff, increasing her allies' survivability by granting Defense, Health, Protection recovery, Critical Hit Immunity and Counter Chance.\n\nIn addition to The Armorer's abilities, she also introduces the brand new [c][F0FF23]Mandalorian[-][/c] faction tag to Galaxy of Heroes! This tag will also be added to the following characters: The Mandalorian, The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor), Jango Fett, Sabine Wren, Gar Saxon, Imperial Super Commando, and Canderous Ordo.\n\nMake The Armorer part of your tribe by unlocking her in the all new Marquee Event WAY OF THE MANDALORE!
NEWSLETTER_THE_ARMORER_TITLE|Our Survival Is Our Strength
NEWSLETTER_THE_STRANGER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]The Stranger[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nHailing from the High Republic era, this enigmatic warrior exploded onto the scene in the forest of Khofar in the Disney+ show, The Acolyte. The Stranger's power is undeniable, cutting down an entire team of Jedi with relative ease. Acting as a mentor to both light and dark side Force users, he seeks to gather a group of powerful students while pursuing his own agenda.\n\nThe Stranger's Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]I Want a Pupil[-][/c], allows him to transform a carefully selected team of Force users into Acolytes, granting them powerful synergies and abilities. It’s no coincidence that the prerequisites for this perfectly sync with the team that Starkiller is looking to assemble. His Special ability, [c][F0FF23]An Acolyte Kills the Dream[-][/c], showcases his tactical prowess by calling Dark Side Unaligned Force User Acolytes to assist while providing defensive benefits to himself and debuffing enemies.\n\nThe Stranger excels at accumulating power throughout battle through his Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Peace is a Lie[-][/c] and his devastating Special ability [c][F0FF23]Was That Its Name?[-][/c], both of which have the capability of instantly defeating opponents. His Unique ability [c][F0FF23]You Might Call Me...Sith[-][/c] provides him with impressive offensive capabilities and defensive measures through Cortosis Armor, making him a formidable opponent in any battle.\n\nFace the challenge of acquiring The Stranger in the upcoming Conquest season! This powerful character offers exceptional leadership for mixed Light and Dark side teams, and brings particular strength to Grand Arena battles through multiple Omicron abilities. Players can earn The Stranger in Conquests starting on 10/27/2025.
NEWSLETTER_THE_STRANGER_TITLE|Stranger Danger
NEWSLETTER_THRAWN_MYTHIC_DESC|The Holotable continues the relentless march of the dark side with the release of the [i]Artist of War[/i] Mythic event.\n\nGather your Phoenix Squadron and face Grand Admiral Thrawn or join forces with the Grand Admiral and crush the Phoenix Rebels! This new multi-tier Mythic event is intended for elder players and has valuable rewards should you succeed.\n\nMaster the [i]Artist of War[/i] today!
NEWSLETTER_THRAWN_MYTHIC_TITLE|Portrait of War
NEWSLETTER_THREEPIO_CHEWIE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nFew pairings in Star Wars have had each other’s backs like [c][F0FF23]Threepio & Chewie[-][/c], who are arriving as a unique combo on the Holotables! The bond forged on Cloud City between one of our favorite droids and Wookiees showed the Empire this unlikely duo is a force to be reckoned with. In addition to being a unique combination unit, Threepio & Chewie offer new gameplay strategies by providing both damage and support abilities, ramping damage, and afflicting [c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c] on enemies. Only an overgrown mophead would miss out on the chance to add Threepio & Chewie to their collection! So, don't do anything foolish and make sure to participate in the Marquee event, [c][F0FF23]Escape From Cloud City[-][/c].
NEWSLETTER_THREEPIO_CHEWIE_TITLE|[i]What Have You Done? I'm Backwards![/i]
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ADVANCED_PVP_TOURNAMENT01_DESC|Earn blueprints for Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1 ship! This Imperial vessel is exclusively available in the BOARDING ACTION SQUAD TOURNAMENT starting Monday. In order to add this ship to your collection, this event requires players to be level 30 or higher.\n\nOnce unlocked, you will need to also have Darth Vader in order to use the TIE Advanced in combat. Dominate the leaderboard in the Boarding Action Squad Tournament to earn this iconic ship!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ADVANCED_PVP_TOURNAMENT01_TITLE|Boarding Action Squad Tournament
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ADVANCED_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_DESC|Earn blueprints for Darth Vader’s personal ship, the TIE Advanced x1! This imperial vessel is available in the BOARDING ACTION SQUAD TOURNAMENT starting Sunday. You will need to be at least level 30 in order to have a chance of adding this ship to your collection.\n\nOnce unlocked, this powerful ship can be piloted by Darth Vader and added to your fleet. Dominate the leaderboard in the Boarding Action Squad Tournament to earn Darth Vader's TIE Advanced x1!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ADVANCED_PVP_TOURNAMENT02_TITLE|The Boarding Action Squad Tournament Returns!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_DAGGER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Dark Side reigns! [c][F0FF23]TIE Dagger[-][/c], piloted by Sith Trooper and the next piece to the upcoming dominant Sith fleet, is coming to the holotables!\n\nThe TIE Dagger brings a high damage attacker to the Sith Fleet. Through its unique [c][F0FF23]Emperor’s Edict[-][/c] the ship gains stacks of [c][F0FF23]Vengeance[-][/c] when enemies attack out of turn or inflict debuffs. When it reaches enough stacks of Vengeance all debuffs are dispelled on Sith allies, it recovers Health, gains stacking Offense, and then takes a bonus turn. During this bonus turn, TIE Dagger will be able to ignore Taunt and when under a Sith Capital Ship, Protection as well.\n\nTIE Dagger is also able to apply some powerful debuffs. When it uses its Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Sith Precision[-][/c] and scores a critical hit, the enemy is inflicted with Ability Block. Additionally, [c][F0FF23]L-7.0 Heavy Laser Cannons[-][/c] can apply Vulnerable to full Health enemies and Tenacity Down to non-full Health enemies.\n\nUnlock the TIE Dagger in the upcoming Galactic Chase event and prepare for the Leviathan!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_DAGGER_TITLE|Blinded by the Sith
NEWSLETTER_TIE_DEFENDER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]TIE Defender[-][/c], piloted by the elite Iden Versio, is coming to the holotables!\n\nThe TIE Defender is set up well to bolster the Empire fleet with the reinforcement ability [c][F0FF23]We Weren't Expecting Special Forces.[-][/c] This grants the new status effect [c][F0FF23]Special Forces[-][/c] that empowers the TIE Defender's other abilities through extra damage, Turn Meter for itself and its Capital ship, and a Stun that can't be evaded, dispelled, or resisted.\n\nTIE Defender has good evasion and foresight synergy from its Unique abilities [c][F0FF23]P-sz9.7 Twin Ion Engine[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]TIE/x7[-][/c]. The latter provides Foresight when TIE Defender has at least one stack of Resilient Defense, which it gains from landing critical hits from its Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Wingtip L-s9.3 Laser Cannons[-][/c], making it quite tricky to take out. This is amplified by the TIE Defender counting as a TIE fighter, making it a strong reinforcement for the Executrix lead fleet with Scythe.\n\nUnlock the TIE Defender in the upcoming Galactic Chase event!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_DEFENDER_TITLE|A Superior Fighter
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ECHELON_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe [c][F0FF23]TIE Echelon[-][/c] is zooming onto the holotables! Piloted by First Order Officer, this impressive tank is ready to provide cover for its allies as they crush the opposition.\n\nThe TIE Echelon increases a First Order fleet’s survivability by granting Protection Up to itself and its allies. To keep its allies safe, TIE Echelon can call First Order allies to assist and then grant them Stealth. Enemy fleets will be forced to focus on the TIE Echelon only to find it's a serious challenge to defeat. This ship continuously gains Defense, Max Health, and Max Protection throughout the battle and recovers Health and Protection whenever a First Order ally lands a critical hit. When called upon for reinforcement, the TIE Echelon gains Taunt whenever a First Order ally's Stealth expires.\n\nUnlock the TIE Echelon during the upcoming [c][F0FF23]Galactic Chase[-][/c] event to add this capable tank to your fleet collection!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_ECHELON_TITLE|Galactic Chase: TIE Echelon
NEWSLETTER_TIE_FIGHTER_DROP_DESC|The TIE Fighter Pilot is now available in Cantina Battles Stage 4 Mission B! This relentless attacker is a great addition to Empire squads with the ability to call down a "TIE Strike," dealing damage to all enemies and inflicting Buff immunity for 2 rounds. His two other abilities, "Targeting Computer" and "Evasive Maneuvers", give great synergy with other Empire units who can debuff enemy squads, granting him increased damage and turn meter with the former and a chance to gain Foresight with the latter. \n\nAdd the TIE Fighter Pilot to your squad today!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_FIGHTER_DROP_TITLE|TIE Fighter Pilot is now available in Cantina Battles!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_INTERCEPTOR_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nConquest 13 begins soon and blueprints for a new ship, the [c][F0FF23]TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype[-][/c], will be available for a limited time in this mode! Piloted by Second Sister, the TIE Interceptor is a powerful reinforcement for Empire fleets. Its Unique, [c][F0FF23]Prototype Design[-][/c], grants TIE Interceptor Foresight when an Empire, Inquisitorius, or Sith ally reinforces, and the allied Capital ship gains Turn Meter when the TIE Interceptor scores a critical hit.\n\nThe TIE Interceptor also introduces two new effects, [c][F0FF23]Ruthless[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Pursued Target[-][/c]. Ruthless is a buff that increases offensive capabilities while Pursued Target is a status effect which allows the TIE Interceptor to ignore Taunt to attack the units with Pursued Target. The TIE Interceptor also gains Turn Meter when it attacks enemies with Pursued Target.\n\nFurthermore, as a leader of the Inquisitors, Darth Vader now reduces allied Empire Capital Ship cooldowns when TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype starts in reinforcements and TIE Advanced x1 is on the field. This effect is being added to the final tier of his Unique, [c][F0FF23]Advanced Targeting System[-][/c].\n\nEarn TIE/IN Interceptor Prototype blueprints during the upcoming Conquest events!
NEWSLETTER_TIE_INTERCEPTOR_TITLE|The Empire's Inquisitors Join The Fleet
NEWSLETTER_TIEFIGHTERPILOT_DESC|The TIE Fighter Pilot has landed. Login daily this month to unlock this Imperial pilot. This relentless attacker is a great addition to Empire squads with the ability to call down a “TIE Strike,” dealing damage to all enemies and inflicting Buff immunity for 2 rounds. His two other abilities, “Targeting Computer” and “Evasive Maneuvers”, give great synergy with other Empire units who can debuff enemy squads.\n\nBe sure to login daily during the month of October and add this fearless pilot to your collection!
NEWSLETTER_TIEFIGHTERPILOT_TITLE|October’s Daily Login: TIE Fighter Pilot
NEWSLETTER_TOURNAMENT_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|A new event is approaching! For more details on this event and its schedule check out the forum post found here https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/discussion/76100/event-information/
NEWSLETTER_TOURNAMENT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|New Event Coming!
NEWSLETTER_TRIPLEZERO_BT1_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]0-0-0[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]BT-1,[-][/c] Doctor Aphra's droids and products of the good sir Tarkin's initiative, are coming to the holotables!\n\n0-0-0's Special ability [c][F0FF23]Specialized in Torture[-][/c] fulfills its namesake by inflicting Torture on enemies and granting Translation to Dark Side allies if the target already had Torture. In 3v3 Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, Torture will last longer on the target and if this defeats an enemy, Dark Side allies will stack Offense. His first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Interrogation Protocol,[-][/c] provides Translation to Dark Side allies when they use an ability on enemies with Torture, and his second Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Drain Organics[-][/c] allows 0-0-0 and BT-1 to grant each other Translation if they gain it and gives Turn Meter to Dark Side allies when they defeat a non-Droid enemy.\n\nBT-1's Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Overcharged Laser[-][/c] and Special ability [c][F0FF23]Agent of Destruction[-][/c] lay down debuffs including Damage Over Time and Expose. If 0-0-0 is an ally, BT-1 assists 0-0-0 through his first Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Homicidal Counterpart[-][/c] and in 3v3 Grand Arenas with an Omicron upgrade, if either of them defeats an enemy they refresh their cooldowns and gain Turn Meter. This ability also gives the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Kill Them All,[-][/c] which calls 0-0-0 to assist. His second Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Blastomech Prototype[-][/c] gives BT-1 plenty of Offense and if he defeats an enemy, he becomes so excited that he takes a bonus turn to use the granted ability [c][F0FF23]Haywire[-][/c] which damages everyone on the field. 0-0-0 was right when he called BT-1 a selfish little murder bucket!\n\nThese droids form such a powerful duo that not only do their kits heavily benefit from them being together on the field, they also share an event! Add 0-0-0 and BT-1 to your roster by unlocking them in the all-new “MURDER AND MANNERS” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_TRIPLEZERO_BT1_TITLE|Entirely Homicidal
NEWSLETTER_TU1_BALANCE_CHANGES_CHANGELOG|Greetings heroes!\n\nWe just released a major update to the balance of the game. Here are some details:\n\nAll units now have ability upgrades available. Make sure to go back to your Characters screen to check for new available upgrades!\n\nAll units have received a balance pass against their damage ratio values on damaging abilities. Underperforming units increased in damaging effectiveness whereas those over performing have been brought more in-line with intended results.\n\nAll Light and Dark Missions have been adjusted to accommodate for new unit balance changes.\n\nSpecial Damage type abilities have been brought in-line with the Physical Damage type ability counterparts.\n\nWe expect that there may be some issues with ability behavior. As always, we will continue to release updates that include bug fixes for unit abilities.\n\nWe hope you will continue to enjoy Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes as we balance and improve the game to make it as fun and fair as we can!\n\n-The Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes team
NEWSLETTER_TU1_CHANGES|Attention Holotable masters, now you can build squads with all your favorite characters,regardless of alignment, with new Cantina Battles. Plus, check out these other new features:\n\nGalactic War Mode – Unlocks at Level 40. Your characters’ health will not regenerate between battles!\n\nSim Tickets – These new reward drops, earned after scoring 3 stars on a mission, let you repeat missions to gain more rewards faster.\n\nUpdated Map – Get a look at the next boss you’ll face in Normal missions and which character shard you could earn in Hard missions.\n\nThanks for playing Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes. Let us know how we’re doing with a rating!
NEWSLETTER_TU11_QOL_DESC|Get excited – everything you love just got better! Now you can:\n\n• Earn the right to multi-sim Galactic War and Ship Challenges\n\n• Receive bonus banners based on combat performance in Territory Wars \n\n• View which Territory War defensive squads were most successful \n\n• Search for units by name when selecting your squad\n\n• Link accounts to play between Android and iOS devices\n\n• Set inactive units as favorites and find all favorites easier\n\n• Research and purchase shipments faster \n\n• View major improvements to the Raids Ticket (Daily) leaderboard\n\n• and so much more!\n\nCheck out the full update notes over at the forums!
NEWSLETTER_TU12_DESC|We've updated the Holotables and added some exciting new features!\n\nEmbark on Quests and tackle challenges from various Cantina characters and learn the lessons needed to become a Holotable champion! Demonstrate your mastery by completing an elite set of Prestigious Quests meant for only the strongest players to earn Player Titles and glory. Player Titles show your competitors the power of your collection and strategies!\n\nPlayers can now join a Starter Guild beginning at level 22! Learn how Guilds work early with a Guild of players near your level before more advanced Guild content. Chat has also been updated to allow players to: send direct messages, create up to 5 Guild Chats, Exchange Gear directly in chat, and join Group Chats of up to 500 players. Guild leaders/officers can also now: schedule raid start times, raid damage allowed times, and Officers can now update the Guild Message in up to 5 Guild Chats.\n\nShips combat has been reworked! Prepare to take your Fleets to the next level with Reinforcement Abilities! All Ship ability kits and stats have also been reworked to make battles more exciting and strategic! Experience reworked Ships combat in Territory Wars, Territory Battles, Fleet Arena, and Ship Challenges. The Ship Ability Materials Challenge has been expanded to include a new tier where players can earn new rewards. We've also added 'Fleet Battles', a new Ships PvE table! Fleet Battles are locked for now, but are coming very soon. What Fleet will you choose to lead you to victory?
NEWSLETTER_TU12_TITLE|Improved Chat, Starter Guilds, Reworked Ship Combat, and much more!
NEWSLETTER_TU17_UPDATE02_SHIPS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nTwo brand new ships have landed on the holotables, the Galactic Republic’s [c][f0ff23]BTL-B Y-wing[-][/c] and the Separatist [c][f0ff23]Hyena Bomber[-][/c].\n\nThe BTL-B Y-wing is an aggressive bomber that can take a beating compared to the stripped down counter part used by the rebellion. Armed with proton bombs and a bubble turret to defend against incoming fighters, the Y-wing can attack even the most heavily defended targets and punch through the enemy’s Taunt. Get shards of the BTL-B Y-wing in an upcoming Marquee event!\n\nThe Separatists also gained a heavily armored bomber to assist their faction’s fleet. The Hyena Bomber is effective at protecting Vulture Droid allies and absorbing an incredible amount of fire power depending on how many Separatist and Droid allies are present but this droid controlled bomber is not just a tank. It can also launch salvos of Buzz Droids at the enemy to weaken their armor and provide allied Separatist ships powerful advantages. Get shards of the Hyena Bomber in the upcoming Galactic Chase starting Nov 1st!
NEWSLETTER_TU17_UPDATE02_SHIPS_TITLE|We’re Starting Our Attack Run!
NEWSLETTER_TU2_PVP_RANKED_REWARDS_DESC|You will now earn Crystals, Arena Tokens, and Credits every day based on your ranking in the Arena. The better your position on the Leaderboard, the better your reward!\n\nRank #1\n500 Crystals, 50K Credits, and 1K Arena Tokens\n\nRank #2\n450 Crystals, 48K Credits, and 950 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #3\n400 Crystals, 46K Credits, and 900 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #4\n350 Crystals, 44K Credits, and 875 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #5\n300 Crystals, 42K Credits, and 850 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #6-10\n250 Crystals, 40K Credits, and 800 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #11-20\n200 Crystals, 30K Credits, and 775 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #21-50\n150 Crystals, 25K Credits, and 750 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #51-100\n100 Crystals, 22.5K Credits, and 725 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #101-200\n75 Crystals, 20K Credits, and 700 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #201-500\n60 Crystals, 18K Credits, and 600 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #501-1000\n50 Crystals, 16K Credits, and 500 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #1001-2500\n40 Crystals, 14K Credits, and 400 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #2501-5000\n35 Crystals, 12K Credits, and 300 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #5001-10000\n25 Crystals, 10K Credits, and 200 Arena Tokens\n\nRank #10001+\n15 Crystals, 5K Credits, and 150 Arena Tokens
NEWSLETTER_TU2_PVP_RANKED_REWARDS_TITLE|New PvP Rank Rewards
NEWSLETTER_TU2_PVP_SEGMENTATION_DESC|Greetings players! We are changing the way that PvP leaderboards work in the game. Going forward, players will be segmented across multiple leaderboards and as a result, your rank may change.
NEWSLETTER_TU2_PVP_SEGMENTATION_TITLE|PvP Rank Change Notice
NEWSLETTER_TU3_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Greetings Heroes,\n\nThis latest update brings an exciting new challenge to players, the Grand Master’s Training Event. In this event you will be able to challenge Grand Master Yoda with a team of Jedi to earn Crystals, Credits and character shards for Grand Master Yoda himself!\n\nAlong with this new event comes new features such as the Shard Shop, a place where you can trade in excess shards you have for your 7 star characters, as well as various bug fixes and visual game improvements.\n\nFor complete details on this update please visit our forums at https://forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars.ea.com/
NEWSLETTER_TU3_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|New Update: Grand Master Yoda!
NEWSLETTER_TU38_NAME|A New Era Has Begun
NEWSLETTER_TU38_SUMMARY|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nHappy 10th Anniversary! As part of this momentous occasion, the game has been updated with a ton of new features!\n\nYou might have noticed something was different the moment you stepped into the Cantina. Now front and center is the latest Marquee event and place to play with them immediately, an all new game mode, Coliseum! Light and Dark Side battles have been moved to the Campaigns tables (formerly the Cantina Table).\n\nThe Era system has been updated and now Marquees have their own progression system during the Era. During each Era, players will be granted the Era Marquee units automatically when their event begins. Battle it out in the Coliseum immediately to earn new materials to upgrade your Marquee units. Face the latest bosses on the Coliseum floor with daily rotating Boss encounters. Who are the Hutts throwing at you this time?! Each Era also contains a special Era Journey Guide Unit that can help you power up your Squads during and after the Era.\n\nEvery other week during an Era you will find Era Challenge events, where you can take on new foes designed to test your Marquee squad’s strength! Era Challenges replace Galactic Challenges and the Episode Pass rewards have moved to Episode Quests.\n\nAfter the Era, these units will be converted to the Legacy progression system and come out upgraded based on the Era Level each unit reached.\n\nCheck out the official forums for more information on these many changes!
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_01_DESC|Is your collection ready? Visit the forums to watch the all-new teaser video for our next major update!
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_01_TITLE|Something big is coming
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_02_DESC|More details on the next major update are available on the forums!
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_02_TITLE|Next Update Preview
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_03_DESC|Are you ready for Guilds and Raids? Be sure to check out the forums to get more information on these exciting new features.
NEWSLETTER_TU4_UPCOMING_FEATURES_03_TITLE|Guilds and Raids are almost here
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_CHIEFTAIN_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nComing from the tribe of Tuskens that took in Boba Fett in the Dune Sea of Tatooine, the [c][F0FF23]Tusken Chieftain[-][/c] is coming to the holotables!\n\nTusken Chieftain brings a new Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Nomadic People[-][/c], to the Tusken faction. Boba Fett, Scion of Jango introduced the Momentum effect to the game and this ability expands it to the Tuskens. Through the Leader, Tusken allies will gain a Momentum stack when an enemy gains bonus turn meter and Tuskens gain Defense and Tenacity for each stack they have.  If a Tusken has enough Momentum when they are targeted, targeting enemies will be hit with a Stun that can't be resisted and the attacked Tusken will lose all Momentum with a chance to inflict a Damage Over Time for each stack lost.\n\nIn 3v3 Grand Arenas with the Omicron upgrade to this Leader ability, Boba Fett, Scion of Jango will count as a Tusken ally assuming there are no summoned units on your side. Additionally, he starts the battle with his payout active and will not lose his Momentum stacks when attacked, making his Special abilities very threatening.\n\nWhile this Tusken team works primarily with Momentum, they also have an affinity for Damage Over Time. Through Tusken Chieftain’s Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Ancestral Claim[-][/c], enemies who recover health or protection are inflicted with a Damage Over Time and Tuskens recover health whenever an enemy takes damage from it. Furthermore, the Tuskens’ own resilience to the harsh desert makes them immune to Damage Over Time.\n\nUnlock Tusken Chieftain in the new “Warriors of the Dune Sea” Marquee event and prepare for the Tusken faction to finally be complete in the next release with the Tusken Warrior!
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_CHIEFTAIN_TITLE|Rich Tradition
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_SHAMAN_CHROMIUM_DESC|Tusken Shaman is now available in Chromium Packs! This offensive healer is able to buff and heal his allies while rapidly inflicting Damage Over Time effects on his enemies.\n\nTusken Shaman is great for Tusken squads with his unique ability, “Master Storyteller”, providing all Tuskens with both Turn Meter and Health recovery for every defeated enemy. His abilities will also pair well with characters who debuff enemy units as each additional negative status effect increases his own abilities effectiveness!\n\nWill you be adding this desert savage to your squad?
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_SHAMAN_CHROMIUM_TITLE|New Chromium Pack Character: Tusken Shaman
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_WARRIOR_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nBorn of the harsh sands of the Dune Sea of Tatooine, a hard as nails huntress fights for her tribe! The [c][F0FF23]Tusken Warrior[-][/c], Boba Fett’s mentor and teacher, has arrived on the holotables to finally complete the Tusken faction.\n\nTusken Warrior expands the Tusken synergy with Damage Over Time and Momentum through her abilities and uses these effects to do big damage. Her Special ability [c][F0FF23]Finishing Strikes[-][/c] does more damage to the target enemy as Warrior has more Momentum, allowing her to ramp up for a big hit. This ability and her Basic ability [c][F0FF23]Gaderffii Smack[-][/c] inflict Damage Over Time, which empowers her Unique ability [c][F0FF23]Centuries of Tradition[-][/c] to increase the damage of her abilities for each Damage Over Time on all enemies and lowers enemy Tenacity when these expire.\n\nWith an Omicron upgrade in Territory Wars, Warrior will dispel herself, refresh the cooldown of her big hit, and take a bonus turn each time she gains enough Momentum.\n\nUnlock Tusken Warrior in the new “WARRIORS OF THE DUNE SEA II” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_TUSKEN_WARRIOR_TITLE|Warrior of the Dune Sea
NEWSLETTER_TW_CLONE_WARS_DESC|The Clone Wars era comes to the Territory Wars Holotable! For a limited time, Territory War bonuses have been upgraded and will affect the Territory Wars that begin on 11/3, 11/13, 11/17 and 11/27. Read on to see the high-level list of changes and be prepared for a new and exciting experience in your guild’s next Territory War…\n\nNew Specific Bonuses: The following characters will have specific bonuses in Territory Wars.\n\nCharacters: Mace Windu, General Grievous\n\nMystery Bonuses: Two characters (one Galactic Republic and one Separatist) have mystery bonuses you will only learn about when you enter your next Territory War.\n\nFor complete details, check out the details panel in Territory Wars or click the button below to go to the forums for a complete breakdown!
NEWSLETTER_TW_CLONE_WARS_TITLE|Clone Wars Rules
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_01_DESC|Territory Wars are coming soon! To prepare, check out these strategies that explain how to earn banners (points) to help secure victory for your Guild.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_01_TITLE|Territory Wars - Earning Banners
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_02_DESC|Before starting Territory Wars, you’ll want to assemble squads to defend your territories. Check out these recommendations on which characters make good defenders.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_02_TITLE|Territory Wars - Defensive Squads
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_03_DESC|In Territory Wars, you will need to choose different squads to use on defense and offense. Check out these tips on which characters to reserve as attackers.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_03_TITLE|Territory Wars - Offensive Squads
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_04_DESC|Certain territories in Territory Wars require ships. Here are some suggestions on which ships you might want to use.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_04_TITLE|Territory Wars - Ships
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_05_DESC|The Guild that works together, wins together. Here are some valuable tips on effectively coordinating with your Guild members.
NEWSLETTER_TW_PRELUDE_05_TITLE|Territory Wars - Teamwork
NEWSLETTER_TW_UPDATE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe’re shaking things up in Territory Wars! We heard positive feedback from the community about the limited-time character bonuses for the 10th anniversary of The Clone Wars, so we're continuing on that path.\n\nThis upcoming Territory War has been created by YOU, the community! You've voted to determine which of your favorite characters to bring into battle and which ones will stay on the sidelines. Head over to the forums to find out if your favorite characters made the cut!\n\nThe forums also have more details on the current community-driven Territory Wars, and stay tuned there for future rounds of voting to help shape Territory Wars!
NEWSLETTER_TW_UPDATE_TITLE|Territory Wars - Community Style
NEWSLETTER_UNITY_UPGRADE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday’s Update improves many of the underlying technologies that we use to create Galaxy of Heroes. These significant tech upgrades enable us to continue to support this amazing game for years to come and bring you the Star Wars experience better than ever.\n\nIt may seem like nothing has changed when you log in, but there are plenty of updates under the hood that allow for numerous improvements in the future. With a unified tool set and modernized APIs, these changes give the designers access to more tools and a smoother process for developing new content.\n\nOn the visual side, this update also enables us to create better character animations and cutscenes that truly capture the exciting moment of Star Wars. Some of those improvements you may have already seen in The Mandalorian characters or the Jedi Knight Luke event and this update allows us to do even more in the years to come.\n\nThis is a large, exciting update for the long term future of the game. We strive to provide you with the highest level of service because we believe in the game, and the community. That’s why we have invested time in upgrading the game’s technology, so we can all enjoy this game as passionate Star Wars fans for years to come.\n\nThank you all for your support!
NEWSLETTER_UNITY_UPGRADE_TITLE|Galaxy of Heroes Technology Update
NEWSLETTER_UNLOCKS_SEP_15_DESCRIPTION|Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes includes many features that unlock as you collect characters and increase your Player Level. Here's the complete list of unlockable features and their requirements:\n\nLight Side Battles: Use your light side characters to battle dark side characters. Unlocked at the beginning of the game.\n\nDark Side Battles: Use your dark side characters to battle light side characters. Unlocked after reaching Player Level 12 and collecting 3 or more dark side characters.\n\nSquad Arena: Battle other players' squads using any characters in your Collection. Unlocked at Player Level 8.\n\nChallenges: Uniquely difficult Battles that drop unique rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 15.\n\nGalactic War: Fight a multi-battle campaign where character health does not regenerate to unlock various rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 40.\n\nEvents And Keys: Collect Keys that allow you to fight in Event Battles that drop valuable rewards. Unlocks at Player Level 52.\n\nWe will be adding more features over the coming months.
NEWSLETTER_UNLOCKS_SEP_15_TITLE|Unlocking Features
NEWSLETTER_UPCOMING_CHARACTER_CHANGES_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nIn today's Update, Darth Vader, General Skywalker, Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, and Wat Tambor have had several changes to their kits in regards to ignoring Defense. Previously, we returned the resources used to upgrade these units beyond Relic 7 to your inbox and reset these units to Relic 7.\n\nWe have also updated several kits with Galactic Legends exceptions in addition to Raid Bosses exceptions. Related to this change, Dark Trooper was reset to Relic 5 if you had upgraded Dark Trooper beyond this level and any resources used to upgrade Dark Trooper above Relic 5 were returned to your inbox in the last Update.\n\nPlease visit the Official Forums for more information.
NEWSLETTER_UPCOMING_CHARACTER_CHANGES_TITLE|Upcoming Character Changes
NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_CANTINA_ENERGY_MESSAGE|With the introduction of Mods, we have reworked how Cantina Energy is refreshed. Previously, Cantina Energy refreshes scaled in cost far more aggressively than standard Energy refreshes. With this update we have brought the cost to refresh Cantina Energy down significantly so you can get the Shards, Ability Materials, and Mods you need!\n\nWe hope that you enjoy this change!
NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_CANTINA_ENERGY_TITLE|Updated Cantina Energy!
NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_WEBSITE_DESC|The official website for Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes has been revamped and now includes pages for game Strategies and Community contributions. Be sure to bookmark it in your browser and check in every week for new content.
NEWSLETTER_UPDATED_WEBSITE_TITLE|Updated Website
NEWSLETTER_VADER_REWORK_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nExcuse the heavy breathing, but we are excited to announce a rework of [c][F0FF23]Darth Vader[-][/c], the man behind the galaxy's most iconic mask, infamous Sith Lord, and a dad who just wants to spend more time with his son. Counted on as the Emperor's most loyal subject, Darth Vader relishes destroying his foes, squashing rebellions, and reminding pompous subordinates to not "choke" on their aspirations. Although he's more machine now than man, there's always room for improvement. As such, Vader will be getting an entirely new ability, [c][F0FF23]Merciless Massacre[-][/c]. Look for the Vader rework just in time for "I Am Your Father's" Day, and together...you can rule the Holotables!
NEWSLETTER_VADER_REWORK_TITLE|I Am Your Father's Day
NEWSLETTER_VANE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Vane[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nA ruthless Pirate Tank, Vane makes his fortune by plundering the trade routes of the Outer Rim. His greed, lust for credits, and mercurial loyalty know no bounds, and he will stop at nothing to amass a fortune beyond imagining.\n\nVane's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Myth of the Outer Rim[-][/c], transforms him into an unstoppable Tank when paired with a crew of Pirate allies. He Taunts whenever another Pirate gains Profit, equalizes his defenses with weaker allies, and becomes more evasive as debuffs stack on him. When [c][F0FF23]Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka[-][/c] is the Leader, Vane gains incredible synergies like damage reduction, Protection recovery, and increased Profit stacking.\n\nHis first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Put it Down, Little One[-][/c], allows Vane to Stun enemies when at higher Health or recover Health when weaker. If he has amassed enough Profit, he can even Steal and refresh Taunt from the enemy. His second Special, [c][F0FF23]It Must Be Fake[-][/c], dispels debuffs from his Pirate crew at the cost of inflicting them on himself, granting allies beneficial effects in return and increasing Vane's maximum Health.\n\nUnlock the fearsome [c][F0FF23]Vane[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"FORTUNE FAVORS THE BOLD II"[-][/c] marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c]! Vane will be a requirement (at Relic 7) for Galactic Legend Pirate King Hondo Ohnaka, as well as usable in the Order 66 Raid and Tales from the Outer Rim Era Battle.
NEWSLETTER_VANE_TITLE|He Probably Thinks this Newsletter is About Him
NEWSLETTER_VEL_SARTHA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nVel Sartha stands as a beacon of hope and resilience for the Rebel Alliance, her unwavering commitment to the cause matched only by her tactical brilliance. A seasoned operative who has survived impossible odds, Vel brings both cunning strategy and battle-tested combat ability to any situation.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c] serves as a Support pillar for the newest [c][F0FF23]Rebel Fighter[-][/c] squad, leveraging her tactical expertise to strengthen her allies while systematically Undermining her enemies. Her [c][F0FF23]BK-43 Blaster Rifle[-][/c] Basic attacks build her defensive resilience while crippling enemy offense, while her [c][F0FF23]Disrupting Barrage[-][/c] Special ability Blinds and protects her squad with a potent Entrenched buff that stacks benefits across her team.\n\nHer Unique abilities, [c][F0FF23]One Path One Choice[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]She Was a Miracle[-][/c], showcase her role as a force multiplier—sharing her impressive stats with Rebel Fighter allies, capitalizing on Undermined enemies, and protecting her closest ally Cinta through coordinated synergy. With her Omicron ability in the Territory Battles game mode, Vel powers up the Rebel Fighter squad with stacking Offense and the ability to quickly Undermine the entire enemy squad.\n\nUnlock [c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c] in [c][F0FF23]"The Price of Rebellion"[-][/c] Marquee event that features daily rewards and harness her power to achieve victory for the Rebel Fighters! Vel Sartha is required at 4 stars to unlock the Journey Guide unit Cassian Andor (Undercover).
NEWSLETTER_VEL_SARTHA_TITLE|Vel Yeah!
NEWSLETTER_VULTURE_DROID_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nThe Variable Geometry Self-Propelled Battle Droid, also known as the [c][F0FF23]Vulture Droid[-][/c], is coming to the holotables! This Droid starfighter, commonly used by the Trade Federation, is a fast and agile attacker that is easily damaged, but also easily replaced. These mass-produced ships are capable of launching Buzz Droids at enemy ships and ripping through their armor, weakening it for further attacks. For the first time on the holotables, this ship doesn’t require any crew, which means you can unlock the Vulture Droid and use it to reinforce your armada immediately. Bolster your fleet with this Separatist starfighter today!\n\nSee you on the holotables!
NEWSLETTER_VULTURE_DROID_TITLE|The Vulture Circles Its Prey
NEWSLETTER_WEDGE_CANTINA_MISSION_MESSAGE|Wedge is now available in Cantina Stage 6 Mission F. This talented Corellian Rebel pilot was a veteran of the attacks on both Death Stars. A leader in Red Squadron, Wedge, is a Rebel attacker with strong offensive abilities that deal more damage based enemy health and debuffs, while providing increased offence and health recovery to Rebel allies.\n\nWill you be adding this Rebel pilot to your squad?
NEWSLETTER_WEDGE_CANTINA_MISSION_TITLE|Wedge is now available in the Cantina Battles!
NEWSLETTER_WICKET_ATST_EVENT_DESC|Welcome our final addition to the Ewok invasion - Wicket arrives in the Galaxy of Heroes! This powerful attacker finds his strength in numbers, granting incredible critical hit and stealth synergies to Ewok squads, while also dealing more critical damage for each Ewok present. In addition, Wicket's unique, Furtive Tactics, gives Wicket a chance to take another turn, each turn.\n\nTo celebrate Wickets arrival, we're introducing a brand new type of event, the Heroic Battle. Heroic Battles will have players fighting huge enemies and earning unique rewards in a recurring event. The first time the AT-ST appears it will yield rare Mods. Future appearances of the AT-ST will be players' source to obtain Wicket shards! Be on the lookout for future appearances of the AT-ST!
NEWSLETTER_WICKET_ATST_EVENT_TITLE|Wicket Arrives and the AT-ST Heroic Battle
NEWSLETTER_WRECKER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes!\n\n[c][F0FF23]Wrecker[-][/c], the resilient and dauntless commando of Clone Force 99 has joined the Holotables! \n\nThis extra large genetically engineered soldier protects his Clone Trooper and Bad Batch allies with a ferocity and strength that few other clones possess. After taking damage from his enemies, Wrecker turns his [c][F0FF23]Fury[-][/c] into a new undispellable buff, [c][F0FF23]Furious[-][/c], which boosts his abilities with additional effects.\n\nWrecker’s large stature and demeanor means he is not particularly suited for sneaking around and there are few words he hates more than "stealth". In battle, whenever Wrecker gains Stealth, he dispels it and gains Taunt. Wrecker would much rather rip enemy droids apart with his hands, use another droid as a melee weapon, or just blow the whole thing up. "Quiet" is not part of this clone’s vocabulary.\n\nUnlock Wrecker in the all new Marquee event: [c][F0FF23]Clone Force 99 III[-][/c]
NEWSLETTER_WRECKER_TITLE|Ready to Wreck
NEWSLETTER_WRECKERS3_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Wrecker (Mercenary)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nA part of Clone Force 99, Wrecker’s loyalty to the other members of the Bad Batch often causes him to run head first into situations, counting on his brute strength and his demolitions expertise to see him through. Wrecker has a particularly strong bond with Omega, whose influence sometimes helps him to temper his more impulsive characteristics.\n\nTrue to his nature, Wrecker again serves as the Tank for this new Bad Batch squad. Wrecker’s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Haymaker[-][/c], deals damage twice while dispelling debuffs on the target enemy and removing Turn Meter for each buff dispelled. His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Colossal Smash[-][/c], gives him an active Taunt and inflicts Disarm on an enemy. [c][F0FF23]Improvised Weapon[-][/c], his second Special ability, allows him to gain permanent defensive stats throughout battle in addition to dealing damage to all enemies and providing a much needed dispel for his allies.\n\nWrecker’s first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You Gotta Be in Front To Win[-][/c], provides extra Health and Protection to him whenever he has a Captive ally, and, while in the Territory Battles game mode with his Omicron active, allows for each Bad Batch ally to be revived once after they’ve already been rescued. Wrecker’s final ability, Soldier of Fortune, gives stacking Offense and Tenacity to his Mercenary allies for each stack of [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c] they have while he is active. \n\nUnlock Wrecker (Mercenary) in the upcoming “[c][E7E7E7]The Cavalry Has Arrived IV[-][/c]” Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
NEWSLETTER_WRECKERS3_TITLE|Why Does It Always Have to Be a Big Monster?
NEWSLETTER_YODA_CHEWIE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Yoda & Chewie[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables!\n\nWhen Master Yoda traveled to Kashyyyk to aid the Wookiees in their defense against the Separatist invasion, he formed an unlikely bond with a young Wookiee warrior named Chewbacca. When Order 66 was executed and the clones turned on Yoda, Chewbacca and Tarfful helped the Jedi Master escape, giving the Jedi Master, and all future Jedi, a chance to survive.\n\nYoda & Chewie's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]May the Furce be with You[-][/c], strikes enemies multiple times while granting themselves Speed Up. Their first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]One with the Furce[-][/c], heals all Wookiee allies and grants them Foresight, with Wookiee Support allies also gaining Frenzy if Tarfful is leading the squad. [c][F0FF23]The Furce Awakens[-][/c], their second Special ability, strips all buffs from enemies before dealing damage and Distracting the primary target, and when paired with Tarfful as Leader, Yoda & Chewie assist again while granting all Wookiee allies Advantage.\n\nTheir Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Furce is My Ally[-][/c], grants all Wookiee allies Foresight and, with a full Wookiee squad, provides Yoda & Chewie with Master's Training while creating powerful synergies around Foresight. With their Grand Arena Omicron active, all Wookiee allies receive significant Critical Damage and Speed bonuses, and a full Wookiee squad gains Master's Training for everyone while adding Retribution to Foresight, inflicting Damage Over Time when attacking out of turn, and spreading Fear when defeating enemies. Additionally, Yoda & Chewie can trigger Damage Over Time effects and even Disarm when using Special abilities while they have Foresight.\n\nUnlock Yoda & Chewie in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"THE LAST HOPE"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Yoda & Chewie are also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Maul (Hate-Fueled). To enter the second tier of the Maul event, Yoda & Chewie will need to be 5 stars and Era Level 54 or higher.
NEWSLETTER_YODA_CHEWIE_TITLE|You Must Learn the Ways of the Furce
NEWSLETTER_ZAALBAR_OMICRON_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nToday's Update adds a brand-new Omicron ability tier to Zaalbar’s kit! This upgrade is added to his second Unique ability, Missions Guardian, and functions in Grand Arena with different modifiers in 5v5 and 3v3.\n\nIn either Grand Arena mode, Zaalbar’s Retribution and Taunt are much more persistent, and he stacks Damage Over Time high on his enemies as he counterattacks.\n\nIn 5v5, Zaalbar brings together his Light Side Old Republic allies to become a formidable blockade, granting them all Defense and Tenacity per enemy debuff, allowing Jolee to revive fallen Old Republic allies instead of just Jedi, and letting other allies that would gain Taunt instead drastically ramp their Offense.\n\nIn 3v3, this Omicron ability pays tribute to one of the darkest timelines of Star Wars Legends. Bringing Darth Revan, Zaalbar, and Mission into battle together causes Mission to be instantly defeated at the start of battle, granting significant stats to Darth Revan and Zaalbar and making them a formidable offensive duo.\n\nThis new ability tier for Zaalbar is now available as an upgrade with your Omicron materials!
NEWSLETTER_ZAALBAR_OMICRON_TITLE|New Omicron Ability Tier for Zaalbar
NEWSLETTER_ZAM_WESELL_DESC|Zam Wesell is now available in Chromium Packs! This scoundrel attacker can inflict Evasion Down and utilize Thermal Detonators to decimate her enemies. With her unique shapeshifting ability granting her increased evasion, this Clawdite Assassin was not one to cross!\n\nWill you be adding this shape-shifting assassin to your squad?
NEWSLETTER_ZAM_WESELL_TITLE|Zam Wesell is now available in Chromium Packs!
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_CANTINA_051124_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Zeta Ability Materials[/b] have been added to [b]Cantina nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 05/11/2024 through 05/13/2024.
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_CANTINA_051124_TITLE|Zeta Ability Materials are available on Cantina Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_CANTINA_060324_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Zeta Ability Materials[/b] have been added to [b]Cantina Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Cantina Energy.\n\nCantina Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 06/3/2024 through 06/6/2024.
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_CANTINA_060324_TITLE|Zeta Ability Materials are available on Cantina Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_FLEET_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Zeta Ability Materials[/b] have been added to [b]Hard Fleet Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Ship Energy.\n\nHard Fleet Battles are rewarding bonus drops from 10/20/2023 through 10/23/2023.
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_FLEET_TITLE|Zeta Ability Materials are available on Hard Fleet Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_MATERIALS_ANNOUNCEMENT_DESC|Use your ships to earn Zeta materials and advance your characters' abilities to new heights!\n\nWith the release of ships, we are introducing Zeta abilities for 13 characters. You can find Zeta materials in Fleet Arena Shipments and the Ship Ability Challenge (Tier 3 and above).\n\nAdditional Zeta abilities will be released regularly. Collect and conquer!
NEWSLETTER_ZETA_MATERIALS_ANNOUNCEMENT_TITLE|Introducing: Zeta Materials and Abilities
NEWSLETTER_ZORII_BLISS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][ffff33]Zorii Bliss[-][/c], leader of the spice runners on Kijimi who fought alongside Poe at the battle of Exogol, is coming to the holotables!\n\nZorii has strong synergy with Exposes to lesser used Resistance characters, especially when they are lead by Poe or Finn. With either of them as the Leader, her Unique ability [c][ffff33]There's More of Us[-][/c] grants stacking Offense to some Resistance who gain turn meter, spreads Tenacity Up when one ally gains it, and grants a chance to inflict Expose when an ally with Tenacity Up attacks. With an Omicron ability upgrade in the Grand Arenas game mode, this ability also spreads Exposes to those who aren't Exposed when Zorii begins her turn Stealthed. Her Special ability [c][ffff33]I've Done Worse For a Lot Less[-][/c] will stack damage for each Expose that has been triggered so she can set up a big hit.\n\nHer second Unique ability [c][ffff33]Spice Runner Skills[-][/c] will start her off Stealthed to boost her other abilities, as well as provide her Resistance and Smuggler allies with extra survivability the first time they lose health. Her Special ability [c][ffff33]Captain's Medallion[-][/c] brings her back into Stealth then dispels her Resistance allies, grants turn meter for each dispel, triggers Taunts on Poe, Finn, and Holdo, then all Resistance allies assist.\n\nIf you wannabe Resistance, you gotta get Zorii Bliss. Unlock her in the new “Resistance Runner” Marquee event!
NEWSLETTER_ZORII_BLISS_LIGHT_DESC|For a limited time, [b]Zorii Bliss[/b] has been added to [b]Light Side Battle nodes[/b] as bonus drops! During this event, the drop rate on each node has been scaled to Energy.\n\nBattles are rewarding bonus drops from 02/24/2024 through 02/28/2024.
NEWSLETTER_ZORII_BLISS_LIGHT_TITLE|Zorii Bliss is available on Light Side Battle nodes!
NEWSLETTER_ZORII_BLISS_TITLE|Take a Guess, Spice Runner
NEWSLETTER_ZUCKUSS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Zuckuss[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nA Gand Findsman, Zuckuss utilized his species' unique mystical traditions to track his targets. His partnership with the protocol droid turned bounty hunter 4-LOM proved highly successful, combining Zuckuss' intuitive tracking abilities with 4-LOM's calculating precision to become one of the most effective bounty hunting duos in the galaxy.\n\nZuckuss excels as a protective Tank for Bounty Hunter teams, using his [c][F0FF23]Augury of Protection[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Ensnaring Shot[-][/c] abilities to control enemies while keeping his allies safe. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Foreseen Strike[-][/c], allows him to attack multiple times while maintaining his defenses through Protection recovery, particularly effective when combined with Foresight.\n\nHis Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Rite of Pursuit[-][/c], transforms Bounty Hunter teams into a coordinated force, providing substantial Protection bonuses and encouraging the use of Foresight for devastating assist attacks. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Findsman's Intuition[-][/c], makes him an especially formidable Tank in Territory Wars, where he gains additional survivability through Bounty Hunter's Resolve and enhanced Protection.\n\nUnlock Zuckuss in the upcoming [c][E7E7E7]"MIST HUNTERS II"[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][E7E7E7]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event!
NEWSLETTER_ZUCKUSS_TITLE|Uncanny Findsman
