order66_RAID_MODIFIER01_DESC_V2|[c][e7e7e7]Additional Effects:[-][/c]\nEnemies gain 70% Accuracy, Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Defense, Defense Penetration, Max Health, Offense, Potency, and Tenacity, and 30 Speed. This bonus Offense stacks with all subsequent tiers.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Vader's Fist (CC-1119 "Appo"):[-][/c] Dark Side Clone Troopers also dispel Retribution on the start of their turn. Whenever Foresight or Retribution is dispelled, that enemy is Exposed for 2 turns, which can't be resisted. Whenever Appo is inflicted with a debuff, a random Knightfall Trooper ally gains 5% Turn Meter (once per turn).\n[c][F0FF23]Imperial March (Knightfall Trooper):[-][/c] Grant Defense Penetration Up to the weakest ally that doesn't have it for 2 turns and remove 1 stack of Execute from Lord Vader.\n[c][F0FF23]Clone Commander (CC-1010 "Fox"):[-][/c] Whenever Fox is inflicted with a debuff, a random Disguised Clone Trooper ally gains 5% Turn Meter (once per turn).\n[c][F0FF23]My New Empire (Lord Vader):[-][/c] Whenever an Empire ally is Marked, dispel it and that ally Stealths for 1 turn.
order66_RAID_MODIFIER02_DESC_V2|[c][e7e7e7]Additional Effects:[-][/c]\nEnemies gain 120% Accuracy, Critical Chance, Defense, Defense Penetration, Max Health, and Potency, and 5000 Offense, and 75 Speed.\n\n[c][F0FF23]What I Say (CC-1010 "Fox"):[-][/c] Remove an additional stack of Execute.\n[c][F0FF23]Battalion Brothers (Knightfall Trooper):[-][/c] +100% Offense while he has Advantage.\n[c][F0FF23]Well-Executed Ambush (Disguised Clone Trooper):[-][/c] Remove a stack of Execute from Lord Vader per Stealthed enemy.\n[c][F0FF23]Twisted Omen (Lord Vader):[-][/c] -5 stacks of Execute after each bonus turn.\n[c][F0FF23]Faction Bonus: Bad Batch:[-][/c] +20% Accuracy.
order66_RAID_MODIFIER03_DESC_V2|[c][e7e7e7]Additional Effects:[-][/c]\nEnemies gain 140% Accuracy, Critical Chance, Defense, Defense Penetration, Max Health, and Potency, and 6000 Offense, and 90 Speed.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Granted Ability: Rescue:[-][/c] +1 Additional instance of damage to unlock.\n[c][F0FF23]My New Empire (Lord Vader):[-][/c] Whenever an enemy gains a buff they also are inflicted with a stack of Damage Over Time for 1 turn.\n[c][F0FF23]Decoy Squad Five (Disguised Clone Trooper):[-][/c] Reduced Massive damage is now Massive damage.\n[c][F0FF23]Hero Bonus: Jedi Master Mace Windu:[-][/c] Tanks gain Protection Up (150%) for 2 turns instead.\n[c][F0FF23]Hero Bonus: Grand Moff Tarkin:[-][/c] Dark Side Clone Troopers gain Defense equal to 75% of his Potency.
order66_RAID_MODIFIER04_DESC_V2|[c][e7e7e7]Additional Effects:[-][/c]\nEnemies gain 170% Defense, Defense Penetration, Max Health, and Potency, and 7000 Offense and 105 Speed.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Granted Ability: Dire Fortitude:[-][/c] Jedi Vanguard add an additional 5 stacks of Execute to Lord Vader.\n[c][F0FF23]Vader's Fist (CC-1119 "Appo"):[-][/c] Whenever Appo uses a Special ability a random Disguised Clone Trooper assists, dealing 30% less damage and then Stealths for 1 turn at the end of the round.\n[c][F0FF23]Clone Commander (CC-1010 "Fox"):[-][/c] Whenever Fox uses a Special ability a random Disguised Clone Trooper assists, dealing 30% less Damage and then Stealths for 1 turn at the end of the round.\n[c][F0FF23]Decoy Squad Five (Disguised Clone Trooper):[-][/c] Deal an additional instance of Massive damage against enemies with Order 66.\n[c][F0FF23]Faction Bonus: Bad Batch:[-][/c] +40% Accuracy and +25% Max Health. Stealthed characters deal 25% more damage. Non-Stealthed characters take 25% less damage when targeted.\n[c][F0FF23]Faction Bonus: Jedi Vanguard:[-][/c] +100% Max Health and Max Protection.
order66_RAID_MODIFIER05_DESC_V2|[c][e7e7e7]Additional Effects:[-][/c]\nEnemies gain 190% Defense, Defense Penetration, Max Health, and Potency, and 8000 Offense and 120 Speed.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Battalion Brothers (Knightfall Trooper):[-][/c] Whenever Knightfall Trooper is defeated, Stun the enemy who defeated them for 1 turn at the end of their turn, which can't be resisted.\n[c][F0FF23]No Entry, No Escape (CC-1010 "Fox"):[-][/c] Ability Block target enemy for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.\n[c][F0FF23]Faction Bonus: Dark Side Clone Troopers:[-][/c] At the start of battle, Dark Side Clone Troopers are immune to Stun for 1 turn.\n[c][F0FF23]Hero Bonus: Grand Moff Tarkin:[-][/c] Dark Side Clone Troopers gain Defense equal to 100% of his Potency.\n[c][F0FF23]Hero Bonus: CC-1119 "Appo":[-][/c] While Knightfall Trooper is active, Dark Side Clone Troopers have 50% Offense.
order66_RAID_MODIFIER06_DESC_V2|[c][e7e7e7]Additional Effects:[-][/c]\nEnemies gain 210% Defense, Defense Penetration, Max Health, and Potency, and 9000 Offense and 135 Speed.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Clever Ruse (Disguised Clone Trooper):[-][/c] No longer loses Stealth whenever he attacks.\n[c][F0FF23]Twisted Omen (Lord Vader):[-][/c] -5 stacks of Execute at start of battle.\n[c][F0FF23]Faction Bonus: Jedi Vanguard:[-][/c] Whenever a Jedi Vanguard defeats an enemy, add a stack of Execute to Lord Vader.\n[c][F0FF23]Hero Bonus: Jocasta Nu:[-][/c] Whenever she uses a Special ability Jedi Vanguard allies gain Critical Hit Immunity for 2 turns instead.
order66_RAID_MODIFIER07_DESC_V2|[c][e7e7e7]Additional Effects:[-][/c]\nEnemies gain 230% Defense, Defense Penetration, Max Health, and 10,000 Offense.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Faction Bonus: Bad Batch:[-][/c] +100% Accuracy. Whenever an enemy dispels Marked, they are Marked for 1 turn, which can't be dispelled, prevented, or resisted, and Lord Vader gains 10 stacks of Execute. Stealthed characters deal 50% more damage. Non-Stealthed characters take 50% less damage when targeted.\n[c][F0FF23]Faction Bonus: Dark Side Clone Troopers:[-][/c] Dark Side Clone Troopers and Tarkin are immune to Stun. Whenever an enemy is inflicted with Order 66, all Dark Side Clone Troopers and Grand Moff Tarkin gain 100% Turn Meter and 25% Offense for 1 turn, an additional 75% Offense for the rest of the battle, and Lord Vader gains 20 stacks of Execute.\n[c][F0FF23]Hero Bonus: Jedi Master Mace Windu:[-][/c] Attackers instead gain 200% Offense. Healer and Support allies dispel all debuffs on Jedi Vanguard allies at the start of their turn. Tank allies instead gain Protection Up (200%) for 2 turns.
order66_RAID_PHASE01_DETAIL_DESC_V2|Operation Knightfall has commenced and Lord Vader has begun his extermination of the Jedi. Fight through the Dark Side Clone Troopers blocking your path. Attempt to interrupt his onslaught before Order 66 is completed.\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-]\n\n[c][b5e7f5]- Lord Vader is only targetable when at least 1 Disguised Clone Trooper or Knightfall Trooper is defeated.\n- Dealing damage to Lord Vader enough times while he is targetable will allow the player to gain the Granted ability, Rescue.\n- Rescue will allow the endangered Jedi to be released from Lord Vader's grasp, gaining significant points.\n- Enemy commanders can call in more Disguised Clone Troopers and Knightfall Troopers by using their Special abilities.\n- Defeating an enemy commander scores more points than defeating Disguised Clone Troopers or Knightfall Troopers and allows the player to obtain powerful Granted abilities as well.\n- Once the fate of all Jedi has been decided, Lord Vader may become enraged and turn on the player. If the player's characters use an ability on their turn against an enraged Lord Vader they can score more points.[-]

PROFUNDITY_GUIDE_DESCRIPTION|An Alliance warship that was a converted Government tower, Profundity was commanded by the mayor of the city of Nystullum, Raddus most notably in the daring battle above Scarif. The Profundity acted as the command ship for the Alliance Fleet above Scarif as Rogue One was attempting to transmit the Death Star plans. Upon receiving the fateful transmission, but before jumping into hyperspace, the Profundity was disabled by Devastator, an Imperial Star Destroyer, and boarded by Darth Vader. As Darth Vader sought to retrieve the stolen plans, a crew of Rebels were able to escape aboard the Tantive IV that was docked aboard the capital ship giving the Rebel Alliance hope.

PROFUNDITY_LIGHTSPEED_I_DESC|Begin assembling the ruthless forces behind Profundity's rise with this Lightspeed Bundle, featuring 7 fully upgraded characters at 7 Stars, Level 85, Relic 7, and Ability Tier 7! PROFUNDITY_LIGHTSPEED_I_INFO|[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- level 85\n- Relic Level 7\n- Ability Tier 7\n\n[b]SHIPS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Ability Tier 7

R2D2_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_II_INFO|[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 7\n- Ability Tier 7

ROGUE_ONE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_I_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 7
ROGUE_ONE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_I_NAME|ROGUE ONE LIGHTSPEED BUNDLE I

SCYTHE_LIGHTSPEED_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 7\n\n[b]SHIP[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Ability Tier 7

SEPARATIST_COMMANDER_LIGHTSPEED_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 7\n- Ability Tier 7\n\n[b]SHIP[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Ability Tier 7

SMUGGLERS_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_GRIEVOUS01_DESC|Granted to: [c][F0FF23]General Grievous[-][/c] \nGeneral Grievous has +300% Offense. At the start of each turn, if Grievous is below 100% Health, he dispels all debuffs on himself and grants Taunt to the other healthiest Droid ally until the end of the turn. When a Droid ally is defeated for the first time in battle, Grievous dispels all debuffs on himself, resets all ability cooldowns, and gains 3 bonus turns.

TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_MACEWINDU01_DESC|Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Mace Windu[-][/c] \nMace Windu has +100% Max Health, +480% Max Protection, +100% Counter Chance, and is immune to Shock, Daze and Stun. Additionally, when attacking Sith with his basic attack Mace deals +1000% damage. Whenever Mace suffers damage, Inflict Expose on all enemies for 2 turns which can't be evaded. If Jango Fett has Expose, Mace Windu's attacks will instantly defeat him (Damage Immunity does not prevent this effect).
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_MACEWINDU01_NAME|BATTLE-ATTUNED MASTER OF THE FORCE
TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_BUFF_TROOPER01_DESC|At the start of battle, Imperial Troopers gain 5 stacks of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]. When an enemy is defeated, all Imperial Troopers gain 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c], up to 10 stacks.\n\n[c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c]: When an Imperial Trooper is defeated, they consume 1 stack of [c][ffff33]Endless Ranks[-][/c] from all Imperial Trooper allies, revive with 100% Health and 100% Protection, reset all their cooldowns, and gain a bonus turn

TERRITORYABILITY_WAR_COUNTDOOKU_MYSTERY_BONUS_DESC|Granted to: [c][F0FF23]Count Dooku[-][/c] \nForce Lightning ignores Protection and deals bonus damage equal to 80% of the target's Max Health if they are already Shocked. THE_PRINCESSES_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO|[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 7

TIEIN_INTERCEPTOR_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 5\n- Ability Tier 8

UNIQUEABILITY_BOSSNASS02_DESC_V2|[c][AFFFFFFF]Light Side[-][/c]\n\n[c][ffff33][Basic] Plasma Pulse:[-][/c] All Gungan allies recover 100% Protection, gain 25% Turn Meter, and have their cooldowns reduced by 1.\n\n[c][ffff33][Unique] Big Bombad Shielding:[-][/c] The Shield Generator has 10 stacks of [c][ffff33]Plasma Shielding[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. Whenever it takes damage it loses 1 stack.\n\nWhile Shield Generator is active, Gungan allies have the following benefits:\n\n- +500% Defense\n- Immune to critical hits\n- Take reduced damage from Percent Health damage effects\n\n[c][ffff33]Plasma Shielding:[-][/c] While the Shield Generator has this, its allies gain bonuses\n\n[c][ffff33][Unique] Pride of the Grand Army:[-][/c] The Shield Generator has no Protection, its Max Health is 1, and it can't be defeated or destroyed while it has Plasma Shielding. When all stacks of Plasma Shielding expire, the Shield Generator is destroyed. The Shield Generator is immune to buffs and debuffs and its Max Health and Max Protection can't be increased.\n\nThe Shield Generator has 50 stacks of [c][ffff33]Recharge[-][/c], which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented. When it loses all stacks of Recharge, it takes a bonus turn and gains 50 stacks of Recharge.\n\n[c][ffff33]Recharge:[-][/c] This unit will take a bonus turn when all stacks expire\n\n[c][ffff33][Unique] Summoned:[-][/c] This unit can only be summoned to the ally slot if it's available. This unit can't be summoned in certain raids. This unit can't be revived. If an effect counts defeated units, this unit doesn't count. When there are no other allied combatants, this unit escapes from battle. A unit can't be revived if this summoned unit exists in their slot.

UNIQUEABILITY_MASTERQUIGON01_TIER_03_DESC|At the start of battle all Galactic Republic allies are immune to Turn Meter Reduction and gain Defense Up for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever Master Qui-Gon is critically hit, all Galactic Republic allies gain 30% Protection Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever any other Jedi ally attacks during Master Qui-Gon's turn, he assists (once per turn).\n\nWhile enemies are inflicted with Tenacity Down they have -30% Critical Damage and Defense.

UNIQUEABILITY_MASTERQUIGON01_TIER_05_DESC|At the start of battle all Galactic Republic allies are immune to Turn Meter Reduction and gain Defense Up for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever Master Qui-Gon is critically hit, all Galactic Republic allies gain 30% Protection Up for 2 turns, all Galactic Republic Attacker allies recover 10% Health, gain Advantage for 2 turns, and ally Padawan Obi-Wan gains Critical Damage Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever any other Jedi ally attacks during Master Qui-Gon's turn, he assists (once per turn).\n\nWhile enemies are inflicted with Tenacity Down they have -30% Critical Damage and Defense.
UNIQUEABILITY_MASTERQUIGON01_TIER_06_DESC|At the start of battle, and whenever Galactic Republic allies are Stunned, they are immune to Turn Meter Reduction and gain Defense Up for 1 turn. The first time any Galactic Republic ally (excluding summons) falls below 50% Health, if the ally in the Leader slot is Galactic Republic, the Leader takes a bonus turn, dispel all debuffs on the Leader, and all Galactic Republic allies gain 25% Max Health until the end of the encounter.\n\nWhenever Master Qui-Gon is critically hit, all Galactic Republic allies gain 30% Protection Up for 2 turns, all Galactic Republic Attacker allies recover 10% Health, gain Advantage for 2 turns, and ally Padawan Obi-Wan gains Critical Damage Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever any other Jedi ally attacks during Master Qui-Gon's turn, he assists (once per turn). If the ally in the Leader slot is Queen Amidala at the start of battle, she gains 25% Turn Meter (50% if there is an active ally Padawan Obi-Wan), and Master Qui-Gon assists whenever she uses her Basic ability.\n\nWhile enemies are inflicted with Tenacity Down they have -30% Critical Damage and Defense.
UNIQUEABILITY_MASTERQUIGON01_TIER_07_DESC|At the start of battle, and whenever Galactic Republic allies are Stunned, they are immune to Turn Meter Reduction and gain Defense Up for 1 turn. The first time any Galactic Republic ally (excluding summons) falls below 50% Health, if the ally in the Leader slot is Galactic Republic, the Leader takes a bonus turn, dispel all debuffs on the Leader, and all Galactic Republic allies gain 25% Max Health until the end of the encounter.\n\nWhenever Master Qui-Gon is critically hit, all Galactic Republic allies gain 30% Protection Up for 2 turns, all Galactic Republic Attacker allies recover 10% Health, gain Advantage for 2 turns, and ally Padawan Obi-Wan gains Critical Damage Up for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever any other Jedi ally attacks during Master Qui-Gon's turn, he assists (once per turn). If the ally in the Leader slot is Queen Amidala at the start of battle, she gains 25% Turn Meter (50% if there is an active ally Padawan Obi-Wan), and Master Qui-Gon assists whenever she uses her Basic ability.\n\nWhile enemies are inflicted with Tenacity Down they have -30% Critical Damage and Defense.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in Territory Wars and all allies are non-Galactic Legend Galactic Republic:[-][/c] At the start of the encounter, all allies gain 50% Max Health (100% Max Health if the ally in the Leader slot is Queen Amidala) for the rest of the encounter, and Defense Up for 3 turns. Whenever Master Qui-Gon is defeated all allies gain 50% Offense for 2 turns and recover 100% Protection.\n\nIf the ally in the Leader slot is Galactic Republic, when they have less than 50% Health, Master Qui-Gon gains 50% bonus Protection for 2 turns at the start of his turn.\n\nIf the ally in the Leader slot is Queen Amidala:\n- Whenever a Galactic Republic ally attacks out of turn, they deal 50% more damage, remove 25% Turn Meter, and inflict Ability Block for 1 turn which can't be evaded on target enemy.\n- Whenever Master Qui-Gon gains Legendary Battle Meditation, all non-Galactic Legend tank enemies are inflicted with Healing Immunity and Protection Disruption for 1 turn which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted.

UNIQUEABILITY_OMEGAS301_DESC|Omega (Fugitive) has +5 Speed.\n\nIf Omega (Fugitive) is in the Leader slot, the first time each ally Omega (Fugitive), Batcher, Hunter (Mercenary), Wrecker (Mercenary), and Crosshair (Scarred) would be defeated:\n\n- Remove all buffs and debuffs and they are inflicted with 10 stacks of Captive until the end of battle\n- While Captive, they can't be targeted, they are immune to all damage, recovery, buffs, and debuffs, and they lose 1 stack of Captive whenever a Bad Batch ally takes a turn\n- Bad Batch allies can contribute to their Rescue Objective\n- If their Rescue Objective is met before they lose all stacks of Captive, they lose Captive and recover 100% Health and Protection; otherwise, they are instantly defeated\n- If all allies are Captive this way, they immediately fail their Rescue Objective\n- This effect persists through defeat\n\n[c][ffff33]Captive:[-][/c] Speed set to 0, can't bonus attack or gain bonus Turn Meter\n\n[c][ffff33]Rescue Objective:[-][/c] Gain 30 stacks of Target Practice

UNIQUEABILITY_OPERATIVE01_TIER_06_DESC|Whenever an enemy dispels a debuff, all Empire allies gain 10% bonus Protection until the end of the encounter.\n\nAt the start of battle, if CC-1119 "Appo" is an ally, all Empire allies can ignore taunt effects to target enemies inflicted with Order 66 and gain Instant Defeat Immunity until the end of battle or CX-2 is defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented. If all allies gained Dramatic Entrance at the start of encounter, all allies gain Dramatic Entrance for 2 turns whenever an enemy unit is defeated.
UNIQUEABILITY_OPERATIVE01_TIER_07_DESC|Whenever an enemy dispels a debuff, all Empire allies gain 10% bonus Protection until the end of the encounter.\n\nAt the start of battle, if CC-1119 "Appo" is an ally, all Empire allies can ignore taunt effects to target enemies inflicted with Order 66 and gain Instant Defeat Immunity until the end of battle or CX-2 is defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled or prevented. If all allies gained Dramatic Entrance at the start of encounter, all allies gain Dramatic Entrance for 2 turns whenever an enemy unit is defeated.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in 3v3 Grand Arenas:[-][/c] Empire allies gain 100% Max Health.\n\nIf all allies at the start of battle are Dark Side Clone Troopers and/or Lord Vader, all allies gain 50% Offense, and the first time they fall below 50% Health, they recover 100% Health and gain 30% bonus Protection for 2 turns.\n\nWhenever any stacks of Damage Over Time are dispelled on the enemy, they gain a stack of Damage Over Time, which can't be dispelled, evaded, or resisted, until the end of battle.\n\nIf CC-1119 "Appo" is active, CX-2 is immune to taunt effects and can't be targeted during enemy turns.

UNIQUEABILITY_OPERATIVE02_TIER_07_DESC_V3|At the start of battle, CX-2 gains 10% Max Health and Offense for each other Empire ally. At the start of each encounter, CX-2 Stealths for 2 turns.\n\nWhile another Empire ally is active, CX-2 ignores taunt effects on his turn.\n\nWhenever CX-2 uses an ability against the same targeted enemy that he did in the previous turn, he gains 50% Critical Chance and Potency (stacking, max 100%) and all Empire allies recover 15% Health and Protection until he uses an ability on his turn against a different target.\n\nWhenever CX-2 uses an ability against the same targeted enemy 3 times in a row, inflict Order 66 on that enemy for 2 turns, which can't be copied, dispelled, evaded or resisted. If all allies at the start of battle are Dark Side Clone Troopers and/or Lord Vader, Lord Vader gains 25% Ultimate Charge whenever an enemy is inflicted with Order 66.

Grant all Rebel allies [c][f0ff23]Suprosa Supercomputer[-][/c] for the rest of the encounter, which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented\n\n[c][f0ff23]Suprosa Supercomputer:[-][/c] Gain 100% Critical Chance and an additional bonus based on the ship's role:\n\n- [c][B5E7F5]Attacker:[-][/c] At the start of turn, dispel Stealth and Taunt from all enemies and inflict Defense Down for 1 turn on a random enemy\n- [c][B5E7F5]Tank:[-][/c] All Rebel allies recover 10% Health and Protection whenever this ship receives damage\n- [c][B5E7F5]Support or Healer:[-][/c] At the start of turn, inflict Target Lock on a random enemy for 2 turns and remove 20% Turn Meter.

UNIQUEABILITY_YODACHEWBACCA01_TIER_06_DESC|At the start of each encounter, Wookiee allies gain Foresight for 2 turns.\n\nIf all allies were Wookiees at the start of battle:\n\n- Wookiee Jedi gain Master's Training until the end of battle\n- Whenever an enemy attacks an ally out of turn, that ally gains 5% Turn Meter\n- Whenever an ally gains Foresight, they gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle (once per turn) and 5% Turn Meter and whenever Foresight expires on an ally, inflict a stack of Off Balance on a random enemy who didn't already have it for 1 turn (once per turn)
UNIQUEABILITY_YODACHEWBACCA01_TIER_07_DESC|At the start of each encounter, Wookiee allies gain Foresight for 2 turns.\n\nIf all allies were Wookiees at the start of battle:\n\n- Wookiee Jedi gain Master's Training until the end of battle\n- Whenever an enemy attacks an ally out of turn, that ally gains 5% Turn Meter\n- Whenever an ally gains Foresight, they gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 100%) until the end of battle (once per turn) and 5% Turn Meter and whenever Foresight expires on an ally, inflict a stack of Off Balance on a random enemy who didn't already have it for 1 turn (once per turn)\n\n[c][e7e7e7]While in Grand Arenas and if there are no Galactic Legend enemies:[-][/c] Wookiee allies gain 25 Speed and 40% Critical Damage.\n\nIf all allies were Wookiees at the start of battle:\n\n- All allies gain Master's Training until the end of battle\n- Whenever an ally attacks out of turn, they inflict the target enemy with a stack of Damage Over Time for 1 turn\n- Whenever an ally gains Foresight, they also gain Retribution for 2 turns and whenever Foresight expires, remove 5% Turn Meter from all enemies\n- The first time each ally defeats an enemy, inflict all enemies with Fear for 1 turn and all allies gain Foresight for 1 turn\n- At the start of each of Yoda & Chewie's turns, inflict all enemies with Vulnerable for 1 turn\n- Whenever Yoda & Chewie use a Special ability while they have Foresight, they trigger all stacks of Damage Over Time on all enemies and inflict Disarm on the target enemy for 2 turns or until Yoda & Chewie are defeated and remove it from all enemies, which can't be copied, dispelled, evaded, or resisted

UNIQUEABILITY_ZAALBAR02_TIER_08_DESC|Zaalbar has +25% Critical Avoidance. If Mission Vao is an ally, she also gains this bonus. When any other ally falls below 100% Health, Zaalbar gains Retribution and Taunt for 2 turns. At the start of each of his turns, Zaalbar and Mission recover 10% Protection for each stack of Damage Over Time on enemies.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in Grand Arenas:[-][/c] Zaalbar gains Retribution and Taunts for 1 turn at the start of battle, at the start of his turn, and whenever he loses Retribution or Taunt. Whenever he attacks out of turn, inflict a stack of Damage Over Time for 2 turns on all enemies, which can’t be evaded or resisted. Enemies can't gain Defense Up or Stealth.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in 5v5 Grand Arenas, if all allies are Light Side Old Republic and the Leader is not a Jedi:[-][/c] Allies are immune to Daze and Expose. At the start of each turn allies gain 20% Defense and Tenacity for each enemy debuff until the end of the turn. Whenever another ally Taunts, they dispel it, take a bonus turn, and gain 400% Offense (stacking) until the end of the encounter or the start of a Galactic Legend's turn. Whenever an enemy gains bonus Turn Meter, they are inflicted with a stack of Damage Over Time for 2 turns, which can’t be evaded or resisted. If Jolee Bindo is an ally, That Looks Pretty Bad revives all defeated allies. These bonuses persist if Zaalbar is defeated.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in 3v3 Grand Arenas, if Darth Revan and Mission Vao are allies and there is no enemy Galactic Legend:[-][/c] Zaalbar and Mission gain the Sith Empire tag until the end of battle. Mission gains a bonus turn at the start of battle. Until the start of that turn she can't be targeted by enemies. At the start of that turn she is instantly defeated and grants her Critical Chance, Critical Damage, Offense, and Speed to Zaalbar and Darth Revan in addition to their own until the end of battle. These effects persist through defeat. Zaalbar and Darth Revan gain Guard until Zaalbar is defeated. Once per turn, Darth Revan assists whenever Zaalbar uses an ability.
