NEWSLETTER_KX_SECURITY_DROID_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]KX Security Droid[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nKX-series security droids serve as the Empire’s heavy enforcers, designed to impose order through strength and intimidation. These towering units execute Imperial directives without hesitation, acting as relentless guardians of ISB operations. \n\n[c][F0FF23]KX Security Droid[-][/c] joins the ISB as a Tank built around Overcharge and Rank mechanics, growing stronger as battle progresses while maintaining control of the battlefield. [c][F0FF23]Baton Deployed[-][/c] builds Overcharge and restores Health and Protection, converting full stacks into an unavoidable Shock. [c][F0FF23]Please Do Not Resist[-][/c] converts his defensive strength into Offense, strikes all enemies, and establishes control with Taunt and defensive buffs. [c][F0FF23]Controlled Operation[-][/c] increases his survivability as Overcharge builds, punishes enemies who critically hit him or defeat allies, and ties into ISB mechanics like Target Lock, Undermine, and Rank. Finally, [c][F0FF23]Chain of Command[-][/c] governs his Rank progression, rewarding him for maintaining Taunt and attacking out of turn with increased damage and counter attacks.\n\nUnlock KX Security Droid in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]STILL RESISTING?[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! KX Security Droid is also a requirement (at 6 stars) to upgrade Cassian Andor (Undercover) to 6 Stars in his Journey Guide event.

FTUE_TU40_TB_MISSIONS_SPECIAL_01|[c][f0ff23]SPECIAL MISSIONS[-][/c] are similar to Combat Missions, but allow only one attempt per Territory Battle. They don't refresh in the next phase even if your guild remains in the same Territory.
FTUE_TU40_TB_MISSIONS_SPECIAL_02|Instead of Territory Points, you can earn rewards for your entire guild like [c][f0ff23]GUILD EVENT TOKENS[-][/c] or shards for [c][f0ff23]EXCLUSIVE CHARACTERS[-][/c].
FTUE_TU40_TB_PLATOONS_01|Completing [c][f0ff23]PLATOONS[-][/c] can improve your odds of victory in missions. They require specific units with [c][f0ff23]MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS[-][/c]. Each player may deploy up to [c][f0ff23]10 UNITS[-][/c] from their roster in each one.
FTUE_TU40_TB_STATS_01|Succeed or fail as a guild! Equal rewards are given to all who participated. It's easy to see everyone's [c][f0ff23]STATS[-][/c], so everyone is accountable!
FTUE_TU40_TB_SUMMARY_01|[c][f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-][/c] run for [c][f0ff23]6 DAYS[-][/c] and have [c][f0ff23]MULTIPLE PHASES[-][/c] to complete.\n\nEvery character and ship in your roster is key to your victory!
FTUE_TU40_TB_TIMER_01|Each phase has a [c][f0ff23]TIME LIMIT[-][/c]. Your units are [c][f0ff23]REFRESHED[-][/c] when the phase starts. Your guild continues fighting in any Territory where no Star was earned in the previous phase.
FTUE_TU40_TB_UNLOCK_01|You are now eligible for [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY BATTLES[-][/c], a cooperative mode where your guild battles through multiple phases of challenging enemies to earn [c][f0ff23]EQUAL REWARDS[-][/c] for all guild members!
FTUE_TU40_TRAINING_DROID_01|Nice work! You got a [c][f0ff23]TRAINING DROID[-][/c], used to upgrade your characters.\n\nOur droid expert, "Bev," will help you out with that.
FTUE_TU40_TW_ENEMY_DEFENSES_01|Command your units to [c][f0ff23]ATTACK[-][/c] here. Once a unit is used to attack, it can't be used elsewhere for the rest of the Territory War, so [c][f0ff23]CHOOSE WISELY[-][/c]!
FTUE_TU40_TW_ENEMY_DEFENSES_02|Successful attacks earn [c][f0ff23]BANNERS[-][/c]. [c][f0ff23]CONQUERING[-][/c] a Territory completely earns a large amount of banners for your guild.
FTUE_TU40_TW_ENEMY_DEFENSES_03|Ah, the front lines. Sometimes I miss them. Select an enemy squad to attack! Good luck, and [c][f0ff23]MAY THE FORCE BE WITH YOU[-][/c]!
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_ATTACK_01|The [c][f0ff23]ATTACK PHASE[-][/c] has begun!\n\nIt's time to go on the offensive!
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_01|Behold the [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY WAR[-][/c] holo-battlefield. This is where you and your guild will take on opposing guilds!
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_02|[c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c] your guild's [c][4286f4]BLUE TERRITORIES[-][/c] on the left.
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_03|[c][f0ff23]ATTACK[-][/c] your opponent's [c][f44256]RED TERRITORIES[-][/c] on the right. Turn the opposing guild into Bantha fodder!
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_PREVIEW_04|Use the [c][f0ff23]PREVIEW PHASE[-][/c] to coordinate battle strategy with your guild. Once you join, your roster is [c][f0ff23]LOCKED[-][/c], but you can leave and re-join to [c][f0ff23]UPDATE[-][/c] your roster with any changes.
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_SETUP_01|The [c][f0ff23]SETUP PHASE[-][/c] has begun!\n\nAssemble [c][f0ff23]DEFENSES[-][/c] on your guild's Territories!
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_SETUP_02|Tap a Territory to [c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c]!\n\nDefenses can only be set during the Setup Phase.
FTUE_TU40_TW_PHASE_SETUP_02_PC|Click a Territory to [c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c]!\n\nDefenses can only be set during the Setup Phase.
FTUE_TU40_TW_SET_DEFENSES_01|Command your units to [c][f0ff23]DEFEND[-][/c] here. Once a unit is placed on defense, it can't be used elsewhere for the rest of the Territory War, so [c][f0ff23]CHOOSE WISELY[-][/c]!
FTUE_TU40_TW_UNLOCK_01|The time has come for you to join your guild in [c][f0ff23]TERRITORY WARS[-][/c]! Fight an epic battle against an opposing guild for phenomenal [c][f0ff23]RARE REWARDS[-][/c].
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_01|I suppose I must suffer through explaining unit upgrades to another new arrival. Very well. I am B7-N5, or as Fey calls me, "Bev."
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_02|Fey tells me you recovered a [c][f0ff23]TRAINING DROID[-][/c] from your first holotable battle. Let's use it now to increase this character's level.
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_03|Tap the plus sign to train this character to Level 2. Training costs Credits, and Training Droids are assigned automatically.
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_03_PC|Click the plus sign to train this character to Level 2. Training costs Credits, and Training Droids are assigned automatically.
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_04|Tap here to finish this upgrade. Don't think about it too hard.
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_04_PC|Click here to finish this upgrade. Don't think about it too hard.
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_05|Somehow you've acquired enough Credits and [c][f0ff23]ABILITY MATERIALS[-][/c] to upgrade this character's ability. Please do it yourself and spare my circuits the effort.
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_06|Characters require [c][f0ff23]GEAR[-][/c] upgrades to increase their power. This green plus icon indicates you have gear to equip. I should think that is obvious.
FTUE_TU40_UNIT_TRAINING_07|You have enough character shards to [c][f0ff23]PROMOTE[-][/c] this character to a new Star level.\n\nI do hope you can take it from here.
FTUE_TU40_WELCOME_01|Welcome to [c][f0ff23]FEY'S CANTINA[-][/c]! That is to say: my cantina. The name's Fey Zara. I own the place and work behind the bar.
FTUE_TU40_WELCOME_RETURNING_PLAYER_01|Hey there! We just reopened after renovations. How do you like the new look? Also, I finally had enough of that trash-talking Hutt. He still hangs around, but I revoked his holotable privileges. My bar, my rules!

MISSION_TU40_CANTINABATTLE_2G_DESC|A droid uprising in the mines acts as cover for a daring heist.

ALL_HANS_ON_DECK_LIGHTSPEED_II_INFO|[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 7\n- Ability Tier 7

NEWSLETTER_ERA_LEVELS_AND_LOANED_UNITS_NAME|Era Levels and Loaned Units
NEWSLETTER_ERA_LEVELS_AND_LOANED_UNITS_SUMMARY|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWith the arrival of the [c][F0FF23]Era of the New Republic[-][/c] to the Holotables, we have some significant changes to how Eras will work going forward.\n\nFirst off, the [c][F0FF23]Era Level cap is being raised from 95 to 135[-][/c]. This change brings with it two significant improvements. First off, in the early days of the event, you’ll be progressing through Era levels faster than ever before. Secondly, exiting the Era will see improved Legacy conversions. Previously the highest you could get in a Legacy conversion was Relic 6 for a maxed-out EL 95 character. Now, a maxed-out EL 135 character has a Legacy conversion of Relic 8.\n\nAdditionally [c][F0FF23]four new tiers are being added to the Coliseum[-][/c], allowing more frequent tier clears and faster progress throughout the Era in this mode.\n\nNext we have [c][F0FF23]Loaned Units[-][/c]. Characters in Galaxy of Heroes are meant to work alongside other characters in squads. Sometimes those other characters are from outside the Era. Loaned Units will give you a glimpse of a character’s potential alongside theirfuture squadmates in the Legacy roster. Each Era we will identify several characters as Loaned Units, and they will be available to you throughout the Era. These are temporary Era versions of Legacy characters meant to be used alongside the Era characters in modes likeColiseum and Era Challenges. You don’t need to own the Legacy versions of these characters, and even if you happen to own the character in question, it uses the temporary Era version. \n\nLoaned Units will get more powerful throughout the Era, and universally. You don’t need to choose which Loaned Units get leveled up, all of them will! This allows you to concentrate on powering up the Era-specific characters to achieve new Coliseum high scores, and conquer higher and higher Feats in Era Challenges.\n\nThe list of units that will be available to all players as Loaned Units in the Era of the New Republic is:\n\nDeath Trooper\nScout Trooper\nStormtrooper\nTIE Fighter Pilot\nSnowtrooper\nGeneral Syndulla\nMon Mothma\nCaptain Drogan\nChopper\nCara Dune\nThe Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)\nCad Bane\nEmbo\nGamorrean Guard\nGreedo\nMob Enforcer\n\nThe Era of the New Republic brings many other quality of life improvements to Galaxy of Heroes. Check out the patch notes on our official forums for the latest info.
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_THE_NEW_REPUBLIC_NAME|Era of the New Republic
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_THE_NEW_REPUBLIC_SUMMARY|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Era of the New Republic[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nWhile the Battle of Jakku marked the official end of the Empire, the Imperial Remnant remained a threat to the galaxy for years following. The New Republic, formed shortly after the Empire’s defeat at Endor, used elements such as the Adelphi Rangers to help hunt down the remaining Imperial Warlords who continued to threaten the galaxy.\n\nThe Era kicks off with the heroic droid [c][F0FF23]R5-D4[-][/c]. This red-accented astromech droid heroically sacrificed his motivator on Tatooine to enable R2-D2 to continue with his secret mission. In the years that followed, R5-D4 joined up with the Rebel alliance, partnered with Captain Carson Teva, and eventually wound up with The Mandalorian and Grogu, helping the pair retake Mandalore from Remnant control.\n\nThe next character is [c][F0FF23]Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot)[-][/c]. Zeb was once part of Hera Syndulla's Rebel cell, and then eventually his penchant for smashing Imperial heads made him the perfect addition to the Adelphi Rangers. He brings with him to Galaxy of Heroes his natural agility and the bo-rifle, a traditional Lasat weapon that is deadly in either its melee or rifle configuration.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Colonel Ward[-][/c] was a New Republic commander with one job: bring down the Imperial Warlords that threaten the security of the galaxy. An accomplished pilot in her own right, Col. Ward oversaw the operations at Adelphi Base, giving assignments to bounty hunters like The Mandalorian and Grogu to hunt down Imperial Warlords.\n\nThen we have [c][F0FF23]Captain Carson Teva[-][/c]. Captain Teva was an X-wing pilot and friend to General Syndulla, Zeb, and even the Mandalorian covert on Nevarro. This veteran of the Rebellion against the Empire will lead the brand new New Republic squad, sharing his battle experience with his teammates in Galaxy of Heroes.\n\nThe Anzellans find themselves teaming up with Grogu himself to aid the New Republic with the unit appropriately named [c][F0FF23]Grogu & Anzellans[-][/c]. This unit has three of the diminutive aliens teaming up with Grogu on their hover-cart, where they used their mechanical jury-rigging and Grogu’s ability with the Force to aid the New Republic squad in bringing down the mightiest of foes.\n\nThe final unit of the Era is the [c][F0FF23]Imperial Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c]. This Imperial Remnant is a Tank and a Leader to other Remnants, giving you even more options for putting together Imperial Remnant squads. Additionally, the existing Snowtrooper will be getting the Imperial Remnant tag, allowing those cold-hearted troopers to be a part of Snowtrooper Commander’s squad if desired.\n\nThe Journey Guide unit for the Era will be the one and only [c][F0FF23]Rotta the Hutt[-][/c]. Like previous Eras, unlocking this unit will require having all the previous marquee characters from the New Republic Era at 4*. To improve the unit will require those same characters at 5*, 6*, and finally 7*/EL [b]125[/b] (see the Loaned Units newsletter for more information on the new Era Levels.).\n\nAdditionally, later this year, the newest Galactic Legend will require units from the New Republic Era as part of their requirements. So now there’s even more reason to make sure you pick them up!\n\nWe hope you enjoy the Era of the New Republic and seeing new fan-favorite characters come to life in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes over the next three months.
NEWSLETTER_R5_D4_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]R5-D4[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nR5-D4, or the “Red One” as he is known to most, is the astromech droid whose sudden malfunction changed the course of galactic history. Though often remembered for a single moment on Tatooine, this droid eventually joined the Rebellion, working alongside their pilots to help take down the Galactic Empire. In Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, R5-D4 steps forward as a key Support unit (and first member) of a powerful New Republic squad, bringing disruption, durability, and a surprising amount of battlefield influence.\n\nR5-D4’s kit revolves around spreading Damage Over Time and creating pressure through enemy cooldown manipulation. With abilities that punish enemies for recovering and reward allies for coordinated play, R5-D4 steadily builds momentum across the encounter. [c][F0FF23]Tactical Support[-][/c] enhances allies based on their roles, allowing Attackers to bypass defenses, Tanks to hold the line, and Supports to avoid being critically hit.\n\nAt the center of the kit is [c][F0FF23]Bad Motivator[-][/c], a high-risk ability that converts Protection into explosive damage and dramatically shifts the flow of battle. While it can be risky to use, it opens windows for aggressive plays and synergizes with R5-D4’s broader cooldown reduction mechanics. [c][F0FF23]Built for Adventure[-][/c] ties everything together, enabling consistent assist calls, stacking defensive bonuses, and powerful scaling effects in Territory Wars via the Omicron ability.\n\nR5-D4 is one of the requirements, at 4 stars, to initially unlock the Journey Guide unit for the Era, [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b]. He will also be a requirement for the [b]Galactic Legend[/b] being released later this year. Unlock R5-D4 in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]RED, LET’S GO[-][/c] Marquee event, where you can kick off the Era of the New Republic with a bang using this unconventional but impactful droid.

NEWSLETTER_ZEB_ORRELIOS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nThe strong arm of the Ghost crew returns with renewed purpose during the early days of the New Republic. After years of fighting alongside the Rebellion, Zeb continues his service as a dedicated protector, bringing his signature combat style and unwavering loyalty to New Republic operations to our Galaxy of Heroes.\n\nZeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) is a New Republic Tank that specializes in defensive tactics that frustrate enemy Accuracy while drawing fire away from his less survivable allies. His [c][F0FF23]Suppressive Barrage[-][/c] has opponents missing their shots with debilitating Accuracy penalties, while [c][F0FF23]Devastating Sweep[-][/c] strips enemy buffs and forces the entire opposing squad to focus their attacks on him through undispellable Provokes. His battlefield flexibility shines through [c][F0FF23]Tactical Reversal[-][/c], which dispels enemy Taunts while establishing his own defensive presence and providing role-specific team buffs paired with matching enemy debuffs when coordinating with his New Republic allies.\n\nHis [c][F0FF23]Lasat Enforcer[-][/c] passive emphasizes Evasion and survivability, scaling with New Republic squad composition while granting Protection Up to his team. The Omicron upgrade transforms him into a defensive juggernaut in [c][F0FF23]3v3 Grand Arenas[-][/c], featuring extreme Evasion mechanics and powerful synergies with Captain Carson Teva and R5-D4.\n\nZeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) is a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking the Journey Guide event for [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b], and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Zeb in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“TRAINING OPERATIONS”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this resilient Tank to your New Republic roster!
NEWSLETTER_ZEB_ORRELIOS_TITLE|Everyone Calls Me Zeb

ROGUE_ONE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_III_INFO|[c][F0FF23]MERGE UNITS[-][/c]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). The Lightspeed Bundle does not directly grant character shards / ship blueprints or resources used in merge upgrades. The upgrade criteria are evaluated against your existing roster, and your units are set to the greater of the two values.\n\nEach unit will first be evaluated for existing shards or star rarity against the bundle upgrade criteria. A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. Units that exceed the star rarity (or cumulative shards/blueprints) will be activated (if unactivated) and then evaluated for additional attributes (gear tier, ability tier, etc). Any surplus shards/blueprints over the bundle upgrade criteria will be retained.\n\nIf your previously unlocked units meet or exceed the bundle upgrade criteria for other attributes, any surplus value will be retained.\n\n[b]CHARACTERS[/b]\n- 7 Stars\n- Level 85\n- Relic Level 7\n- Ability Tier 7

NEWSLETTER_COLONEL_WARD_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Colonel Ward[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nA veteran officer and Support unit for the New Republic, Colonel Ward specializes in coordinating battlefield pressure and exposing enemy weaknesses for her allies to exploit. Whether directing fire from the front lines or supporting operations from the cockpit of her starship, Ward excels at keeping enemy forces pinned down while New Republic squads maintain momentum through constant counterattacks and coordinated retaliation.\n\nWard’s kit is built around punishing enemies who interfere with New Republic defenses. She spreads debuffs like Evasion Down, Burning, Healing Immunity, and Expose while enabling allies to capitalize on counterattacks and out of turn effects. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]New Republic's Most Wanted[-][/c], disrupts hidden enemies by stripping Stealth and Marking those targets, while her second Special ability applies broad pressure across the entire enemy team.\n\nHer Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]New Republic Officer[-][/c], ties the kit together with strong synergy for Taunting allies, Healers, and Supports. Ward steadily builds offensive pressure through Retaliate and On the Run mechanics, rewarding teams that maintain control of the battlefield over extended encounters. In Grand Arenas, her Omicron further strengthens New Republic squads with additional On the Run pressure and scaling stat boosts.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Colonel Ward[-][/c] is a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking the Journey Guide event for [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b], and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Colonel Ward in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“EYES ON THE OUTER RIM”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this cunning Support to your New Republic roster!

EVENT_SON_TO_A_MURDERED_TIER01_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- R5-D4 (Era Level 135)\n- R2-D2 (Era Level 135)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Jawas have placed restraining bolts on both droids.\n- All Jawas have an additional [c][F0FF23]Use Droid Caller[-][/c] ability that Stuns the target droid.\n- Damaging a Jawa increases the cooldown on their [c][F0FF23]Use Droid Caller[-][/c] ability by 1.\n- Pay extra attention to the [c][f0ff23]TURN ORDER TRACKER[-][/c] (tap the left facing arrow on the right edge of the screen), the Turn Meter bar on the Jawas, and the cooldown status of [c][F0FF23]Use Droid Caller[-][/c] to prioritize which Jawa to damage next.\n- If R5-D4 or R2-D2 are defeated or if both R5-D4 and R2-D2 are Stunned at the same time, the battle will end in defeat (R5-D4's Stun from their Special ability [c][F0FF23]Bad Motivator[-][/c] does not count towards defeat).\n- Defeat all Jawas to attempt your escape!
EVENT_SON_TO_A_MURDERED_TIER02_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Carson Teva (Era Level 135)\n- R5-D4 (Era Level 135)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- R5-D4 begins the encounter captured by the Empire and starts with the debuff [c][F0FF23]Captive[-][/c].\n- Captain Carson Teva has an additional ability, [c][F0FF23]Free R5-D4[-][/c], that will recover 20% Health and Protection to Captain Carson Teva and R5-D4; it also removes [c][F0FF23]Captive[-][/c] from R5-D4, but starts on cooldown.\n- The cooldown of [c][F0FF23]Free R5-D4[-][/c] is reduced by 1 every time Captain Carson Teva attacks during an enemy's turn.\n- Whenever Captain Carson Teva uses his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Keeping the Peace[-][/c], he dispels all debuffs on himself.\n- Save R5-D4 and defeat the Empire enemies to achieve victory.\n- Captain Carson Teva or R5-D4 being defeated will result in immediate loss.
EVENT_SON_TO_A_MURDERED_TIER03_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Snowtrooper Commander (Era Level 135)\n- Snowtrooper (Era Level 135)\n- Snowtrooper (Era Level 135)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) will show who he is going to target on his next turn via the [c][F0FF23]You're Next[-][/c] status effect.\n- Allies with [c][F0FF23]You're Next[-][/c] can't Stealth.\n- Scoring a critical hit on The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) will inflict him with Offense Down for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.\n- Whenever Snowtrooper Commander Taunts, he gains Advantage for 1 turn.\n- The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor)'s abilities have been modified for this battle.\n- Victory will be achieved when The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) is reduced to 10% Health.\n\n[c][F0FF23]You're Next:[-][/c] The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) deals dramatically increased damage to enemies with this effect
EVENT_SON_TO_A_MURDERED_TIER04_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Rotta the Hutt (Era Level 135)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Rotta has a new ability, [c][F0FF23]Grandstand[-][/c].\n- Using Grandstand gives him stacks of [c][F0FF23]Grandstanding[-][/c].\n- Each stack of [c][F0FF23]Grandstanding[-][/c] gives him extra Critical Damage and Offense.\n- Whenever Rotta takes damage, he loses a stack of [c][F0FF23]Grandstanding[-][/c].\n- If Rotta loses all stacks of [c][F0FF23]Grandstanding[-][/c], the battle ends in defeat.\n- Victory will be achieved when The Mandalorian (Beskar Armor) is reduced to 10% Health.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Grandstanding:[-][/c] +25% Critical Damage and Offense per stack until the end of battle; lose one stack of Grandstanding when receiving damage

EVENT_MARQUEE_CARSONTEVA_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- R5-D4\n- Hera Syndulla\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With his Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Captain of the Adelphi Rangers[-][/c], New Republic allies inflict 1 stack of [c][F0FF23]On the Run[-][/c] whenever they counterattack.\n- On the Run reduces enemy's Evasion and Tenacity. \n- Whenever an enemy reaches 10 stacks of On the Run they take Max Health Damage and Carson Teva's team gets a bonus turn.\n- Additionally, New Republic allies gain Potency when they resist a debuff and gain Retribution when they use a Special ability.

LEADERABILITY_CARSONTEVA_TIER_03_DESC_V3|At the start of battle, New Republic allies gain 50% Accuracy and Critical Damage. Whenever an ally counterattacks, that enemy is Exposed for 1 turn. Whenever any New Republic ally counterattacks, that ally deals 50% more damage. Whenever a New Republic ally resists a debuff, they gain 100% Potency for 1 turn.\n\nIf there is an allied New Republic Galactic Legend or there are no other Galactic Legends in the battle, whenever a New Republic ally counterattacks, inflict the target enemy with a stack of On the Run (stacking, max 10).\n\n[c][EBB000]On the Run:[-][/c] -10% Evasion and Tenacity per stack; at 10 stacks, lose all stacks, take 20% Max Health damage (can't be defeated by this damage), and all enemies gain a bonus turn. whenever stacks of On the Run are reset, inflict 2 stacks to this character and 1 stack to all other allies
LEADERABILITY_CARSONTEVA_TIER_04_DESC_V3|At the start of battle, New Republic allies gain 50% Accuracy and Critical Damage. Whenever an ally counterattacks, that enemy is Exposed for 1 turn. Whenever any New Republic ally counterattacks, that ally deals 50% more damage. Whenever a New Republic ally resists a debuff, they gain 100% Potency for 1 turn.\n\nIf there is an allied New Republic Galactic Legend or there are no other Galactic Legends in the battle, whenever a New Republic ally counterattacks, inflict the target enemy with a stack of On the Run (stacking, max 10). Whenever another New Republic ally counterattacks, they gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) until the end of encounter.
LEADERABILITY_CARSONTEVA_TIER_07_DESC_V3|At the start of battle, New Republic allies gain 50% Accuracy and Critical Damage. If there is an allied New Republic Galactic Legend or there are no other Galactic Legends in the battle, whenever a New Republic ally counterattacks, inflict the target enemy with a stack of On the Run (stacking, max 10).\n\nWhenever a New Republic ally uses a Special ability, all other New Republic allies gain Retribution for 1 turn. Whenever New Republic ally resists a debuff, they gain 100% Potency for 1 turn.\n\nWhenever any New Republic ally counterattacks, that ally deals 50% more damage. Whenever another New Republic ally counterattacks, they gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 50%) until the end of encounter and gain Defense Penetration Up for 1 turn. Whenever an ally counterattacks, that enemy is Exposed for 1 turn.\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in Territory Battles:[-][/c] Rebel allies gain 50% Max Health. If all allies are New Republic, they gain 100% Max Health and Max Protection until the end of battle, and 50% Defense Penetration and Offense for 2 turns; at the start of each encounter, New Republic Tank allies gain Foresight until the end of the encounter; New Republic allies are immune to Daze for 2 turns; whenever an enemy recovers Health or Protection, they are inflicted with Healing Immunity for 2 turns, which can't be resisted; whenever a New Republic ally attacks out of turn, they deal 100% more damage, the attack can't be evaded, inflict the target enemy with a stack of On the Run, and call a random New Republic ally to assist; whenever an enemy gains 5 stacks of On the Run, reset the cooldown of Keeping the Peace;\n\nThe first time each New Republic ally falls below 50% Health, they gain Damage Immunity for 1 turn; whenever a New Republic ally defeats an enemy, inflict Deathmark on the strongest enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted, and Expose all other enemies for 2 turns

NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_CARSON_TEVA_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Captain Carson Teva[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nA veteran pilot and trusted marshal of the New Republic, Captain Carson Teva spent years patrolling the Outer Rim in the difficult years following the fall of the Empire. Known for his calm judgment and willingness to operate beyond strict protocol when necessary, Teva became a reliable ally to those resisting growing Imperial threats in the shadows. His experience coordinating fighters and local defenders makes him a natural fit for leading New Republic forces into battle.\n\nCaptain Teva’s Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Captain of the Adelphi Rangers[-][/c], turns counterattacks into constant pressure against the enemy team, spreading stacks of the new On the Run debuff while empowering New Republic allies with Defense Penetration, Offense, and Retribution. Enemies struggle to escape coordinated retaliation, as Captain Teva’s squad will be triggering the effects of their Basic abilities when used during the opponent's turns. In Territory Battles, Teva dramatically improves the survivability and offensive pressure of full New Republic squads while overwhelming enemies through relentless attacks out of turn.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Keeping the Peace[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Unauthorized Operation[-][/c] reinforce Teva’s role as a tactical leader. He coordinates assists, punishes enemies who rely on debuffs or excessive Speed, and works closely with his trusty astromech droid R5-D4 to keep his squad active and aggressive.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Captain Carson Teva[-][/c] is a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b] in the Journey Guide event, and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Captain Teva in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“CLASSIFIED INFORMATION”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this seasoned New Republic marshal to your roster.
NEWSLETTER_CAPTAIN_CARSON_TEVA_TITLE|Sneak Attack!
NEWSLETTER_CINTA_KAZ_DESC_V2|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Cinta Kaz[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nAfter her family was massacred by stormtroopers, she became a fierce believer in the Rebellion's cause. Cinta Kaz brings determination and tactical cunning to every engagement. Her unwavering commitment to the fight and her bond with her squad make her a formidable presence on the battlefield.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Cinta Kaz[-][/c] is a Rebel Fighter Attacker who specializes in hit-and-run tactics and debuff amplification. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Blaster Burn[-][/c], deals damage and inflicts Defense Down, which becomes permanent if the target is Undermined. Her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Fight To The Death[-][/c], creates a debuff chain: Breach leads to Ability Block, which leads to Deathmark, and Undermined enemies can't resist it.\n\nHer Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Blooded, Fearless Warrior[-][/c], makes her the heart of Rebel Fighter teams. Whenever she uses an ability while Stealthed, she Exposes her target and she assists her Rebel Fighter allies against Undermined enemies. While in [c][F0FF23]Territory Wars[-][/c] with her Omicron ability, Cinta gains massive survivability through Stealth and defensive stats, and enemies that damage her become Undermined, or suffer Healing Immunity if they are already Undermined. Additionally, she and her Rebel Fighter allies gain increased stats for each Undermined foe, and recover Health and Protection whenever a Deathmarked enemy is defeated. \n\nHer second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You're The Only Reason I'm Here[-][/c], deepens her synergy with [c][F0FF23]Vel Sartha[-][/c]. Cinta and Vel recover Health and Protection whenever Cinta damages enemies, and if Vel is present, Cinta regains Stealth and Offense whenever her Stealth is dispelled, creating a relentless offensive cycle.\n\nUnlock [c][F0FF23]Cinta Kaz[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]FAITH IN THE DARK[-][/c] Marquee event that [c][F0FF23]gives out daily rewards[-][/c] for the duration of the event! Cinta is also one of the requirements (at 4 stars) to initially unlock the event for Cassian Andor (Undercover). 
NEWSLETTER_ROTTA_THE_HUTT_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe have put together this information in order to properly prepare everyone for the upcoming event to unlock Rotta the Hutt.\n\nThe event is four tiers in length. The first two tiers are playable alongside Grogu & Anzellans’ release.\n\nTier 1:\nRequired to unlock -\n\nCarson Teva (4 stars)\nColonel Ward (4 stars)\nGrogu & Anzellans (4 stars)\nR5-D4 (4 stars)\nZeb Orrellios (New Republic Pilot) (4 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use this unit in the tier) -\nR5-D4 (Era Level 90)\n\nRewards enough shards to unlock Rotta the Hutt at 4 stars.\n\nTier 2:\nRequired to unlock -\n\nCarson Teva(5 stars)\nColonel Ward (5 stars)\nGrogu & Anzellans (5 stars)\nR5-D4 (5 stars)\nZeb Orrellios (New Republic Pilot) (5 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use these units in the tier)  -\nCarson Teva (Era Level 95)\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Rotta the Hutt to 5 stars.\n\nThe final two tiers are playable alongside Snowtrooper Commander’s release.\n\nTier 3:\nRequired to unlock -\n\nCarson Teva (6 stars)\nColonel Ward (6 stars)\nGrogu & Anzellans (6 stars)\nR5-D4 (6 stars)\nSnowtrooper Commander (6 stars)\nZeb Orrellios (New Republic Pilot) (6 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use this unit in the tier)  -\nSnowtrooper Commander (Era Level 110)\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Rotta the Hutt to 6 stars.\n\nTier 4:\nRequired to unlock -\n\nCarson Teva (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nColonel Ward (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nGrogu & Anzellans (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nR5-D4 (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nSnowtrooper Commander (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nZeb Orrellios (New Republic Pilot) (7 stars - Era Level 125)\n\nYou will borrow a 7 star,  Era Level 135 Rotta the Hutt to play this tier with. You will not be using your own Rotta the Hutt.\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Rotta the Hutt to 7 stars.\n\nNote: These requirements are only for the first run of the Journey Guide Event (the one that takes place during the Era). When Rotta the Hutt’s Event eventually returns the requirements to play each tier will be significantly higher.

DATACRON_CHARACTER_CHIEFTNEBIT_002_DESC|At the start of battle, all Jawa allies gain 300% Bonus Protection.\n\nWhenever an enemy is inflicted with a Thermal Detonator, Chief Nebit gains 25% Defense (stacking, max 400%) and Jawa allies recover 25% Health and Protection.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_CHOPPER_001_DESC_V2|Whenever a Phoenix ally takes damage, all Phoenix allies gain 30% Max Health (stacking) and 30% Offense for 1 turn. Chopper ignores Taunt during his turns. Whenever Chopper takes damage while Taunting, Chopper recovers 50% Protection and all Phoenix allies gain 30% Turn Meter until the end of 2 turns.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_COBBVANTH_001_DESC|At the start of battle, if all allies are Constable, Jawa, or Tusken, gain the following effects:\n\n- Constable Support allies are inflicted with Marked until all other allies have taken a turn.\n\n- The first time Cobb Vanth uses High Noons against each enemy, they gain the Outlaw tag.\n\n- Whenever Cobb uses High Noons against an enemy Outlaw, reduce the cooldown for High Noons by 3.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_PAPLOO_002_DESC|Paploo Taunts for 2 turns at the start of battle, which can't be dispelled. If there were no Galactic Legends at the start of battle, allies ignore Taunt effects while Paploo is Taunting.\n\nWhenever Paploo uses a Special ability, allies gain 50% Defense and Offense (stacking, max 300%) and recover 25% Health and Protection.\n\nWhenever Paploo uses Galvanize, decrease the cooldowns of all Ewok allies by 2.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_PRINCESSKNEESAA_002_DESC|Whenever Princess Kneesaa attacks out of turn, she gains 10% Critical Damage and Offense (stacking, max 200%) until she is defeated. If there were no Galactic Legends at the start of battle, her out of turn attacks gain an additional 15% Critical Damage and Offense, they ignore Protection, and they deal an additional instance of True damage.\n\nWhenever Kneesaa uses a Special ability, the target enemy is inflicted with 1 stack of Damage Over Time for 1 turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TALIA_001_DESC|Whenever Nightsister allies use a Special ability on an enemy with any stacks of Plague, all other Nightsister allies assist, a random enemy is inflicted with 1 stack of Plague which can't be resisted, and the cooldown for Water of Life is reduced by 1.\n\nIf Mother Talzin is the ally in the Leader slot at the start of battle, at the start of each Nightsister ally's turn all Plagued enemies are Marked for 1 turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TARFFUL_002_DESC|If there are no Galactic Legends, Wookiee allies gain 1 stack of Bulwark for 1 turn each time they attack out of turn, are critically hit, Evade, or lose Taunt.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_TUSKENSHAMAN_001_DESC|The first time a Tusken ally inflicts a debuff each turn, they gain 5 stacks of Heal Over Time and the target enemy is inflicted with 2 stacks of Damage Over Time for 2 turns.\n\nThe first time an ally loses any stacks of Momentum each turn, they gain 1 stack of Momentum for 3 turns, 2 stacks of Heal Over Time for 2 turns, trigger all allies' stacks of Heal Over Time, and trigger all enemies' stacks of Damage Over Time.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_UGNAUGHT_002_DESC|At the start of battle, if Hondo Ohnaka and Ezra Bridger are allies and there are no other allies, gain the following effects:\n\n- At the start of each turn, if Hondo Ohnaka has more stacks of Ransom than Ugnaught, Ugnaught and Ezra gain 2 stacks of Ransom (stacking, max 50) which can't be copied, dispelled, or prevented, and all allies gain 25% Defense and Offense (stacking) for the rest of battle. These increases persist through defeat.\n\n- Whenever Ezra Bridger assists, he gains Dramatic Entrance for 1 turn, the strongest ally who doesn't already have it gains Frenzy until the start of their next turn, and the weakest ally who doesn't already have it gains Tactical Genius for 1 turn.\n\n- Whenever Ugnaught uses his Basic ability, dispel all debuffs on all allies, then all allies assist a total of 6 times. Whenever Ugnaught uses a Special ability, dispel all enemy buffs and Fracture the target enemy until the start of Ugnaught's next turn or until Ugnaught is defeated.\n\n- At the start of battle, all allies gain 400% bonus Protection and Backup Plan for the rest of battle. Whenever an ally takes damage, all allies recover 30% Health.\n\n- At the start of battle, if Ugnaught is on Offense, allies gain 50% Evasion until the end of battle. If there are no Galactic Legends, they gain an additional 50% Evasion.

EVENT_MARQUEE_GOPHERANTS_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Carson Teva\n- Colonel Ward\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Grogu & Anzellans' Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Good Shot, Baby![-][/c], inflicts the enemy with Off Balance, and if it's used during the enemy's turn, Ability Block them.\n- Grogu & Anzellans' first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Tune Up[-][/c], equalizes all allies' Health, then grants them Defense Up. EVENT_MARQUEE_GOPHERANTS_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Carson Teva\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- During Grogu & Anzellans' turn, their Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Good Shot, Baby![-][/c], inflicts Force Influence on the enemy.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GOPHERANTS_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Carson Teva\n- Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot)\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Grogu & Anzellans' first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Tune Up[-][/c], New Republic allies recover Health and gain stacks of Heal Over Time.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GOPHERANTS_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Carson Teva\n- Colonel Ward\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Grogu & Anzellans' second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Strapped In[-][/c], all allies gain Dramatic Entrance and stacks of Heal Over Time.\n- Also, the target New Republic ally gains Retribution and their cooldowns are reduced.\n- The target enemy is inflicted with a stack of On the Run and their cooldowns are increased.
EVENT_MARQUEE_GOPHERANTS_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Captain Carson Teva\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Grogu & Anzellans' Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Bad Baby![-][/c], whenever an Attacker or Tank ally loses Deflective Ward, Retaliate, Retribution, or a Taunt effect, they trigger their stacks of Heal Over Time.\n- Also, at the start of each enemy's turn, Grogu & Anzellans gain stacking Defense and allies ignore Taunt effects during enemy turns.

NEWSLETTER_GROGU_ANZELLANS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nNot every hero charges into battle blaster-first. [c][F0FF23]Grogu & Anzellans[-][/c] bring a different kind of Support to the Holotables, combining Grogu's growing Force abilities with the ingenuity of talented Anzellan mechanics. As a Light Side Healer for Mandalorian and New Republic squads, they specialize in keeping allies operational, disrupting enemy plans, and turning battlefield setbacks into opportunities.\n\nGrogu & Anzellans specialize in sustaining their team through powerful healing and utility effects. Their first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Tune Up[-][/c], equalizes ally Health before providing defensive bonuses and additional recovery for Mandalorian and New Republic allies. Their second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Strapped In[-][/c], disrupts enemy plans by dispelling buffs while granting Dramatic Entrance and Heal Over Time effects to allies. They can also empower key New Republic allies by reducing cooldowns and granting Retribution while simultaneously slowing enemy momentum through cooldown increases and On the Run.\n\nTheir first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Bad Baby![-][/c], bolsters New Republic squads with increased durability through bonus Health, Protection, and Deflective Ward. Grogu & Anzellans also excel at countering control effects, helping allies recover from debilitating debuffs while providing additional Health recovery whenever key defensive effects are removed. In Grand Arenas, they become even more difficult to pin down, gaining additional survivability for their squad and Untargetable after using Special abilities.\n\nTheir second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Din Grogu[-][/c] showcases Grogu's growing connection to the Force. He disrupts enemies with Distract and On the Run while steadily building Force Connection throughout the encounter, growing stronger as the battle progresses.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Grogu & Anzellans[-][/c] are a requirement (at 4*) for unlocking [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b] in the Journey Guide event, and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock Grogu & Anzellans in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]“SMALL BUT MIGHTY”[-][/c] Marquee event and add this unlikely crew of mischief-makers to your New Republic roster!
NEWSLETTER_GROGU_ANZELLANS_TITLE|No Head Room
NEWSLETTER_LEIA_JEDI_TRAINING_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Leia (Jedi Training)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nAfter the fall of the Empire, Leia Organa continued her Jedi training under the guidance of her brother, Luke Skywalker. A vision of her son’s future convinced her to step away from completing her Jedi path, but the lessons she learned and the connection she forged with the Force remained an important part of her journey.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Leia (Jedi Training)[-][/c] is an Attacker who thrives alongside Jedi Master Luke Skywalker, growing stronger throughout battle as she gains Jedi Lessons and deepens her connection to the Force. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Tactical Strike[-][/c], helps her adapt as the battle unfolds, gaining Jedi Lessons against faster enemies and unleashing additional attacks against slower foes, while her Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Instinct of the Force[-][/c], allows her to pressure enemies and capitalize on opportunities created by her fellow Jedi. \n\nAs battles progress, Leia becomes an increasingly valuable ally through her Unique abilities, [c][F0FF23]The Unchosen Path[-][/c] and [c][F0FF23]Disciple of the Force[-][/c]. She supports Jedi allies with Protection recovery, bonus turns, and powerful team-wide benefits while lifting Jedi Master Luke Skywalker to reach his full potential. Her second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Final Lesson[-][/c], adapts to different opponents while accelerating Luke's Ultimate Charge, creating a powerful partnership between master and student that rewards dedicated Jedi squads.\n\nWhile in Grand Arenas, Leia further enhances Jedi teams through additional survivability, anti-revive effects, and powerful synergy with Jedi Master Luke Skywalker. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Leia (Jedi Training)[-][/c] through the upcoming Conquest event and strengthen one of the galaxy's most iconic Jedi pairings.
NEWSLETTER_LEIA_JEDI_TRAINING_TITLE|The Road Not Taken
NEWSLETTER_ROTTA_THE_HUTT_KIT_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Rotta the Hutt[-][/c] arrives on the Holotables as a powerful new Light Side Attacker and Leader for Hutt Cartel squads. Once known as Jabba's young heir, Rotta has grown into a formidable presence in his own right, capable of leading Hutt Cartel forces into battle or standing alone against overwhelming odds. Rotta brings a relentless fighting style built around Bleeds, Thermal Detonators, and overwhelming durability.\n\nAs a Hutt Cartel Leader, Rotta empowers his allies through [c][F0FF23]A Legacy Reforged[-][/c], granting significant boosts to survivability, offensive capabilities, and battlefield control. His leadership rewards Hutt Cartel teams for applying Bleeds and Thermal Detonators, keeping allies healthy while generating Turn Meter throughout the battle. Combined with his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Pedunkee Mufkin[-][/c], Rotta creates a resilient squad that shrugs off disruption, punishes enemy debuffs, and keeps pressure on opponents through constant recovery and bonus turns.\n\nRotta is equally dangerous when fighting alone. His [c][F0FF23]Cleave the Unworthy[-][/c] steadily weakens enemies over the course of battle while increasing his own Speed, allowing him to snowball into an unstoppable threat. His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Knock 'Em Dead[-][/c], blankets enemy teams with Bleeds and Off Balance before setting up devastating follow-up attacks, while his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Showboat[-][/c], triggers accumulated damage effects, Stuns opponents, and can instantly defeat weakened enemies. When entering battle without allies, Rotta gains tremendous bonuses to Health, Protection, and durability, transforming him into a true solo powerhouse capable of taking on entire squads by himself.\n\nWhile in Grand Arenas, Rotta further enhances Hutt Cartel teams with powerful Thermal Detonator synergies, bonus Protection, and relentless offensive momentum. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Rotta the Hutt[-][/c] through his upcoming Journey Guide event, [c][F0FF23]"CHAMPION OF THE PIT"[-][/c], and unleash him as a one-Hutt wrecking crew. To learn more about the characters required for his event, check out the Rotta the Hutt Journey Guide Event Requirements newsletter.
NEWSLETTER_ROTTA_THE_HUTT_KIT_TITLE|The Son Also Rises

EVENT_MARQUEE_REMNANTSNOWCOMMANDER_M02_DESC_V2|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Snowtrooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Snowtrooper Commander's Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]T-21B Blaster Rifle[-][/c], calls Snowtrooper to assist, making them a powerful duo.\n- Use his Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Hunker Down[-][/c], to gain Defense and all Imperial Remnant allies gain Protection Up.\n
EVENT_MARQUEE_REMNANTSNOWCOMMANDER_M03_DESC_V2|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Snowtrooper\n- TIE Fighter Pilot\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Snowtrooper Commander’s second Special, [c][F0FF23]Rifle Butt[-][/c], allows him to Stealth all non-Tank Imperial Remnant allies.\n- If Snowtrooper and TIE Fighter Pilot are active allies, they gain Offense equal to Snowtrooper Commander's Defense.\n
EVENT_MARQUEE_REMNANTSNOWCOMMANDER_M04_DESC_V2|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Snowtrooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Snowtrooper Commander’s Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Warlord's Enforcer[-][/c], whenever an enemy attacks out of turn, inflict Speed Down on them, and whenever an enemy resists a debuff, inflict Tenacity Down on them.\n- The first time any other Imperial Remnant ally falls low on Health, they gain Health and Protection Up and Snowtrooper Commander Taunts.
EVENT_MARQUEE_REMNANTSNOWCOMMANDER_M05_DESC_V2|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Scout Trooper\n- Dark Trooper\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Snowtrooper Commander's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Whiteout Conditions[-][/c], whenever he is inflicted with a debuff while Taunting, all other Imperial Remnant allies gain Turn Meter.\n- When he is not Taunting, he gains Turn Meter whenever another Imperial Remnant ally is damaged by an enemy.\n- Whenever another Imperial Remnant ally scores more than one critical hit during their turn, they Stealth and Snowtrooper Commander Taunts.

If Princess Leia and Stormtrooper Han are present, these increases are tripled. While a Rebel ally has more than 50% Health, they have 100% Defense and whenever they use an ability on their turn, they Expose the target enemy for 1 turn. While a Rebel ally has less than 50% Health, they gain 50% Offense.\n\nWhile a Rebel ally is Stealthed, they have 20% Defense Penetration. If Stealth or Taunt is dispelled from a Rebel ally, they gain Defense Up and Foresight for 1 turn. If a Rebel ally removes Turn Meter from an enemy, [c][F0FF23]Distract[-][/c] that enemy for 1 turn, which can't be evaded or resisted.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Distracted:[-][/c] Can't gain bonus Turn Meter\n\n[c][E7E7E7]While in 3v3 Grand Arenas, and there is an allied Princess Leia, Stormtrooper Han, and no enemy Galactic Legends:[-][/c]\nWhenever Stealth is dispelled from a Rebel ally, reduce the cooldowns of their abilities by 1. NEWSLETTER_SNOWTROOPER_COMMANDER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nFollowing the Empire's collapse, scattered Imperial forces fought to maintain control of what remained of the Empire. Snowtrooper Commanders led small groups of Imperial units in some of the galaxy's harshest environments, helping maintain order and discipline among the Imperial Remnant's remaining forces.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] is a Tank and Leader built to protect Imperial Remnant allies while turning enemy pressure into opportunities for his squad. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]T-21B Blaster Rifle[-][/c], applies Vulnerable and helps Imperial Remnant allies capitalize on weakened enemies, while his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Hunker Down[-][/c], allows him to establish a strong defensive position and reinforce both Empire and Imperial Remnant allies. As enemies focus their attacks on Snowtrooper Commander, Imperial Remnant allies gain increased Defense Penetration and Turn Meter, allowing them to build momentum while he absorbs the enemy's attention.\n\nHis second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Rifle Butt[-][/c], disrupts enemy plans by Stunning enemies while helping allies leverage Snowtrooper Commander's high Defense. It also helps protect vulnerable Imperial Remnant allies by concealing them with Stealth, making it more difficult for opponents to target the squad's key damage dealers. Meanwhile, his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Whiteout Conditions[-][/c], rewards Imperial Remnant allies for operating from the shadows, strengthening the squad whenever Snowtrooper Commander draws enemy attention or absorbs hostile attacks. Together, these abilities create a defensive core that enables Imperial Remnant squads to outlast and overwhelm their opponents.\n\nAs a Leader, [c][F0FF23]Warlord's Enforcer[-][/c] greatly improves the durability of Imperial Remnant allies while hindering enemies that attack out of turn or resist the squad's debuffs. With his Omicron in the 3v3 Grand Arenas game mode, Snowtrooper Commander further enhances Imperial Remnant teams with powerful Stealth synergies, additional survivability, and escalating battlefield pressure that grows throughout the encounter.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] is a requirement (at 6* and Era Level 110) for [b]Rotta the Hutt[/b] in the Journey Guide event to promote Rotta to 6*, and will be a requirement for this year’s [b]Galactic Legend[/b]. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Snowtrooper Commander[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"IMPERIAL VANGUARD"[-][/c] Marquee event and bring a steadfast defender to your Imperial Remnant roster!

DATACRON_CHARACTER_BB8_001_DESC|At the start of battle, if all other allies are Droids, all allies gain the Resistance tag until the end of battle. At the start of battle, Resistance allies gain Secret Intel for 2 turns. Whenever an ally gains Secret Intel, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Chance (stacking, max 100%) and Critical Damage (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. The first time a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health, BB-8 resets the cooldown of Illuminated Destiny. Whenever BB-8 uses a Special ability, inflict Buff Immunity on a random enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_BISHOP_001_DESC|Whenever Colonel Ward inflicts a debuff on an enemy, she gains 30% Potency and Max Health (each stacking, max 150%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever a New Republic ally damages an Exposed enemy, that ally recovers 30% Protection and inflicts Ability Block on that enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted. Whenever Colonel Ward uses New Republic's Most Wanted, the target ally gains a bonus turn.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_CARSONTEVA_001_DESC|Carson Teva gains 30% Offense (stacking, max 150%) each time he counterattacks until the end of the encounter. Carson Teva can't be defeated while other allies are active. Whenever Carson Teva uses Keeping the Peace, a New Republic Tank ally assists. The first time each enemy reaches 5 stacks of On the Run, New Republic allies gain 50% Turn Meter until the end of battle. Carson Teva recovers 30% Health and Protection and gains 30% Critical Damage (stacking, max 180%) until the end of battle.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_DARKREY_001_DESC|Whenever Rey (Dark Side Vision) inflicts Fear, reduce the cooldowns of First Order allies by 1. Whenever Rey (Dark Side Vision) uses Malevolent Lineage, if all enemies are Shocked, deal bonus damage equal to 20% of their Max Health to all enemies, which can't be evaded. While Rey (Dark Side Vision) is Untargetable, she gains 20% Offense and First Order allies gain 20% Critical Damage.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_GOPHERANTS_001_DESC|Whenever Grogu & Anzellans uses Strapped In, the target New Republic ally also gains Critical Hit Immunity for 2 turns and 30% Turn Meter. Whenever Grogu & Anzellans uses Tune Up, New Republic allies also gain Protection (50%) and Speed Up for 2 turns. Whenever an enemy gains a stack of On the Run, Grogu & Anzellans gains 1 additional stack of Force Connection. Whenever an enemy with Force Influence uses an ability, that enemy deals bonus True damage equal to 30% of their Max Health to themselves, which can't be evaded.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_KYLORENUNMASKED_001_DESC|Whenever Kylo Ren (Unmasked) takes damage while Taunting, he gains 10% Defense (stacking, max 100%) and Max Health (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter, and First Order allies gain 10% Offense (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever Kylo Ren (Unmasked) attacks out of turn, he inflicts Offense Down on target enemy for 2 turns. Whenever Kylo Ren (Unmasked) Stuns an enemy, increase that enemy's cooldowns by 1 and First Order allies gain Offense Up for 2 turns.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_R5D4_001_DESC|Whenever R5-D4 gains Retaliate, he also gains Defense Up and Potency Up for 2 turns. Whenever a New Republic ally counterattacks an enemy, that ally inflicts 2 stacks of Damage Over Time on that enemy for 2 turns, which can't be resisted. Whenever an enemy with Damage Over Time uses an ability, the ally in the Leader slot gains 30% Offense (stacking, max 210%) and reduces the cooldown of Bad Motivator by 5 until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_RACCOON_001_DESC|Rotta the Hutt's solo effects are active even when he has allies. Whenever Rotta the Hutt critically hits, he gains 10% Critical Chance (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever Rotta uses Knock 'Em Dead, if any enemy is inflicted with Off Balance, Hutt Cartel allies recover 15% Health and Protection. Whenever Rotta defeats an enemy, he gains 10% Offense (stacking, max 80%) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_RANGERZEB_001_DESC|While Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) is Taunting, New Republic allies are immune to Ability Block, Daze, and Stun, can't be instantly defeated, and take 30% less damage. Whenever Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot) loses Taunt, he gains Taunt for 1 turn. The first time Zeb Orrelios (New Republic Pilot), Carson Teva, R5-D4, Colonel Ward or Grogu & Anzellans falls below 50% Health, that ally gains Damage Immunity for 2 turns and New Republic allies gain 30% Turn Meter.
DATACRON_CHARACTER_REMNANTSNOWCOMMANDER_001_DESC|At the start of Snowtrooper Commander's turn, he gains 15% Defense for each active Imperial Remnant ally for 1 turn. The first time each Imperial Remnant ally is defeated, Snowtrooper Commander revives that ally with 30% Health and Protection. Whenever an Imperial Remnant ally inflicts Ability Block on an enemy, that ally also inflicts Buff Immunity on that enemy for 2 turns. Whenever Snowtrooper Commander uses Rifle Butt, he inflicts Fracture until the start of Snowtrooper Commander's next turn or Snowtrooper Commander is defeated, which can't be copied, dispelled, or evaded.
DATACRON_FACTION_FIRSTORDER_004_DESC|At the start of battle, First Order allies gain 20% Health Steal, Offense, and Retribution for 1 turn. Whenever a First Order ally counterattacks, that ally gains 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 50%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever a First Order ally Stuns an enemy, First Order allies recover 10% Health and Protection.
DATACRON_FACTION_RESISTANCE_004_DESC|Whenever a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health for the first time, that ally gains Protection Over Time (50%) for 2 turns. Whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit, that ally gains 10% Health Steal (stacking, max 100%) until the end of the encounter. Whenever any Resistance ally assists, that ally gains 15% Turn Meter. Whenever a Resistance ally defeats an enemy, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 150%) until the end of the encounter.
DATACRON_FACTION_RESISTANCE_005_DESC|Whenever a Resistance ally falls below 50% Health for the first time, they gain Protection Over Time (50%) for 2 turns. Whenever a Resistance ally scores a critical hit, they gain 5% Health Steal (stacking, max 25%) until the end of encounter. Whenever a Resistance ally defeats an enemy, Resistance allies gain 10% Critical Damage (stacking, max 50%) until the end of encounter.

EVENT_MARQUEE_LUKESTARKILLER_M01_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept)\n- Commander Luke Skywalker\n- Threepio & Chewie\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Laser-Sword Strike[-][/c], grants Starkiller (Luke Concept) Turn Meter if Commander Luke Skywalker is the ally in the Leader slot.\n- His first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Son of the Suns[-][/c], deals damage and inflicts Buff Immunity and the new [c][ffff33]Shared Fate[-][/c] debuff on target enemy.\n- With his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Grip of Tython[-][/c], Starkiller (Luke Concept) deals damage to all enemies and dispels all debuffs from his allies.\n- His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Force of Others[-][/c], grants Critical Chance, Max Health, and Max Protection to all Rebel allies. Enemies are also Exposed when critically hit by Rebel allies, increasing the squad’s damage output even further.
EVENT_MARQUEE_LUKESTARKILLER_M02_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In addition to gaining Turn Meter, Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Laser-Sword Strike[-][/c], also dispels buffs and deals damage to the target enemy.
EVENT_MARQUEE_LUKESTARKILLER_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Commander Luke Skywalker\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Son of the Suns[-][/c], he not only deals damage, but also calls Commander Luke Skywalker to assist if he is in the Leader slot and inflicts [c][ffff33]Shared Fate[-][/c] on target enemy. If Commander Luke Skywalker has Call to Action, he assists again.\n- Damaging an enemy inflicted with Shared Fate spreads a portion of that damage to all other enemies, allowing Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s team to cripple his foes.
EVENT_MARQUEE_LUKESTARKILLER_M04_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Commander Luke Skywalker\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With his second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Grip of Tython[-][/c], he inflicts Ability Block on all enemies.\n- If Commander Luke Skywalker is the ally in the Leader slot and there are no Galactic Legend allies, then any enemy critically hit by this ability will lose Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_LUKESTARKILLER_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Commander Luke Skywalker\n- Chewbacca\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Force of Others[-][/c], each time an enemy uses their Special ability while they are inflicted with Shared Fate, all other enemies have their cooldowns increased.\n- The first time an ally gains Guard, all other allies also gain Guard, which makes them resilient against critical hits and the debilitating Daze and Stun debuffs.\n- Because of Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s Unique, whenever Commander Luke Skywalker gains Call to Action, all other Rebel allies gain it as well, helping the entire squad to bypass enemies with Taunt.
EVENT_MARQUEE_LUKESTARKILLER_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Commander Luke Skywalker\n- Han Solo\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- While in Grand Arenas, Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s Omicron on his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Force of Others[-][/c], allows Rebel allies to gain bonus Defense Penetration while they are attacking out of turn.\n- Whenever an enemy inflicts Ability Block on Rebel allies, they dispel it and gain Protection Up, turning the enemy's tactics into a powerful boon for Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s team.\n- Enemies inflicted with Shared Fate can't gain bonus Turn Meter, Starkiller (Luke Concept) gains Turn Meter whenever they take a turn.\n- [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, this battle is being simulated as if it were in the Grand Arenas game mode and with Starkiller (Luke Concept)'s Omicron enabled.

EVENT_MARQUEE_MARAJADESKYWALKER_M03_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Mara Jade Skywalker's first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Always Play Fair[-][/c], she damages all enemies while granting Offense Up to all allies and Riposte to herself. EVENT_MARQUEE_MARAJADESKYWALKER_M05_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- With Mara Jade Skywalker's Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]A Galactic Union[-][/c], if Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker is the ally in the Leader slot, she gains Jedi's Will, and they both gain Instant Defeat Immunity, and inflicting Healing Immunity on Vulnerable enemies.\n- Her cooldowns are reset whenever an ally uses Jedi Knight Luke's Granted ability, [c][F0FF23]Heroes Arise[-][/c], and she assists Jedi allies with Resilient Defense whenever they attack.\n- Whenever she attacks out of turn, she gains Protection Up. At the end of every character's turn, if she hasn't received damage, she gains Offense and Turn Meter.
EVENT_MARQUEE_MARAJADESKYWALKER_M06_DESC|[c][24ccf4]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Are [c][F0FF23]NOT SHARED[-][/c] between tiers\n\n[c][24ccf4]Rewards:[-][/c]\n- Features first time and repeatable rewards\n- Refreshes daily until event ends\n\n[c][24ccf4]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker\n\n[c][24ccf4]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- While in Grand Arenas and there are no Galactic Legends, Mara Jade Skywalker's Omicron on [c][F0FF23]A Galactic Union[-][/c] dramatically enhances her kit.\n- At the start of battle, the enemy Leader loses Protection.\n- Whenever an enemy is defeated, Mara Jade Skywalker gains increased Defense Penetration.\n- Mara Jade Skywalker is immune to Fear and Stun if Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker is the ally in the Leader slot.\n- On Jedi Knight Skywalker's first turn, Mara Jade Skywalker gains a bonus turn.\n- Whenever an ally uses Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker's Granted ability, Mara Jade Skywalker gains bonus Turn Meter.\n - [c][ffff33]NOTE:[-][/c] For demonstrative purposes, this battle is being simulated as if it were in the Grand Arena game mode and with Mara Jade Skywalker's Omicron enabled.

EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER01_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Yoda (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n-Yoda confronts his darker half, a dark half that represents the path not taken. Does Yoda have the strength to stand up to this corruption, or will his willpower waver and fall in the face of overwhelming darkness?\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Grand Master Yoda shifts between [c][F0FF23]Peace[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Justice[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Guardian[-][/c] Stances at the start of each of his turns.\n- Each Stance can only be damaged by a specific attack. Watch Grand Master Yoda's current Stance carefully and choose your action accordingly.\n- Using the wrong attack will trigger a powerful counterattack and inflict additional penalties, making future turns more difficult.\n- If Yoda (Dark Side Vision) cannot use the correct attack, consider using [c][F0FF23]Bide[-][/c] to recover Health and inflict the enemy with Healing Immunity before passing the turn. Be aware that using Bide will also Stun Yoda (Dark Side Vision), so use it when the tradeoff is worthwhile.\n- Success depends on matching the correct ability to each Stance, managing cooldowns efficiently.
EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER02_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept) (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n-Imperial Stormtroopers have breached the hull of the Rebel blockade runner, causing the atmosphere to quickly escape. Our hero, Starkiller (Luke Concept), has donned a breath mask and faces off against the lightsaber and shield wielding Stormtroopers in an effort to escape the clutches of the Empire.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- At the start of each Stormtrooper (Concept)'s turn, [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] is reduced for each buff that Stormtrooper has.\n- If [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] reaches 0%, the battle will end in defeat. Carefully manage enemy buffs to slow the loss of Air Supply.\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can ignore [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c], allowing him to target priority enemies regardless of active tanks.\n- Pay close attention to the [c][F0FF23]TURN METER[-][/c] of each Stormtrooper (Concept) and decide which enemies need to be targeted before they take their turns.\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can also inflict [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] as if Commander Luke Skywalker were in the leader slot, allowing damage dealt to spread rapidly across the enemy team.\n- Proper timing of [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] and buff control will be key to preserving your Air Supply and defeating all enemies!
EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER03_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Mara Jade Skywalker (EL: 130)\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n-In a throne room on Mount Tantiss, Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker face off against a clone of Luke made from the hand he lost on Cloud City. Mara Jade still hears the echoing last command from the Emperor: Kill Luke Skywalker, a command she has thus far resisted...\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Luuke Skywalker can only take damage while afflicted with [c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Off-Balance[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stagger[-][/c], or [c][F0FF23]Stun[-][/c].\n- Use Mara Jade Skywalker and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker's abilities carefully to stack the required debuffs on Luuke Skywalker before attempting to attack him.\n- Pay close attention to which debuffs are currently active on Luuke Skywalker and plan your turns accordingly.\n- Timing and debuff management are the key to victory, keep Luuke Skywalker controlled long enough for Mara Jade Skywalker to strike the decisive blow!
EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER04_ERA_DESC|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Darth Jar Jar (EL: 130)\n- Rey (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)\n- Yoda (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In order to defeat each enemy, they must be affected by a specific debuff. Jaxxon must have Massively Overpowered , Viper must have Target Lock, and Cal Kestis has to be Manipulated when they are defeated.\n- Defeating an enemy without their required debuff will cause them to revive.\n- Pay close attention to enemy Health and avoid defeating targets before the proper debuff has been applied. Managing damage output and timing your abilities correctly will be essential to completing the encounter.\n- One of the biggest challenges will be applying [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c] to Viper. Wait for Viper to inflict [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c], then use Yoda (Dark Side Vision) to transfer or spread the debuff back onto Viper before finishing her off.\n- Jaxxon will receive Massively Overpowered when Darth Jar Jar, Rey (Dark Side Vision) and Yoda (Dark Side Vision) have Dark Master's Training.\n- Defeat all enemies under the correct debuff conditions to claim victory!
