NEWSLETTER_DARTH_JAR_JAR_JOURNEY_GUIDE_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\nWe have put together this information in order to properly prepare everyone for the upcoming event to unlock Darth Jar Jar.\n\nThe event is four tiers in length. The first two tiers are playable alongside Jaxxon’s release.\n\nTier 1:\nRequired to unlock -\n\nMara Jade Skywalker (4 stars)\nYoda (Dark Side Vision) (4 stars)\nStarkiller (Luke Concept) (4 stars)\nStormtrooper (Concept) (4 stars)\nJaxxon (4 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use this unit in the tier) -\nYoda (Dark Side Vision) (Era Level 90)\n\nRewards enough shards to unlock Darth Jar Jar at 4 stars.\n\nTier 2:\nRequired to unlock -\n\nMara Jade Skywalker (5 stars)\nYoda (Dark Side Vision) (5 stars)\nStarkiller (Luke Concept) (5 stars)\nStormtrooper (Concept) (5 stars)\nJaxxon (5 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use these units in the tier) -\nStarkiller (Luke Concept) (Era Level 95)\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Darth Jar Jar to 5 stars.\n\nThe final two tiers are playable alongside The Ronin’s release.\n\nTier 3:\nRequired to unlock -\n\nMara Jade Skywalker (6 stars)\nYoda (Dark Side Vision) (6 stars)\nStarkiller (Luke Concept) (6 stars)\nStormtrooper (Concept) (6 stars)\nJaxxon (6 stars)\nThe Ronin (6 stars)\n\nRequired to play (you will use this unit in the tier)  -\nMara Jade Skywalker (Era Level 110)\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Darth Jar Jar to 6 stars.\n\nTier 4:\nRequired to unlock - \n\nMara Jade Skywalker (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nYoda (Dark Side Vision) (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nStarkiller (Luke Concept) (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nStormtrooper (Concept) (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nJaxxon (7 stars - Era Level 125)\nThe Ronin (7 stars - Era Level 125)\n\nYou will borrow a 7 star, Era Level 130 Darth Jar Jar to play this tier with. You will not be using your own Darth Jar Jar.\n\nRewards enough shards to promote Darth Jar Jar to 7 stars.\n\nNote: These requirements are only for the first run of the Journey Guide Event (the one that takes place during the Era). When Darth Jar Jar’s Event eventually returns the requirements to play each tier will be significantly higher.
NEWSLETTER_DARTH_JAR_JAR_JOURNEY_GUIDE_TITLE|Darth Jar Jar Journey Guide Event Requirements
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_MYTHS_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Era of Myths & Legends[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nThroughout Star Wars history, there have always been stories that exist just beyond the boundaries of the galaxy we know. Legends passed between fans, alternate paths never taken, concept art brought to life, and characters whose popularity grew into something much larger than their original appearances. The Era of Myths & Legends celebrates these unforgettable stories, bringing some of Star Wars' most fascinating untold destinies and fan-favorite legends to Galaxy of Heroes over the coming months.\n\nOur first Marquee release is [c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c]. One of the most beloved characters from Star Wars Legends, Mara Jade's journey from Emperor's Hand to Jedi Master has captivated fans for decades. She arrives ready to bring her unique perspective and powerful Force abilities to the Holotables.\n\nThe second Marquee character is [c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c]. Drawn from one of the most intriguing alternate possibilities in Star Wars history, this version of Yoda explores what might have happened had one of the Jedi Order's greatest Masters fallen to the dark side.\n\nNext comes [c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c], a character pulled directly from early concept explorations of Luke Skywalker. Inspired by Ralph McQuarrie's original artwork, he offers a glimpse into a version of Star Wars that almost was while reimagining one of the franchise's most iconic heroes. Following him is the fourth Marquee character, [c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c], which continues that celebration of Star Wars history by bringing one of the earliest visual interpretations of the Empire's soldiers into the game.\n\nNo Era of Myths & Legends would be complete without one of Star Wars' most unexpected fan favorites. [c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c], the green Lepi smuggler from the original Marvel Star Wars comics (and self-admitted real deep cut), hops into the Holotables with all the charm and adventure that made him a cult classic among fans.\n\nOur final Marquee character is [c][F0FF23]The Ronin[-][/c]. Inspired by Star Wars: Visions, this wandering warrior walks a path unlike any other, blending familiar Star Wars themes with a striking interpretation of the galaxy far, far away.\n\nAll of this leads to the Journey Guide character for the Era: [c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c]. This unexpected Sith Lord has become one of the galaxy's most memorable alternate-universe characters. Now, players will have the opportunity to unlock Darth Jar Jar and unleash the dark power lurking behind that familiar Gungan grin. Unlocking Darth Jar Jar will require having all the previous marquee characters from the Era of Myths & Legends at 4*. To improve the unit will require those same characters at 5*, 6*, and finally 7*/EL 125\n\nWe hope you enjoy the Era of Myths & Legends! From beloved Legends characters and classic concept art to alternate destinies, we're excited to bring some of Star Wars' most iconic and unexpected stories to the Holotables over the coming months!
NEWSLETTER_ERA_OF_MYTHS_TITLE|Era of Myths & Legends
NEWSLETTER_MARA_JADE_SKYWALKER_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nOnce the Emperor's most trusted Hand, Mara Jade forged a new destiny after the fall of the Empire. Guided by Luke Skywalker, she left her past behind to become a Jedi Master, eventually standing beside him as both a trusted ally and his wife while continuing to carve her own path as one of the Order's most formidable warriors. One of the most beloved characters from Star Wars Legends, Mara Jade Skywalker embodies the balance she found on her journey to the light.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c] is an Attacker who excels alongside Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker, rewarding coordinated attacks and relentless offensive pressure. Her Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Two Halves[-][/c], showcases the pair's seamless teamwork, allowing them to strike in tandem and build momentum through coordinated follow-up attacks, while her first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]I Always Play Fair[-][/c], weakens enemy defenses and empowers Jedi allies to press the advantage. Together, Mara and Luke create a formidable partnership that grows stronger as the battle unfolds.\n\nHer second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Last Command[-][/c] rewards Jedi allies for fighting together, becoming increasingly devastating as they launch coordinated attacks throughout the battle. Meanwhile, her Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]A Galactic Union[-][/c] reinforces Mara's role as a relentless attacker, granting powerful benefits to Jedi allies while strengthening her synergy with Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker. Their combined abilities create a highly mobile Jedi squad capable of maintaining constant pressure through teamwork and well-timed assist attacks.\n\nWhile in Grand Arenas, Mara Jade Skywalker gains additional survivability, battlefield control, and powerful tools that target the enemy Leader, making her a formidable force against non-Galactic Legend squads. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Mara Jade Skywalker[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"THE LAST COMMAND"[-][/c] Marquee event and reunite one of Star Wars Legends' most iconic Jedi partnerships on the Holotables!

NEWSLETTER_YODA_DARK_SIDE_VISION_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nDuring his journey to uncover the mysteries of the Force, Yoda was confronted with a terrifying vision of the darkness lurking within himself. This vision imagines one of the Jedi Order's greatest Masters embracing the power he spent a lifetime resisting, transforming his wisdom into a tool for domination rather than enlightenment.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c] is a Sith Healer who strengthens his allies by turning the enemy's greatest advantages against them. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Force Fisticuffs[-][/c], strikes twice, Dazes the target, and restores Health and Protection to Sith allies, with a chance to Stun enemies that were already Dazed. Meanwhile, [c][F0FF23]Consume, I Will[-][/c] damages all enemies, cleanses debuffs from Sith allies by transferring them to Yoda, then passes those debuffs to a target enemy before dispelling them from himself. Rather than relying on brute force, Yoda steadily erodes his opponents strength while reinforcing the resilience of his Sith companions.\n\nHis second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Hear Me, You Will[-][/c] empowers a chosen Sith ally with Dark Master's Training while shrouding Yoda in Stealth and reinforcing the entire team with sustained healing effects, further strengthening Sith allies as the battle unfolds. Meanwhile, his first Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Learn the Darkness, You Will[-][/c], grants Yoda Dark Master's Training at the start of battle and enhances all allies who receive it, allowing them to strip buffs with their Basic abilities, apply Buff Disruption with their Specials, recover Protection at the end of their turns, and take reduced damage from enemies attacking out of turn. His second Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]You are Weak... POWERLESS[-][/c], further bolsters Yoda's defenses while accelerating him whenever Sith allies are afflicted with debuffs, weakening enemy recovery, and sharing his growing Defense with the rest of the team as the battle progresses.\n\nWhile in Territory Battles, Yoda (Dark Side Vision) greatly increases the durability of Sith squads, allowing them to resist control effects, share Dark Master's Training more easily, and steadily overpower even the toughest enemies. Yoda (Dark Side Vision) will be required at 4 stars and Era Level 90 to unlock [b]Darth Jar Jar[/b] in the [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Yoda (Dark Side Vision)[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"A DARK REFLECTION"[-][/c] Marquee event and witness one of the Force's darkest possibilities brought to life on the Holotables!

EZRA_BRIDGER_EXILE_LIGHTSPEED_BUNDLE_INFO|[b]MERGE UNITS[/b]\n\nUnits included in the Lightspeed Bundle are upgraded according to a predetermined set of upgrade criteria (listed below). A unit at lower star rarity (or unactivated with less cumulative shards/blueprints) than the bundle upgrade criteria will be upgraded and activated. NEWSLETTER_STARKILLER_LUKE_CONCEPT_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c] steps out of legend and onto the Holotables!\n\nLong before Luke Skywalker became the hero audiences know today, the character was envisioned very differently during the earliest stages of Star Wars' development. Inspired by Ralph McQuarrie's iconic concept artwork, Starkiller (Luke Concept) celebrates one of the franchise's earliest creative ideas, paying tribute to the original surname and visual design that eventually evolved into Luke Skywalker. This unique interpretation offers a glimpse into a version of Star Wars that almost was.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c] is a Support who thrives alongside Commander Luke Skywalker, enhancing Rebel allies by amplifying their critical strikes and enabling powerful follow-up attacks. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Laser-Sword Strike[-][/c], strips away enemy buffs, while his first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Son of the Suns[-][/c] introduces the Shared Fate effect, allowing damage dealt to a single enemy to ripple across the opposing squad. Together with Commander Luke Skywalker, the pair create devastating opportunities to pressure multiple enemies at once.\n\nHis second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]The Grip of Tython[-][/c] disrupts the enemy team with Ability Block while reinforcing Rebel allies by dispelling debuffs and increasing their Offense through stacking bonuses. Meanwhile, his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Force of Others[-][/c] transforms Commander Luke Skywalker's Rebel squad into an even greater threat by rewarding critical hits, spreading Guard to additional allies, and creating new opportunities to control the flow of battle through Shared Fate.\n\nWhile in Grand Arenas, Starkiller (Luke Concept) further enhances Rebel teams by granting Rebel allies Defense Penetration on out-of-turn attacks, improving their survivability and maintaining pressure on enemies afflicted with Shared Fate. He is required at 4 stars for the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event to unlock [b]Darth Jar Jar[/b] and will be needed at 5 stars and Era Level 95 to promote Darth Jar Jar to 5 stars during the Era.\n\nUnlock [c][F0FF23]Starkiller (Luke Concept)[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"ANCIENT RECKONING"[-][/c] Marquee event and discover one of Star Wars' earliest visions brought to life on the Holotables!

NEWSLETTER_STORMTROOPER_CONCEPT_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c] steps out of Star Wars history and onto the Holotables!\n\nBased on Ralph McQuarrie's iconic early concept artwork, Stormtrooper (Concept) brings one of the original visions for the Empire's soldiers to life. Long before the familiar white armor and blaster rifles became synonymous with Imperial might, these early designs depicted armored enforcers wielding distinctive shields and laser-swords. As part of the Era of Myths & Legends, this classic concept joins Galaxy of Heroes as a tribute to the artwork that helped define the look and feel of Star Wars.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c] is a Tank built to stand at the front of Imperial Trooper squads, protecting allies while punishing enemies who dare attack him. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Enforcer's Blade[-][/c], grants him Defense Up and allows him to recover Health and Protection if he is buffed, while [c][F0FF23]Linebreaker[-][/c] Stuns the target enemy and bolsters the Imperial Trooper line with protective effects, while also opening windows for Attacker allies to capitalize and push the assault forward.\n\nHis Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Alderaan Prison Security[-][/c], turns Stormtrooper (Concept) into a relentless protector for Imperial Trooper squads. While he is Taunting, he becomes even harder to bring down and strikes back at anyone who tries to focus him. He also keeps his fellow Troopers safer, bolstering their defenses and stepping in to shield the first ally who begins to falter. In Grand Arenas, his presence becomes even more disruptive, helping the squad endure longer, punishing control effects by dispelling Daze and granting Turn Meter, and maintaining pressure by allowing allies to call another random ally to assist.\n\nStormtrooper (Concept) will be required at 4 stars to unlock Darth Jar Jar in the "TERRIBLE TINGS" Journey Guide event and at 7 stars and Era Level 125 to access the final tier of the event. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Stormtrooper (Concept)[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"BLADE AND BASTION"[-][/c] Marquee event and command one of Star Wars' earliest Imperial designs on the Holotables!

EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER01_ERA_DESC_V2|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Yoda (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Yoda confronts his darker half, a dark half that represents the path not taken. Does Yoda have the strength to stand up to this corruption, or will his willpower waver and fall in the face of overwhelming darkness?\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Grand Master Yoda shifts between [c][F0FF23]Peace[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Justice[-][/c], and [c][F0FF23]Guardian[-][/c] Stances at the start of each of his turns.\n- Each Stance can only be damaged by a specific attack. Watch Grand Master Yoda's current Stance carefully and choose your ability accordingly.\n- Using the wrong attack will trigger a powerful counterattack and inflict additional penalties.\n- If Yoda (Dark Side Vision) cannot use the correct attack, consider using [c][F0FF23]Bide[-][/c] to recover Health and inflict the enemy with Healing Immuity before passing the turn. Be aware that using Bide will also Stun Yoda (Dark Side Vision), so use it when the tradeoff is worthwhile.\n- Success depends on matching the correct ability to each Stance, managing cooldowns efficiently.
EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER02_ERA_DESC_V2|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept) (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Stormtroopers have breached the hull of the Rebel blockade runner, causing the atmosphere to quickly escape. Our hero, Starkiller (Luke Concept), has donned a breath mask and faces off against the lightsaber and shield wielding Stormtroopers in an effort to escape the clutches of the Empire.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- At the start of each Stormtrooper (Concept)'s turn, [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] is reduced for each buff that Stormtrooper has.\n- If [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] reaches 0%, the battle will end in defeat. Carefully manage enemy buffs to slow the loss of Air Supply.\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can ignore [c][F0FF23]Taunt[-][/c], allowing him to target priority enemies regardless of active tanks.\n- Pay close attention to the [c][F0FF23]TURN METER[-][/c] of each Stormtrooper (Concept) and decide which enemies need to be targeted before they take their turns.\n- Starkiller (Luke Concept) can also inflict [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] as if Commander Luke Skywalker were in the leader slot, allowing damage dealt to spread rapidly across the enemy team.\n- Proper timing of [c][F0FF23]Shared Fate[-][/c] and buff control will be key to preserving your [c][F0FF23]Air Supply[-][/c] and defeating all enemies!
EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER03_ERA_DESC_V2|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Mara Jade Skywalker (EL: 130)\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n-In a throne room on Mount Tantiss, Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker face off against a clone of Luke made from the hand he lost on Cloud City. Mara Jade still hears the echoing last command from the Emperor,"Kill Luke Skywalker", a command she has thus far resisted...\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Luuke Skywalker can only take damage while afflicted with 2 or more of the following debuffs:[c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Defense Down[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stagger[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stun[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Vulnerable[-][/c].\n- Use Mara Jade Skywalker and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker's abilities carefully to stack the required debuffs on Luuke Skywalker before attempting to attack him.\n- Pay close attention to which debuffs are currently active on Luuke Skywalker and plan your turns accordingly.\n- Timing and debuff management are the key to victory, keep Luuke Skywalker controlled long enough for Mara Jade Skywalker to strike the decisive blow!
EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER03_ERA_DESC_V3|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Mara Jade Skywalker (EL: 130)\n- Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- In a throne room on Mount Tantiss, Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker face off against a clone of Luke made from the hand he lost on Cloud City. Mara Jade still hears the echoing last command from the Emperor,"Kill Luke Skywalker", a command she has thus far resisted...\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- Luuke Skywalker can only take damage while afflicted with 2 or more of the following debuffs:[c][F0FF23]Blind[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Defense Down[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stagger[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Stun[-][/c], [c][F0FF23]Vulnerable[-][/c].\n- Use Mara Jade Skywalker and Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker's abilities carefully to stack the required debuffs on Luuke Skywalker before attempting to attack him.\n- Pay close attention to which debuffs are currently active on Luuke Skywalker and plan your turns accordingly.\n- Keep Luuke Skywalker controlled long enough to strike the decisive blow!\n- If Mara Jade Skywalker or Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker are defeated the battle will end in defeat.
EVENT_MEESALESS_MASSACRE_TIER04_ERA_DESC_V2|[c][ACFEFF][c][23C8F5]Victory Counts:[-][/c]\n- Unlimited (1x rewards only)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Borrowed:[-][/c]\n- Darth Jar Jar (EL: 130)\n- Rey (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)\n- Yoda (Dark Side Vision) (EL: 130)\n\n[c][23C8F5]Lore:[-][/c]\n- Shuffling off the disguise of a goofy sidekick, Darth Jar Jar takes the reigns as the dark mastermind in a universe that reimagines characters from across a rebuilt galaxy.\n\n[c][23C8F5]Strategy Tips:[-][/c]\n- In order to defeat each enemy, they must be affected by a specific debuff. Jaxxon must have [c][F0FF23]Massively Overpowered[-][/c] , Viper must have [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c], and Cal Kestis has to be [c][F0FF23]Manipulated[-][/c] when they are defeated.\n- Defeating an enemy without their required debuff will cause them to revive.\n- One of the biggest challenges will be applying [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c] to Viper. Wait for Viper to inflict [c][F0FF23]Target Lock[-][/c], then use Yoda (Dark Side Vision) to transfer or spread the debuff back onto Viper before finishing her off.\n- Jaxxon will receive [c][F0FF23]Massively Overpowered[-][/c] when Darth Jar Jar, Rey (Dark Side Vision) and Yoda (Dark Side Vision) have [c][F0FF23]Dark Master's Training[-][/c].\n- If Darth Jar Jar, Rey (Dark Side Vision) or Yoda (Dark Side Vision) are defeated, the battle will end in defeat.

NEWSLETTER_DARTH_JAR_JAR_EVENT_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c] is coming to the Holotables!\n\nOne of Star Wars' most unexpected alternate visions finally arrives in Galaxy of Heroes. A long-hidden Sith identity revealed, Darth Jar Jar transforms the galaxy's most underestimated Gungan into a calculating master of manipulation. Behind every clumsy stumble lies careful planning, every accident conceals intent, and every move brings his enemies one step closer to defeat.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c] is a Sith Leader who doesn't simply command the battlefield; he quietly reshapes it around his enemies. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Mesa Going to Hurt Yousa[-][/c] weakens the opposition with Shock and Tenacity Down while strengthening Sith allies, but his true plan begins with [c][F0FF23]Yousa People Gonna Die[-][/c]. By Manipulating a chosen enemy, Darth Jar Jar turns them into an unwitting pawn, using their own actions to spread chaos throughout the opposing squad. Before his enemies realize they're playing into his hands, the battle has already begun to unravel.\n\nThat deception reaches its peak through [c][F0FF23]Letten the Haten Flow[-][/c], where Darth Jar Jar Siphons Max Protection from his opponents to empower his Sith allies, transforming the enemy's greatest advantages into his own. His Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]The Phantom Menace[-][/c], and Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Da Force Shall Freein Mesa[-][/c] reward careful planning rather than reckless aggression, orchestrating a web of Marks and Manipulation to unleash carefully timed counter plays. Whether empowering Darth Sidious, directing Darth Maul toward priority targets, or baiting enemies into costly mistakes, Darth Jar Jar ensures every Sith ally plays their part in his grand design.\n\nWhile in Grand Arenas, Darth Jar Jar's schemes become even more oppressive as his Manipulated victims fuel the strength of the entire Sith squad while attempts to control his allies are swiftly turned back on their attackers. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Darth Jar Jar[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event and discover what happens when the galaxy's greatest fool reveals himself to be its greatest threat.
NEWSLETTER_DARTH_JAR_JAR_EVENT_TITLE|Mesa Behind It All
NEWSLETTER_EMBO_KEIBU_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Embo & Keibu[-][/c] are coming to the Holotables!\n\nDecades after making a name for himself as one of the galaxy's most formidable bounty hunters during the Clone Wars, Embo remained on the hunt. Taken directly from The Mandalorian and Grogu, this version of the renowned Kyuzo bounty hunter unites him with his loyal anooba companion, Keibu. Older, experienced, and no less dangerous, the pair brings a lifetime spent pursuing the galaxy's most elusive quarry to Galaxy of Heroes.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Embo & Keibu[-][/c] lead a Bounty Hunter Mercenary squad that turns bonus turns into a deadly game of pursuit. Their Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Anooba Ambush[-][/c], inflicts the target with Bleed while feeding Turn Meter back to Embo & Keibu, and their first Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Kyuzo Hat Trick[-][/c], gives Embo & Keibu the tools to crack Tanks or punch through less durable opponents. With a full Bounty Hunter Mercenary squad, these attacks can hand bonus turns directly to Embo & Keibu's fellow hunters, letting the right Mercenary leap into action exactly when they're needed.\n\nTheir second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Flush Out the Quarry[-][/c], is where the hunt truly begins. Embo & Keibu can take an enemy Captive while marking another for Ambush, setting the stage for their Leader ability, [c][F0FF23]Business Is Business[-][/c], to turn the enemy's actions against them. While Embo & Keibu hold an enemy Captive, enemy buffs, dispels, and out-of-turn attacks build Ransom. Collect enough before Embo & Keibu's next turn and the Captive is released and left Exposed. Come up short, and the quarry is Tortured for the rest of the encounter. Meanwhile, every bonus turn taken by Embo & Keibu's crew becomes increasingly dangerous, reducing cooldowns, Stunning targets, and adding additional attacks as the hunt continues.\n\nCompleting Embo & Keibu's Contract unlocks the granted ability, [c][F0FF23]Smoke and Shadow[-][/c], giving the pair a chance to disappear from sight, tend to an injured ally, and leave enemies who attacked their crew with reduced Offense. Their Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Soldier of Fortune[-][/c], gives Embo & Keibu another resource to exploit as enemy buffs are stripped away, providing additional Offense for Bounty Hunter Mercenary allies while allowing Embo & Keibu to trade accumulated stacks for Protection recovery and greater Critical Damage.\n\nAs a Conquest character, Embo & Keibu bring a new Leader to the Bounty Hunter Mercenary squad with tools for Grand Arenas, Territory Battles, and Territory Wars. Choose your quarry, collect your Ransom, and make sure the galaxy remembers the most important rule of bounty hunting: business is business.
NEWSLETTER_EMBO_KEIBU_TITLE|No Country for Old Bounty Hunters
NEWSLETTER_JAXXON_DESC|Hi Holotable Heroes,\n\n[c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c] is bounding his way onto the Holotables!\n\nFirst appearing in Marvel's original Star Wars comics, Jaxxon is one of the galaxy's most memorable rogues. The green Lepi adventurer earned a reputation for quick reflexes, quicker wit, and an uncanny knack for finding trouble alongside Lando Calrissian and his fellow Scoundrels. Decades later, this fan-favorite Legends character finally bounds into Galaxy of Heroes, bringing his trademark charm—and plenty of firepower—with him.\n\n[c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c] is an Attacker who keeps Scoundrel squads moving with rapid-fire attacks and strong Prepared synergies. His Basic ability, [c][F0FF23]Blaster's Up, Doc[-][/c], rewards Prepared allies by giving them Turn Meter, while [c][F0FF23]Hop 'Til You Drop[-][/c] throws key enemies Off Balance before they have a chance to respond. Whether darting around the battlefield or opening the door for his allies, Jaxxon thrives in the middle of the action.\n\nHis second Special ability, [c][F0FF23]Fluffle Shuffle[-][/c] delivers a burst of damage that becomes even more dangerous when his allies have Prepared. Meanwhile, his Unique ability, [c][F0FF23]Starship Down[-][/c] celebrates Jaxxon's long-standing friendship with Lando Calrissian, rewarding the duo with powerful bonuses while reinforcing the entire Scoundrel squad. Even when the odds catch up to him, Jaxxon has one more trick up his sleeve, slipping away into Stealth before jumping right back into the fight.\n\nWhile in Territory Battles, Jaxxon turns Scoundrel squads into an even greater force through enhanced Prepared synergies, increased survivability, and explosive opening turns that keep opponents on the back foot.\n\nJaxxon will be required at 4 stars to unlock [b]Darth Jar Jar[/b] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"TERRIBLE TINGS"[-][/c] Journey Guide event and at 7 stars and Era Level 125 to access the final tier of the event. Unlock [c][F0FF23]Jaxxon[-][/c] in the upcoming [c][F0FF23]"ACTION JAXXON"[-][/c] Marquee event and welcome one of the most unexpected heroes from Star Wars Legends to your Scoundrel roster!
NEWSLETTER_JAXXON_TITLE|The Fast and the Furriest
